candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) ; True iff the observation is the last day / end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower (applicability of 6.10(a) and 6.10(b))
  (indebtedness_principal Real) ; Aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries as of the test day, excluding Indebtedness of the type in clause (i)(D) of the definition of Indebtedness
  (cash_investments Real) ; Aggregate amount of Cash Investments as of the test day, subtracted from the Indebtedness amount
  (annualized_combined_case_revenues Real) ; Annualized Combined Case Revenues for the fiscal quarter; the covenant denominator is this value times two
  (dedicated_customers Real) ; Number of Dedicated Customers at the end of the fiscal quarter
  (is_period_mar_31_1998 Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on March 31, 1998 (minimum $17,000,000)
  (is_period_jun_30_1998 Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on June 30, 1998 (minimum $20,000,000)
  (is_period_sep_30_1998 Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on September 30, 1998 (minimum $22,000,000)
  (is_period_dec_31_1998 Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on December 31, 1998 (minimum $26,000,000)
  (is_period_mar_30_1999 Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on March 30, 1999, as dated in the source (minimum $29,000,000)
  (is_period_jun_30_1999 Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on June 30, 1999 (minimum $32,000,000)
  (is_period_sep_30_1999_or_later Bool) ; True iff the fiscal quarter ends on September 30, 1999 or any later date (minimum $36,000,000)
  (combined_case_revenues Real) ; Combined Case Revenues for the fiscal quarter, in dollars
  (excluded_fees Real) ; Aggregate amount of Excluded Fees for the fiscal quarter, in dollars, subtracted from Combined Case Revenues
) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.10(a): (Indebtedness - Cash Investments) / (Annualized Combined Case Revenues * 2) must not be greater than 2.35
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (<= (/ (- indebtedness_principal cash_investments)
               (* 2.0 annualized_combined_case_revenues))
            2.35))
    ; 6.10(b): Dedicated Customers must not be less than 7,000
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= dedicated_customers 7000.0))
    ; 6.10(c): Combined Case Revenues minus Excluded Fees must not be less than the scheduled amount
    (=> is_period_mar_31_1998 (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 17000000.0))
    (=> is_period_jun_30_1998 (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 20000000.0))
    (=> is_period_sep_30_1998 (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 22000000.0))
    (=> is_period_dec_31_1998 (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 26000000.0))
    (=> is_period_mar_30_1999 (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 29000000.0))
    (=> is_period_jun_30_1999 (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 32000000.0))
    (=> is_period_sep_30_1999_or_later (>= (- combined_case_revenues excluded_fees) 36000000.0))
  )
)

; any_note_unpaid: True iff at this observation any Note remains unpaid.

(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (any_note_unpaid Bool)
    (any_bank_commitment Bool)
    (consolidated_debt Real)
    (ctnw_before_exclusions Real)
    (investments_in_joint_ventures Real)
    (investments_in_non_guarantor_subsidiaries Real)
    (interest_coverage_ratio Real)) Bool

      (<= (/ consolidated_debt
             (- ctnw_before_exclusions
                investments_in_joint_ventures
                investments_in_non_guarantor_subsidiaries))

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_LRA)
; secured_leverage_ratio: Secured Leverage Ratio of Parent for the Test Period being observed, as an atomic ratio (e.g. 3.00 means 3.00:1.00).
; interest_coverage_ratio: Interest Coverage Ratio of Parent for the Test Period being observed, as an atomic ratio (e.g. 3.50 means 3.50:1.00).
; test_period_ends_on_or_after_2015_09_30: true iff the observed Test Period ends on or after September 30, 2015, the first Test Period to which Section 7.10(a) and (b) apply.
; holiday_written_notice_given: true iff Parent gave written notice to the Administrative Agent electing the Secured Leverage Holiday for the Relevant Acquisition relevant to this observation.
; holiday_acquisition_consideration_usd: aggregate consideration, in US dollars, paid by Parent and its Restricted Subsidiaries for the Permitted Acquisition relevant to this observation.
; holiday_acquisition_is_permitted_acquisition: true iff the acquisition relevant to this observation is a Permitted Acquisition.
; holiday_use_count: number of Secured Leverage Holidays elected between the Closing Date and the Maturity Date, counting the holiday relevant to this observation. If no holiday is relevant, supply 0.
; test_period_in_holiday_350_stage: true iff the observed Test Period is the current period for testing a Relevant Acquisition, or one of the next two Test Periods following the closing date of that acquisition.
; test_period_in_holiday_325_stage: true iff the observed Test Period is one of the next two succeeding Test Periods (the third and fourth after the closing date) after the 3.50 stage of that acquisition.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (secured_leverage_ratio Real)
    (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
    (test_period_ends_on_or_after_2015_09_30 Bool)
    (holiday_written_notice_given Bool)
    (holiday_acquisition_consideration_usd Real)
    (holiday_acquisition_is_permitted_acquisition Bool)
    (holiday_use_count Real)
    (test_period_in_holiday_350_stage Bool)
    (test_period_in_holiday_325_stage Bool)) Bool
  (let ((holiday_valid (and holiday_written_notice_given
                            holiday_acquisition_is_permitted_acquisition
                            (> holiday_acquisition_consideration_usd 250000000.0)
                            (<= holiday_use_count 2.0))))
    (let ((max_secured_leverage
           (ite (and holiday_valid test_period_in_holiday_350_stage) 3.5
                (ite (and holiday_valid test_period_in_holiday_325_stage) 3.25 3.0))))
      (=> test_period_ends_on_or_after_2015_09_30
          (and (<= secured_leverage_ratio max_secured_leverage)
               (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.5))))))

candidate.notes: Both covenants are encoded pointwise for each Test Period, gated by the September 30, 2015 start. The Secured Leverage maximum is 3.00 by default. It becomes 3.50 or 3.25 only when the holiday is valid (written notice, Permitted Acquisition, consideration above $250,000,000, at most two uses) and the period falls in the corresponding stage. After the first four Test Periods the maximum returns to 3.00. Interest Coverage must be at least 3.50, so exactly 3.50 complies. Secured Leverage must be at most the applicable maximum, so exactly the maximum complies. The source says 'Material Acquisition' in one place and 'Relevant Acquisition' elsewhere; these are treated as the same defined term. If several holidays overlap, the stage flags are assumed to be supplied for the applicable holiday. The 'current period' testing under the Permitted Acquisition definition is folded into the 3.50-stage flag because that definition is not supplied. Ratio definitions are not supplied, so both ratios are atomic inputs.

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; closing_date_has_occurred: true iff the observation time is from and after the Closing Date.

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (closing_date_has_occurred Bool)
  (commitment_in_effect Bool)
  (note_outstanding_unpaid Bool)
  (other_amount_owing Bool)
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)

  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
  (net_loss_current_quarter Bool)
  (net_loss_prior_quarter Bool)
  (na_pali_commitments_and_indebtedness Real)
) Bool
  (=> (and closing_date_has_occurred
           (or commitment_in_effect note_outstanding_unpaid other_amount_owing letter_of_credit_outstanding))
      (and
        (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= leverage_ratio 2.0))
        (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.25))
        (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (not (and net_loss_current_quarter net_loss_prior_quarter)))
        (<= na_pali_commitments_and_indebtedness 105000000.0))))

issues: The Transportation revenue input is defined as covering 'the same 12-month period as the Transportation Business capex test'. Section 7.4(D)(ii) states no period for that revenue, so this adds a period the source does not give. Clause (i) uses 'immediately preceding twelve months' for the other revenue, so the two revenue periods are treated inconsistently.

The non_transportation_revenue_prior_12m comment says 'the immediately preceding twelve months' without saying what it precedes (the observation date or the capex measurement window). The parameter meaning is therefore ambiguous, and the clause (i) threshold depends on which reading applies.

The capex input descriptions omit the source rule in 7.4(D) that Capital Expenditures of all Subsidiaries for the 12-month period are included, even if incurred before the entity became a Subsidiary. The formula cannot enforce this, so the comments must state it, and they do not.

The ICR and leverage tests, the net worth test and the capex tests are well structured pointwise, with sensible tier flags and non-strict or strict comparisons matching the source. The defects above are in parameter definitions, not in the formula's arithmetic.

issues: Annual clause: the obligation is gated on days_since_fiscal_year_end > 90, but the 'delivered within 90 days' flags are inputs that already encode the deadline compliance. The formula therefore never checks the delivery against the deadline and is circular. Delivery on day 100 would be reported as 'within 90 days' only if the input says so, and the formula hides the substance of the obligation in the flags.

Clause (d) accountants' statement is required only when annual statements are delivered, and clause (c) certificate is required with each set of statements. The candidate captures (c) and (d) as 'delivered simultaneously' but does not check the content: the (c) certificate must also be delivered for the annual set, and the (d) accountants' statement must include the Default belief and confirmation of calculations. This is only a coarse approximation.

Quarterly clause: for quarters 1–3 the (b) deadline applies. The formula does not cover the fourth-quarter case, which is correct, but the quarter-end flags and the days counter are not tied to a specific quarter instance. The days_since_quarter_end counter may refer to the most recent quarter while the fiscal year-end annual obligations also apply. At the year-end boundary the semantics are ambiguous.

Clause (e): the formula is gated on days_since_officer_knowledge_of_default > 5, but the certificate flag 'delivered within 5 days' is an input that already encodes compliance. If the Default stops continuing before day 5, no obligation applies, and the 'if such Default is then continuing' condition is evaluated at the observation rather than at the day-5 deadline, so the condition is mis-scoped.
The remaining clauses (f), (g), (h), (i), (j) are omitted without justification, and no scoping rationale is given. This makes the decomposition incomplete relative to the covenant as stated.

Parameter comments are vague in places. For example, 'delivered ... simultaneously' does not specify what it is simultaneous with beyond naming the statements, and the Default-knowledge meaning is under-specified because the flag combines knowledge and continuation.
judge.reason: The candidate encodes deadline compliance as opaque Boolean inputs, which are guarded by elapsed-day comparisons, so the key timing obligation is not computed in the formula. Clause (e) is mis-scoped relative to 'if such Default is then continuing', and clauses (f)–(j) are omitted. The formalization is therefore neither faithful nor complete.

; is_test_jun_30_1994: True iff the observation date is June 30, 1994, with period values measured for the two consecutive fiscal quarters then ended.

; working_capital_reserve: The Borrower's Working Capital Reserve at the start of the test period.
; cash_and_cash_equivalents: Cash and Cash Equivalents of the Borrower and the Consolidated Subsidiaries at the start of the test period.
; readily_marketable_securities: Readily Marketable Securities of the Borrower and the Consolidated Subsidiaries at the start of the test period, valued at cost, or at fair value if cost is materially different from fair value.
; amounts_payable_affiliated_funds: Amounts Payable to Affiliated Funds for Share Purchases at the start of the test period.
; receivables_from_brokers: Receivables from Brokers for Sale of Fund Shares at the start of the test period.
; first_day_before_revolving_maturity: True iff the first day of the test period is prior to the Revolving Credit Loan Maturity Date.
; total_commitment: Total Commitment at the first day of the test period (or the Closing Date, if later).
; revolving_loans_outstanding: Aggregate amount of Revolving Credit Loans outstanding at the first day of the test period (or the Closing Date, if later).
; net_unit_sale_proceeds: Aggregate cash proceeds to the Borrower from the issue and sale of Units and exercises of options to buy Units, net of selling commissions and offering expenses, for the test period.
; consolidated_fixed_charges: Consolidated Fixed Charges for the test period, as defined in Section 9.1(c) (atomic Real; definition not supplied).
; mandatory_principal_installments: Mandatory installments of principal required to be paid during the test period on all Funded Debt of the Borrower and the Consolidated Subsidiaries, excluding scheduled installments already included in Consolidated Fixed Charges.
; mandatory_capitalized_lease_payments: Mandatory payments required to be paid during the test period under any Capitalized Leases, excluding rental payments and other scheduled installments included in Consolidated Fixed Charges.
; voluntary_prepayments_funded_debt: Voluntary prepayments of principal of Funded Debt made during the test period, excluding payments under Section 3.3 in respect of the Revolving Credit Loans.
; distributions_paid: Distributions paid during the test period by the Borrower, or by a Consolidated Subsidiary to a Person other than the Borrower or a Consolidated Subsidiary.
; acquisition_cash_payments: Cash payments during the test period by the Borrower and its Consolidated Subsidiaries in respect of Acquisitions, including net purchase price, deferred purchase price installments and interest, brokers and finders fees, and other out-of-pocket expenses.
(define-fun covenant_holds (

  (is_test_jun_30_1994 Bool)
  (is_test_sep_30_1994 Bool)
  (is_test_quarter_end_after_sep_1994 Bool)
  (consolidated_adjusted_cash_flow Real)
  (working_capital_reserve Real)
  (cash_and_cash_equivalents Real)
  (readily_marketable_securities Real)
  (amounts_payable_affiliated_funds Real)
  (receivables_from_brokers Real)
  (first_day_before_revolving_maturity Bool)
  (total_commitment Real)
  (revolving_loans_outstanding Real)
  (net_unit_sale_proceeds Real)
  (consolidated_fixed_charges Real)
  (mandatory_principal_installments Real)
  (mandatory_capitalized_lease_payments Real)
  (voluntary_prepayments_funded_debt Real)
  (distributions_paid Real)
  (acquisition_cash_payments Real)
) Bool
  (=> (or is_test_mar_31_1994 is_test_jun_30_1994 is_test_sep_30_1994 is_test_quarter_end_after_sep_1994)

                        working_capital_reserve
                        (+ cash_and_cash_equivalents readily_marketable_securities))
                   (ite (> amounts_payable_affiliated_funds receivables_from_brokers)
                        (- amounts_payable_affiliated_funds receivables_from_brokers)
                        0.0))
                (ite first_day_before_revolving_maturity (- total_commitment revolving_loans_outstanding) 0.0)
                net_unit_sale_proceeds)

                mandatory_principal_installments
                mandatory_capitalized_lease_payments
                voluntary_prepayments_funded_debt
                distributions_paid
                acquisition_cash_payments))
          1.0)))

issues: The compliance test (/ total_liabilities tangible_net_worth) <= 4.0 treats any negative tangible net worth as compliant, because the quotient is negative and so is at most 4.0. A borrower with positive liabilities and negative tangible net worth has a leverage far above 4.0 to 1.0 and would be in breach. {
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitment_loan_or_lc_outstanding Bool) ; True if any Commitment, Loan or L/C Liability is outstanding at the observation
  (amounts_payable_not_paid_in_full Bool) ; True if amounts payable by Borrower under the agreement have not yet been paid in full at the observation
  (is_test_date Bool) ; True if the observation date is a Test Date (as defined in the agreement)
  (total_leverage_ratio Real) ; Total Leverage Ratio as of the Test Date (atomic input; definition not supplied)
  (lev_p1_9_30_99_to_3_30_00 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/99 to 3/30/00
  (lev_p2_3_31_00_to_9_29_00 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 3/31/00 to 9/29/00
  (lev_p3_9_30_00_to_12_30_01 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/00 to 12/30/01
  (lev_p4_12_31_01_to_12_30_02 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/01 to 12/30/02
  (lev_p5_12_31_02_to_12_30_03 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/02 to 12/30/03
  (lev_p6_12_31_03_onward Bool) ; True if the observation date falls on or after 12/31/03
  (interest_coverage_ratio Real) ; Interest Coverage Ratio as of the Test Date (atomic input; definition not supplied)
  (icr_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_00 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/99 to 12/30/00
  (icr_p2_12_31_00_to_12_30_01 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/00 to 12/30/01
  (icr_p3_12_31_01_to_12_30_02 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/01 to 12/30/02
  (icr_p4_12_31_02_onward Bool) ; True if the observation date falls on or after 12/31/02
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the Test Date (atomic input; definition not supplied)
  (fcc_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_01 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/99 to 12/30/01
  (fcc_p2_12_31_01_to_12_30_02 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/01 to 12/30/02
  (fcc_p3_12_31_02_to_12_30_03 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/02 to 12/30/03
  (fcc_p4_12_31_03_to_12_30_04 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/03 to 12/30/04
  (fcc_p5_12_31_04_to_12_30_05 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/04 to 12/30/05
  (fcc_p6_12_31_05_onward Bool) ; True if the observation date falls on or after 12/31/05
  (net_worth Real) ; Borrower's Net Worth at the Test Date, in dollars
  (closing_net_worth_after_sbcl Real) ; Borrower's Net Worth at the Closing Date after giving effect to the SBCL Acquisition, in dollars
  (adjusted_net_income_sum Real) ; Sum of Adjusted Net Income for each fiscal quarter beginning with the first fiscal quarter after the Closing Date, without reduction for losses (loss quarters count as zero), in dollars
  (equity_proceeds_sum Real) ; Equity Proceeds received by Borrower after the Closing Date from each Equity Issuance, summed, in dollars
  (moodys_at_least_baa3 Bool) ; True if Borrower's unsecured senior long term debt is rated Baa3 (or the equivalent) or higher by Moody's at the Test Date
  (sp_at_least_bbb_minus Bool) ; True if Borrower's unsecured senior long term debt is rated BBB- (or the equivalent) or higher by S&P at the Test Date
  (capex_in_period Real) ; Aggregate Capital Expenditures made by the Companies in the capex period being measured, in dollars
  (capex_prior_shortfall Real) ; Shortfall carried from the immediately preceding capex period: permitted amount for that period minus its aggregate Capital Expenditures when positive, else 0; 0 for the first period, in dollars
  (permitted_acq_ebitda_sum Real) ; Sum of the positive most recent trailing four quarter EBITDA of each Permitted Acquisition consummated by any Qualified Company during the measured period (nonpositive amounts count as 0), in dollars
  (cx_p1_effective_date_to_6_30_2000 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period Effective Date to 6/30/2000
  (cx_p2_7_1_2000_to_12_31_2000 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 7/1/2000 to 12/31/2000
  (cx_p3_2001 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2001 to 12/31/2001
  (cx_p4_2002 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2002 to 12/31/2002
  (cx_p5_2003 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2003 to 12/31/2003
  (cx_p6_2004 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2004 to 12/31/2004
  (cx_p7_2005 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2005 to 12/31/2005
  (cx_p8_2006 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2006 to 12/31/2006
  (cx_p9_2007 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2007 to 12/31/2007
  (lease_payments_fiscal_year Real) ; Aggregate GAAP lease payments by Companies on a consolidated basis under agreements to rent or lease any Property, including extensions or renewals and property taxes paid as additional rent, excluding Capital Leases and lease payments in connection with Sale and Leaseback Transactions permitted by Section 9.06, for the fiscal year, in dollars
  (is_fiscal_year_lease_measurement Bool) ; True if the observation measures lease payments for a full fiscal year
  (fiscal_year_1999_or_later Bool) ; True if the fiscal year measured is fiscal 1999 or later
) Bool
  (=> (and commitment_loan_or_lc_outstanding amounts_payable_not_paid_in_full)
    (and
      ; (a) maximum Total Leverage Ratio
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p1_9_30_99_to_3_30_00) (<= total_leverage_ratio 5.00))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p2_3_31_00_to_9_29_00) (<= total_leverage_ratio 4.75))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p3_9_30_00_to_12_30_01) (<= total_leverage_ratio 4.50))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p4_12_31_01_to_12_30_02) (<= total_leverage_ratio 3.75))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p5_12_31_02_to_12_30_03) (<= total_leverage_ratio 3.00))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p6_12_31_03_onward) (<= total_leverage_ratio 2.50))
      ; (b) minimum Interest Coverage Ratio
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_00) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.25))
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p2_12_31_00_to_12_30_01) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.50))
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p3_12_31_01_to_12_30_02) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.00))
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p4_12_31_02_onward) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.50))
      ; (c) minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_01) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.10))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p2_12_31_01_to_12_30_02) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.15))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p3_12_31_02_to_12_30_03) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.20))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p4_12_31_03_to_12_30_04) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.20))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p5_12_31_04_to_12_30_05) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.20))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p6_12_31_05_onward) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.00))
      ; (d) minimum Net Worth, waived at a Test Date if rated at least Baa3 by Moody's AND at least BBB- by S&P
      (=> is_test_date
        (or (and moodys_at_least_baa3 sp_at_least_bbb_minus)
            (>= net_worth (+ (* 0.85 closing_net_worth_after_sbcl)
                             (* 0.75 adjusted_net_income_sum)
                             (* 0.75 equity_proceeds_sum)))))
      ; (e) capex limit = base + usable carryover (shortfall capped at 25% of base, 45% in period 2) + 20% of acquisition EBITDA
      (=> cx_p1_effective_date_to_6_30_2000
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 135000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p2_7_1_2000_to_12_31_2000
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 55000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 24750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 24750000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p3_2001
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 110000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p4_2002
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 110000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p5_2003
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 115000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 28750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 28750000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p6_2004

          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0)))))
      ; (f) operating lease payments cap per fiscal year
      (=> (and is_fiscal_year_lease_measurement fiscal_year_1999_or_later)

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitment_loan_or_lc_outstanding Bool) ; True if any Commitment, Loan or L/C Liability is outstanding at the observation
  (amounts_payable_not_paid_in_full Bool) ; True if amounts payable by Borrower under the agreement have not yet been paid in full at the observation
  (is_test_date Bool) ; True if the observation date is a Test Date (as defined in the agreement)
  (total_leverage_ratio Real) ; Total Leverage Ratio as of the Test Date (atomic input; definition not supplied)
  (lev_p1_9_30_99_to_3_30_00 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/99 to 3/30/00
  (lev_p2_3_31_00_to_9_29_00 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 3/31/00 to 9/29/00
  (lev_p3_9_30_00_to_12_30_01 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/00 to 12/30/01
  (lev_p4_12_31_01_to_12_30_02 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/01 to 12/30/02
  (lev_p5_12_31_02_to_12_30_03 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/02 to 12/30/03
  (lev_p6_12_31_03_onward Bool) ; True if the observation date falls on or after 12/31/03
  (interest_coverage_ratio Real) ; Interest Coverage Ratio as of the Test Date (atomic input; definition not supplied)
  (icr_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_00 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/99 to 12/30/00
  (icr_p2_12_31_00_to_12_30_01 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/00 to 12/30/01
  (icr_p3_12_31_01_to_12_30_02 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/01 to 12/30/02
  (icr_p4_12_31_02_onward Bool) ; True if the observation date falls on or after 12/31/02
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the Test Date (atomic input; definition not supplied)
  (fcc_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_01 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 9/30/99 to 12/30/01
  (fcc_p2_12_31_01_to_12_30_02 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/01 to 12/30/02
  (fcc_p3_12_31_02_to_12_30_03 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/02 to 12/30/03
  (fcc_p4_12_31_03_to_12_30_04 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/03 to 12/30/04
  (fcc_p5_12_31_04_to_12_30_05 Bool) ; True if the observation date falls in 12/31/04 to 12/30/05
  (fcc_p6_12_31_05_onward Bool) ; True if the observation date falls on or after 12/31/05
  (net_worth Real) ; Borrower's Net Worth at the Test Date, in dollars
  (closing_net_worth_after_sbcl Real) ; Borrower's Net Worth at the Closing Date after giving effect to the SBCL Acquisition, in dollars
  (adjusted_net_income_sum Real) ; Sum of Adjusted Net Income for each fiscal quarter beginning with the first fiscal quarter after the Closing Date, without reduction for losses (loss quarters count as zero), in dollars
  (equity_proceeds_sum Real) ; Equity Proceeds received by Borrower after the Closing Date from each Equity Issuance, summed, in dollars
  (moodys_at_least_baa3 Bool) ; True if Borrower's unsecured senior long term debt is rated Baa3 (or the equivalent) or higher by Moody's at the Test Date
  (sp_at_least_bbb_minus Bool) ; True if Borrower's unsecured senior long term debt is rated BBB- (or the equivalent) or higher by S&P at the Test Date
  (capex_in_period Real) ; Aggregate Capital Expenditures made by the Companies in the capex period being measured, in dollars
  (capex_prior_shortfall Real) ; Shortfall carried from the immediately preceding capex period: permitted amount for that period minus its aggregate Capital Expenditures when positive, else 0; 0 for the first period, in dollars
  (permitted_acq_ebitda_sum Real) ; Sum of the positive most recent trailing four quarter EBITDA of each Permitted Acquisition consummated by any Qualified Company during the measured period (nonpositive amounts count as 0), in dollars
  (cx_p1_effective_date_to_6_30_2000 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period Effective Date to 6/30/2000
  (cx_p2_7_1_2000_to_12_31_2000 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 7/1/2000 to 12/31/2000
  (cx_p3_2001 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2001 to 12/31/2001
  (cx_p4_2002 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2002 to 12/31/2002
  (cx_p5_2003 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2003 to 12/31/2003
  (cx_p6_2004 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2004 to 12/31/2004
  (cx_p7_2005 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2005 to 12/31/2005
  (cx_p8_2006 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2006 to 12/31/2006
  (cx_p9_2007 Bool) ; True if the observation measures the capex period 1/1/2007 to 12/31/2007
  (lease_payments_fiscal_year Real) ; Aggregate GAAP lease payments by Companies on a consolidated basis under agreements to rent or lease any Property, including extensions or renewals and property taxes paid as additional rent, excluding Capital Leases and lease payments in connection with Sale and Leaseback Transactions permitted by Section 9.06, for the fiscal year, in dollars
  (is_fiscal_year_lease_measurement Bool) ; True if the observation measures lease payments for a full fiscal year
  (fiscal_year_1999_or_later Bool) ; True if the fiscal year measured is fiscal 1999 or later
) Bool
  (=> (and commitment_loan_or_lc_outstanding amounts_payable_not_paid_in_full)
    (and
      ; (a) maximum Total Leverage Ratio
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p1_9_30_99_to_3_30_00) (<= total_leverage_ratio 5.00))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p2_3_31_00_to_9_29_00) (<= total_leverage_ratio 4.75))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p3_9_30_00_to_12_30_01) (<= total_leverage_ratio 4.50))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p4_12_31_01_to_12_30_02) (<= total_leverage_ratio 3.75))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p5_12_31_02_to_12_30_03) (<= total_leverage_ratio 3.00))
      (=> (and is_test_date lev_p6_12_31_03_onward) (<= total_leverage_ratio 2.50))
      ; (b) minimum Interest Coverage Ratio
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_00) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.25))
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p2_12_31_00_to_12_30_01) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.50))
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p3_12_31_01_to_12_30_02) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.00))
      (=> (and is_test_date icr_p4_12_31_02_onward) (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.50))
      ; (c) minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p1_9_30_99_to_12_30_01) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.10))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p2_12_31_01_to_12_30_02) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.15))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p3_12_31_02_to_12_30_03) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.20))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p4_12_31_03_to_12_30_04) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.20))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p5_12_31_04_to_12_30_05) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.20))
      (=> (and is_test_date fcc_p6_12_31_05_onward) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.00))
      ; (d) minimum Net Worth, waived at a Test Date if rated at least Baa3 by Moody's AND at least BBB- by S&P
      (=> is_test_date
        (or (and moodys_at_least_baa3 sp_at_least_bbb_minus)
            (>= net_worth (+ (* 0.85 closing_net_worth_after_sbcl)
                             (* 0.75 adjusted_net_income_sum)
                             (* 0.75 equity_proceeds_sum)))))
      ; (e) capex limit = base + usable carryover (shortfall capped at 25% of base, 45% in period 2) + 20% of acquisition EBITDA
      (=> cx_p1_effective_date_to_6_30_2000
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 135000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p2_7_1_2000_to_12_31_2000
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 55000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 24750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 24750000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p3_2001
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 110000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p4_2002
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 110000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 27500000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p5_2003
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 115000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 28750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 28750000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p6_2004
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 120000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 30000000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 30000000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p7_2005
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 125000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 31250000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 31250000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p8_2006
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 130000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 32500000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 32500000.0)))))
      (=> cx_p9_2007
        (<= capex_in_period (+ 135000000.0 (* 0.20 permitted_acq_ebitda_sum)
          (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 0.0) 0.0 (ite (<= capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0) capex_prior_shortfall 33750000.0)))))
      ; (f) operating lease payments cap per fiscal year
      (=> (and is_fiscal_year_lease_measurement fiscal_year_1999_or_later)
        (<= lease_payments_fiscal_year 125000000.0))
    )))

candidate.notes: The whole covenant is guarded by the Section 9 duration condition (a Commitment, Loan or L/C Liability outstanding AND amounts payable not yet paid in full), then covers 9.11(a)-(f) as a conjunction. Ratio tests apply at Test Dates within the stated period flags. Net Worth is waived only if both rating tests hold. For (e), the shortfall carryover is usable only up to the 125% cap (145% for 7/1/2000-12/31/2000), so it is limited to 25% (45%) of the base, and 20% of the positive Permitted Acquisition EBITDA is added on top of that. The phrase 'excluding Capital Leases plus any lease payments ... Sale and Leaseback' in (f) is read as excluding both categories. The first capex period has no preceding period, so the evaluator should supply 0 for its shortfall. No division is used.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

The source allows the shortfall carryover only to the extent the amount expended does not exceed 125% (145% for 7/1/2000-12/31/2000) of the base amount, computed before any carryover and before the clause (y) addition. judge.reason: Most of the covenant is formalized correctly: the leverage, interest coverage and fixed charge period thresholds with correct strictness, the net worth minimum with its dual-rating waiver, the lease cap, and the parameter comments. The capex carryover limit is wrong, however. The source caps carryover so that total expenditure stays at or below 125% (145% in period 2) of the base amount, before the clause (y) addition. The candidate caps the carryover amount at 25% of the base and then adds the clause (y) amount on top, so it permits spending the source forbids when the acquisition EBITDA addition is positive.

; cash_in_lc_account: Real, amount of cash then held in the Letter of Credit Account.
; back_to_back_lc_face_amount: Real, face amount of back-to-back letters of credit delivered pursuant to Section 2.02(j).
; loan_or_lc_disbursement_owing: Bool, true if principal of or interest on any Loan, or reimbursement of any LC Disbursement, is owing to any Lender or the Administrative Agent.
; appraisal_semiannual_deadline_date: Bool, true if the observation date is the May 15 or November 15 end of a 30-day pre-date window, on or after the first such date at least 90 days after Appraised Collateral was first added to the Collateral.
; appraisal_delivered_in_semiannual_window: Bool, true if the Borrower delivered to the Administrative Agent an Appraisal of the Pledged Aircraft, Pledged Engines and Pledged Spare Parts establishing the Appraised Value on a date within the 30 days before that May 15 or November 15.
; additional_appraised_collateral_pledged_today: Bool, true if Additional Collateral comprised of Appraised Collateral is pledged as Collateral on the observation date.
; additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered: Bool, true if an Appraisal of that Additional Collateral was delivered to the Administrative Agent on the pledge date.
; additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days: Real, age in days of that Appraisal as of the pledge date.
; new_spare_engine_exception_applies: Bool, true if a new spare Engine is pledged within 90 days after delivery from the manufacturer to Borrower and is of the same make and model as a spare Engine then in (or being replaced in) the Collateral (an Existing Engine Type).
; borrower_elected_new_engine_appraisal: Bool, true if the Borrower elects to provide an Appraisal for the new spare Engine for purposes of determining its Appraised Value under clause (iii) of the proviso of the definition of Appraised Value.
; appraisal_request_with_eod_pending: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent has requested an Appraisal and an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
; days_since_appraisal_request: Real, days elapsed since that Administrative Agent request.
; appraisal_delivered_after_request: Bool, true if the requested Appraisal was delivered to the Administrative Agent within 45 days after the request.
; field_audit_annual_deadline_date: Bool, true if the observation date is the October 31 end of a 30-day pre-date window, beginning 90 days after a Pledged Account was first added to the Collateral.
; field_audit_delivered_in_annual_window: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent received a Field Audit establishing the Certified Value of the Pledged Accounts on a date within the 30 days before that October 31.
; field_audit_request_with_eod_pending: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent has requested a Field Audit and an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
; days_since_field_audit_request: Real, days elapsed since that Administrative Agent request.
; field_audit_delivered_after_request: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent received the requested Field Audit within 45 days after the request.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_in_effect Bool)
  (lc_face_amount_outstanding Real)
  (cash_in_lc_account Real)
  (back_to_back_lc_face_amount Real)
  (loan_or_lc_disbursement_owing Bool)
  (appraisal_semiannual_deadline_date Bool)
  (appraisal_delivered_in_semiannual_window Bool)
  (additional_appraised_collateral_pledged_today Bool)
  (additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered Bool)
  (additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days Real)
  (new_spare_engine_exception_applies Bool)
  (borrower_elected_new_engine_appraisal Bool)
  (appraisal_request_with_eod_pending Bool)
  (days_since_appraisal_request Real)
  (appraisal_delivered_after_request Bool)
  (field_audit_annual_deadline_date Bool)
  (field_audit_delivered_in_annual_window Bool)
  (field_audit_request_with_eod_pending Bool)
  (days_since_field_audit_request Real)
  (field_audit_delivered_after_request Bool)
) Bool
  (=>
    (or commitments_in_effect
        (> lc_face_amount_outstanding (+ cash_in_lc_account back_to_back_lc_face_amount))
        loan_or_lc_disbursement_owing)
    (and
      (=> appraisal_semiannual_deadline_date appraisal_delivered_in_semiannual_window)
      (=> additional_appraised_collateral_pledged_today
          (or (and additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered
                   (<= additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days 180))
              (and new_spare_engine_exception_applies
                   (not borrower_elected_new_engine_appraisal))))
      (=> (and appraisal_request_with_eod_pending (> days_since_appraisal_request 45))
          appraisal_delivered_after_request)
      (=> field_audit_annual_deadline_date field_audit_delivered_in_annual_window)
      (=> (and field_audit_request_with_eod_pending (> days_since_field_audit_request 45))
          field_audit_delivered_after_request))))",

; appraisal_delivered_in_semiannual_window: Bool, true if the Borrower delivered to the Administrative Agent an Appraisal of the Pledged Aircraft, Pledged Engines and Pledged Spare Parts establishing the Appraised Value on a date within the 30 days before that May 15 or November 15.
; additional_appraised_collateral_pledged_today: Bool, true if Additional Collateral comprised of Appraised Collateral is pledged as Collateral on the observation date.
; additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered: Bool, true if an Appraisal of that Additional Collateral was delivered to the Administrative Agent on the pledge date.
; additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days: Real, age in days of that Appraisal as of the pledge date.
; new_spare_engine_exception_applies: Bool, true if a new spare Engine is pledged within 90 days after delivery from the manufacturer to Borrower and is of the same make and model as a spare Engine then in (or being replaced in) the Collateral (an Existing Engine Type).
; borrower_elected_new_engine_appraisal: Bool, true if the Borrower elects to provide an Appraisal for the new spare Engine for purposes of determining its Appraised Value under clause (iii) of the proviso of the definition of Appraised Value.
; appraisal_request_with_eod_pending: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent has requested an Appraisal and an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
; days_since_appraisal_request: Real, days elapsed since that Administrative Agent request.
; appraisal_delivered_after_request: Bool, true if the requested Appraisal was delivered to the Administrative Agent within 45 days after the request.
; field_audit_annual_deadline_date: Bool, true if the observation date is the October 31 end of a 30-day pre-date window, beginning 90 days after a Pledged Account was first added to the Collateral.
; field_audit_delivered_in_annual_window: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent received a Field Audit establishing the Certified Value of the Pledged Accounts on a date within the 30 days before that October 31.
; field_audit_request_with_eod_pending: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent has requested a Field Audit and an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
; days_since_field_audit_request: Real, days elapsed since that Administrative Agent request.
; field_audit_delivered_after_request: Bool, true if the Administrative Agent received the requested Field Audit within 45 days after the request.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_in_effect Bool)
  (lc_face_amount_outstanding Real)
  (cash_in_lc_account Real)
  (back_to_back_lc_face_amount Real)
  (loan_or_lc_disbursement_owing Bool)
  (appraisal_semiannual_deadline_date Bool)
  (appraisal_delivered_in_semiannual_window Bool)
  (additional_appraised_collateral_pledged_today Bool)
  (additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered Bool)
  (additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days Real)
  (new_spare_engine_exception_applies Bool)
  (borrower_elected_new_engine_appraisal Bool)
  (appraisal_request_with_eod_pending Bool)
  (days_since_appraisal_request Real)
  (appraisal_delivered_after_request Bool)
  (field_audit_annual_deadline_date Bool)
  (field_audit_delivered_in_annual_window Bool)
  (field_audit_request_with_eod_pending Bool)
  (days_since_field_audit_request Real)
  (field_audit_delivered_after_request Bool)
) Bool
  (=>
    (or commitments_in_effect
        (> lc_face_amount_outstanding (+ cash_in_lc_account back_to_back_lc_face_amount))
        loan_or_lc_disbursement_owing)
    (and
      (=> appraisal_semiannual_deadline_date appraisal_delivered_in_semiannual_window)
      (=> additional_appraised_collateral_pledged_today
          (or (and additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered
                   (<= additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days 180))
              (and new_spare_engine_exception_applies
                   (not borrower_elected_new_engine_appraisal))))
      (=> (and appraisal_request_with_eod_pending (> days_since_appraisal_request 45))
          appraisal_delivered_after_request)
      (=> field_audit_annual_deadline_date field_audit_delivered_in_annual_window)
      (=> (and field_audit_request_with_eod_pending (> days_since_field_audit_request 45))
          field_audit_delivered_after_request))))

candidate.notes: Applicability follows the Section 5 lead-in. Its three conditions are decomposed as an OR: Commitments in effect, LC face amount above cash plus back-to-back LCs, or Loan or LC Disbursement amounts owing. The 'other amount due and unpaid' tail is not modeled. Each recurring delivery duty is tested pointwise at its deadline date, using flags for the calendar dates and for whether delivery occurred in the required window. The 45-day request duties are violated only when the deadline has passed (days > 45) without delivery. The 180-day staleness proviso and the new-spare-Engine exception are encoded for the Additional Collateral clause. Not modeled: the Agent's discretionary good-faith request for an updated Appraisal, the Borrower's optional extra Appraisals, the Borrower-belief-based weekly mark-to-market of Eligible Accounts (Markdown Date), the Agent's cooperation duty, and the Field Auditor expense reimbursement. These depend on subjective judgments or are not delivery or timing tests.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

issues: The Section 5.07(b) weekly mark-to-market obligation is omitted. While the Borrower reasonably believes it would not comply with Section 6.09(a) after excluding the Pledged Accounts, it must mark-to-market all Eligible Accounts weekly on a Business Day. This can be modeled with Boolean inputs for the belief condition and for performance on the Markdown Date, but the candidate has neither.

The Administrative Agent's right to request an updated Appraisal is omitted. It applies when the Agent in good faith believes a material assumption is incorrect, unless the failure would not reasonably be expected to push the Collateral Coverage Ratio below 1.0 to 1.0. The Borrower and Guarantors must cooperate with the Appraiser(s) so the Agent receives the updated Appraisal.
The applicability guard omits the parenthetical 'any other amount that is due and unpaid' as a trigger. It also covers only Loan principal/interest and LC reimbursement as owing amounts.

The Borrower's obligation to cooperate with the Field Auditor and to bear the Field Auditor's reasonable out-of-pocket costs is not represented. The appraisal and field-audit request clauses also do not capture the 'promptly' requirement, only the 45-day outer limit.

Some Boolean parameter descriptions are muddled. For example, appraisal_semiannual_deadline_date and field_audit_annual_deadline_date are described as 'the end of a 30-day pre-date window', which blurs whether they flag the deadline date itself or the window. This leaves the date regime less precisely defined than required.
judge.reason: The candidate correctly handles the semiannual and annual appraisal and field-audit delivery obligations, the 180-day age limit for Additional Collateral appraisals, the new-spare-Engine exception, and the 45-day post-request deadlines. It also does not add unsupported financial assumptions. However, it leaves out several operative Section 5.07 obligations (weekly Eligible Accounts mark-to-market, updated-Appraisal request cooperation, Field Auditor cooperation and costs) and part of the applicability guard. It is therefore not a complete or equivalent formalization of the covenant.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; loans_outstanding: true iff there are any Loans outstanding at the observation time.
; commitment_terminated: true iff the Commitment has terminated at the observation time.
; obligations_paid_in_full: true iff all the Obligations have been paid and satisfied in full at the observation time.
; tangible_net_worth: Borrower's Tangible Net Worth at the observation time, in dollars.
; consolidated_net_income: Consolidated Net Income for the relevant fiscal period, in dollars (may be negative; no sign assumption).
; equity_net_proceeds: net proceeds, in dollars, of any sale by the Borrower in the relevant period of equity securities, or warrants or subscription rights for equity securities, issued by the Borrower.
; is_four_quarter_period_end: true iff the observation is at the end of a period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Borrower.
; funded_debt: Funded Debt of the Borrower as at the end of that four-consecutive-fiscal-quarter period, in dollars.
; ebit_four_quarters: EBIT of the Borrower for that four-consecutive-fiscal-quarter period, in dollars.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is at the end of a fiscal quarter.
; ebit_quarter: EBIT of the Borrower for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.
; interest_expense_quarter: interest expense of the Borrower for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (loans_outstanding Bool)
  (commitment_terminated Bool)
  (obligations_paid_in_full Bool)
  (tangible_net_worth Real)
  (consolidated_net_income Real)
  (equity_net_proceeds Real)
  (is_four_quarter_period_end Bool)
  (funded_debt Real)
  (ebit_four_quarters Real)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (ebit_quarter Real)
  (interest_expense_quarter Real)) Bool
  (=> (or loans_outstanding
          (not commitment_terminated)
          (not obligations_paid_in_full))
      (and
        ; (a) Tangible Net Worth must not be less than the required sum
        (>= tangible_net_worth
            (+ 100000000.0
               (* 0.5 consolidated_net_income)
               (* 1.0 equity_net_proceeds)))
        ; (b) Funded Debt to EBIT must not be greater than 2.5 to 1 at four-quarter period end
        (=> is_four_quarter_period_end
            (<= (/ funded_debt ebit_four_quarters) 2.5))
        ; (c) EBIT to interest expense must not be less than 3.5 to 1 at fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
            (>= (/ ebit_quarter interest_expense_quarter) 3.5)))))",

    {"name": "consolidated_net_income", "meaning": "Consolidated Net Income for the relevant fiscal period, in dollars; sign not assumed.", "source_quote": "fifty percent (50%) of Consolidated Net Income for the relevant fiscal period"},
    {"name": "equity_net_proceeds", "meaning": "Net proceeds in dollars of any sale by the Borrower in the relevant period of equity securities, or warrants or subscription rights for equity securities, issued by the Borrower.", "source_quote": "the net proceeds of any sale by the Borrower in the relevant period of any equity securities issued by the Borrower or any warrants or subscription rights for any equity securities issued by the Borrower"},

; equity_net_proceeds: net proceeds, in dollars, of any sale by the Borrower in the relevant period of equity securities, or warrants or subscription rights for equity securities, issued by the Borrower.
; is_four_quarter_period_end: true iff the observation is at the end of a period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Borrower.
; funded_debt: Funded Debt of the Borrower as at the end of that four-consecutive-fiscal-quarter period, in dollars.
; ebit_four_quarters: EBIT of the Borrower for that four-consecutive-fiscal-quarter period, in dollars.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is at the end of a fiscal quarter.
; ebit_quarter: EBIT of the Borrower for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.
; interest_expense_quarter: interest expense of the Borrower for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (loans_outstanding Bool)
  (commitment_terminated Bool)
  (obligations_paid_in_full Bool)
  (tangible_net_worth Real)
  (consolidated_net_income Real)
  (equity_net_proceeds Real)
  (is_four_quarter_period_end Bool)
  (funded_debt Real)
  (ebit_four_quarters Real)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (ebit_quarter Real)
  (interest_expense_quarter Real)) Bool
  (=> (or loans_outstanding
          (not commitment_terminated)
          (not obligations_paid_in_full))
      (and
        ; (a) Tangible Net Worth must not be less than the required sum
        (>= tangible_net_worth
            (+ 100000000.0
               (* 0.5 consolidated_net_income)
               (* 1.0 equity_net_proceeds)))
        ; (b) Funded Debt to EBIT must not be greater than 2.5 to 1 at four-quarter period end
        (=> is_four_quarter_period_end
            (<= (/ funded_debt ebit_four_quarters) 2.5))
        ; (c) EBIT to interest expense must not be less than 3.5 to 1 at fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
            (>= (/ ebit_quarter interest_expense_quarter) 3.5)))))

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; Pointwise reading: each observation is one Debt item of Borrower or a covered Subsidiary, tested against the Section 9.1 exceptions (a)-(i).
; debt_in_scope: Bool, true if the observed Debt is Debt of Borrower or of a Subsidiary other than a Non-Recourse Subsidiary that is incurred, created, assumed or permitted to exist.
; is_incurrence_now: Bool, true if the observed Debt is being incurred at this observation (as opposed to merely continuing to exist).
; default_exists_or_would_result: Bool, true if a Default exists at the time of the incurrence or would result from it.
; is_subsidiary_loan_to_borrower_or_subsidiary: Bool, true if the Debt is a loan by a Subsidiary of Borrower to Borrower or to another Subsidiary of Borrower.
; is_debt_under_agreement_or_revolving_docs: Bool, true if the Debt is Debt pursuant to this Agreement or Debt of Borrower/Subsidiaries to the Revolving Loans Banks under the Revolving Loans Documents (clause a).
; is_listed_existing_debt: Bool, true if the Debt is Existing Debt identified in Borrower's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 1996 (clause b).
; is_renewal_extension_refi_of_listed_debt: Bool, true if the Debt is a renewal, extension or refinancing of Debt referred to in clause (b).
; refi_increases_principal: Bool, true if that renewal, extension or refinancing increases the outstanding principal amount of the refinanced Debt.
; refi_terms_materially_more_onerous: Bool, true if the terms and provisions of that renewal, extension or refinancing are materially more onerous than the terms and conditions of the Debt on the Closing Date.
; is_permitted_purchase_money_debt: Bool, true if the Debt is purchase money Debt secured by purchase money Liens, and the Debt and Liens are permitted under and meet all requirements of clause (g) of the definition of Permitted Liens (clause c).
; is_intercompany_debt_ordinary_course: Bool, true if the Debt is Intercompany Debt between Borrower (including Guarantors to the extent necessary under the final sentence of Section 9.1) and a Subsidiary, incurred in the ordinary course of business or consistent with prudent business practices (clause d).
; intercompany_debt_is_secured: Bool, true if the clause (d) Intercompany Debt is secured.
; intercompany_debt_evidenced_by_instruments: Bool, true if the clause (d) Intercompany Debt is evidenced by instruments.
; instruments_satisfactory_and_pledged: Bool, true if the instruments are satisfactory to the Agent and pledged to the Agent for the benefit of the Banks under a security agreement in form and substance satisfactory to the Agent.
; pledge_would_give_senior_notes_holders_right: Bool, true if such a pledge would give the holders of the Senior Notes the contract right to also obtain the benefit of the pledge (the exception to the pledge requirement).
; is_hedge_debt: Bool, true if the Debt is under Currency Hedge Agreements or Interest Rate Protection Agreements (clause e).
; hedge_counterparty_highly_rated: Bool, true if each counterparty is rated in one of the two highest rating categories of Standard and Poor's Corporation or Moody's Investors Service, Inc.
; aggregate_hedge_notional: Real, aggregate notional amount in US dollars outstanding at the observation of all Currency Hedge Agreements and Interest Rate Protection Agreements of Borrower and its Subsidiaries other than Non-Recourse Subsidiaries.
; is_ordinary_course_bond_debt: Bool, true if the Debt of Borrower or a Subsidiary was incurred in the ordinary course of business in respect of performance bonds, surety bonds or appeal bonds (clause f).
; aggregate_bond_principal: Real, aggregate principal amount in US dollars outstanding at the observation of such performance, surety and appeal bond Debt of Borrower and its Subsidiaries.
; is_acquired_subsidiary_debt: Bool, true if the Debt is Debt of a Person who becomes a Subsidiary under a transaction permitted by this Agreement after the Closing Date, and was outstanding before the Subsidiary was acquired (clause g).
; acquired_debt_incurred_due_to_transaction: Bool, true if that Debt was incurred as a result of, or in anticipation of, the acquisition transaction.
; is_permitted_refinancing_debt: Bool, true if the Debt is Permitted Refinancing Debt (clause h).
; proforma_interest_coverage_ratio: Real, the Proforma Interest Coverage Ratio (to 1.00) after giving pro forma effect to the incurrence (clause i).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (debt_in_scope Bool)
    (is_incurrence_now Bool)
    (default_exists_or_would_result Bool)
    (is_subsidiary_loan_to_borrower_or_subsidiary Bool)
    (is_debt_under_agreement_or_revolving_docs Bool)
    (is_listed_existing_debt Bool)
    (is_renewal_extension_refi_of_listed_debt Bool)
    (refi_increases_principal Bool)
    (refi_terms_materially_more_onerous Bool)
    (is_permitted_purchase_money_debt Bool)
    (is_intercompany_debt_ordinary_course Bool)
    (intercompany_debt_is_secured Bool)
    (intercompany_debt_evidenced_by_instruments Bool)
    (instruments_satisfactory_and_pledged Bool)
    (pledge_would_give_senior_notes_holders_right Bool)
    (is_hedge_debt Bool)
    (hedge_counterparty_highly_rated Bool)
    (aggregate_hedge_notional Real)
    (is_ordinary_course_bond_debt Bool)
    (aggregate_bond_principal Real)
    (is_acquired_subsidiary_debt Bool)
    (acquired_debt_incurred_due_to_transaction Bool)
    (is_permitted_refinancing_debt Bool)
    (proforma_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
  ) Bool
  (=> debt_in_scope
    (or
      ; (a)
      is_debt_under_agreement_or_revolving_docs
      ; (b)
      is_listed_existing_debt
      (and is_renewal_extension_refi_of_listed_debt
           (not refi_increases_principal)
           (not refi_terms_materially_more_onerous))
      ; (e)
      (and is_hedge_debt
           hedge_counterparty_highly_rated
           (<= aggregate_hedge_notional 10000000.0))
      ; (f)
      (and is_ordinary_course_bond_debt
           (<= aggregate_bond_principal 5000000.0))
      ; clauses (c), (d), (g), (h), (i), subject to the Default proviso
      (and
        (not (and is_incurrence_now
                  default_exists_or_would_result
                  (not is_subsidiary_loan_to_borrower_or_subsidiary)))
        (or
          ; (c)
          is_permitted_purchase_money_debt
          ; (d)
          (and is_intercompany_debt_ordinary_course
               (not intercompany_debt_is_secured)
               (or (not intercompany_debt_evidenced_by_instruments)
                   instruments_satisfactory_and_pledged
                   pledge_would_give_senior_notes_holders_right))
          ; (g)
          (and is_acquired_subsidiary_debt
               (not acquired_debt_incurred_due_to_transaction))
          ; (h)
          is_permitted_refinancing_debt
          ; (i)
          (<= proforma_interest_coverage_ratio 2.5))))))",

    (is_incurrence_now Bool)
    (default_exists_or_would_result Bool)
    (is_subsidiary_loan_to_borrower_or_subsidiary Bool)
    (is_debt_under_agreement_or_revolving_docs Bool)
    (is_listed_existing_debt Bool)

    (refi_increases_principal Bool)
    (refi_terms_materially_more_onerous Bool)
    (is_permitted_purchase_money_debt Bool)

    (intercompany_debt_evidenced_by_instruments Bool)

    (pledge_would_give_senior_notes_holders_right Bool)
    (is_hedge_debt Bool)
    (hedge_counterparty_highly_rated Bool)
    (aggregate_hedge_notional Real)
    (is_ordinary_course_bond_debt Bool)
    (aggregate_bond_principal Real)
    (is_acquired_subsidiary_debt Bool)

{

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; notes_and_obligations_not_repaid_in_full: true if the Notes and all Obligations payable under the Loan Documents have not yet been repaid in full at the observation.
; holders_written_consent_otherwise: true if the Holders have consented in writing to otherwise (waiving or modifying Section 6.12) at the observation.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true if the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the measurement date for the ratio tests and the quarter-completion date for Net Income.
; is_quarter_through_june_30_2005: true if the fiscal quarter being measured is any fiscal quarter through the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2005.
; is_quarter_on_or_after_sept_30_2005: true if the fiscal quarter being measured is the quarter ending September 30, 2005 or any later fiscal quarter.
; fcr_ebitda: consolidated EBITDA of the Parent Company and its Subsidiaries, four-quarter rolling, for the Fixed Charges Ratio measurement period.

; fcr_cash_interest_expense: consolidated cash interest expense for the same period.
; fcr_cash_taxes_paid: consolidated cash taxes paid for the same period.
; fcr_required_principal_payments_on_debt: consolidated required principal payments on debt for the same period.
; fcr_capital_lease_payments: consolidated capital lease payments for the same period.
; senior_debt_not_paid_in_full: true if the Senior Debt has not been paid in full at the as-of date, so the Asset Coverage Ratio denominator applies.
; gross_accounts_receivable: consolidated gross accounts receivable, billed and unbilled, as of the calculation date.
; unrestricted_cash: consolidated unrestricted cash as of the calculation date.
; senior_avg_loan_balance_30d: prior thirty-day average outstanding loan balance under the Senior Credit Facility.
; outstanding_letters_of_credit_face: face amount of all outstanding letters of credit on the as-of date of the calculation.
; notes_outstanding_balance: outstanding balance of the Notes on the as-of date of the calculation.

; leverage_ebitda: consolidated EBITDA of the Parent Company and its Subsidiaries for the Leverage Ratio measurement period (denominator).
; fiscal_year_to_date_capex: aggregate consolidated capital expenditures (including leasehold improvements and capitalized costs) made or incurred in the current fiscal year through the observation.

; fcr_nonborrower_ebitda: EBITDA attributable to the Non-Borrower Subsidiaries included in the Fixed Charges Ratio calculation for the period.
; leverage_nonborrower_ebitda: EBITDA attributable to the Non-Borrower Subsidiaries included in the Leverage Ratio calculation for the period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (notes_and_obligations_not_repaid_in_full Bool)
  (holders_written_consent_otherwise Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_quarter_through_june_30_2005 Bool)
  (is_quarter_on_or_after_sept_30_2005 Bool)
  (fcr_ebitda Real)
  (fcr_rent_and_operating_lease_expense Real)
  (fcr_cash_interest_expense Real)
  (fcr_cash_taxes_paid Real)
  (fcr_required_principal_payments_on_debt Real)
  (fcr_capital_lease_payments Real)
  (senior_debt_not_paid_in_full Bool)
  (gross_accounts_receivable Real)
  (unrestricted_cash Real)
  (senior_avg_loan_balance_30d Real)
  (outstanding_letters_of_credit_face Real)
  (notes_outstanding_balance Real)
  (in_first_year_after_date_hereof Bool)
  (in_second_year_after_date_hereof Bool)
  (on_or_after_two_years_from_date_hereof Bool)
  (is_quarter_closing_through_sep30_2004 Bool)
  (is_quarter_on_or_after_oct1_2004 Bool)
  (total_debt Real)
  (leverage_ebitda Real)

  (has_prior_fiscal_year Bool)
  (prior_fiscal_year_capex Real)
  (net_income_with_permitted_addbacks Real)
  (fcr_nonborrower_ebitda Real)

  (=> (and notes_and_obligations_not_repaid_in_full (not holders_written_consent_otherwise))

        (>= (/ (+ fcr_ebitda fcr_rent_and_operating_lease_expense)
               (+ fcr_rent_and_operating_lease_expense fcr_cash_interest_expense fcr_cash_taxes_paid

            1.15))

      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_on_or_after_sept_30_2005)
        (>= (/ (+ fcr_ebitda fcr_rent_and_operating_lease_expense)
               (+ fcr_rent_and_operating_lease_expense fcr_cash_interest_expense fcr_cash_taxes_paid
                  fcr_required_principal_payments_on_debt fcr_capital_lease_payments))
            1.25))

        (>= (/ (+ gross_accounts_receivable unrestricted_cash)

                  (ite (>= 6000000.0 (* 0.5 notes_outstanding_balance)) 6000000.0 (* 0.5 notes_outstanding_balance))))
            1.0))

        (>= (/ (+ gross_accounts_receivable unrestricted_cash)
               (+ senior_avg_loan_balance_30d outstanding_letters_of_credit_face
                  (ite (>= 8000000.0 (* 0.8 notes_outstanding_balance)) 8000000.0 (* 0.8 notes_outstanding_balance))))
            1.0))
      ;; (b)(C) Asset Coverage Ratio >= 1.00, from two years onward
      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end senior_debt_not_paid_in_full on_or_after_two_years_from_date_hereof)
        (>= (/ (+ gross_accounts_receivable unrestricted_cash)
               (+ senior_avg_loan_balance_30d outstanding_letters_of_credit_face
                  (ite (>= 6000000.0 notes_outstanding_balance) 6000000.0 notes_outstanding_balance)))
            1.0))
      ;; (c) Leverage Ratio <= 3.50 through Sept 30, 2004
      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_closing_through_sep30_2004)
        (<= (/ total_debt leverage_ebitda) 3.5))
      ;; (c) Leverage Ratio <= 3.00 from and after Oct 1, 2004
      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_on_or_after_oct1_2004)
        (<= (/ total_debt leverage_ebitda) 3.0))
      ;; (d) Capex limit 4,500,000 plus carryover (capped at 2,250,000) from a prior Carryover Year
      (<= fiscal_year_to_date_capex
          (+ 4500000.0
             (ite (and has_prior_fiscal_year (< prior_fiscal_year_capex 4500000.0))
                  (ite (<= (- 4500000.0 prior_fiscal_year_capex) 2250000.0)
                       (- 4500000.0 prior_fiscal_year_capex)
                       2250000.0)
                  0.0)))

      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= net_income_with_permitted_addbacks 0.0))
      ;; Non-Borrower Subsidiaries EBITDA at most 5% of consolidated EBITDA, at no time exceeded

      (<= leverage_nonborrower_ebitda (* 0.05 leverage_ebitda)))))",

                  (ite (<= (- 4500000.0 prior_fiscal_year_capex) 2250000.0)

candidate.notes: All of Section 6.12(a)-(e), plus the 5% Non-Borrower EBITDA cap, is conjoined under the lead-in condition (obligations not repaid and no written Holder consent). Ratios are kept as divisions, so QF_NRA is used and a zero denominator is left to the evaluator to report as unresolved. Asset Coverage has no explicit test date, so it is gated on the fiscal-quarter-end flag, and each of the three Notes-balance periods has its own conjunct. Capex is tested pointwise on fiscal-year-to-date spending against 4,500,000 plus the carryover, which is the shortfall in the prior year capped at 2,250,000 and applies only if a prior fiscal year exists. The 5% cap is applied at every observation because the source says 'at no time'. FCR and leverage EBITDA are separate inputs because the source gives a four-quarter rolling basis only for the Fixed Charges Ratio.

issues: The Non-Borrower Subsidiaries proviso limits how much non-borrower EBITDA may be included when calculating compliance with Section 6.12 (a cap on inclusion). The candidate instead turns it into a standalone compliance condition that fails the whole covenant if the share exceeds 5%. That is an unsupported strengthening of the source: the source does not clearly say that an excess is itself a breach, rather than being excluded or capped in the calculation.

The two 5% constraints are not gated by is_fiscal_quarter_end or by any measurement-period flag, but their inputs are described as 'for the period' of the ratio calculation. At non-quarter-end observations the meaning of fcr_ebitda, leverage_ebitda and the non-borrower EBITDA inputs is undefined, so the constraints may be evaluated on meaningless values. The comments and the formula scope do not agree.

The 5% test is applied separately to the Fixed Charges Ratio EBITDA and the Leverage Ratio EBITDA. The source does not define two separate test populations; it speaks of 'the total EBITDA ... for the applicable period'. This decomposition is an interpretive choice that the source does not support.
judge.reason: The ratio tests (fixed charges, asset coverage with its three greater-of tiers, leverage), the capex carryover with its $2.25M cap, the net income test, and the consent and not-repaid applicability guards all match the source with correct thresholds and strictness. However, the Non-Borrower 5% proviso is encoded as an independent, ungated violation condition. This goes beyond the source, which limits the amount included in the calculations, and it leaves the inputs ambiguous at non-quarter-end observations. The formalization is therefore not faithful on that clause.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of Borrower (the covenants are determined as of that date).
; obligations_repaid_in_full: true iff the Obligations have been repaid in full at the observation time.
; all_letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated: true iff all Letters of Credit have expired or terminated at the observation time.
; total_revolving_credit_commitment_expired_or_terminated: true iff the Total Revolving Credit Commitment has expired or terminated at the observation time.
; leverage_ratio: Borrower's Leverage Ratio, consolidated with the Restricted Subsidiaries, as a plain ratio (0.60 means 0.60 to 1).
; ebitda: Borrower's EBITDA, consolidated with the Restricted Subsidiaries (numerator of the interest coverage ratio).
; interest_incurred: Borrower's Interest Incurred, consolidated with the Restricted Subsidiaries (denominator of the interest coverage ratio).
; tangible_net_worth: Borrower's Tangible Net Worth in US dollars, consolidated with the Restricted Subsidiaries.
; cumulative_positive_annual_net_profits: sum in US dollars of annual net profits for each fiscal year ending after September 30, 2005, where a year with a net loss counts as 0 (no deduction for any annual net loss).
; aggregate_stock_issuance_equity_increase: aggregate increase in US dollars in Borrower's shareholders' equity after the date of the agreement from issuance of capital stock (including on conversion of Indebtedness), excluding stock issued under an employee stock ownership, stock option or stock purchase plan and excluding any portion attributable to goodwill recognized in connection with an Acquisition.
; speculative_lots_owned: number of Speculative Lots owned by Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries at the observation time, excluding Models.
; closed_sales_prior_12_months: number of Closed Sales during the immediately preceding twelve calendar months.
; developed_lots_lots_under_development_land_parcels_cost: GAAP cost in US dollars of Developed Lots, Lots Under Development and Land Parcels owned by Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries as of the date of determination.
; adjusted_tangible_net_worth: Borrower's Adjusted Tangible Net Worth in US dollars.
; moodys_investment_grade: true iff Borrower maintains an Investment Grade Rating from Moody's at the observation time.
; sp_investment_grade: true iff Borrower maintains an Investment Grade Rating from S&P at the observation time.
; fitch_investment_grade: true iff Borrower maintains an Investment Grade Rating from Fitch at the observation time.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (obligations_repaid_in_full Bool)
    (all_letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated Bool)
    (total_revolving_credit_commitment_expired_or_terminated Bool)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (ebitda Real)
    (interest_incurred Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cumulative_positive_annual_net_profits Real)
    (aggregate_stock_issuance_equity_increase Real)
    (speculative_lots_owned Real)
    (closed_sales_prior_12_months Real)
    (developed_lots_lots_under_development_land_parcels_cost Real)
    (adjusted_tangible_net_worth Real)
    (moodys_investment_grade Bool)
    (sp_investment_grade Bool)
    (fitch_investment_grade Bool)) Bool
  (let ((covenant_period_active
          (not (and obligations_repaid_in_full
                    all_letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated
                    total_revolving_credit_commitment_expired_or_terminated)))
        (investment_grade_by_two
          (or (and moodys_investment_grade sp_investment_grade)
              (and moodys_investment_grade fitch_investment_grade)
              (and sp_investment_grade fitch_investment_grade))))
    (=> (and covenant_period_active is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (and
          ; (a) Leverage Ratio not more than 0.60 to 1
          (<= leverage_ratio 0.60)
          ; (b) EBITDA to Interest Incurred not less than 2.50 to 1.0
          (>= (/ ebitda interest_incurred) 2.50)
          ; (c) Tangible Net Worth floor
          (>= tangible_net_worth
              (+ 3718000000.0
                 (* 0.50 cumulative_positive_annual_net_profits)
                 (* 0.50 aggregate_stock_issuance_equity_increase)))
          ; (d) Speculative Lots cap, not operative during Investment Grade Rating by at least two agencies
          (=> (not investment_grade_by_two)
              (<= speculative_lots_owned (* 0.40 closed_sales_prior_12_months)))
          ; (e) land and lot costs cap, not operative during Investment Grade Rating by at least two agencies
          (=> (not investment_grade_by_two)
              (<= developed_lots_lots_under_development_land_parcels_cost
                  (* 1.50 adjusted_tangible_net_worth)))))))",

; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of Borrower (the covenants are determined as of that date).

; tangible_net_worth: Borrower's Tangible Net Worth in US dollars, consolidated with the Restricted Subsidiaries.
; cumulative_positive_annual_net_profits: sum in US dollars of annual net profits for each fiscal year ending after September 30, 2005, where a year with a net loss counts as 0 (no deduction for any annual net loss).

; moodys_investment_grade: true iff Borrower maintains an Investment Grade Rating from Moody's at the observation time.
; sp_investment_grade: true iff Borrower maintains an Investment Grade Rating from S&P at the observation time.
; fitch_investment_grade: true iff Borrower maintains an Investment Grade Rating from Fitch at the observation time.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (obligations_repaid_in_full Bool)
    (all_letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated Bool)
    (total_revolving_credit_commitment_expired_or_terminated Bool)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (ebitda Real)
    (interest_incurred Real)
