    (cumulative_positive_annual_net_profits Real)
    (aggregate_stock_issuance_equity_increase Real)
    (speculative_lots_owned Real)
    (closed_sales_prior_12_months Real)
    (developed_lots_lots_under_development_land_parcels_cost Real)
    (adjusted_tangible_net_worth Real)
    (moodys_investment_grade Bool)
    (sp_investment_grade Bool)
    (fitch_investment_grade Bool)) Bool
  (let ((covenant_period_active
          (not (and obligations_repaid_in_full
                    all_letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated
                    total_revolving_credit_commitment_expired_or_terminated)))
        (investment_grade_by_two
          (or (and moodys_investment_grade sp_investment_grade)
              (and moodys_investment_grade fitch_investment_grade)
              (and sp_investment_grade fitch_investment_grade))))

          (<= leverage_ratio 0.60)
          ; (b) EBITDA to Interest Incurred not less than 2.50 to 1.0
          (>= (/ ebitda interest_incurred) 2.50)
          ; (c) Tangible Net Worth floor
          (>= tangible_net_worth
              (+ 3718000000.0
                 (* 0.50 cumulative_positive_annual_net_profits)
                 (* 0.50 aggregate_stock_issuance_equity_increase)))
          ; (d) Speculative Lots cap, not operative during Investment Grade Rating by at least two agencies
          (=> (not investment_grade_by_two)

          ; (e) land and lot costs cap, not operative during Investment Grade Rating by at least two agencies
          (=> (not investment_grade_by_two)
              (<= developed_lots_lots_under_development_land_parcels_cost
                  (* 1.50 adjusted_tangible_net_worth)))))))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; leverage_ratio: Leverage Ratio of Parent as of the observation date (to 1.00), as defined in the credit agreement.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of Parent.
; qualifying_acquisition_consummated: true iff a Material Acquisition involving cash consideration of at least US$100,000,000 has been consummated, and the observation date falls in the relevant election window of that acquisition.
; written_election_made: true iff Parent gave the written election to the Administrative Agent for that Material Acquisition.
; prior_election_made: true iff Parent had previously made such an election for an earlier Material Acquisition.
; two_quarters_no_increase_since_prior: true iff at least two consecutive full fiscal quarters have ended since the prior election date with no increase in effect.
; two_quarters_ratio_within_350_since_prior: true iff the Leverage Ratio on the last day of at least two consecutive full fiscal quarters ended since the prior election date did not exceed 3.50 to 1.00.
; in_4_00_window: true iff the observation date is the last day of the fiscal quarter in which the Material Acquisition was consummated, or of the first or second full fiscal quarter ending after its consummation.
; in_3_75_window: true iff the observation date is the last day of the third or fourth full fiscal quarter ending after the Material Acquisition's consummation.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((leverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (qualifying_acquisition_consummated Bool)
                            (written_election_made Bool)
                            (prior_election_made Bool)
                            (two_quarters_no_increase_since_prior Bool)
                            (two_quarters_ratio_within_350_since_prior Bool)
                            (in_4_00_window Bool)
                            (in_3_75_window Bool)) Bool
  (let ((election_effective
         (and qualifying_acquisition_consummated
              written_election_made
              (or (not prior_election_made)
                  two_quarters_no_increase_since_prior
                  two_quarters_ratio_within_350_since_prior))))
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (<= leverage_ratio
            (ite (and election_effective in_4_00_window) 4.00
                 (ite (and election_effective in_3_75_window) 3.75
                      3.50))))))

  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_proposing_additional_debt: Bool, true iff at this observation the Borrower or a Subsidiary is incurring/proposing to incur additional Debt (5.08a).
; debt_incurred_after_effective_date: Real, USD aggregate outstanding principal of all Debt of the Borrower and its Consolidated Subsidiaries incurred after the Effective Date (5.08a), computed per 5.08f (LCR/CITGO Refining Debt excluded; Replacement Debt substituted for Replaced Debt).
; ebitda: Real, USD EBITDA for the most recently ended four-fiscal-quarter period, computed per 5.08f (LCR/CITGO Refining excluded; annualized/last-announced-period rules).
; interest_expense_pro_forma_a: Real, USD Consolidated Interest Expense for the same four-quarter period, giving effect to all Debt actually outstanding in the period and assuming the proposed Debt was incurred on the first day of the period (5.08a), per 5.08f.
; period_ends_through_1994: Bool, true iff the last quarter of the measured four-fiscal-quarter period falls in the period from the Effective Date through December 31, 1994.
; period_ends_in_1995: Bool, true iff the last quarter of the measured four-fiscal-quarter period falls in the period January 1, 1995 through December 31, 1995.
; period_ends_in_1996: Bool, true iff the last quarter of the measured four-fiscal-quarter period falls in the period January 1, 1996 through December 31, 1996.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: Bool, true iff this observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter (5.08b, 5.08c).
; consolidated_capex_ex_lcr: Real, USD Consolidated Capital Expenditures for the four-fiscal-quarter period, with all items attributable to the activities or business of LCR excluded (5.08b).
; consolidated_interest_expense: Real, USD Consolidated Interest Expense for the four-fiscal-quarter period, including Net Interest on Replacement Debt per 5.08f(2) and excluding LCR/CITGO Refining interest per 5.08f(1) (5.08b).
; consolidated_debt: Real, USD Consolidated Debt for the four-fiscal-quarter period, with Replacement Debt substituted for Replaced Debt and LCR/CITGO Refining Debt excluded per 5.08f (5.08c).
; is_declaring_dividend: Bool, true iff at this observation the Borrower declares, makes or pays, or incurs liability to make or pay, or causes/permits a Dividend (5.08d).
; aggregate_dividends_since_1994_after_effect: Real, USD aggregate of all Dividends declared or paid on or after January 1, 1994, after giving effect to the Dividend at issue (5.08d).
; net_income_adjusted: Real, USD Consolidated Net Income or Loss (loss negative), excluding non-cash Non-Operating Special Items, for the period from October 1, 1993 through the most recently completed fiscal quarter (5.08d).
; is_on_or_after_effective_date: Bool, true iff this observation is on or after the Effective Date (5.08e).
; aggregate_investments: Real, USD aggregate of all Investments (5.08e).
; excess_investments_equity_funded: Bool, true iff all Investments above $200,000,000 are investments by the Borrower or LRC in LCR made from proceeds of a capital markets offering consisting solely of equity securities (5.08e proviso).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_proposing_additional_debt Bool)
    (debt_incurred_after_effective_date Real)
    (ebitda Real)
    (interest_expense_pro_forma_a Real)
    (period_ends_through_1994 Bool)
    (period_ends_in_1995 Bool)
    (period_ends_in_1996 Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (consolidated_capex_ex_lcr Real)
    (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
    (consolidated_debt Real)
    (is_declaring_dividend Bool)
    (aggregate_dividends_since_1994_after_effect Real)
    (net_income_adjusted Real)
    (is_on_or_after_effective_date Bool)
    (aggregate_investments Real)
    (excess_investments_equity_funded Bool)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; 5.08a Debt Incurrence Test
    (=> (and is_proposing_additional_debt (> debt_incurred_after_effective_date 75000000.0))
        (>= (/ ebitda interest_expense_pro_forma_a)
            (ite period_ends_through_1994 1.75 (ite period_ends_in_1995 2.0 2.25))))
    ; 5.08b Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio: must not be less than the designated ratio
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (not (< (/ (- ebitda consolidated_capex_ex_lcr) consolidated_interest_expense)
                (ite period_ends_through_1994 1.15 (ite period_ends_in_1995 1.3 2.0)))))
    ; 5.08c Leverage Ratio: must not be greater than the designated ratio
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (not (> (/ consolidated_debt ebitda)
                (ite period_ends_through_1994 6.5
                  (ite period_ends_in_1995 5.5
                    (ite period_ends_in_1996 4.5 4.0))))))
    ; 5.08d Dividend Payments
    (=> is_declaring_dividend
        (<= aggregate_dividends_since_1994_after_effect
            (+ 72000000.0 net_income_adjusted)))
    ; 5.08e Restricted LCR Investments
    (=> is_on_or_after_effective_date
        (or (<= aggregate_investments 200000000.0)
            excess_investments_equity_funded))
  )
)",

; is_on_or_after_effective_date: Bool, true iff this observation is on or after the Effective Date (5.08e).
; aggregate_investments: Real, USD aggregate of all Investments (5.08e).
; excess_investments_equity_funded: Bool, true iff all Investments above $200,000,000 are investments by the Borrower or LRC in LCR made from proceeds of a capital markets offering consisting solely of equity securities (5.08e proviso).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_proposing_additional_debt Bool)
    (debt_incurred_after_effective_date Real)
    (ebitda Real)
    (interest_expense_pro_forma_a Real)
    (period_ends_through_1994 Bool)
    (period_ends_in_1995 Bool)
    (period_ends_in_1996 Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (consolidated_capex_ex_lcr Real)
    (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
    (consolidated_debt Real)
    (is_declaring_dividend Bool)
    (aggregate_dividends_since_1994_after_effect Real)
    (net_income_adjusted Real)
    (is_on_or_after_effective_date Bool)
    (aggregate_investments Real)
    (excess_investments_equity_funded Bool)
  ) Bool

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_listed_quarter_end: Bool, true iff the observation date is the last day of a calendar quarter (Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30 or Dec 31) and so can be a date listed in the Section 7.12 tables.
; obs_year: Real, calendar year of the observation date (for example 1999).
; obs_month: Real, calendar month number of the observation date (3, 6, 9 or 12 on listed dates).
; indebtedness_excl_revolving: Real, Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on the test date, excluding the portion that constitutes Revolving Loans.
; avg_revolving_in_indebtedness: Real, average amount of Revolving Loans (the portion of Indebtedness) outstanding during the Test Period ending on the test date, with Test Period clause (ii) computed from the Closing Date.
; senior_indebtedness_excl_revolving: Real, Senior Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on the test date, excluding the portion that constitutes Revolving Loans.
; avg_revolving_in_senior: Real, average amount of Revolving Loans (the portion of Senior Indebtedness) outstanding during the Test Period ending on the test date.
; consolidated_ebitda: Real, Consolidated EBITDA of the Borrower for the Test Period ending on the test date.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_listed_quarter_end Bool) (obs_year Real) (obs_month Real) (indebtedness_excl_revolving Real) (avg_revolving_in_indebtedness Real) (senior_indebtedness_excl_revolving Real) (avg_revolving_in_senior Real) (consolidated_ebitda Real)) Bool
  (=> (and is_listed_quarter_end (>= obs_year 1998) (<= obs_year 2004))
      (and
        ; 7.12(a) Total Leverage Ratio maximum by test date
        (<= (/ (+ indebtedness_excl_revolving avg_revolving_in_indebtedness) consolidated_ebitda)
            (ite (= obs_year 1998) 4.25
            (ite (= obs_year 1999) (ite (<= obs_month 6) 4.25 4.0)
            (ite (= obs_year 2000) 3.75
            (ite (= obs_year 2001) 3.5 3.0)))))
        ; 7.12(b) Senior Leverage Ratio maximum by test date
        (<= (/ (+ senior_indebtedness_excl_revolving avg_revolving_in_senior) consolidated_ebitda)
            (ite (= obs_year 1998) 3.5
            (ite (= obs_year 1999) (ite (= obs_month 12) 3.25 3.5)
            (ite (= obs_year 2000) (ite (= obs_month 12) 3.0 3.25)
            (ite (= obs_year 2001) (ite (= obs_month 12) 2.5 3.0) 2.5)))))))
)

    (is_q2_2010_end Bool)
    (is_q3_2010_end Bool)
    (is_q4_2010_end Bool)
    (consolidated_ebitda_ttm Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)

    (accounts_balance Real)
    (inventory_balance Real)
    (revolving_loans_principal Real)
    (letter_of_credit_obligations Real)
    (is_on_or_after_fy2010_end Bool)
    (dscr_ttm Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) minimum Consolidated EBITDA, trailing twelve months, not below the stated amount
    (=> is_fy2009_end (>= consolidated_ebitda_ttm 8000000.0))
    (=> is_q1_2010_end (>= consolidated_ebitda_ttm 9500000.0))
    (=> is_q2_2010_end (>= consolidated_ebitda_ttm 11000000.0))
    (=> is_q3_2010_end (>= consolidated_ebitda_ttm 12500000.0))

    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_on_or_after_fy2010_end)

; current_liabilities: current liabilities in USD.
; non_current_liabilities: non-current liabilities in USD.
; annual_net_income_after_taxes: net income after taxes in USD for the fiscal year ending at the observation. Relevant only at fiscal year end.
; quarterly_pretax_profit: pre-tax profit (net profit before tax) in USD for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation.
; interest_expense_net_cap: interest expense in USD net of capitalized interest expense, for the quarter ending at the observation.
; depreciation_expense: depreciation expense in USD for the quarter ending at the observation.
; rent_expense: rent expense in USD for the quarter ending at the observation.
; amortization_expense: amortization expense in USD for the quarter ending at the observation.
; total_interest_expense: total interest expense in USD for the quarter ending at the observation.
; prior_current_maturity_ltd: prior period current maturity of long-term debt in USD.
; prior_current_maturity_sub_debt: prior period current maturity of subordinated debt in USD.
; total_funded_debt: all debt in USD except accounts payable, accruals, and current liabilities incurred in the normal course of business.
; ttm_pretax_profit: net profit before tax in USD for the trailing four quarters.
; ttm_interest_expense_net_cap: interest expense in USD net of capitalized interest expense, for the trailing four quarters.
; ttm_depreciation_expense: depreciation expense in USD for the trailing four quarters.
; ttm_amortization_expense: amortization expense in USD for the trailing four quarters.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (covenant_applies Bool)
  (bank_written_consent Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_fiscal_year_end Bool)
  (stockholders_equity Real)
  (subordinated_debt Real)
  (intangible_assets Real)
  (quarterly_net_income Real)
  (current_liabilities Real)
  (non_current_liabilities Real)
  (annual_net_income_after_taxes Real)
  (quarterly_pretax_profit Real)
  (interest_expense_net_cap Real)
  (depreciation_expense Real)
  (rent_expense Real)
  (amortization_expense Real)
  (total_interest_expense Real)
  (prior_current_maturity_ltd Real)
  (prior_current_maturity_sub_debt Real)
  (total_funded_debt Real)
  (ttm_pretax_profit Real)
  (ttm_interest_expense_net_cap Real)
  (ttm_depreciation_expense Real)
  (ttm_amortization_expense Real)) Bool
  (=> (and covenant_applies (not bank_written_consent))
    (and
      ; (a) TNW = equity + sub debt - intangibles >= 29,000,000 + 75% of quarterly net income (losses excluded)
      (>= (- (+ stockholders_equity subordinated_debt) intangible_assets)
          (+ 29000000.0 (* 0.75 (ite (> quarterly_net_income 0.0) quarterly_net_income 0.0))))
      ; (b) Total Liabilities / TNW <= 1.25
      (<= (/ (- (+ current_liabilities non_current_liabilities) subordinated_debt)
             (- (+ stockholders_equity subordinated_debt) intangible_assets))
          1.25)
      ; (c) annual net income after taxes at fiscal year end
      (=> is_fiscal_year_end (>= annual_net_income_after_taxes 1000000.0))
      ; (c) quarterly pre-tax profit at fiscal quarter end
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= quarterly_pretax_profit 250000.0))
      ; (d) EBITDAR coverage >= 2.0 at fiscal quarter end
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
          (>= (/ (+ quarterly_pretax_profit interest_expense_net_cap depreciation_expense rent_expense amortization_expense)
                 (+ total_interest_expense rent_expense prior_current_maturity_ltd prior_current_maturity_sub_debt))
              2.0))
      ; (e) Total Funded Debt / trailing four quarters EBITDA <= 2.0
      (<= (/ total_funded_debt
             (+ ttm_pretax_profit ttm_interest_expense_net_cap ttm_depreciation_expense ttm_amortization_expense))
          2.0))))

candidate.notes: Covenant is applied pointwise. Clauses (a), (b) and (e) have no calendar restriction, so they apply at every observation; (c) and (d) are gated by quarter-end and year-end flags. Tangible Net Worth, Total Liabilities, EBITDAR, the coverage denominator and EBITDA are inlined from their stated definitions. 'Quarterly net income' is read as net income for the fiscal quarter, with losses floored at zero. The source does not state the EBITDAR measurement period, so the quarter ending at the observation is assumed. Ratios are written as divisions, so a zero denominator is left to the evaluator to report as unresolved. QF_NRA is used because the denominators are variables.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

judge.reason: The formula matches Section 4.9 clause by clause. (a) TNW = equity + subordinated debt − intangibles, compared with ≥ $29M + 75% of positive-only quarterly net income. (b) Total Liabilities = current + non-current − subordinated debt, divided by TNW, ≤ 1.25. (c) Net income after taxes ≥ $1M at fiscal year end, and pre-tax profit ≥ $250K at fiscal quarter end. (d) EBITDAR = pre-tax profit + net interest + depreciation + rent + amortization, over total interest + rent + prior-period current maturities of long-term and subordinated debt, ≥ 2.0 at quarter end. (e) Total Funded Debt over trailing-four-quarter EBITDA (pre-tax profit + net interest + depreciation + amortization) ≤ 2.0, with correct strictness throughout. The written-consent exception and the covenant-active condition appear only as guards. The substantive financial tests stay in the formula, so the covenant is not hidden in an opaque flag. Calendar flags gate the periodic tests, and all parameters have clear, source-grounded comments. Divisions rely on the evaluator's unresolved-on-zero policy, and no positivity or other domain assumptions are added.

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_outstanding Bool) ; true if, at this observation, any Loan or other amount is owing to any Lender or the Administrative Agent under the agreement
  (is_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31 Bool) ; true if the observation date is the last day of a calendar month ending on or after October 31, 2006
  (prior_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31 Bool) ; true if the calendar month immediately before the observed month also ends on or after October 31, 2006
  (shutdown_ebit Real) ; Shutdown EBIT as of the observation date (last day of the calendar month)
  (is_period_end_2006_10_31 Bool) ; true if the observation date is October 31, 2006, the last day of the period March 31, 2006 through October 31, 2006
  (is_period_end_2006_11_30 Bool) ; true if the observation date is November 30, 2006, the last day of the period March 31, 2006 through November 30, 2006
  (is_period_end_2006_12_31 Bool) ; true if the observation date is December 31, 2006, the last day of the period March 31, 2006 through December 31, 2006
  (is_period_end_2007_01_31 Bool) ; true if the observation date is January 31, 2007, the last day of the period March 31, 2006 through January 31, 2007
  (is_period_end_2007_02_28 Bool) ; true if the observation date is February 28, 2007, the last day of the period March 31, 2006 through February 28, 2007
  (is_period_end_2007_03_31 Bool) ; true if the observation date is March 31, 2007, the last day of the period March 31, 2006 through March 31, 2007
  (shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash Real) ; in dollars, the amount of the Shutdown Subsidiaries' aggregate Modified Net Working Capital existing as of March 31, 2006 that has been converted to cash from March 31, 2006 through the observation date
  (commercial_ebit_month Real) ; in dollars, Commercial EBIT for the calendar month ending on the observation date
  (commercial_ebit_prior_month Real) ; in dollars, Commercial EBIT for the calendar month immediately preceding the observed month
  (residential_ebit_month Real) ; in dollars, Residential EBIT for the calendar month ending on the observation date
  (residential_ebit_prior_month Real) ; in dollars, Residential EBIT for the calendar month immediately preceding the observed month
  (fccr Real) ; Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the observation date, calculated on a trailing twelve calendar month basis, as a number (x in x to 1.00)
  (leverage_ratio Real) ; Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, calculated on a trailing twelve calendar month basis, as a number (x in x to 1.00)
  (is_leverage_month_end_2006_10_31_to_2007_03_31 Bool) ; true if the observation date is a period ending in the table from October 31, 2006 through March 31, 2007 (the 4.75 to 1.00 rows)
  (is_leverage_month_end_on_or_after_2007_04_30 Bool) ; true if the observation date is April 30, 2007 or the last day of any calendar month thereafter
  (prior_to_bofa_loan_termination_date Bool) ; true if the observation time is prior to the BofA Loan Termination Date
  (cash_collateral Real) ; in dollars, Cash Collateral in the Cash Collateral Account at the observation time
  (is_quarter_end_for_ebitda_capex_test Bool) ; true if the observation date is the last day of the second, third or fourth fiscal quarter of the Borrower's 2006 fiscal year or of the first fiscal quarter of the 2007 fiscal year
  (ebitda_capex_level_quarter Real) ; in dollars, EBITDA-CapEx Level for the single fiscal quarter ending on the observation date
  (is_cumulative_ebitda_capex_measurement_date Bool) ; true if the observation date is the last day of a period of consecutive quarters commencing on the first day of the second fiscal quarter of the Borrower's 2006 fiscal year and ending no later than the last day of the first quarter of the 2007 fiscal year
  (ebitda_capex_level_cumulative Real) ; in dollars, cumulative EBITDA-CapEx Level for the consecutive quarters from the first day of the second fiscal quarter of the 2006 fiscal year through the observation date
)
Bool
  (=> obligations_outstanding
    (and
      ; (a) Shutdown EBIT must not be less than zero
      (=> is_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31 (>= shutdown_ebit 0.0))
      ; (b) minimum conversion to cash by period end
      (=> is_period_end_2006_10_31 (>= shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash 17200000.0))
      (=> is_period_end_2006_11_30 (>= shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash 18900000.0))
      (=> is_period_end_2006_12_31 (>= shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash 20600000.0))
      (=> is_period_end_2007_01_31 (>= shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash 22300000.0))
      (=> is_period_end_2007_02_28 (>= shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash 22600000.0))
      (=> is_period_end_2007_03_31 (>= shutdown_nwc_converted_to_cash 23600000.0))
      ; (c) Commercial EBIT must not be below 1,250,000 in both of two consecutive months
      (=> (and is_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31 prior_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31)
          (not (and (< commercial_ebit_month 1250000.0) (< commercial_ebit_prior_month 1250000.0))))
      ; (d) Residential EBIT must not be below 1,750,000 in both of two consecutive months
      (=> (and is_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31 prior_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31)
          (not (and (< residential_ebit_month 1750000.0) (< residential_ebit_prior_month 1750000.0))))
      ; (e) fixed charge coverage ratio at least 1.25
      (=> is_month_end_on_or_after_2006_10_31 (>= fccr 1.25))
      ; (f) leverage ratio must not exceed the table value
      (=> is_leverage_month_end_2006_10_31_to_2007_03_31 (<= leverage_ratio 4.75))
      (=> is_leverage_month_end_on_or_after_2007_04_30 (<= leverage_ratio 4.25))
      ; (g) Cash Collateral at least 20,000,000 prior to the BofA Loan Termination Date
      (=> prior_to_bofa_loan_termination_date (>= cash_collateral 20000000.0))
      ; (h)(i) quarterly EBITDA-CapEx Level at least negative 20,000,000
      (=> is_quarter_end_for_ebitda_capex_test (>= ebitda_capex_level_quarter (- 20000000.0)))
      ; (h)(ii) cumulative EBITDA-CapEx Level at least negative 20,000,000
      (=> is_cumulative_ebitda_capex_measurement_date (>= ebitda_capex_level_cumulative (- 20000000.0)))
    )
  )
)",

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter, the date as of which ratios are tested.
; is_compliance_period: true iff the financial statements tested are for a period ending on or after March 31, 1998.
; total_current_assets: PBS total current assets (GAAP) at the quarter end.
; total_current_liabilities: PBS total current liabilities (GAAP) at the quarter end.
; ebitda_ttm: EBITDA for the 12-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; interest_expense_ttm: total interest expense deducted in determining net income for the 12-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; current_maturities_ltd: all current maturities of principal on all unsubordinated long-term indebtedness of Borrowers, excluding any amount outstanding under the Line of Credit, as of the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; senior_funded_debt: total funded unsubordinated indebtedness of Borrowers per GAAP, including capital leases, excluding indebtedness and capital leases of U.S. Trucking, Inc.
; term_loan_made: true iff the Term Loan has been made as of the observation, so the post-Term-Loan test (d) applies; false means the pre-Term-Loan schedule (c) applies.
; date_thru_1998_06_30: true iff the observation date is from the date of the agreement to and including June 30, 1998.
; date_1998_07_01_to_09_30: true iff the observation date is from July 1, 1998 to and including September 30, 1998.
; date_1998_10_01_to_12_31: true iff the observation date is from October 1, 1998 to and including December 31, 1998.
; date_from_1999_01_01: true iff the observation date is on or after January 1, 1999.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_compliance_period Bool)
    (total_current_assets Real)
    (total_current_liabilities Real)
    (ebitda_ttm Real)
    (interest_expense_ttm Real)
    (current_maturities_ltd Real)
    (senior_funded_debt Real)
    (term_loan_made Bool)
    (date_thru_1998_06_30 Bool)
    (date_1998_07_01_to_09_30 Bool)
    (date_1998_10_01_to_12_31 Bool)
    (date_from_1999_01_01 Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_compliance_period)
      (and
        ; (a) Current Ratio >= 1.20
        (>= (/ total_current_assets total_current_liabilities) 1.2)
        ; (b) Debt Service Coverage Ratio >= 1.5
        (>= (/ ebitda_ttm (+ interest_expense_ttm current_maturities_ltd)) 1.5)
        ; (c) before the Term Loan: dated Senior Funded Debt to EBITDA limits
        (=> (not term_loan_made)
            (and
              (=> date_thru_1998_06_30 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 6.5))
              (=> date_1998_07_01_to_09_30 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 6.0))
              (=> date_1998_10_01_to_12_31 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 5.5))
              (=> date_from_1999_01_01 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 5.0))))
        ; (d) from and after the Term Loan: Senior Funded Debt to EBITDA <= 3.5
        (=> term_loan_made (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 3.5)))))",

    {"name": "total_current_assets", "meaning": "PBS total current assets (GAAP) at the quarter end, the numerator of the Current Ratio.", "source_quote": "total current assets"},
    {"name": "total_current_liabilities", "meaning": "PBS total current liabilities (GAAP) at the quarter end, the denominator of the Current Ratio.", "source_quote": "total current liabilities"},
    {"name": "ebitda_ttm", "meaning": "EBITDA for the 12-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter. Used in the Debt Service Coverage Ratio and the Senior Funded Debt to EBITDA Ratio.", "source_quote": "EBITDA for the twelve (12) month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "interest_expense_ttm", "meaning": "Total interest expense deducted in determining net income for the 12-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "total interest expense deducted in determining net income for the twelve (12) month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "current_maturities_ltd", "meaning": "Current maturities of principal on all unsubordinated long-term indebtedness of Borrowers, excluding any amount outstanding under the Line of Credit, as of the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "all current maturities of principal with respect to all unsubordinated long-term indebtedness, excluding any amount outstanding under the Line of Credit, of Borrowers as of the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "senior_funded_debt", "meaning": "Senior Funded Debt: total funded unsubordinated indebtedness of Borrowers per GAAP, including capital leases, excluding indebtedness and capital leases of U.S. Trucking, Inc.", "source_quote": "total funded unsubordinated indebtedness, according to GAAP and including capital leases but excluding any indebtedness and capital leases of U.S. Trucking, Inc., of Borrowers"},
    {"name": "term_loan_made", "meaning": "True iff the Term Loan has been made as of the observation, so test (d) applies. False means it has not been made, so the pre-Term-Loan schedule (c) applies.", "source_quote": "From and after the making of the Term Loan"},
    {"name": "date_thru_1998_06_30", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is from the date of the agreement to and including June 30, 1998.", "source_quote": "From the date hereof to and including June 30, 1998"},
    {"name": "date_1998_07_01_to_09_30", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is from July 1, 1998 to and including September 30, 1998.", "source_quote": "From July 1, 1998 to and including September 30, 1998"},

; interest_expense_ttm: total interest expense deducted in determining net income for the 12-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; current_maturities_ltd: all current maturities of principal on all unsubordinated long-term indebtedness of Borrowers, excluding any amount outstanding under the Line of Credit, as of the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; senior_funded_debt: total funded unsubordinated indebtedness of Borrowers per GAAP, including capital leases, excluding indebtedness and capital leases of U.S. Trucking, Inc.
; term_loan_made: true iff the Term Loan has been made as of the observation, so the post-Term-Loan test (d) applies; false means the pre-Term-Loan schedule (c) applies.
; date_thru_1998_06_30: true iff the observation date is from the date of the agreement to and including June 30, 1998.
; date_1998_07_01_to_09_30: true iff the observation date is from July 1, 1998 to and including September 30, 1998.
; date_1998_10_01_to_12_31: true iff the observation date is from October 1, 1998 to and including December 31, 1998.
; date_from_1999_01_01: true iff the observation date is on or after January 1, 1999.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_compliance_period Bool)
    (total_current_assets Real)
    (total_current_liabilities Real)
    (ebitda_ttm Real)
    (interest_expense_ttm Real)
    (current_maturities_ltd Real)
    (senior_funded_debt Real)
    (term_loan_made Bool)
    (date_thru_1998_06_30 Bool)
    (date_1998_07_01_to_09_30 Bool)
    (date_1998_10_01_to_12_31 Bool)
    (date_from_1999_01_01 Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_compliance_period)
      (and
        ; (a) Current Ratio >= 1.20
        (>= (/ total_current_assets total_current_liabilities) 1.2)
        ; (b) Debt Service Coverage Ratio >= 1.5
        (>= (/ ebitda_ttm (+ interest_expense_ttm current_maturities_ltd)) 1.5)
        ; (c) before the Term Loan: dated Senior Funded Debt to EBITDA limits
        (=> (not term_loan_made)
            (and
              (=> date_thru_1998_06_30 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 6.5))
              (=> date_1998_07_01_to_09_30 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 6.0))
              (=> date_1998_10_01_to_12_31 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 5.5))
              (=> date_from_1999_01_01 (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 5.0))))
        ; (d) from and after the Term Loan: Senior Funded Debt to EBITDA <= 3.5
        (=> term_loan_made (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm) 3.5)))))

Ratios with stated definitions (Senior Debt and Total Debt over EBITDA) are kept as divisions, so a zero adjusted EBITDA is reported by the evaluator as unresolved. z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

; incurs_additional_debt: true iff at this observation the Gaming Enterprise Borrower incurs, or permits the incurrence of, additional Debt.
; lender_written_consent: true iff Lender has given written consent to this additional Debt.
; uncured_default_exists: true iff an uncured Default exists at this observation.
; debt_is_unsecured: true iff the additional Debt is unsecured.
; debt_due_in_less_than_six_months: true iff the additional unsecured Debt is due in less than six months.
; aggregate_short_term_unsecured_debt: Real, dollars; aggregate of all unsecured Debt due in less than six months of the Gaming Enterprise Borrower outstanding at this time, including the additional Debt.
; tangible_net_worth: Real, dollars; Tangible Net Worth of the Gaming Enterprise Borrower at this observation.
; ebitda_prior_12_months: Real, dollars; EBITDA of the Gaming Enterprise Borrower for the 12 calendar months immediately preceding the incurrence of the additional Debt.
; max_debt_service_incl_additional: Real, dollars; maximum Debt Service on all Debt of the Gaming Enterprise Borrower including the additional Debt, over the current fiscal year and all future fiscal years.
; proceeds_used_solely_to_refund_long_debt: true iff the proceeds of the additional unsecured Debt are used solely to refund existing outstanding Debt of a maturity in excess of one year.
; has_lower_annual_debt_service_than_refinanced: true iff the additional Debt has a lower annual Debt Service than the Debt refinanced.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (incurs_additional_debt Bool)
  (lender_written_consent Bool)
  (uncured_default_exists Bool)
  (debt_is_unsecured Bool)
  (debt_due_in_less_than_six_months Bool)
  (aggregate_short_term_unsecured_debt Real)
  (tangible_net_worth Real)
  (ebitda_prior_12_months Real)
  (max_debt_service_incl_additional Real)
  (proceeds_used_solely_to_refund_long_debt Bool)
  (has_lower_annual_debt_service_than_refinanced Bool)) Bool
  (=> incurs_additional_debt
      (or

        (and (not uncured_default_exists)
             debt_is_unsecured
             debt_due_in_less_than_six_months

                 (ite (>= 50000.0 (* 0.02 tangible_net_worth))

             has_lower_annual_debt_service_than_refinanced))))

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_within_covenant_term Bool)
  (is_quarter_ending_on_or_after_2014_09_30 Bool)

  (is_quarter_ending_2016_03_31_to_2016_12_31 Bool)
  (is_quarter_ending_on_or_after_2017_03_31 Bool)
) Bool
  (and
    ; 7.08(a): interest coverage must not be less than 3.00:1.00
    (=> (and is_within_covenant_term is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_ending_on_or_after_2014_09_30)
        (>= consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio 3.0))
    ; 7.08(b)(i): leverage must not be greater than 4.50:1.00

    ; 7.08(b)(ii): leverage must not be greater than 4.25:1.00
    (=> (and is_within_covenant_term is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_ending_2015_06_30_to_2015_12_31)
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 4.25))
    ; 7.08(b)(iii): leverage must not be greater than 4.00:1.00
    (=> (and is_within_covenant_term is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_ending_2016_03_31_to_2016_12_31)

    ; 7.08(b)(iv): leverage must not be greater than 3.75:1.00
    (=> (and is_within_covenant_term is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_ending_on_or_after_2017_03_31)
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.75))
  )
)

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_LRA)
; days_since_fiscal_year_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of the most recent completed fiscal year of Debtor (Section 7.1.1 deadline clock).
; annual_financials_delivered: true iff, by the observation, Debtor has delivered to Lender the audited balance sheet and statements of earnings, retained earnings and cash flows for that most recent completed fiscal year, with prior-year comparative figures (Section 7.1.1).
; days_since_fiscal_month_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of the most recent completed fiscal month of Debtor (Section 7.1.2 deadline clock).
; monthly_financials_delivered: true iff, by the observation, Debtor has delivered the officer-certified balance sheet and statements of earnings, retained earnings and cash flows for that most recent completed fiscal month, with comparative figures for the same month of the preceding fiscal year (Section 7.1.2).
; days_since_month_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of the most recent completed month (Section 7.1.5 and 7.1.8 deadline clock).
; agings_inventory_delivered: true iff, by the observation, Debtor has delivered agings of accounts payable and accounts receivable and inventory listings, each as of the end of that most recent completed month (Section 7.1.5).
; officer_statement_delivered: true iff, by the observation, Debtor has delivered the Exhibit E statement certified by the chief financial officer for that most recent completed month (Section 7.1.8).
; days_since_last_collateral_report: days elapsed at the observation since Debtor last delivered to Lender the Collateral-Obligation Ratio report (Section 7.1.4).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (days_since_fiscal_year_end Real)
  (annual_financials_delivered Bool)
  (days_since_fiscal_month_end Real)
  (monthly_financials_delivered Bool)
  (days_since_month_end Real)
  (agings_inventory_delivered Bool)
  (officer_statement_delivered Bool)
  (days_since_last_collateral_report Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; 7.1.1: annual financials due within 90 days after fiscal year end
    (=> (> days_since_fiscal_year_end 90) annual_financials_delivered)
    ; 7.1.2: monthly financials due within 30 days after fiscal month end
    (=> (> days_since_fiscal_month_end 30) monthly_financials_delivered)
    ; 7.1.5: agings and inventory listings due within 15 days after month end
    (=> (> days_since_month_end 15) agings_inventory_delivered)
    ; 7.1.8: Exhibit E statement due within 30 days after month end
    (=> (> days_since_month_end 30) officer_statement_delivered)
    ; 7.1.4: Collateral-Obligation Ratio report at least weekly
    (<= days_since_last_collateral_report 7)
  )
)

candidate.notes: Covers all of Section 5.8 except (l), which is [Reserved]. Percentages are decimal fractions. QF_NRA is used because ratio tests divide by non-constant denominators; a zero denominator is left to the evaluator to report as unresolved. (b)-(e) divide as written. (g), (j) and (m) use multiplication because the source states them as percentages of a base. 'At no time' clauses (g), (i), (j), (k), (m) apply at every observation. (j) has no calendar trigger beyond 'such date', so it applies at every observation. The 'to the extent necessary' dividend exceptions in (h) are modeled as total necessary amounts, with the ceiling being the greater of 90% of FFO and the applicable necessary amount. This reading is an interpretation. During a 6.1(a) Event of Default, only the REIT-necessary amount is allowed. Under (m), the Borrower, the Guarantor and their sum are each tested strictly below 20% of Tangible FMV.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; makes_rjp: true if, at this observation, Company, a Guarantor Subsidiary or a Restricted Subsidiary declares or makes a Restricted Junior Payment.
; clause_a_payment: true if the payment is a clause (a) payment (payments to Holding required under the Corporate Services Reimbursement Agreement, or reimbursement of Holding's specified fees and expenses).
; no_eod_8_1a: true if no Event of Default under Section 8.1(a) has occurred and is continuing.
; clause_b_payment: true if the payment is required under the Holding Tax Sharing Agreement.
; tax_sharing_paid_amount: Real, amount paid by Company and its Subsidiaries under the Holding Tax Sharing Agreement (USD).
; hypothetical_consolidated_tax_liability: Real, consolidated tax liabilities that would be payable if Company and its Subsidiaries filed a consolidated tax return with Company as parent (USD).
; clause_c_interest_payment: true if the payment lets Holding make regularly scheduled interest payments on the Convertible Debentures or on post-Closing Date Holding Indebtedness whose proceeds funded a Holding Capital Contribution.
; clause_c_ii_payment: true if the payment lets Holding make mandatory prepayments or redemptions, conversion-right payments, or repayment at maturity under clause (c)(ii).
; c_ii_paid_solely_from_permitted_proceeds: true if the clause (c)(ii) amounts are paid solely from proceeds of Indebtedness under Section 6.1(x) or 6.1(y) or Additional Term Loans.
; clause_d_payment: true if the payment lets Holding fund regulatory capital or other requirements of Holding's Insurance Subsidiaries.
; clause_d_fiscal_year_aggregate: Real, aggregate clause (d) payments in the current Fiscal Year including this payment (USD).
; no_default_or_eod_d: true if no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or is caused by the payment.
; pro_forma_6_7_compliance: true if Company and its Restricted Subsidiaries comply with the Section 6.7 financial covenants on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to the payment, as of the last day of the most recently ended Fiscal Quarter.
; clause_e_payment: true if the payment is an additional Restricted Junior Payment to Holding under clause (e).
; no_default_or_eod_e: true if no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or would be caused by the payment.
; clause_e_aggregate: Real, aggregate clause (e) payments including this payment (USD).
; clause_e_fiscal_years_counted: Real, number of Fiscal Years, including the current one, for which the $100,000,000 annual amount accumulates (unused amounts carry forward).
; holding_capital_contributions_not_otherwise_applied: Real, aggregate Holding Capital Contributions that are Not Otherwise Applied (USD).
; pro_forma_leverage_ratio: Real, Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter, on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to the additional Restricted Junior Payments.
; reduced_leverage_ratio_amount: Real, Reduced Leverage Ratio Amount applicable as of that day.
; cumulative_excess_cash_flow_not_otherwise_applied: Real, Cumulative Excess Cash Flow that is Not Otherwise Applied (USD); each period's Excess Cash Flow is floored at zero, per the source definition.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (makes_rjp Bool)
  (clause_a_payment Bool)
  (no_eod_8_1a Bool)
  (clause_b_payment Bool)
  (tax_sharing_paid_amount Real)
  (hypothetical_consolidated_tax_liability Real)
  (clause_c_interest_payment Bool)
  (clause_c_ii_payment Bool)
  (c_ii_paid_solely_from_permitted_proceeds Bool)
  (clause_d_payment Bool)
  (clause_d_fiscal_year_aggregate Real)
  (no_default_or_eod_d Bool)
  (pro_forma_6_7_compliance Bool)
  (clause_e_payment Bool)
  (no_default_or_eod_e Bool)
  (clause_e_aggregate Real)
  (clause_e_fiscal_years_counted Real)
  (holding_capital_contributions_not_otherwise_applied Real)
  (pro_forma_leverage_ratio Real)
  (reduced_leverage_ratio_amount Real)
  (cumulative_excess_cash_flow_not_otherwise_applied Real)
) Bool
  (=> makes_rjp
    (or
      (and clause_a_payment no_eod_8_1a)
      (and clause_b_payment
           (<= tax_sharing_paid_amount hypothetical_consolidated_tax_liability))
      (and clause_c_interest_payment (not clause_c_ii_payment))
      (and clause_c_ii_payment c_ii_paid_solely_from_permitted_proceeds)
      (and clause_d_payment
           (<= clause_d_fiscal_year_aggregate 10000000.0)
           no_default_or_eod_d
           pro_forma_6_7_compliance)
      (and clause_e_payment
           no_default_or_eod_e
           (<= clause_e_aggregate
               (+ (* 100000000.0 clause_e_fiscal_years_counted)
                  holding_capital_contributions_not_otherwise_applied
                  (ite (<= pro_forma_leverage_ratio reduced_leverage_ratio_amount)
                       cumulative_excess_cash_flow_not_otherwise_applied
                       0.0))))
    )))",

    {"name": "makes_rjp", "meaning": "True if, at this observation, Company, a Guarantor Subsidiary or a Restricted Subsidiary declares or makes a Restricted Junior Payment.", "source_quote": "declare or make any Restricted Junior Payment"},
    {"name": "clause_a_payment", "meaning": "True if the payment is a clause (a) payment: a payment to Holding required under the Corporate Services Reimbursement Agreement, or a reimbursement of Holding's specified fees and expenses.", "source_quote": "Company may make payments to Holding to the extent required under the Corporate Services Reimbursement Agreement"},
    {"name": "no_eod_8_1a", "meaning": "True if no Event of Default under Section 8.1(a) has occurred and is continuing.", "source_quote": "so long as no Event of Default pursuant to Section 8.1(a) shall have occurred and be continuing"},
    {"name": "clause_b_payment", "meaning": "True if the payment is made by Company or a Restricted Subsidiary and is required under the Holding Tax Sharing Agreement.", "source_quote": "Company and its Restricted Subsidiaries may make payments required under the Holding Tax Sharing Agreement"},
    {"name": "tax_sharing_paid_amount", "meaning": "Amount paid by Company and its Subsidiaries under the Holding Tax Sharing Agreement, in USD.", "source_quote": "in no event shall the amount paid by Company and its Subsidiaries exceed the consolidated tax liabilities"},
    {"name": "hypothetical_consolidated_tax_liability", "meaning": "Consolidated tax liabilities that would be payable if Company and its Subsidiaries filed a consolidated tax return with Company as parent, in USD.", "source_quote": "the consolidated tax liabilities that would be payable if Company and its Subsidiaries filed a consolidated tax return with Company as the parent company"},
    {"name": "clause_c_interest_payment", "meaning": "True if the payment lets Holding make regularly scheduled interest payments on the Convertible Debentures or on post-Closing Date Holding Indebtedness whose proceeds funded a Holding Capital Contribution.", "source_quote": "make regularly scheduled payments of interest in respect of"},
    {"name": "clause_c_ii_payment", "meaning": "True if the payment lets Holding make mandatory prepayments or redemptions, conversion-right payments, or repayment at maturity under clause (c)(ii).", "source_quote": "make mandatory prepayments or redemptions (including payment of premium) of"},
    {"name": "c_ii_paid_solely_from_permitted_proceeds", "meaning": "True if the clause (c)(ii) amounts are paid solely from proceeds of Indebtedness under Section 6.1(x) or 6.1(y) or Additional Term Loans.", "source_quote": "paid solely from the proceeds of Indebtedness incurred pursuant to Section 6.1(x) or Section 6.1(y) or Additional Term Loans"},
    {"name": "clause_d_payment", "meaning": "True if the payment lets Holding fund regulatory capital or other requirements of Holding's Insurance Subsidiaries.", "source_quote": "to fund regulatory capital or other requirements relating to the Insurance Subsidiaries of Holding"},
    {"name": "clause_d_fiscal_year_aggregate", "meaning": "Aggregate clause (d) payments in the current Fiscal Year, including this payment, in USD.", "source_quote": "in an aggregate amount not to exceed $10,000,000 in any Fiscal Year"},
    {"name": "no_default_or_eod_d", "meaning": "True if no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or is caused by the payment.", "source_quote": "no Default or Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing or shall be caused thereby"},
    {"name": "pro_forma_6_7_compliance", "meaning": "True if Company and its Restricted Subsidiaries comply with the Section 6.7 financial covenants on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to the payment, as of the last day of the most recently ended Fiscal Quarter.", "source_quote": "shall be in compliance with the financial covenants set forth in Section 6.7 on a Pro Forma Basis"},
    {"name": "clause_e_payment", "meaning": "True if the payment is an additional Restricted Junior Payment to Holding under clause (e).", "source_quote": "Company may make additional Restricted Junior Payments to Holding"},
    {"name": "no_default_or_eod_e", "meaning": "True if no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or would be caused by the payment.", "source_quote": "so long as no Default or Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing or would be caused thereby"},
    {"name": "clause_e_aggregate", "meaning": "Aggregate clause (e) payments including this payment, in USD.", "source_quote": "in an aggregate amount not to exceed the sum of"},
    {"name": "clause_e_fiscal_years_counted", "meaning": "Number of Fiscal Years, including the current one, for which the $100,000,000 annual amount accumulates, with unused amounts carrying forward.", "source_quote": "$100,000,000 in any Fiscal Year (with any unused amounts accumulating on a cumulative basis to each subsequent Fiscal Year)"},
    {"name": "holding_capital_contributions_not_otherwise_applied", "meaning": "Aggregate Holding Capital Contributions that are Not Otherwise Applied, in USD.", "source_quote": "the aggregate amount of Holding Capital Contributions that are Not Otherwise Applied"},
    {"name": "pro_forma_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter, determined on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to the additional Restricted Junior Payments.", "source_quote": "the Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter (determined on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to such additional Restricted Junior Payments)"},
    {"name": "reduced_leverage_ratio_amount", "meaning": "Reduced Leverage Ratio Amount applicable as of the last day of the immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter.", "source_quote": "does not exceed Reduced Leverage Ratio Amount applicable as of such day"},
    {"name": "cumulative_excess_cash_flow_not_otherwise_applied", "meaning": "Cumulative Excess Cash Flow that is Not Otherwise Applied, in USD; each period's Excess Cash Flow is floored at zero per the source definition.", "source_quote": "the amount of Cumulative Excess Cash Flow that is Not Otherwise Applied"}
  ],
  "notes": "Pointwise translation of Section 6.4: whenever a Restricted Junior Payment is declared or made, it must fit at least one exception, clauses (a)-(e). Each clause's conditions are encoded as its own conjunction, and the clause (c)(ii) proviso is applied only to (ii) payments. Clause (e) cap = $100,000,000 times fiscal years counted, plus Holding Capital Contributions Not Otherwise Applied, plus Cumulative Excess Cash Flow Not Otherwise Applied only if the pro forma Leverage Ratio does not exceed the Reduced Leverage Ratio Amount (non-strict). Cumulative aggregates and Defined-term quantities are supplied as evaluator inputs because the source gives no state-update rules. The Section 6 lead-in is covered by pointwise applicability to Restricted Subsidiaries."
}

That input is only loosely defined: the accumulation start year (for example the Closing Date fiscal year) is not stated. The formula therefore cannot be verified against the source's "unused amounts accumulating" rule.

clause_e_aggregate is described only as "aggregate clause (e) payments including this payment". Its period is not stated, either cumulative since the start of accumulation or per Fiscal Year. This is needed to match the cumulative comparison against the (i)+(ii)+(iii) cap.

clause_a_payment is described as reimbursement of Holding's "specified fees and expenses". It does not state the actual source conditions: Transaction costs paid or payable within 180 days of the Closing Date, or costs of an unsuccessful equity or debt offering, Permitted Acquisition or Investment. This does not meet the requirement for precise parameter meanings.

Clause (c) is encoded as (interest and not c_ii) or (c_ii and proceeds proviso). A payment that combines scheduled interest with a (c)(ii) payment is judged only by the proviso, which the source does not require for the interest part. The (c)(ii) comment also does not say that the prepayment, redemption or repayment must relate to the Convertible Debentures or the clause (i)(B) Indebtedness.
The cumulative Excess Cash Flow input is said to be floored at zero per period, but the flooring is done outside the function. The comment asserts a definition the formula does not enforce.
judge.reason: The structure of the clause (a) to (e) disjunction and the strict and non-strict inequalities match the source in most places. However, several key parameters (clause_a_payment, clause_e_fiscal_years_counted, clause_e_aggregate) are vague or underspecified, and the clause (e)(i) accumulation and the clause (c) split are only approximated. These gaps prevent establishing a faithful formalization under the required parameter-precision standard.

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrowers.
; in_tfd_period_1: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls from and including the date hereof to and including May 31, 2004 (limit 3.25 to 1.0).
; in_tfd_period_2: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls from and including August 31, 2004 to and including May 31, 2005 (limit 3.00 to 1.0).
; in_tfd_period_3: true iff the fiscal quarter end falls from and including August 31, 2005 and at all times thereafter (limit 2.75 to 1.0).
; total_funded_debt: Total Funded Debt of the Borrowers at the observation time, as defined in the credit agreement.
; ebitda_four_quarters: EBITDA of the Borrowers for the four fiscal quarters then ended.
; fixed_charges_four_quarters: Fixed Charges of the Borrowers for the same four fiscal quarters then ended.
; net_worth: Net Worth of the Borrowers at the observation time.
; capex_fiscal_year_to_date: aggregate Capital Expenditures of the Borrowers and their Subsidiaries in the current fiscal year to the observation time, in US dollars (or Australian/NZ Dollar Equivalent). It excludes Capital Expenditures made with Net Cash Proceeds of any Event of Loss as permitted by Section 2.2(b)(i) and those made with proceeds of grants from governmental entities.
; senior_ratio_below_2_every_quarter: true iff the Total Senior Funded Debt/EBITDA Ratio was strictly less than 2.0 to 1.0 for each fiscal quarter of the current fiscal year.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (in_tfd_period_1 Bool)
  (in_tfd_period_2 Bool)
  (in_tfd_period_3 Bool)
  (total_funded_debt Real)
  (ebitda_four_quarters Real)
  (fixed_charges_four_quarters Real)
  (net_worth Real)
  (capex_fiscal_year_to_date Real)
  (senior_ratio_below_2_every_quarter Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) Total Funded Debt Ratio: TFD / EBITDA not more than the period limit
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_tfd_period_1)
        (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda_four_quarters) 3.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_tfd_period_2)
        (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda_four_quarters) 3.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_tfd_period_3)
        (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda_four_quarters) 2.75))
    ; (b) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio: EBITDA / Fixed Charges not less than 1.5
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters fixed_charges_four_quarters) 1.5))
    ; (c) Leverage Ratio: TFD / (TFD + Net Worth) not more than 0.60
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (<= (/ total_funded_debt (+ total_funded_debt net_worth)) 0.6))
    ; (d) Capital Expenditures: 25,000,000 cap if the senior ratio proviso is met, else 20,000,000
    (<= capex_fiscal_year_to_date
        (ite senior_ratio_below_2_every_quarter 25000000.0 20000000.0))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_four_quarter_period_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Borrower.
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as at the observation date, as an atomic ratio (x in x:1.00).
; consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio: Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio as at the observation date, as an atomic ratio (x in x:1.00).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_after_closing_date: true iff the observation date is a fiscal quarter end that follows the Closing Date.
; is_before_endako_completion_quarter: true iff the observation date is not later than the last day of the fiscal quarter preceding the Endako Completion Date (also true if the Endako Completion Date has not yet occurred).
; is_after_endako_completion_date: true iff the observation date is a fiscal quarter end following the Endako Completion Date (Endako Project operated at an average of 80% of production design capacity over a 75-day period).
; is_before_mt_milligan_completion_quarter: true iff the observation date is not later than the last day of the fiscal quarter preceding the Mt. Milligan Completion Date (also true if that date has not yet occurred).
; consolidated_liquidity: Consolidated Liquidity at the observation date, in US dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_four_quarter_period_end Bool)
                            (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (is_after_closing_date Bool)
                            (is_before_endako_completion_quarter Bool)
                            (is_after_endako_completion_date Bool)
                            (is_before_mt_milligan_completion_quarter Bool)
                            (consolidated_liquidity Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; 7.1(a): leverage must not exceed 3.00:1.00
    (=> is_four_quarter_period_end (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.0))
    ; 7.1(b): interest coverage must not be less than 3.00:1.00
    (=> is_four_quarter_period_end (>= consolidated_interest_coverage_ratio 3.0))
    ; 7.1(c)(i): liquidity not less than $100,000,000 before Endako completion
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_after_closing_date is_before_endako_completion_quarter)
        (>= consolidated_liquidity 100000000.0))
    ; 7.1(c)(ii): liquidity not less than $75,000,000 after Endako completion, before Mt. Milligan completion
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_after_endako_completion_date is_before_mt_milligan_completion_quarter)
        (>= consolidated_liquidity 75000000.0))))

; consent_obtained: true iff consent has been obtained in the manner set forth in Section 12.10 for the observation.

; in_period_nov_1_1996_through_oct_31_1998: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date falls from November 1, 1996 through and including October 31, 1998 (required ratio 2.0 to 1.0).
; in_period_nov_1_1998_and_thereafter: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date falls on or after November 1, 1998 (required ratio 2.5 to 1.0).
; net_income: Net Income of Maxim and its Subsidiaries for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on or immediately prior to the observation date, on the basis the covenant requires for that measurement period (annualized pro forma for the period ending Oct 31, 1996; the combined Maxim/Image basis stated for the periods ending Jan 31, Apr 30 and Jul 31, 1997).
; income_franchise_taxes_paid_cash: income and franchise taxes paid in cash during the same measurement period, on the same basis.
; interest_expense_paid_cash: Interest Expense paid in cash during the same measurement period, on the same basis.
; interest_expense: Interest Expense for the same measurement period (denominator), on the same basis.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (obligations_outstanding_or_commitments_not_terminated Bool)
    (consent_obtained Bool)
    (in_period_closing_date_through_oct_31_1996 Bool)
    (in_period_nov_1_1996_through_oct_31_1998 Bool)
    (in_period_nov_1_1998_and_thereafter Bool)
    (net_income Real)
    (income_franchise_taxes_paid_cash Real)
    (interest_expense_paid_cash Real)
    (interest_expense Real)
  ) Bool

           obligations_outstanding_or_commitments_not_terminated
           (not consent_obtained))
      (and
        (=> in_period_closing_date_through_oct_31_1996
            (>= (/ (+ net_income income_franchise_taxes_paid_cash interest_expense_paid_cash) interest_expense) 1.75))
        (=> in_period_nov_1_1996_through_oct_31_1998
            (>= (/ (+ net_income income_franchise_taxes_paid_cash interest_expense_paid_cash) interest_expense) 2.0))
        (=> in_period_nov_1_1998_and_thereafter
            (>= (/ (+ net_income income_franchise_taxes_paid_cash interest_expense_paid_cash) interest_expense) 2.5)))))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

issues: The source requires the ratio to be maintained 'as of the last day of each Fiscal Quarter, or the immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter'. The candidate tests only the ratio at the current quarter-end observation and drops the alternative 'immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter' measurement date.

The candidate has no input for the Parent Cash Flow Coverage Ratio as of the immediately preceding Fiscal Quarter, so it cannot express that alternative. This makes it stricter than the source if the 'or' is read as allowing either date. The wording is ambiguous, and the candidate neither models it nor documents the choice.

The applicability and threshold parts are fine: the outstanding-obligation flag, the quarter-end flag, the December 31, 2005 start flag, and the >= 1.00 test are all correct. The omitted preceding-quarter alternative still makes the formalization incomplete.
judge.reason: The candidate correctly handles the applicability conditions, the start date, and the non-strict 1.00 threshold, and each parameter is clearly documented. That misrepresents the covenant's scope, so it is not an equivalent or complete formalization.

(define-fun covenant_holds (

    (is_test_period_on_or_after_2004_03_31 Bool)
    (ebitda_ltm Real)
    (rentals_ltm Real)

    (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real)

        (<= (/ (- indebtedness_end cash_and_equivalents) ebitda_ltm) 3.25))
    ; 7.4(C) Minimum Consolidated Net Worth at any time

        (+ 85000000.0
           (* 0.5 cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income)
           equity_issuance_net_cash_proceeds))
    ; 7.4(D) Maximum Capital Expenditures per fiscal year
    (<= capex_fiscal_year_expended_or_committed 25000000.0)
  )

  (in_period_oct3_1998_to_oct2_1999 Bool) ; quarter end falls in the period October 3, 1998 through October 2, 1999 (cap 4.50)
  (is_quarter_end_after_oct_2_1999 Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ends after October 2, 1999 (cap 4.00)
  (funded_debt_to_ebitda_ratio Real) ; Consolidated Funded Debt/Consolidated EBITDA Ratio at this quarter end (rolling 4 Fiscal Quarters after October 2, 1999)
  (is_fcc_test_date Bool) ; observation is a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio test date: end of Fiscal Year 1999 or a later quarter end, rolling four quarters basis

    ; 4.12.3

    ; 4.12.4
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_before_termination_date is_fq_ending_jan_2_1999)
        (>= consolidated_tangible_net_worth 95000000.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_before_termination_date is_fq_ending_apr_3_1999)
        (>= consolidated_tangible_net_worth 99000000.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_before_termination_date is_fq_ending_jul_3_1999)

    ; 4.12.5

  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) ; observation is the end of a Fiscal Quarter
  (is_quarter_end_after_mar_31_1999 Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ending at this observation ends after March 31, 1999
  (senior_debt_to_ebitda_ratio Real) ; Consolidated Senior Debt/Consolidated EBITDA Ratio at this quarter end, based on the immediately preceding 4 Fiscal Quarters
  (in_period_jul1_1998_to_apr3_1999 Bool) ; quarter end falls in the period July 1, 1998 through April 3, 1999 (cap 5.00)
  (in_period_jul1_1998_to_jul3_1999 Bool) ; quarter end falls in the period July 1, 1998 through July 3, 1999 (cap 4.50)
  (in_period_oct3_1998_to_oct2_1999 Bool) ; quarter end falls in the period October 3, 1998 through October 2, 1999 (cap 4.50)
  (is_quarter_end_after_oct_2_1999 Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ends after October 2, 1999 (cap 4.00)
  (funded_debt_to_ebitda_ratio Real) ; Consolidated Funded Debt/Consolidated EBITDA Ratio at this quarter end (rolling 4 Fiscal Quarters after October 2, 1999)
  (is_fcc_test_date Bool) ; observation is a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio test date: end of Fiscal Year 1999 or a later quarter end, rolling four quarters basis
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio on the rolling four quarters basis at this test date
  (is_before_termination_date Bool) ; observation is in the period until the Credit Facility Commitment Termination Date, so 4.12.4 applies
  (is_fq_ending_jan_2_1999 Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ends January 2, 1999
  (is_fq_ending_apr_3_1999 Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ends April 3, 1999
  (is_fq_ending_jul_3_1999 Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ends July 3, 1999
  (is_fq_thereafter Bool) ; the Fiscal Quarter ends after July 3, 1999 (the Each Fiscal Quarter thereafter row)
  (additional_fq_after_oct_1_1999 Real) ; number of additional Fiscal Quarters after October 1, 1999 counted through this quarter, inclusive
  (consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real) ; Consolidated Tangible Net Worth in dollars at this quarter end
  (is_on_or_after_termination_date Bool) ; observation is from and after the Credit Facility Commitment Termination Date, so 4.12.5 applies
  (total_liabilities_to_net_worth_ratio Real) ; Consolidated Total Liabilities/Consolidated Net Worth Ratio at this observation time
) Bool

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_period_jul1_1998_to_jul3_1999)
        (<= funded_debt_to_ebitda_ratio 4.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end in_period_oct3_1998_to_oct2_1999)
        (<= funded_debt_to_ebitda_ratio 4.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_end_after_oct_2_1999)

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_before_termination_date is_fq_ending_apr_3_1999)
        (>= consolidated_tangible_net_worth 99000000.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_before_termination_date is_fq_ending_jul_3_1999)

issues: 4.12.2: the candidate conjoins every overlapping period row, so a quarter end that falls in several rows is held to the strictest cap. The table lists 5.00 for the period ending April 3, 1999, then 4.50 for periods ending July 3, 1999 and October 2, 1999. The most natural reading is that each row's ratio applies to the quarter ending at that row's end date. Under the candidate, the quarter ending April 3, 1999 also falls in the July 1, 1998 through July 3, 1999 row, so it is held to 4.50 instead of 5.00. This is a wrong threshold, and the 'rows overlap, so each cap is enforced' choice is an unsupported interpretation.

4.12.4: the parameter additional_fq_after_oct_1_1999 is ambiguous about whether the quarter ending October 2, 1999 counts as the first additional quarter or zero ('counted through this quarter, inclusive'). The step-up arithmetic therefore may be off by one quarter, since the source says 'after October 1, 1999'.
Several flags, such as the in_period_* flags, are described only as 'falls in the period', which allows the overlap problem above and does not pin down one row per quarter end.
judge.reason: Most scope and arithmetic elements are reasonable: the 2.50 cap, the 1.25 floor, the 5.75 cap, the tangible net worth floors, the termination-date regimes and the pointwise treatment of 'at all times'. However, the 4.12.2 encoding enforces every overlapping row simultaneously, which imposes a stricter 4.50 cap on the April 3, 1999 quarter where the table gives 5.00. The step-up count in 4.12.4 is also underspecified. The formalization is therefore not faithful.

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_last_day_of_calendar_month: true iff the observation date is the last day of a calendar month ("as of the last day of each calendar month").
; quick_assets: Borrower's Quick Assets at the observation date (atomic; no definition supplied).
; current_liabilities: Borrower's Current Liabilities at the observation date.
; deferred_maintenance_royalties_and_license_revenue: amount of deferred maintenance and royalties and other revenue derived from Licenses, the amount subtracted from Current Liabilities.
; unrestricted_cash: Borrower's unrestricted cash at the observation date.
; revolving_line_availability: amount available under the Committed Revolving Line at the observation date.
; indebtedness_to_bank: Borrower's total Indebtedness to Bank at the observation date.
; other_secured_indebtedness: all other secured Indebtedness of Borrower (excluding Indebtedness to Bank) at the observation date.
; gross_revenue: Borrower's actual gross revenue for the measurement period ending at the observation date.
; projected_gross_revenue: Borrower's projected gross revenue for the same period under its revenue plan attached as Exhibit F.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_last_day_of_calendar_month Bool)
    (quick_assets Real)
    (current_liabilities Real)
    (deferred_maintenance_royalties_and_license_revenue Real)
    (unrestricted_cash Real)
    (revolving_line_availability Real)
    (indebtedness_to_bank Real)
    (other_secured_indebtedness Real)
    (gross_revenue Real)
    (projected_gross_revenue Real)) Bool
  (=> is_last_day_of_calendar_month
      (and
        ; (a) Quick Ratio >= 1.75 to 1.00
        (>= (/ quick_assets (- current_liabilities deferred_maintenance_royalties_and_license_revenue)) 1.75)
        ; (b) Liquidity Ratio >= 1.75 to 1.00
        (>= (/ (+ unrestricted_cash revolving_line_availability) (+ indebtedness_to_bank other_secured_indebtedness)) 1.75)
        ; (c) Minimum Revenue: gross revenue >= 80% of projected gross revenue
        (>= gross_revenue (* 0.8 projected_gross_revenue)))))

{
