  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (covenant_in_effect Bool) ; Article VI is in force at this observation: Commitments not yet expired/terminated, or Loans, Fees, other amounts not paid in full, or Letters of Credit not expired/terminated or LC Disbursements not reimbursed
  (is_covered_event Bool) ; At this observation a Loan Party or Restricted Subsidiary sells, transfers, leases or otherwise disposes of an asset (incl. Equity Interests), or the Borrower permits a Subsidiary (incl. Unrestricted) to issue additional Equity Interest in itself
  (fair_value Bool) ; The covered disposition/issuance is made for fair value
  (cash_consideration_pct Real) ; Percent (0-100 scale) of total consideration for the event received in cash
  (is_clause_i Bool) ; Event is a sale of inventory or used, surplus, obsolete, outdated, inefficient or worn out equipment and other property in the ordinary course of business
  (is_to_borrower_or_sub_loan_party Bool) ; Event is a sale/transfer/disposition to the Borrower or another Subsidiary Loan Party
  (is_to_bioglan Bool) ; The transferee of the event is Bioglan
  (collateral_actions_taken Bool) ; Loan Parties have taken all actions necessary or reasonably requested by the Collateral Agent to maintain/perfect/protect/preserve Liens on the Collateral and comply with Sections 5.11 and 5.12 where applicable
  (is_real_property_lease_ordinary_course Bool) ; Event is a lease or sublease of Real Property in the ordinary course of business
  (is_sale_leaseback Bool) ; The Real Property lease/sublease constitutes a sale and leaseback transaction
  (is_permitted_investments_sale Bool) ; Event is a sale of Permitted Investments
  (is_pharmabio_investment_sale Bool) ; Event is a sale of Permitted PharmaBio Investments (clause (v)(A))
  (is_pharmabio_swap Bool) ; Event is a Permitted PharmaBio Swap (clause (v)(B))
  (is_non_operating_investment Bool) ; The clause (v) sale or swap is of Non-Operating Investments
  (pro_forma_compliant_6_13_to_6_16 Bool) ; After giving effect to the sale/swap (and other PharmaBio sales/swaps since the last day of the preceding Test Period) pro forma as the proviso describes, the Borrower would comply with Sections 6.13 through 6.16 inclusive
  (is_investment_permitted_6_04 Bool) ; Event is a transfer of assets constituting Investments permitted under Section 6.04
  (is_asian_sub_equity_issuance Bool) ; Event is an issuance by a Designated Asian Subsidiary of its Equity Interests
  (is_public_offering_or_strategic_institutional_sale Bool) ; The issuance is in connection with a public offering of Equity Interests or a sale of Equity Interests to a strategic or institutional investor
  (borrower_restricted_ownership_pct Real) ; Percent (0-100 scale) of the Designated Asian Subsidiary's outstanding Equity Interests, fully diluted, owned by the Borrower and Restricted Subsidiaries after the issuance
  (issuance_proceeds_retained_reinvested Bool) ; Net proceeds of the issuance are retained by the Designated Asian Subsidiary and reinvested in its business
  (issuance_proceeds_applied_prepayment Bool) ; Net proceeds of the issuance are applied toward prepayment of Loans to the extent required by Section 2.06(c)(iii), with the modified 270/540-day deadline
  (is_between_wholly_owned_non_us_subs Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets between Wholly Owned Non-U.S. Subsidiaries
  (is_contemplated_by_6_01_a_ix_1 Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets as contemplated by Section 6.01(a)(ix)(1)
  (is_clause_x_disposition Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets not otherwise permitted under this Section, relied on under clause (x)
  (is_equity_of_restricted_sub Bool) ; The assets disposed of under clause (x) are Equity Interests of a Restricted Subsidiary
  (fy_clause_x_fmv Real) ; Aggregate fair market value in USD of all assets disposed of in reliance on clause (x) in the current Fiscal Year, including this event
  (cumulative_clause_x_fmv Real) ; Aggregate fair market value in USD of all assets disposed of in reliance on clause (x) since inception, including this event
  (clause_x_net_proceeds_applied Bool) ; Net Proceeds of the clause (x) disposition are applied as required by Section 2.06(c)(iii)

  (=> (and covenant_in_effect is_covered_event)
      (and fair_value
           (or
             ;; (i)
             is_clause_i
             ;; (ii)
             (and is_to_borrower_or_sub_loan_party (not is_to_bioglan) collateral_actions_taken)
             ;; (iii)

  (is_real_property_lease_ordinary_course Bool) ; Event is a lease or sublease of Real Property in the ordinary course of business
  (is_sale_leaseback Bool) ; The Real Property lease/sublease constitutes a sale and leaseback transaction
  (is_permitted_investments_sale Bool) ; Event is a sale of Permitted Investments
  (is_pharmabio_investment_sale Bool) ; Event is a sale of Permitted PharmaBio Investments (clause (v)(A))
  (is_pharmabio_swap Bool) ; Event is a Permitted PharmaBio Swap (clause (v)(B))
  (is_non_operating_investment Bool) ; The clause (v) sale or swap is of Non-Operating Investments
  (pro_forma_compliant_6_13_to_6_16 Bool) ; After giving effect to the sale/swap (and other PharmaBio sales/swaps since the last day of the preceding Test Period) pro forma as the proviso describes, the Borrower would comply with Sections 6.13 through 6.16 inclusive
  (is_investment_permitted_6_04 Bool) ; Event is a transfer of assets constituting Investments permitted under Section 6.04
  (is_asian_sub_equity_issuance Bool) ; Event is an issuance by a Designated Asian Subsidiary of its Equity Interests
  (is_public_offering_or_strategic_institutional_sale Bool) ; The issuance is in connection with a public offering of Equity Interests or a sale of Equity Interests to a strategic or institutional investor
  (borrower_restricted_ownership_pct Real) ; Percent (0-100 scale) of the Designated Asian Subsidiary's outstanding Equity Interests, fully diluted, owned by the Borrower and Restricted Subsidiaries after the issuance
  (issuance_proceeds_retained_reinvested Bool) ; Net proceeds of the issuance are retained by the Designated Asian Subsidiary and reinvested in its business
  (issuance_proceeds_applied_prepayment Bool) ; Net proceeds of the issuance are applied toward prepayment of Loans to the extent required by Section 2.06(c)(iii), with the modified 270/540-day deadline
  (is_between_wholly_owned_non_us_subs Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets between Wholly Owned Non-U.S. Subsidiaries
  (is_contemplated_by_6_01_a_ix_1 Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets as contemplated by Section 6.01(a)(ix)(1)
  (is_clause_x_disposition Bool) ; Event is a sale, transfer or disposition of assets not otherwise permitted under this Section, relied on under clause (x)
  (is_equity_of_restricted_sub Bool) ; The assets disposed of under clause (x) are Equity Interests of a Restricted Subsidiary
  (fy_clause_x_fmv Real) ; Aggregate fair market value in USD of all assets disposed of in reliance on clause (x) in the current Fiscal Year, including this event

             is_clause_i
             ;; (ii)
             (and is_to_borrower_or_sub_loan_party (not is_to_bioglan) collateral_actions_taken)

                  (<= cumulative_clause_x_fmv 100000000)
                  clause_x_net_proceeds_applied
                  (>= cash_consideration_pct 100))))))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (revolving_credit_commitments_in_effect Bool) ; Revolving Credit Commitments remain in effect at the observation time
  (loan_or_lc_outstanding_unpaid Bool) ; any Loan or Letter of Credit remains outstanding and unpaid at the observation time
  (other_amount_owing Bool) ; any other amount is owing to any Lender or the Administrative Agent hereunder at the observation time
  (leverage_ratio Real) ; Leverage Ratio (total indebtedness to EBITDA, atomic) on the last day of the fiscal quarter, as a plain number (3.00 to 1.00 = 3.0)
  (leverage_date_tier_3_00 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 3.00 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2002 through Mar 31 2003 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_75 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.75 to 1.00 (Jun 30 2003 through Dec 31 2003 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_50 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.50 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2004 through Sep 30 2005 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_25 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.25 to 1.00 (Dec 31 2005 through Mar 31 2007 rows)
  (consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters Real) ; Consolidated EBITDA of the Borrower for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date
  (consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters Real) ; Consolidated Interest Expense of the Borrower for the same four consecutive fiscal quarters
  (coverage_date_tier_4_00 Bool) ; observation is the date on which the last of the four quarters ends, and it is listed in 8.1(b) with ratio 4.00 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2002 through Dec 31 2002 rows)
  (coverage_date_tier_4_25 Bool) ; same, for a date listed in 8.1(b) with ratio 4.25 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2003 through Dec 31 2003 rows)
  (coverage_date_tier_4_50 Bool) ; same, for a date listed in 8.1(b) with ratio 4.50 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2004 through Mar 31 2007 rows)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real) ; Consolidated Net Worth of the Borrower at the observation time, in dollars
  (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real) ; sum over fiscal quarters beginning after the Closing Date and ended at or prior to the observation time of Consolidated Net Income, counting only positive quarters (negative quarters count as 0), in dollars
  (goodwill_writeoff_after_closing Real) ; aggregate writeoff of goodwill intangible assets after the Closing Date, to the extent reflected under GAAP on the financial statements delivered under Section 7.1 for fiscal periods ending after the Closing Date, in dollars
) Bool
  (=> (or revolving_credit_commitments_in_effect
          loan_or_lc_outstanding_unpaid
          other_amount_owing)
      (and
        ; 8.1(a): Leverage Ratio must not be greater than the scheduled ratio
        (ite leverage_date_tier_3_00 (<= leverage_ratio 3.0)
        (ite leverage_date_tier_2_75 (<= leverage_ratio 2.75)
        (ite leverage_date_tier_2_50 (<= leverage_ratio 2.5)
        (ite leverage_date_tier_2_25 (<= leverage_ratio 2.25)
             true))))
        ; 8.1(b): EBITDA / Interest Expense must not be less than the scheduled ratio
        (ite coverage_date_tier_4_00
             (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters) 4.0)
        (ite coverage_date_tier_4_25
             (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters) 4.25)
        (ite coverage_date_tier_4_50
             (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters) 4.5)
             true)))
        ; 8.1(c): Net Worth must not be less than 115,000,000 + 50% of cumulative positive net income - goodwill writeoff

  (leverage_date_tier_3_00 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 3.00 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2002 through Mar 31 2003 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_75 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.75 to 1.00 (Jun 30 2003 through Dec 31 2003 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_50 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.50 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2004 through Sep 30 2005 rows)
  (leverage_date_tier_2_25 Bool) ; observation is the last day of a fiscal quarter listed in 8.1(a) with ratio 2.25 to 1.00 (Dec 31 2005 through Mar 31 2007 rows)
  (consolidated_ebitda_four_quarters Real) ; Consolidated EBITDA of the Borrower for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date
  (consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters Real) ; Consolidated Interest Expense of the Borrower for the same four consecutive fiscal quarters
  (coverage_date_tier_4_00 Bool) ; observation is the date on which the last of the four quarters ends, and it is listed in 8.1(b) with ratio 4.00 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2002 through Dec 31 2002 rows)
  (coverage_date_tier_4_25 Bool) ; same, for a date listed in 8.1(b) with ratio 4.25 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2003 through Dec 31 2003 rows)
  (coverage_date_tier_4_50 Bool) ; same, for a date listed in 8.1(b) with ratio 4.50 to 1.00 (Mar 31 2004 through Mar 31 2007 rows)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real) ; Consolidated Net Worth of the Borrower at the observation time, in dollars
  (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real) ; sum over fiscal quarters beginning after the Closing Date and ended at or prior to the observation time of Consolidated Net Income, counting only positive quarters (negative quarters count as 0), in dollars
  (goodwill_writeoff_after_closing Real) ; aggregate writeoff of goodwill intangible assets after the Closing Date, to the extent reflected under GAAP on the financial statements delivered under Section 7.1 for fiscal periods ending after the Closing Date, in dollars
) Bool

          loan_or_lc_outstanding_unpaid

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; leverage_ratio: the Borrower's Leverage Ratio at the observation time (atomic Real; no definition supplied). At a quarter end it is the ratio as of that quarter end. At an Advance it is the ratio after giving effect to the Advance.
; is_calendar_quarter_end: true iff the observation is as of the end of a calendar quarter (Section 7.8(a)).
; is_facility_b_increasing_advance: true iff the observation is at the time of an Advance increasing the principal amount of the Facility B Loans, after giving effect to the Advance (Section 7.8(b)).
; threshold_debt_proceeds_received: true iff the Threshold Debt Proceeds have been received as of the observation.
; cash_equity_proceeds_received: true iff the Cash Equity Proceeds have been received as of the observation.
; in_period_agreement_date_to_2000_03_30: true iff the observation date is within the period Agreement Date through March 30, 2000.
; in_period_2000_03_31_to_2002_03_30: true iff the observation date is within the period March 31, 2000 through March 30, 2002.
; on_or_after_2002_03_31: true iff the observation date is March 31, 2002 or thereafter.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((leverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_calendar_quarter_end Bool)
                            (is_facility_b_increasing_advance Bool)
                            (threshold_debt_proceeds_received Bool)
                            (cash_equity_proceeds_received Bool)
                            (in_period_agreement_date_to_2000_03_30 Bool)
                            (in_period_2000_03_31_to_2002_03_30 Bool)
                            (on_or_after_2002_03_31 Bool)) Bool
  (=> (or is_calendar_quarter_end is_facility_b_increasing_advance)
      (let ((both_received (and threshold_debt_proceeds_received cash_equity_proceeds_received)))
        (and
          ; (i) prior to receipt of both (x) and (y)
          (=> (and (not both_received) in_period_agreement_date_to_2000_03_30) (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
          (=> (and (not both_received) in_period_2000_03_31_to_2002_03_30) (<= leverage_ratio 4.0))
          (=> (and (not both_received) on_or_after_2002_03_31) (<= leverage_ratio 3.5))
          ; (ii) after receipt of both (x) and (y)
          (=> (and both_received in_period_agreement_date_to_2000_03_30) (<= leverage_ratio 5.0))
          (=> (and both_received in_period_2000_03_31_to_2002_03_30) (<= leverage_ratio 5.0))
          (=> (and both_received on_or_after_2002_03_31) (<= leverage_ratio 4.0))))))

; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true exactly when the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter (applies to 7.11(a) and 7.11(c)).
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: the Consolidated Leverage Ratio at this observation, as a ratio x for x:1.0.
; consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: the Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio at this observation, as a ratio x for x:1.0.
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated Net Worth at this observation, in US dollars.
; cumulative_floored_quarterly_net_income: in US dollars, the sum over each fiscal quarter ending after the Closing Date and on or before this observation of max(Consolidated Net Income for that quarter, 0). Each quarter is floored at zero before summing.
; cumulative_equity_transaction_net_proceeds: in US dollars, the cumulative net proceeds from Equity Transactions occurring after the Closing Date, up to this observation.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (cumulative_floored_quarterly_net_income Real)
  (cumulative_equity_transaction_net_proceeds Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; 7.11(a): at each fiscal quarter end, leverage ratio not greater than 3.0:1.0
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.0))
    ; 7.11(b): at all times, net worth not less than 180 million + 50% of cumulative floored quarterly net income + 75% of cumulative equity net proceeds
    (>= consolidated_net_worth
        (+ 180000000.0
           (* 0.5 cumulative_floored_quarterly_net_income)
           (* 0.75 cumulative_equity_transaction_net_proceeds)))
    ; 7.11(c): at each fiscal quarter end, fixed charge coverage ratio not less than 2.0:1.0
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 2.0))
  )
)

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (on_or_after_effective_date Bool) ; True if the observation is on or after the Effective Date.
  (commitments_terminated_and_obligations_paid Bool) ; True if the Total Revolving Loan Commitment and all Letters of Credit have terminated (or been cash collateralized or backstopped per Section 4.02(d)) and the Loans, Notes, Unpaid Drawings, interest, Fees and other Obligations (except Section 13.13 indemnities not then due) are paid in full.
  (sub_debt_payment_made Bool) ; True if Magellan, the Borrower or a Subsidiary makes (or gives notice of) a voluntary or optional payment, prepayment, redemption or acquisition for value of Permitted Subordinated Debt, including a prepayment or redemption from an asset sale, change of control or similar event, or a deposit of money or securities before due to pay it.
  (is_magellan_redemption_or_repurchase Bool) ; True if the sub_debt_payment_made action is a redemption or repurchase of outstanding Permitted Subordinated Debt effected by Magellan, the only action the provisos (A) and (B) can permit.
  (default_exists_or_would_result Bool) ; True if a Default or Event of Default then exists or would result from the redemption or repurchase.
  (fiscal_year_redemption_total Real) ; Aggregate USD amount expended on all Permitted Subordinated Debt redemptions and repurchases in the current fiscal year of Magellan, including the proposed one.
  (pro_forma_9_08_compliant Bool) ; True if Pro Forma Basis calculations for the Calculation Period show the Section 9.08 financial covenant would have been complied with as of the last day of that period.
  (pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio Real) ; Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Calculation Period, computed on the Pro Forma Basis as if the redemption or repurchase (and earlier ones in that period) occurred on its first day.
  (total_unutilized_revolving_commitment Real) ; Total Unutilized Revolving Loan Commitment then in effect, in USD, immediately after giving effect to the proposed redemption or repurchase.
  (unrestricted_cash_and_equivalents Real) ; Aggregate USD amount of all Unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of Magellan and its Subsidiaries at such time, immediately after giving effect to the proposed redemption or repurchase.
  (officer_certificate_delivered Bool) ; True if Magellan delivered to the Administrative Agent (with copies for each Lender) a certificate from an Authorized Officer certifying compliance with clauses (i) through (iii) and containing the required calculations.
  (sub_debt_document_executed Bool) ; True if a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document has been executed and delivered by this observation.
  (amends_sub_debt_document Bool) ; True if Magellan, the Borrower or a Subsidiary amends or modifies (or permits the amendment or modification of) a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (amendment_less_restrictive Bool) ; True if the amendment makes the provisions less restrictive on Magellan and its Subsidiaries (including any representation, warranty, covenant, default or event of default).
  (amendment_reduces_rates_or_fees Bool) ; True if the amendment reduces interest rates, commissions or fees paid or to be paid by Magellan or any Subsidiary in connection with the Permitted Subordinated Debt.
  (amendment_extends_maturity Bool) ; True if the amendment extends the stated maturity of any Indebtedness under the Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (amendment_reduces_prepayment_premiums Bool) ; True if the amendment reduces or eliminates any prepayment premiums.
  (amendment_not_materially_adverse_per_agent Bool) ; True if the amendment is otherwise not adverse to the Lenders in any material respect, in the reasonable opinion of the Administrative Agent.
  (amends_subordination_provisions Bool) ; True if the amendment or modification is to the subordination provisions of a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (agent_prior_written_consent_subordination Bool) ; True if the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the amendment of the subordination provisions.
  (amends_org_or_equity_documents Bool) ; True if Magellan or the Borrower amends, modifies or changes its certificate/articles of incorporation, formation certificate, LLC agreement, by-laws or equivalent, or any agreement on its capital stock or equity interests (including any Shareholders' Agreement), or enters into a new such agreement.
  (org_or_equity_change_not_materially_adverse Bool) ; True if the amendment, modification, change or other action could not reasonably be expected to be adverse to the interests of the Lenders in any material respect.
  (amends_or_enters_tax_sharing_agreement Bool) ; True if a Tax Tax-sharing action occurs: amendment or modification (or permitting it) of a Tax Sharing Agreement, or entry into a new tax sharing, tax allocation or similar agreement.
  (agent_prior_written_consent_tax Bool) ; True if the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the tax sharing amendment or new agreement.
  (tax_agreement_exclusively_among_credit_parties Bool) ; True if the tax sharing, allocation or similar agreement is exclusively between or among the Credit Parties.
) Bool
  (=> (and on_or_after_effective_date (not commitments_terminated_and_obligations_paid))
    (and
      ; Clause (i): restricted Permitted Subordinated Debt payments, unless permitted by proviso (A) or (B)
      (=> sub_debt_payment_made
        (and is_magellan_redemption_or_repurchase
          (or
            (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)
                 (<= fiscal_year_redemption_total 10000000.0))
            (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)

                 (>= (+ total_unutilized_revolving_commitment unrestricted_cash_and_equivalents) 75000000.0)

      ; Clause (ii): amendments of Permitted Subordinated Debt Documents

        org_or_equity_change_not_materially_adverse)
      ; Clause (iv): tax sharing agreements

        (or agent_prior_written_consent_tax

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (on_or_after_effective_date Bool) ; True if the observation is on or after the Effective Date.
  (commitments_terminated_and_obligations_paid Bool) ; True if the Total Revolving Loan Commitment and all Letters of Credit have terminated (or been cash collateralized or backstopped per Section 4.02(d)) and the Loans, Notes, Unpaid Drawings, interest, Fees and other Obligations (except Section 13.13 indemnities not then due) are paid in full.
  (sub_debt_payment_made Bool) ; True if Magellan, the Borrower or a Subsidiary makes (or gives notice of) a voluntary or optional payment, prepayment, redemption or acquisition for value of Permitted Subordinated Debt, including a prepayment or redemption from an asset sale, change of control or similar event, or a deposit of money or securities before due to pay it.
  (is_magellan_redemption_or_repurchase Bool) ; True if the sub_debt_payment_made action is a redemption or repurchase of outstanding Permitted Subordinated Debt effected by Magellan, the only action the provisos (A) and (B) can permit.
  (default_exists_or_would_result Bool) ; True if a Default or Event of Default then exists or would result from the redemption or repurchase.
  (fiscal_year_redemption_total Real) ; Aggregate USD amount expended on all Permitted Subordinated Debt redemptions and repurchases in the current fiscal year of Magellan, including the proposed one.
  (pro_forma_9_08_compliant Bool) ; True if Pro Forma Basis calculations for the Calculation Period show the Section 9.08 financial covenant would have been complied with as of the last day of that period.
  (pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio Real) ; Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Calculation Period, computed on the Pro Forma Basis as if the redemption or repurchase (and earlier ones in that period) occurred on its first day.
  (total_unutilized_revolving_commitment Real) ; Total Unutilized Revolving Loan Commitment then in effect, in USD, immediately after giving effect to the proposed redemption or repurchase.
  (unrestricted_cash_and_equivalents Real) ; Aggregate USD amount of all Unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of Magellan and its Subsidiaries at such time, immediately after giving effect to the proposed redemption or repurchase.
  (officer_certificate_delivered Bool) ; True if Magellan delivered to the Administrative Agent (with copies for each Lender) a certificate from an Authorized Officer certifying compliance with clauses (i) through (iii) and containing the required calculations.
  (sub_debt_document_executed Bool) ; True if a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document has been executed and delivered by this observation.
  (amends_sub_debt_document Bool) ; True if Magellan, the Borrower or a Subsidiary amends or modifies (or permits the amendment or modification of) a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (amendment_less_restrictive Bool) ; True if the amendment makes the provisions less restrictive on Magellan and its Subsidiaries (including any representation, warranty, covenant, default or event of default).
  (amendment_reduces_rates_or_fees Bool) ; True if the amendment reduces interest rates, commissions or fees paid or to be paid by Magellan or any Subsidiary in connection with the Permitted Subordinated Debt.
  (amendment_extends_maturity Bool) ; True if the amendment extends the stated maturity of any Indebtedness under the Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (amendment_reduces_prepayment_premiums Bool) ; True if the amendment reduces or eliminates any prepayment premiums.
  (amendment_not_materially_adverse_per_agent Bool) ; True if the amendment is otherwise not adverse to the Lenders in any material respect, in the reasonable opinion of the Administrative Agent.
  (amends_subordination_provisions Bool) ; True if the amendment or modification is to the subordination provisions of a Permitted Subordinated Debt Document.
  (agent_prior_written_consent_subordination Bool) ; True if the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the amendment of the subordination provisions.
  (amends_org_or_equity_documents Bool) ; True if Magellan or the Borrower amends, modifies or changes its certificate/articles of incorporation, formation certificate, LLC agreement, by-laws or equivalent, or any agreement on its capital stock or equity interests (including any Shareholders' Agreement), or enters into a new such agreement.
  (org_or_equity_change_not_materially_adverse Bool) ; True if the amendment, modification, change or other action could not reasonably be expected to be adverse to the interests of the Lenders in any material respect.
  (amends_or_enters_tax_sharing_agreement Bool) ; True if a Tax Tax-sharing action occurs: amendment or modification (or permitting it) of a Tax Sharing Agreement, or entry into a new tax sharing, tax allocation or similar agreement.
  (agent_prior_written_consent_tax Bool) ; True if the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the tax sharing amendment or new agreement.
  (tax_agreement_exclusively_among_credit_parties Bool) ; True if the tax sharing, allocation or similar agreement is exclusively between or among the Credit Parties.
) Bool
  (=> (and on_or_after_effective_date (not commitments_terminated_and_obligations_paid))
    (and
      ; Clause (i): restricted Permitted Subordinated Debt payments, unless permitted by proviso (A) or (B)
      (=> sub_debt_payment_made
        (and is_magellan_redemption_or_repurchase
          (or
            (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)
                 (<= fiscal_year_redemption_total 10000000.0))
            (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)
                 pro_forma_9_08_compliant
                 (<= pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio 1.5)
                 (>= (+ total_unutilized_revolving_commitment unrestricted_cash_and_equivalents) 75000000.0)
                 officer_certificate_delivered))))
      ; Clause (ii): amendments of Permitted Subordinated Debt Documents
      (=> (and sub_debt_document_executed amends_sub_debt_document)
        (and
          (or amendment_less_restrictive
              amendment_reduces_rates_or_fees
              amendment_extends_maturity
              amendment_reduces_prepayment_premiums
              amendment_not_materially_adverse_per_agent)
          (or (not amends_subordination_provisions)
              agent_prior_written_consent_subordination)))
      ; Clause (iii): organizational and equity document changes
      (=> amends_org_or_equity_documents
        org_or_equity_change_not_materially_adverse)
      ; Clause (iv): tax sharing agreements
      (=> amends_or_enters_tax_sharing_agreement
        (or agent_prior_written_consent_tax
            tax_agreement_exclusively_among_credit_parties)))))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; ebitda: EBITDA of the Borrower for the twelve fiscal months then ended.
; rental_expense: Rental Expense for the same twelve fiscal months.
; capex: aggregate principal amount of Capital Expenditures of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for the same twelve fiscal months.
; interest_expense: Interest Expense of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis for the same twelve fiscal months.
; loans_outstanding: aggregate outstanding principal amount of all Loans under this Agreement at the observation time.
; short_term_loans_outstanding: aggregate outstanding principal amount of all "Loans" under the Short-Term Credit Agreement at the observation time.
; total_commitment: Total Commitment under this Agreement at the observation time.
; short_term_total_commitment: "Total Commitment" under the Short-Term Credit Agreement at the observation time.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (ebitda Real)
                            (rental_expense Real)
                            (capex Real)
                            (interest_expense Real)
                            (loans_outstanding Real)
                            (short_term_loans_outstanding Real)
                            (total_commitment Real)
                            (short_term_total_commitment Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
      (>= (/ (- (+ ebitda rental_expense) capex)
             (+ interest_expense rental_expense))
          (ite (< (+ loans_outstanding short_term_loans_outstanding)
                  (* 0.25 (+ total_commitment short_term_total_commitment)))
               1.0
               1.25))))

issues: Section 7.4(d) is omitted. It requires prompt delivery of SEC and exchange filings, including the 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, and registration statements. The function has no input or formula term for it.
Section 7.4(e) is omitted. It requires prompt delivery of financial statements, reports and proxy statements mailed to shareholders. This is not represented.

The obligation to furnish information about the business and financial condition of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on reasonable request is omitted. This could be a Boolean input, such as 'requested information furnished promptly'.

judge.reason: The pointwise structure is reasonable. The credit-available-or-unpaid applicability and waiver guard are sensible, and the deadline flags for (a), (b), (c) and (f) are plausible. However, the candidate drops several explicit Section 7.4 obligations: the SEC filings in (d), the shareholder mailings in (e), and the on-request information duty. It also only partly captures the independent-accountant certification and comparative-statement details in (b). The function can therefore report compliance while the covenant is breached, so it is incomplete and not equivalent to the source.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the date as of which all four ratios are determined.
; ebitda: EBITDA for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date (pro forma for Permitted Acquisitions as the source describes).
; capital_expenditures: Capital Expenditures for the same four-quarter period.
; interest_expense: Interest Expense for the same four-quarter period, used in the fixed charge denominator.
; sched_amort_term_loans: scheduled amortization of the principal portion of the Term Loans for the period.
; sched_amort_other_debt: scheduled amortization of the principal portion of all other Indebtedness for borrowed money of the Borrower for the period.
; cash_taxes_paid: cash taxes paid by the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for the period.
; restricted_payments: Restricted Payments made during the period, excluding Acquisition Redemptions and Restricted Payments made pursuant to CLAUSE (III) of SECTION 7.3(F).
; customer_loan_guaranty_payments: payments made by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, under any Customer Loan Guaranties during the period.
; customer_lease_guaranty_payments: payments made by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, under any Customer Lease Guaranties during the period.
; total_debt: Total Debt as of the last day of the fiscal quarter.
; rentals: Rentals for the four-quarter period ending on the observation date.
; cash_interest_expense: cash Interest Expense for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date.
; lev_band1: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through March 31, 2001, which is the first band of the Leverage and Lease Adjusted Leverage tables.
; lev_band2: true iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2001 through March 31, 2002.
; lev_band3: true iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2002 through March 31, 2003.
; lev_band4: true iff the quarter end falls in "each quarter thereafter", meaning after March 31, 2003.
; ice_band1: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through December 31, 1999.
; ice_band2: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 2000 through December 31, 2000.
; ice_band3: true iff the quarter end is a fiscal quarter after December 31, 2000.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (ebitda Real)
    (capital_expenditures Real)
    (interest_expense Real)
    (sched_amort_term_loans Real)
    (sched_amort_other_debt Real)
    (cash_taxes_paid Real)
    (restricted_payments Real)
    (customer_loan_guaranty_payments Real)
    (customer_lease_guaranty_payments Real)
    (total_debt Real)
    (rentals Real)
    (cash_interest_expense Real)
    (lev_band1 Bool)
    (lev_band2 Bool)
    (lev_band3 Bool)
    (lev_band4 Bool)
    (ice_band1 Bool)
    (ice_band2 Bool)
    (ice_band3 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (A) Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of at least 1.10 to 1.00
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= (/ (- ebitda capital_expenditures)
               (+ interest_expense sched_amort_term_loans sched_amort_other_debt
                  cash_taxes_paid restricted_payments
                  customer_loan_guaranty_payments customer_lease_guaranty_payments))
            1.10))
    ; (B) Maximum Leverage Ratio: Total Debt / EBITDA must not be greater than the band limit
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band1) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 4.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band2) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 3.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band3) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 3.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band4) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 2.50))
    ; (C) Maximum Lease Adjusted Leverage Ratio: (Total Debt + 8 * Rentals) / (EBITDA + Rentals)
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band1)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 5.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band2)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 4.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band3)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 4.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band4)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 3.75))
    ; (D) Interest Expense Coverage Ratio: EBITDA / cash Interest Expense of at least the band minimum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band1) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 2.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band2) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 3.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band3) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 3.50))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the date as of which all four ratios are determined.", "source_quote": "the last day of each fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "ebitda", "meaning": "EBITDA for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date, pro forma for Permitted Acquisitions as described in the source.", "source_quote": "EBITDA"},
    {"name": "capital_expenditures", "meaning": "Capital Expenditures for the four-quarter period ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "Capital Expenditures"},
    {"name": "interest_expense", "meaning": "Interest Expense for the four-quarter period, used in the fixed charge denominator.", "source_quote": "Interest Expense"},
    {"name": "sched_amort_term_loans", "meaning": "Scheduled amortization of the principal portion of the Term Loans for the period.", "source_quote": "scheduled amortization of the principal portion of the Term Loans"},
    {"name": "sched_amort_other_debt", "meaning": "Scheduled amortization of the principal portion of all other Indebtedness for borrowed money of the Borrower for the period.", "source_quote": "scheduled amortization of the principal portion of all other Indebtedness for borrowed money of the Borrower"},
    {"name": "cash_taxes_paid", "meaning": "Cash taxes paid by the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for the period.", "source_quote": "cash taxes paid by the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries"},
    {"name": "restricted_payments", "meaning": "Restricted Payments made during the period, excluding Acquisition Redemptions and Restricted Payments made pursuant to CLAUSE (III) of SECTION 7.3(F).", "source_quote": "Restricted Payments (other than Acquisition Redemptions and Restricted Payments made pursuant to CLAUSE (III) of SECTION 7.3(F)) made during such period"},
    {"name": "customer_loan_guaranty_payments", "meaning": "Payments made by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, pursuant to any Customer Loan Guaranties during the period.", "source_quote": "any payments made by the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries directly or indirectly pursuant to any Customer Loan Guaranties during such period"},
    {"name": "customer_lease_guaranty_payments", "meaning": "Payments made by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, pursuant to any Customer Lease Guaranties during the period.", "source_quote": "any payments made by the Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries directly or indirectly pursuant to any Customer Lease Guaranties"},
    {"name": "total_debt", "meaning": "Total Debt as of the last day of the fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "Total Debt as of the last day of each such fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "rentals", "meaning": "Rentals for the four-quarter period ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "for EBITDA and Rentals, the actual amount for the four-quarter period ending on such day"},
    {"name": "cash_interest_expense", "meaning": "Cash Interest Expense for the four fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "cash Interest Expense"},
    {"name": "lev_band1", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through March 31, 2001, the first band of the leverage and lease adjusted leverage tables.", "source_quote": "March 31, 1999 through March 31, 2001"},
    {"name": "lev_band2", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2001 through March 31, 2002.", "source_quote": "June 30, 2001 through March 31, 2002"},
    {"name": "lev_band3", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2002 through March 31, 2003.", "source_quote": "June 30, 2002 through March 31, 2003"},
    {"name": "lev_band4", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is in the 'each quarter thereafter' band, meaning after March 31, 2003.", "source_quote": "Each quarter thereafter"},
    {"name": "ice_band1", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through December 31, 1999 for the interest coverage test.", "source_quote": "commencing with the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 1999 through the fiscal quarter ending December 31, 1999"},
    {"name": "ice_band2", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is within March 31, 2000 through December 31, 2000 for the interest coverage test.", "source_quote": "commencing with the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2000 through the fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2000"},
    {"name": "ice_band3", "meaning": "True iff the quarter end is a fiscal quarter after December 31, 2000 for the interest coverage test.", "source_quote": "3.50 to 1.00 for each fiscal quarter thereafter"}
  ],
  "notes": "All four financial covenants in Section 7.4 are conjoined, and each is guarded by the quarter-end flag. Date bands are Boolean inputs, so the evaluator supplies them directly. ; lev_band1: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through March 31, 2001, which is the first band of the Leverage and Lease Adjusted Leverage tables.
; lev_band2: true iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2001 through March 31, 2002.
; lev_band3: true iff the quarter end is within June 30, 2002 through March 31, 2003.
; lev_band4: true iff the quarter end falls in "each quarter thereafter", meaning after March 31, 2003.
; ice_band1: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 1999 through December 31, 1999.
; ice_band2: true iff the quarter end is within March 31, 2000 through December 31, 2000.
; ice_band3: true iff the quarter end is a fiscal quarter after December 31, 2000.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (ebitda Real)
    (capital_expenditures Real)
    (interest_expense Real)
    (sched_amort_term_loans Real)
    (sched_amort_other_debt Real)
    (cash_taxes_paid Real)
    (restricted_payments Real)
    (customer_loan_guaranty_payments Real)
    (customer_lease_guaranty_payments Real)
    (total_debt Real)
    (rentals Real)
    (cash_interest_expense Real)
    (lev_band1 Bool)
    (lev_band2 Bool)
    (lev_band3 Bool)
    (lev_band4 Bool)
    (ice_band1 Bool)
    (ice_band2 Bool)
    (ice_band3 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (A) Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of at least 1.10 to 1.00
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= (/ (- ebitda capital_expenditures)
               (+ interest_expense sched_amort_term_loans sched_amort_other_debt
                  cash_taxes_paid restricted_payments
                  customer_loan_guaranty_payments customer_lease_guaranty_payments))
            1.10))
    ; (B) Maximum Leverage Ratio: Total Debt / EBITDA must not be greater than the band limit
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band1) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 4.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band2) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 3.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band3) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 3.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band4) (<= (/ total_debt ebitda) 2.50))
    ; (C) Maximum Lease Adjusted Leverage Ratio: (Total Debt + 8 * Rentals) / (EBITDA + Rentals)
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band1)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 5.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band2)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 4.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band3)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 4.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_band4)
        (<= (/ (+ total_debt (* 8.0 rentals)) (+ ebitda rentals)) 3.75))
    ; (D) Interest Expense Coverage Ratio: EBITDA / cash Interest Expense of at least the band minimum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band1) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 2.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band2) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 3.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end ice_band3) (>= (/ ebitda cash_interest_expense) 3.50))))

candidate.notes: All four financial covenants in Section 7.4 are conjoined, and each is guarded by the quarter-end flag. Date bands are Boolean inputs, so the evaluator supplies them directly. EBITDA is a single input because every ratio uses the same four-quarter figure. Division is kept in the formula, so a zero denominator is reported as unresolved. The Leverage and Lease Adjusted Leverage tests use <= because the Borrower must not permit a ratio 'greater than' the limit. The Fixed Charge and Interest Coverage tests use >= because they require 'at least' the stated minimum. The pro forma treatment of Permitted Acquisitions is assumed to be reflected in the supplied inputs. The Agents' approval of adjustments is not modeled.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

issues: The Minimum TNW formula applies 0.5 times cumulative net profits "sign as reported". The source only says the Minimum TNW Amount is increased by 50% of net profits for each fiscal year. A loss year would lower the minimum in the candidate, and a loss in one year would offset profits from another. The source does not support either effect. ; gross_statement_delivered_on_time: true iff the Investment Advisor gave the Administrative Agent, by telephone or facsimile, a reasonably detailed statement of the Gross Asset Coverage Ratio for the observation Business Day by not later than the following Business Day.
; net_asset_coverage_ratio: Net Asset Coverage Ratio as of the observation date, expressed as x in x:1.00.
; is_net_calculation_date: true iff the observation date is a Calculation Date for the Net Asset Coverage Ratio test.
; is_net_proviso_business_day: true iff the observation date is a Business Day after a Calculation Date on which the Net Asset Coverage Ratio was less than 4.10:1.00, and the ratio has not yet been greater than 4.10:1.00 (the proviso period).
; net_statement_delivered_on_time: true iff the Investment Advisor gave the Administrative Agent, by telephone or facsimile, a reasonably detailed statement of the Net Asset Coverage Ratio for the observation Business Day by not later than the following Business Day.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((cp_maintenance_ratio Real)
                            (is_last_business_day_of_calendar_week Bool)
                            (gross_asset_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_gross_calculation_date Bool)
                            (is_gross_proviso_business_day Bool)
                            (gross_statement_delivered_on_time Bool)
                            (net_asset_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_net_calculation_date Bool)
                            (is_net_proviso_business_day Bool)
                            (net_statement_delivered_on_time Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) CP Maintenance Ratio must not be less than 4.05 on the last Business Day of a calendar week
    (=> is_last_business_day_of_calendar_week (>= cp_maintenance_ratio 4.05))
    ; (b) Gross Asset Coverage Ratio must not be less than 4.00 on Calculation Dates and proviso Business Days
    (=> (or is_gross_calculation_date is_gross_proviso_business_day)
        (>= gross_asset_coverage_ratio 4.00))
    ; (b) proviso: a statement is due for each Business Day in the proviso period
    (=> is_gross_proviso_business_day gross_statement_delivered_on_time)
    ; (c) Net Asset Coverage Ratio must not be less than 4.00 on Calculation Dates and proviso Business Days
    (=> (or is_net_calculation_date is_net_proviso_business_day)
        (>= net_asset_coverage_ratio 4.00))
    ; (c) proviso: a statement is due for each Business Day in the proviso period
    (=> is_net_proviso_business_day net_statement_delivered_on_time)))

issues: The source sets the 4.00:1.00 minimum only 'as of any Calculation Date'. The proviso requires the ratio to be calculated on each later Business Day, but it does not say that the 4.00 minimum is tested on those days. The candidate adds that test with `(or is_gross_calculation_date is_gross_proviso_business_day)` and the net equivalent. That broadens the covenant beyond the text, unless the source defines those days as Calculation Dates, which it does not.

The proviso-period flags are ambiguous at the end of the period. 'Has not yet been greater than 4.10' does not say whether the Business Day on which the ratio first exceeds 4.10 is inside the period. That affects whether the statement obligation and the 4.00 test apply on that day.

The proviso flags depend on the history of the same ratio (an earlier Calculation Date below 4.10, and no exceedance since). The flags therefore carry part of the covenant's applicability logic as inputs. The candidate does not define the period boundaries precisely enough for the evaluator to supply them faithfully.
judge.reason: Parts (a) and the basic Calculation Date tests (b) and (c) are correct, with the right thresholds and strictness. The candidate also makes the 4.00 minimum binding on every proviso-period Business Day, and the source does not say that. It further leaves the end of the proviso period ambiguous. The formalization is therefore not equivalent to the source and rests on an unsupported scope extension.

                            (leverage_ratio Real)

issues: The has_unincreased_quarter_in_last_four input is not anchored to the election. The source tests the 'most recently ended four consecutive Fiscal Quarter period' as a condition on making the increase, which is a one-time test at election. The candidate evaluates it at every observation. In the 2nd to 4th quarters of an elected window, the last four quarters would typically all be increased, so the input would be false. The formula would then wrongly revert to 2.75 for quarters the election legitimately covers. The comment does not say the test is made as of the election date.

The inputs for the election are only loosely tied to a specific election. acquisition_consideration_six_month refers to 'the relevant six consecutive month period' without saying it is the period for the election being relied on. election_notice_given has the same gap. Per-observation compliance therefore cannot be determined faithfully.

increase_times_including_this and increased_quarters_including_this are defined as counts 'counting the election being relied on', and the lifetime caps are applied to them at every observation. In later quarters of the window the meaning of 'including this' is ambiguous. The comments do not clearly resolve whether prior elections are counted or whether the cap is tested at election time.

The source says 'more than four times (or with respect to more than twelve Fiscal Quarters)'. The candidate applies both caps conjunctively. This is a plausible reading, but the source's parenthetical is ambiguous and the candidate does not document the choice.
judge.reason: The base 2.75 test and the 3.00 alternative threshold are correct, as is the test-period-end guard from 2014-09-30. However, the proviso conditions that belong to the election event are applied as per-observation inputs with ambiguous anchoring. The 'at least one unincreased quarter in the last four' condition is the clearest case: evaluated at each observation, it can wrongly deny the increase in later quarters of a valid window. The parameter meanings are therefore underspecified for the election-dependent logic, so the formalization is not faithful.

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter, the date at which Section 4.9(a)-(d) ratios are tested.
; is_on_or_after_first_test_period: true iff the observed fiscal-quarter period ends on or after March 31, 1997, the first period for which compliance is determined.
; total_current_assets: Investors' total current assets (GAAP, consistently applied) at the quarter-end observation.
; total_current_liabilities: Investors' total current liabilities (GAAP, consistently applied) at the quarter-end observation.
; ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter: EBITDA for the twelve-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; interest_expense_ttm_prior_quarter: total interest expense deducted in determining net income for the twelve-month period ending on the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; current_maturities_principal_prior_quarter: all current maturities of principal on all unsubordinated long-term indebtedness of Borrowers, excluding any amount outstanding under the Line of Credit, as of the last day of the immediately preceding fiscal quarter.
; senior_funded_debt: Senior Funded Debt, i.e. total funded unsubordinated indebtedness of Borrowers per GAAP, including capital leases.
; term_loan_made: true iff the Term Loan has been made as of the observation (true = from and after the making of the Term Loan; false = prior to it).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_on_or_after_first_test_period Bool)
    (total_current_assets Real)
    (total_current_liabilities Real)
    (ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter Real)
    (interest_expense_ttm_prior_quarter Real)
    (current_maturities_principal_prior_quarter Real)
    (senior_funded_debt Real)
    (term_loan_made Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_on_or_after_first_test_period)
      (and
        ; (a) Current Ratio >= 1.20
        (>= (/ total_current_assets total_current_liabilities) 1.2)
        ; (b) Debt Service Coverage Ratio >= 1.5
        (>= (/ ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter
               (+ interest_expense_ttm_prior_quarter current_maturities_principal_prior_quarter))
            1.5)
        ; (c) before Term Loan: Senior Funded Debt / EBITDA <= 5.0; (d) from and after Term Loan: <= 3.5
        (ite term_loan_made
             (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter) 3.5)
             (<= (/ senior_funded_debt ebitda_ttm_prior_quarter) 5.0)))))

; consolidated_funded_debt: Consolidated Funded Debt at the observation date.
; consolidated_ebitda_midstream_ltm: Consolidated EBITDA-Midstream for the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date, or ending on the last day of the most recently ended fiscal quarter if the date is not a quarter end.
; present_value: the Present Value amount at the observation date, as used in Section 7.11(c)(2).
; debt_ratings_trigger_period_active: true iff the observation date falls within a Debt Ratings Trigger Period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (funded_debt_to_cap_ratio Real)
    (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
    (investment_grade_date_occurred Bool)
    (consolidated_funded_debt Real)
    (consolidated_ebitda_midstream_ltm Real)
    (present_value Real)
    (debt_ratings_trigger_period_active Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; 7.11(a): at each fiscal quarter end, ratio must not exceed 0.6
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= funded_debt_to_cap_ratio 0.6))
    ; 7.11(b): at each fiscal quarter end, leverage ratio must not exceed 3.5, ceasing from the Investment Grade Date
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end (not investment_grade_date_occurred))
        (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 3.5))
    ; 7.11(c): only during a Debt Ratings Trigger Period, debt <= 3.5 * EBITDA-Midstream + Present Value / 1.50
    (=> debt_ratings_trigger_period_active
        (<= consolidated_funded_debt
            (+ (* 3.5 consolidated_ebitda_midstream_ltm) (/ present_value 1.50))))))

A positive liabilities total divided by a negative net worth gives a negative ratio, which is <= 1.75, so the formula reports compliance. ; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (0.60 = 60%).
; secured_leverage_ratio: Secured Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (0.45 = 45%).
; unencumbered_leverage_ratio: Unencumbered Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (0.60 = 60%).
; secured_recourse_debt_ratio: Secured Recourse Debt Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (0.075 = 7.5%).
; fixed_charge_ratio_annualized: Parent's consolidated Fixed Charge Ratio for the fiscal quarter then ended, annualized, as a multiple X in X to 1.0.
; tangible_net_worth: Parent's consolidated Tangible Net Worth as of the observation date, in dollars.
; equity_issuance_net_proceeds_since_2012_09_10: total net proceeds of all Equity Issuances received by Parent or Borrower after September 10, 2012, in dollars, before removing the excluded redemption-related proceeds.
; excluded_redemption_related_proceeds: portion of those net proceeds received within 90 days after a redemption, retirement or repurchase of ownership or equity interests in Borrower or Parent, capped at the amount paid for that redemption, retirement or repurchase, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter Bool)
  (obligations_outstanding Bool)
  (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
  (secured_leverage_ratio Real)
  (unencumbered_leverage_ratio Real)
  (secured_recourse_debt_ratio Real)
  (fixed_charge_ratio_annualized Real)
  (tangible_net_worth Real)
  (equity_issuance_net_proceeds_since_2012_09_10 Real)
  (excluded_redemption_related_proceeds Real)) Bool
  (=> (and is_last_day_of_fiscal_quarter obligations_outstanding)
      (and (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 0.60)
           (<= secured_leverage_ratio 0.45)
           (<= unencumbered_leverage_ratio 0.60)
           (<= secured_recourse_debt_ratio 0.075)
           (>= fixed_charge_ratio_annualized 1.5)
           (>= tangible_net_worth
               (+ 502634000.0
                  (* 0.75 (- equity_issuance_net_proceeds_since_2012_09_10
                             excluded_redemption_related_proceeds)))))))

; revolving_note_unpaid: the Revolving Credit Note remains unpaid at the observation time.
; bank_has_commitment: the Bank has a Commitment under the Agreement at the observation time.
; acquisition_made: the Borrower and/or Guarantor makes an Acquisition at this observation.
; prior_written_consent: the Bank gave prior written consent to this Acquisition.
; acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets: the acquisition is of stock or assets (excluding real property) of another person or entity.
; borrower_is_surviving_entity: the Borrower is the surviving entity.
; same_line_of_business: the acquiree (or the acquired assets' use) is in the same general line of business as the Borrower and the Guarantor.
; acquiree_us_organized: the acquiree is incorporated or organized in the United States.
; acquisition_non_hostile: the acquisition is non-hostile in nature.
; no_default_before: prior to the acquisition there is no Default or Event of Default under the Agreement.
; no_default_after: immediately following the acquisition there is no Default or Event of Default under the Agreement.
; third_party_consents_obtained: all third party consents and approvals necessary for the acquisition have been obtained.
; free_clear_evidence_ok: evidence exists that the stock or assets are purchased free and clear of liens/encumbrances other than those permitted under the Agreement and, for stock, free of restrictions other than those acceptable to the Bank.
; acquiree_becomes_subsidiary: the proposed acquiree becomes a Subsidiary of the Borrower.
; bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues: the Bank and its counsel are satisfied with all issues relating to consideration for the entity to guaranty and pledge all of its assets as Collateral.
; sub_guarantee_delivered: the Subsidiary immediately executed and delivered its Guarantee of the Borrower's Revolving Credit Commitment obligations, in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank and its counsel.
; sub_pledge_delivered: the Subsidiary immediately pledged all its assets as Collateral and executed all documentation required by the Bank to perfect a first priority security interest, satisfactory to the Bank and its counsel.
; environmental_compliance_evidence: evidence exists that the acquiree complies with all environmental, federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations for all real estate to be acquired by the Borrower.
; aggregate_consideration: aggregate Consideration in dollars paid by the Borrower for this and all prior acquisitions during the term of the Agreement.
; bank_received_documentation: prior to consummation, the Bank received, for satisfactory review and approval, all documentation required by the Bank for the Acceptable Acquisition (clause (i)).
; other_info_received: prior to consummation, the Bank received such other information, documentation or certificates as it reasonably requested, satisfactory in form and substance (clause (iii)).
; liabilities_before: Consolidated Total Liabilities (including non-perpetual preferred stock) of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries before the acquisition.
; liabilities_after: Consolidated Total Liabilities (including non-perpetual preferred stock) of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries after the acquisition.
; total_assets_after: Consolidated Total Assets of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries after the acquisition.
; buyout_liabilities_after: portion of Consolidated Total Liabilities after the acquisition derived from past or present buyouts, acquisitions or recapitalizations.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (revolving_note_unpaid Bool)
  (bank_has_commitment Bool)
  (acquisition_made Bool)
  (prior_written_consent Bool)
  (acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets Bool)
  (borrower_is_surviving_entity Bool)
  (same_line_of_business Bool)
  (acquiree_us_organized Bool)
  (acquisition_non_hostile Bool)
  (no_default_before Bool)
  (no_default_after Bool)
  (third_party_consents_obtained Bool)
  (free_clear_evidence_ok Bool)
  (acquiree_becomes_subsidiary Bool)
  (bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues Bool)
  (sub_guarantee_delivered Bool)
  (sub_pledge_delivered Bool)
  (environmental_compliance_evidence Bool)
  (aggregate_consideration Real)
  (bank_received_documentation Bool)
  (other_info_received Bool)
  (liabilities_before Real)
  (liabilities_after Real)
  (total_assets_after Real)
  (buyout_liabilities_after Real)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or revolving_note_unpaid bank_has_commitment) acquisition_made)
      (or prior_written_consent
          (and acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets
               borrower_is_surviving_entity
               same_line_of_business
               acquiree_us_organized
               acquisition_non_hostile
               no_default_before
               no_default_after
               third_party_consents_obtained
               free_clear_evidence_ok
               (=> acquiree_becomes_subsidiary
                   (and bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues
                        sub_guarantee_delivered
                        sub_pledge_delivered))
               environmental_compliance_evidence
               (<= aggregate_consideration 2000000.0)
               bank_received_documentation
               (or (and (< liabilities_after (* 2.0 liabilities_before))
                        (<= (/ liabilities_after total_assets_after) 0.5))
                   (and (<= (/ liabilities_after total_assets_after) 0.75)
                        (< (/ buyout_liabilities_after liabilities_after) 0.25)))
               other_info_received))))",

    {"name": "bank_has_commitment", "meaning": "The Bank has a Commitment under the Agreement at the observation time.", "source_quote": "the Bank shall have any Commitment under this Agreement"},

    {"name": "free_clear_evidence_ok", "meaning": "Evidence exists that the stock or assets are purchased free and clear of non-permitted liens/encumbrances and, for stock, free of restrictions other than those acceptable to the Bank.", "source_quote": "evidence that such stock or assets are to be purchased free and clear of any liens or encumbrances other than any liens or encumbrances permitted under this Agreement and, in the case of stock, free of any restrictions other than those acceptable to the Bank"},

    {"name": "bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues", "meaning": "The Bank and its counsel are satisfied with all issues relating to consideration for the entity to guaranty and pledge all its assets as Collateral.", "source_quote": "the Bank and its counsel shall be satisfied with all issues relating to consideration for such entity to guaranty and pledge all of its assets as Collateral"},

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (revolving_note_unpaid Bool)
  (bank_has_commitment Bool)
  (acquisition_made Bool)
  (prior_written_consent Bool)
  (acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets Bool)
  (borrower_is_surviving_entity Bool)
  (same_line_of_business Bool)
  (acquiree_us_organized Bool)
  (acquisition_non_hostile Bool)
  (no_default_before Bool)
  (no_default_after Bool)
  (third_party_consents_obtained Bool)
  (free_clear_evidence_ok Bool)
  (acquiree_becomes_subsidiary Bool)
  (bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues Bool)
  (sub_guarantee_delivered Bool)
  (sub_pledge_delivered Bool)
  (environmental_compliance_evidence Bool)
  (aggregate_consideration Real)
  (bank_received_documentation Bool)
  (other_info_received Bool)
  (liabilities_before Real)
  (liabilities_after Real)
  (total_assets_after Real)
  (buyout_liabilities_after Real)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or revolving_note_unpaid bank_has_commitment) acquisition_made)
      (or prior_written_consent
          (and acquires_stock_or_nonreal_assets
               borrower_is_surviving_entity
               same_line_of_business
               acquiree_us_organized
               acquisition_non_hostile
               no_default_before
               no_default_after
               third_party_consents_obtained
               free_clear_evidence_ok
               (=> acquiree_becomes_subsidiary
                   (and bank_satisfied_guaranty_pledge_issues
                        sub_guarantee_delivered
                        sub_pledge_delivered))
               environmental_compliance_evidence
               (<= aggregate_consideration 2000000.0)
               bank_received_documentation
               (or (and (< liabilities_after (* 2.0 liabilities_before))
                        (<= (/ liabilities_after total_assets_after) 0.5))
                   (and (<= (/ liabilities_after total_assets_after) 0.75)
                        (< (/ buyout_liabilities_after liabilities_after) 0.25)))
               other_info_received))))

candidate.notes: Pointwise: if the covenant term is active (note unpaid or Commitment) and an Acquisition is made, it must have prior written consent or be an Acceptable Acquisition (criteria i-x plus the Bank's prior-receipt items). Criterion (viii) applies only if the acquiree becomes a Subsidiary. The leverage test uses either option (a) or option (b). 'Not double' is read as liabilities_after < 2 * liabilities_before. 'Higher than' is encoded as <=, and '25% or more' as < 0.25. Ratios use division, so an evaluator-reported zero denominator is unresolved. The Bank's discretionary right to reset financial covenants is not a restriction on the Borrower, so it is not encoded.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.
