{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Companies.
; ends_jan31: true iff the four fiscal quarters end on a January 31 (Adjusted Capital Expenditures cap of $25,000,000).
; ends_apr_jul_oct: true iff the four fiscal quarters end on April 30, July 31, or October 31 (cap of $15,000,000).
; in_period_through_jul_1999: true iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end after the Closing Date through and including July 31, 1999 (minimum 1.15).
; in_period_oct1999_to_jul2000: true iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end from October 31, 1999 through and including July 31, 2000 (minimum 1.20).
; in_period_from_oct2000: true iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end commencing with October 31, 2000 (minimum 1.25).
; resort_ebitda_4q: Resort EBITDA in dollars for the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date, with the pro forma acquisition/disposition adjustments applied.
; actual_capex_4q: the Companies' actual capital expenditures in dollars during the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; interest_obligation_4q: interest on the Obligation in dollars paid or payable in the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q: scheduled principal and interest payments in dollars on all Funded Debt other than the Obligation in the four fiscal quarters (for the period ending June 30, 1997, computed as though all such Debt was incurred at the start of the period).
; vri_distributions_4q: Distributions made by VRI in dollars in the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (ends_jan31 Bool)
    (ends_apr_jul_oct Bool)
    (in_period_through_jul_1999 Bool)
    (in_period_oct1999_to_jul2000 Bool)
    (in_period_from_oct2000 Bool)
    (resort_ebitda_4q Real)
    (actual_capex_4q Real)
    (interest_obligation_4q Real)
    (sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q Real)
    (vri_distributions_4q Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; January 31 case: Adjusted Capital Expenditures = min(actual capex, 25,000,000)
      (=> ends_jan31
        (and
          (=> in_period_through_jul_1999
            (>= (/ (- resort_ebitda_4q (ite (<= actual_capex_4q 25000000.0) actual_capex_4q 25000000.0))
                   (+ interest_obligation_4q sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q vri_distributions_4q))
                1.15))
          (=> in_period_oct1999_to_jul2000
            (>= (/ (- resort_ebitda_4q (ite (<= actual_capex_4q 25000000.0) actual_capex_4q 25000000.0))
                   (+ interest_obligation_4q sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q vri_distributions_4q))
                1.20))
          (=> in_period_from_oct2000
            (>= (/ (- resort_ebitda_4q (ite (<= actual_capex_4q 25000000.0) actual_capex_4q 25000000.0))
                   (+ interest_obligation_4q sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q vri_distributions_4q))
                1.25))))
      ; April 30 / July 31 / October 31 case: Adjusted Capital Expenditures = min(actual capex, 15,000,000)
      (=> ends_apr_jul_oct
        (and
          (=> in_period_through_jul_1999
            (>= (/ (- resort_ebitda_4q (ite (<= actual_capex_4q 15000000.0) actual_capex_4q 15000000.0))
                   (+ interest_obligation_4q sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q vri_distributions_4q))
                1.15))
          (=> in_period_oct1999_to_jul2000
            (>= (/ (- resort_ebitda_4q (ite (<= actual_capex_4q 15000000.0) actual_capex_4q 15000000.0))
                   (+ interest_obligation_4q sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q vri_distributions_4q))
                1.20))
          (=> in_period_from_oct2000
            (>= (/ (- resort_ebitda_4q (ite (<= actual_capex_4q 15000000.0) actual_capex_4q 15000000.0))
                   (+ interest_obligation_4q sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q vri_distributions_4q))
                1.25)))))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Companies, when the ratio is calculated.", "source_quote": "As calculated as of the last day of each fiscal quarter of the Companies"},
    {"name": "ends_jan31", "meaning": "True iff the four fiscal quarters end on a January 31; the Adjusted Capital Expenditures cap is $25,000,000.", "source_quote": "for the four fiscal quarters ending any January 31"},
    {"name": "ends_apr_jul_oct", "meaning": "True iff the four fiscal quarters end on April 30, July 31, or October 31; the Adjusted Capital Expenditures cap is $15,000,000.", "source_quote": "for the four fiscal quarters ending on any April 30, July 31, or October 31"},
    {"name": "in_period_through_jul_1999", "meaning": "True iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end after the Closing Date through and including July 31, 1999 (minimum ratio 1.15).", "source_quote": "As of the last day of each fiscal quarter occurring after the Closing Date through and including July 31, 1999: 1.15 to 1.00"},
    {"name": "in_period_oct1999_to_jul2000", "meaning": "True iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end from October 31, 1999 through and including July 31, 2000 (minimum ratio 1.20).", "source_quote": "As of the last day of each fiscal quarter commencing with October 31, 1999, through and including July 31, 2000: 1.20 to 1.00"},
    {"name": "in_period_from_oct2000", "meaning": "True iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end commencing with October 31, 2000 (minimum ratio 1.25).", "source_quote": "As of the last day of each fiscal quarter commencing with October 31, 2000: 1.25 to 1.00"},
    {"name": "resort_ebitda_4q", "meaning": "Resort EBITDA in dollars for the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date, with the pro forma acquisition and disposition adjustments applied.", "source_quote": "Resort EBITDA for the four fiscal quarters ending on such last day"},
    {"name": "actual_capex_4q", "meaning": "The Companies' actual capital expenditures in dollars during the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "the Companies' actual capital expenditures during such four fiscal quarters"},
    {"name": "interest_obligation_4q", "meaning": "Interest on the Obligation in dollars in the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "interest on the Obligation"},
    {"name": "sched_pi_other_funded_debt_4q", "meaning": "Scheduled principal and interest payments in dollars on all Funded Debt other than the Obligation in the four fiscal quarters. For the period ending June 30, 1997, computed as though all such Debt was incurred at the beginning of the period.", "source_quote": "scheduled principal and interest payments on all other Funded Debt"},
    {"name": "vri_distributions_4q", "meaning": "Distributions made by VRI in dollars in the four fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "Distributions made by VRI"}
  ],
  "notes": "The covenant requires ratio = (Resort EBITDA - Adjusted Capital Expenditures) / (interest on the Obligation + scheduled principal and interest on other Funded Debt + VRI Distributions) to be not less than the applicable minimum, so the formula uses >=. Adjusted Capital Expenditures is min(actual capex, cap), with a cap of 25,000,000 for January 31 and 15,000,000 for April 30, July 31 and October 31. Each period-and-cap combination is an implication, so an observation matching no flag is vacuous. A zero denominator is left to the evaluator to report as unresolved. QF_NRA is used because the divisor is a variable expression. The pro forma Resort EBITDA adjustment and the June 30, 1997 debt assumption are carried in the meanings of the supplied inputs. The survival-period language (commitments outstanding until the Obligation is paid) is not modeled as a separate input, because the pointwise evaluation covers observations while the covenant is in force."
}

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; commitments_or_amounts_outstanding: true iff at the observation time any Bank has any Commitment under the agreement or any amount payable under the agreement remains unpaid.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; consolidated_adjusted_ebit_four_quarters: Consolidated Adjusted EBIT for the four fiscal quarters then ended taken as a single accounting period, excluding the effect of the one-time $123,800,000 (after tax) restructuring charge.
; consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters: Consolidated Interest Expense for the four fiscal quarters then ended taken as a single accounting period, excluding the effect of the one-time restructuring charge.
; consolidated_railcar_lease_expense_four_quarters: Consolidated Railcar Lease Expense for the four fiscal quarters then ended taken as a single accounting period, excluding the effect of the one-time restructuring charge.
; tnw_prior_quarter_end: Consolidated Tangible Net Worth calculated as at the end of the most recently ended fiscal quarter, excluding the effect of the one-time restructuring charge.
; writeoffs_special_charges_announced_in_quarter: total amount of write-offs and similar special charges publicly announced by the Borrower during the current fiscal quarter, as a nonreducing-sign-positive amount that reduces Consolidated Tangible Net Worth.
; restricted_payments_in_quarter: total amount of Restricted Payments made during the current fiscal quarter, as a positive amount that reduces Consolidated Tangible Net Worth.
; cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income: sum of Consolidated Net Income over each fiscal quarter ended after December 31, 1995 and on or before the observation date whose Consolidated Net Income is positive; non-positive quarters contribute zero; excludes the effect of the one-time restructuring charge.
; gatx_exposure: aggregate amount of investments by the Borrower in, net advances by the Borrower to, and receivables due to the Borrower from, GATX and its Subsidiaries other than the Borrower and Subsidiaries of the Borrower, as at the observation date.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_or_amounts_outstanding Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (consolidated_adjusted_ebit_four_quarters Real)
  (consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters Real)
  (consolidated_railcar_lease_expense_four_quarters Real)
  (tnw_prior_quarter_end Real)
  (writeoffs_special_charges_announced_in_quarter Real)
  (restricted_payments_in_quarter Real)
  (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real)
  (gatx_exposure Real)) Bool
  (=> commitments_or_amounts_outstanding
    (and
      ; (a) interest and railcar lease coverage ratio strictly greater than 1.45 to 1.0 at fiscal quarter end
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (> (/ consolidated_adjusted_ebit_four_quarters
              (+ consolidated_interest_expense_four_quarters
                 (* 0.5 consolidated_railcar_lease_expense_four_quarters)))
           1.45))
      ; (b) deemed Consolidated Tangible Net Worth strictly greater than $570,000,000 plus 25% of cumulative positive quarterly net income
      (> (- (- tnw_prior_quarter_end writeoffs_special_charges_announced_in_quarter) restricted_payments_in_quarter)
         (+ 570000000.0 (* 0.25 cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income)))
      ; (c) GATX exposure not exceeding 65% of deemed Consolidated Tangible Net Worth
      (<= gatx_exposure
          (* 0.65 (- (- tnw_prior_quarter_end writeoffs_special_charges_announced_in_quarter) restricted_payments_in_quarter))))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; in_stage_2: observation falls during Stage 2.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter.
; on_or_after_q_2003_03_31: the Fiscal Quarter ending at this observation is the quarter ending March 31, 2003 or a later one.
; on_or_after_q_2003_12_31: the Fiscal Quarter ending at this observation is the quarter ending December 31, 2003 or a later one.
; before_initial_funding_date: observation is at a time prior to the Initial Funding Date.
; is_last_fq_before_initial_funding: the quarter ending at this observation is the Fiscal Quarter most recently ended prior to the Initial Funding Date.
; senior_leverage_ratio: Senior Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; max_senior_leverage_ratio: maximum Senior Leverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(a) for that Fiscal Quarter.
; total_leverage_ratio: Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; max_total_leverage_ratio: maximum Total Leverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(b) for that Fiscal Quarter.
; interest_coverage_ratio: Interest Coverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; min_interest_coverage_ratio: minimum Interest Coverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(c) for that Fiscal Quarter.
; pro_forma_dscr: Pro Forma Debt Service Coverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter.
; min_pro_forma_dscr: minimum Pro Forma Debt Service Coverage Ratio on Schedule 6.7(d) for that Fiscal Quarter.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((in_stage_2 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (on_or_after_q_2003_03_31 Bool)
                            (on_or_after_q_2003_12_31 Bool)
                            (before_initial_funding_date Bool)
                            (is_last_fq_before_initial_funding Bool)
                            (senior_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (max_senior_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (total_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (max_total_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (min_interest_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (pro_forma_dscr Real)
                            (min_pro_forma_dscr Real)) Bool
  (=> (and in_stage_2
           is_fiscal_quarter_end
           (not (and before_initial_funding_date (not is_last_fq_before_initial_funding))))
      (and (=> on_or_after_q_2003_03_31
               (and (<= senior_leverage_ratio max_senior_leverage_ratio)
                    (<= total_leverage_ratio max_total_leverage_ratio)
                    (>= interest_coverage_ratio min_interest_coverage_ratio)))
           (=> on_or_after_q_2003_12_31
               (>= pro_forma_dscr min_pro_forma_dscr)))))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrowers and their Subsidiaries.
; consolidated_ebit: Consolidated EBIT for the then most-recently ended four fiscal quarters (numerator of the ratio).
; consolidated_interest_expense: Consolidated Interest Expense for the then most-recently ended four fiscal quarters (denominator of the ratio).
; admin_agent_requested: true iff the Administrative Agent has requested that the Borrowers enter into Rate Management Transactions in respect of this quarter-end determination.
; rate_mgmt_entered_promptly_after_request: true iff the Borrowers, promptly after that request, have entered into one or more Rate Management Transactions with one or more financial institutions.
; rate_mgmt_fixed_rate: true iff those Rate Management Transactions provide for a fixed rate of interest.
; rate_mgmt_notional_amount_usd: aggregate notional amount, in US dollars, of those Rate Management Transactions.
; rate_mgmt_avg_weighted_maturity_years: average weighted maturity, in years, of those Rate Management Transactions.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (consolidated_ebit Real)
    (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
    (admin_agent_requested Bool)
    (rate_mgmt_entered_promptly_after_request Bool)
    (rate_mgmt_fixed_rate Bool)
    (rate_mgmt_notional_amount_usd Real)
    (rate_mgmt_avg_weighted_maturity_years Real)

  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end
           (< (/ consolidated_ebit consolidated_interest_expense) 3.0)
           admin_agent_requested)
      (and rate_mgmt_entered_promptly_after_request
           rate_mgmt_fixed_rate
           (>= rate_mgmt_notional_amount_usd 25000000.0)
           (>= rate_mgmt_avg_weighted_maturity_years 2.0))))

issues: The antecedent conjoins is_fiscal_quarter_end with admin_agent_requested at the same observation. The source ties the obligation to the Administrative Agent's request, and the ratio is the one for the most recently ended four quarters at that time. A request normally comes after the quarter-end date, so at that observation is_fiscal_quarter_end is false and the implication holds vacuously. The comment for admin_agent_requested says the request is made 'in respect of this quarter-end determination'. The source has no such per-quarter linkage, so this adds an unsupported assumption that the request and the determination are tied to the same observation.

The consequent requires the entry to be done at the same observation as the request. The 'promptly after request' timing is collapsed into a single Boolean, and the pointwise treatment of a later obligation is not specified. The comments do not explain how the evaluator should set this flag across observations.
judge.reason: The thresholds are right: ratio < 3.0, notional >= $25,000,000, weighted maturity >= 2 years, and a fixed rate. The guard is wrong, though. Requiring is_fiscal_quarter_end together with the Agent's request means the obligation is checked only when a request coincides with a quarter-end observation. The source triggers the obligation on the request, using the ratio as of the most recently ended four fiscal quarters. The candidate therefore misstates applicability and would pass histories that violate the covenant.

teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; obligations_or_commitment_outstanding: True iff any of the Obligations remain unpaid or the Bank has any Commitment at the observation time.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: True iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter.
; quick_ratio: Borrower's Quick Ratio as of the fiscal quarter end, as a number (1.40 means 1.40 to 1.0).
; consolidated_tangible_net_worth: Consolidated Tangible Net Worth as of the fiscal quarter end, in US dollars.
; consolidated_total_liabilities: Consolidated Total Liabilities as of the fiscal quarter end, in US dollars.
; current_quarter_in_profitability_period: True iff the fiscal quarter ending at this observation falls within the period from the Closing Date through the Revolving Expiry Date.
; prior_quarter_in_profitability_period: True iff the immediately preceding fiscal quarter also falls within the period from the Closing Date through the Revolving Expiry Date.
; current_net_operating_income: Consolidated net operating income (negative means loss) for the fiscal quarter ending at this observation, in US dollars.
; current_net_after_tax_income: Consolidated net after-taxes income (negative means loss) for the fiscal quarter ending at this observation, in US dollars.
; prior_net_operating_income: Consolidated net operating income (negative means loss) for the immediately preceding fiscal quarter, in US dollars.
; prior_net_after_tax_income: Consolidated net after-taxes income (negative means loss) for the immediately preceding fiscal quarter, in US dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_or_commitment_outstanding Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (quick_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real)
  (consolidated_total_liabilities Real)
  (current_quarter_in_profitability_period Bool)
  (prior_quarter_in_profitability_period Bool)
  (current_net_operating_income Real)
  (current_net_after_tax_income Real)
  (prior_net_operating_income Real)
  (prior_net_after_tax_income Real)) Bool
  (=> (and obligations_or_commitment_outstanding is_fiscal_quarter_end)

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; obligations_outstanding: true if any Note or other amount due under the agreement is outstanding and unpaid at the observation time.
; total_indebtedness_excl_lc: Total Indebtedness on the observation date, excluding all letters of credit (Section 6.01(1) numerator).
; total_indebtedness_incl_lc: Total Indebtedness on the observation date, including letters of credit other than those issued under Section 2.02 (Section 6.01(2) numerator).
; ebitdar_review_period: EBITDAR of the Borrower for the four consecutive fiscal quarters most recently ended on or before the determination date (Review Period).
; acquired_ebitdar: Without duplication, EBITDAR of any Person acquired by the Borrower or any Subsidiary (purchase, merger, consolidation or otherwise) for each fiscal quarter or portion thereof from twelve months before the determination date to the acquisition date. Use 0 if none.
; ebit_4q: EBIT for the four consecutive quarters ended on or before the observation date.
; interest_expense_4q: Interest Expense for the same four consecutive quarters ended on or before the observation date.
; tangible_net_worth: Tangible Net Worth at the observation time.
; positive_net_income_sum: Sum, over each fiscal quarter commencing with the quarter ended September 30, 2002 up to the observation time, of that quarter's Net Income if positive (zero for a quarter with non-positive Net Income). This is before applying the 75%.
; equity_net_proceeds_sum: Sum of Net Proceeds from the issuance and sale of equity securities after the date of the agreement, up to the observation time. This is before applying the 75%.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_outstanding Bool)
  (total_indebtedness_excl_lc Real)
  (total_indebtedness_incl_lc Real)
  (ebitdar_review_period Real)
  (acquired_ebitdar Real)
  (ebit_4q Real)
  (interest_expense_4q Real)
  (tangible_net_worth Real)
  (positive_net_income_sum Real)
  (equity_net_proceeds_sum Real)) Bool
  (=> obligations_outstanding
    (and
      ; 6.01(1): ratio must not be greater than 2.75 to 1.0

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

; consolidated_total_capitalization: Consolidated total Capitalization, in dollars, after giving effect to the clause (g) issuance.

issues: The source says the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio is determined on four of the previous five fiscal quarters 'at the Borrower's option'. The Borrower may therefore pick whichever four-quarter basis satisfies the covenant, so compliance should hold if any permitted basis gives at least 1.20.

The candidate collapses this choice into one opaque input, fccr_elected_basis, 'computed on the basis the Borrower elects'. It can report noncompliance when the Borrower elected, or was assigned, a weaker basis even though another permitted basis meets 1.20. It can also leave the evaluator unsure which basis to supply when no formal election was made.

A more faithful formalization would take the ratio for each of the five permitted four-of-five-quarter bases as separate inputs and require at least one of them to be at least 1.2. The five-option choice would then be in the formula instead of hidden in an input description.
The applicability guard, the quarter-end flag and the threshold of at least 1.2 are correct. The parameter comments are otherwise clear.
judge.reason: The applicability condition, the quarter-end scope and the non-strict 1.20 threshold are correct. However, the Borrower's option to use any four of the previous five quarters is an existential choice that the candidate hides in a single 'elected' ratio input. The formula therefore does not capture the source semantics of compliance under the Borrower's best permitted basis.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; advance_unpaid: true iff any Advance remains unpaid at the observation time.
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: true iff any Letter of Credit is outstanding at the observation time.
; lender_commitment_exists: true iff any Lender Party has any Commitment hereunder at the observation time.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding: true iff the observed quarter is the first complete fiscal quarter after the Initial Funding Date or a later one (start condition for clauses (a), (b), (c)).
; is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter: true iff the observed quarter is the First through Eighth Quarter of the senior debt schedule (counting from the first complete fiscal quarter after the Initial Funding Date); false for each fiscal quarter thereafter.
; consolidated_total_funded_debt: Consolidated Total Funded Debt as of the observation date.
; consolidated_senior_debt: Consolidated Senior Debt as of the observation date.
; pro_forma_ebitda_ltm: Pro Forma EBITDA for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of the Borrower.
; cash_capex_ltm: cash Capital Expenditures made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four fiscal quarters.
; cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm: federal, state, local and foreign income taxes paid in cash by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four fiscal quarters.
; cash_interest_paid_ltm: cash interest paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on all Debt during the four fiscal quarters.
; scheduled_principal_paid: scheduled principal amounts of all Debt paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four-fiscal-quarter period stated in clause (c).
; cash_dividends_paid_ltm: cash dividends paid by the Borrower to holders of its common stock during the four fiscal quarters (0 if none).
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated total assets minus Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries as of the observation date.
; initial_net_worth: Consolidated total assets minus Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries at the Initial Funding Date.
; cumulative_positive_net_income: cumulative Consolidated positive net income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, with net losses excluded (counted as zero), over the clause (d) cumulative period.
; cumulative_equity_net_proceeds: cumulative Net Proceeds of any Equity Issuance over the clause (d) cumulative period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (advance_unpaid Bool)
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
  (lender_commitment_exists Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding Bool)
  (is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter Bool)
  (consolidated_total_funded_debt Real)
  (consolidated_senior_debt Real)
  (pro_forma_ebitda_ltm Real)
  (cash_capex_ltm Real)
  (cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm Real)
  (cash_interest_paid_ltm Real)
  (scheduled_principal_paid Real)
  (cash_dividends_paid_ltm Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (initial_net_worth Real)
  (cumulative_positive_net_income Real)
  (cumulative_equity_net_proceeds Real)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or advance_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_commitment_exists)
           is_fiscal_quarter_end)
      (and
        (=> is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding
            (and
              ; (a) total funded debt / Pro Forma EBITDA <= 4.25
              (<= (/ consolidated_total_funded_debt pro_forma_ebitda_ltm) 4.25)
              ; (b) senior debt / Pro Forma EBITDA <= 3.50 for first eight quarters, 3.45 thereafter
              (<= (/ consolidated_senior_debt pro_forma_ebitda_ltm)
                  (ite is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter 3.5 3.45))
              ; (c) fixed charge coverage ratio >= 1.45
              (>= (/ (- (- pro_forma_ebitda_ltm cash_capex_ltm) cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm)
                     (+ (+ cash_interest_paid_ltm scheduled_principal_paid) cash_dividends_paid_ltm))
                  1.45)))
        ; (d) minimum net worth
        (>= consolidated_net_worth
            (+ (+ (* 0.8 initial_net_worth)
                  (* 0.8 cumulative_positive_net_income))
               cumulative_equity_net_proceeds)))))",

    {"name": "advance_unpaid", "meaning": "True iff any Advance remains unpaid at the observation time.", "source_quote": "any Advance shall remain unpaid"},
    {"name": "letter_of_credit_outstanding", "meaning": "True iff any Letter of Credit is outstanding at the observation time.", "source_quote": "any Letter of Credit shall be outstanding"},
    {"name": "lender_commitment_exists", "meaning": "True iff any Lender Party has any Commitment hereunder at the observation time.", "source_quote": "any Lender Party shall have any Commitment hereunder"},
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of each fiscal quarter of the Borrower"},
    {"name": "is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding", "meaning": "True iff the observed quarter is the first complete fiscal quarter after the Initial Funding Date or a later one; this is the start condition for clauses (a), (b) and (c).", "source_quote": "commencing with the first complete fiscal quarter after the Initial Funding Date"},
    {"name": "is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter", "meaning": "True iff the observed quarter is the First through Eighth Quarter of the senior debt ratio schedule (3.50:1.00); false for each fiscal quarter thereafter (3.45:1.00).", "source_quote": "Each Fiscal Quarter Thereafter 3.45:1.00"},
    {"name": "consolidated_total_funded_debt", "meaning": "Consolidated Total Funded Debt as of the observation date, the numerator in clause (a).", "source_quote": "Consolidated Total Funded Debt"},
    {"name": "consolidated_senior_debt", "meaning": "Consolidated Senior Debt as of the observation date, the numerator in clause (b).", "source_quote": "Consolidated Senior Debt"},
    {"name": "pro_forma_ebitda_ltm", "meaning": "Pro Forma EBITDA for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of the Borrower.", "source_quote": "Pro Forma EBITDA for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of the Borrower"},
    {"name": "cash_capex_ltm", "meaning": "Cash Capital Expenditures made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four fiscal quarters.", "source_quote": "cash Capital Expenditures made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during such four fiscal quarters"},
    {"name": "cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm", "meaning": "Federal, state, local and foreign income taxes paid in cash by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four fiscal quarters.", "source_quote": "the aggregate amount of federal, state, local and foreign income taxes paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries in cash during such four fiscal quarters"},
    {"name": "cash_interest_paid_ltm", "meaning": "Cash interest paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on all Debt during the four fiscal quarters.", "source_quote": "cash interest paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on all Debt during such four fiscal quarters"},
    {"name": "scheduled_principal_paid", "meaning": "Scheduled principal amounts of all Debt paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four-fiscal-quarter period stated in clause (c).", "source_quote": "scheduled principal amounts of all Debt paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the preceding four fiscal quarters commencing on such day"},
    {"name": "cash_dividends_paid_ltm", "meaning": "Cash dividends paid by the Borrower to holders of its common stock during the four fiscal quarters (0 if none).", "source_quote": "cash dividends, if any, paid by the Borrower to the holders of its common stock during such four fiscal quarters"},
    {"name": "consolidated_net_worth", "meaning": "Excess of Consolidated total assets over Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries as of the observation date.", "source_quote": "an excess of Consolidated total assets over Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries"},
    {"name": "initial_net_worth", "meaning": "Excess of Consolidated total assets over Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries at the Initial Funding Date.", "source_quote": "the excess of Consolidated total assets over Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries at the Initial Funding Date"},
    {"name": "cumulative_positive_net_income", "meaning": "Cumulative Consolidated positive net income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries over the clause (d) cumulative period, with net losses excluded (counted as zero).", "source_quote": "Consolidated positive net income (and excluding one hundred percent (100%) of Consolidated net losses)"},
    {"name": "cumulative_equity_net_proceeds", "meaning": "Cumulative Net Proceeds of any Equity Issuance over the clause (d) cumulative period.", "source_quote": "Net Proceeds of any Equity Issuance"}
  ],
  "notes": "The covenant applies only while an Advance is unpaid, a Letter of Credit is outstanding, or a Lender Party has a Commitment (OR of three Booleans), and only at fiscal quarter-ends. Clauses (a)-(c) additionally require the 'commencing' condition; clause (d) does not state it, so it applies at every fiscal quarter-end. Ratios use division as defined in the source, so a zero denominator is left to the evaluator to report as unresolved. Clause (c)'s phrase 'preceding four fiscal quarters commencing on such day' is garbled in the source; scheduled_principal_paid is kept as an input with the source wording. In clause (d), the cumulative inputs are supplied by the evaluator, and the 80% factors are applied in the formula. ; is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding: true iff the observed quarter is the first complete fiscal quarter after the Initial Funding Date or a later one (start condition for clauses (a), (b), (c)).
; is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter: true iff the observed quarter is the First through Eighth Quarter of the senior debt schedule (counting from the first complete fiscal quarter after the Initial Funding Date); false for each fiscal quarter thereafter.
; consolidated_total_funded_debt: Consolidated Total Funded Debt as of the observation date.
; consolidated_senior_debt: Consolidated Senior Debt as of the observation date.
; pro_forma_ebitda_ltm: Pro Forma EBITDA for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of the Borrower.
; cash_capex_ltm: cash Capital Expenditures made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four fiscal quarters.
; cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm: federal, state, local and foreign income taxes paid in cash by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four fiscal quarters.
; cash_interest_paid_ltm: cash interest paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries on all Debt during the four fiscal quarters.
; scheduled_principal_paid: scheduled principal amounts of all Debt paid by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries during the four-fiscal-quarter period stated in clause (c).
; cash_dividends_paid_ltm: cash dividends paid by the Borrower to holders of its common stock during the four fiscal quarters (0 if none).
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated total assets minus Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries as of the observation date.
; initial_net_worth: Consolidated total assets minus Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries at the Initial Funding Date.
; cumulative_positive_net_income: cumulative Consolidated positive net income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, with net losses excluded (counted as zero), over the clause (d) cumulative period.
; cumulative_equity_net_proceeds: cumulative Net Proceeds of any Equity Issuance over the clause (d) cumulative period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (advance_unpaid Bool)
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
  (lender_commitment_exists Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding Bool)
  (is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter Bool)
  (consolidated_total_funded_debt Real)
  (consolidated_senior_debt Real)
  (pro_forma_ebitda_ltm Real)
  (cash_capex_ltm Real)
  (cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm Real)
  (cash_interest_paid_ltm Real)
  (scheduled_principal_paid Real)
  (cash_dividends_paid_ltm Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (initial_net_worth Real)
  (cumulative_positive_net_income Real)
  (cumulative_equity_net_proceeds Real)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or advance_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_commitment_exists)
           is_fiscal_quarter_end)
      (and
        (=> is_on_or_after_first_complete_fiscal_quarter_after_initial_funding
            (and
              ; (a) total funded debt / Pro Forma EBITDA <= 4.25
              (<= (/ consolidated_total_funded_debt pro_forma_ebitda_ltm) 4.25)
              ; (b) senior debt / Pro Forma EBITDA <= 3.50 for first eight quarters, 3.45 thereafter
              (<= (/ consolidated_senior_debt pro_forma_ebitda_ltm)
                  (ite is_senior_first_through_eighth_quarter 3.5 3.45))
              ; (c) fixed charge coverage ratio >= 1.45
              (>= (/ (- (- pro_forma_ebitda_ltm cash_capex_ltm) cash_income_taxes_paid_ltm)
                     (+ (+ cash_interest_paid_ltm scheduled_principal_paid) cash_dividends_paid_ltm))
                  1.45)))
        ; (d) minimum net worth
        (>= consolidated_net_worth
            (+ (+ (* 0.8 initial_net_worth)
                  (* 0.8 cumulative_positive_net_income))
               cumulative_equity_net_proceeds)))))

A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. ; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: the Borrower's Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the consecutive four-quarter period ending on the observation date.
; debt_ebitda_ratio: the Borrower's Debt/EBITDA Ratio for the consecutive four-quarter period ending on the observation date.
; is_determination_date_after_base_date: true iff the observation date is a determination date that occurs after March 31, 1998.
; tangible_net_worth: the Borrower's Tangible Net Worth on the determination date.
; tnw_on_base_date: the Borrower's Tangible Net Worth on the base date, March 31, 1998.

                            (required_lenders_written_consent Bool)
                            (leverage_ratio Real)
                            (is_june_30_1998 Bool)
                            (is_sep30_or_dec31_1998 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_dec_31_1998 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (debt_ebitda_ratio Real)

                            (tangible_net_worth Real)

                            (quarterly_net_income_sum Real)
                            (equity_net_proceeds Real)
                            (debt_converted_principal Real)
                            (capex_fiscal_year_aggregate Real)) Bool

                   (* 0.80 quarterly_net_income_sum)
                   (* 0.75 equity_net_proceeds)
                   (* 0.75 debt_converted_principal))))
        (<= capex_fiscal_year_aggregate 35000000))))",

    {"name": "fixed_charge_coverage_ratio", "meaning": "The Borrower's Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the consecutive four-quarter period ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "Neither Borrower shall permit its Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio to be less than 2.50 to 1.00"},

    {"name": "tangible_net_worth", "meaning": "The Borrower's Tangible Net Worth on the determination date.", "source_quote": "Neither Borrower shall permit its Tangible Net Worth on any date of determination"},

    {"name": "quarterly_net_income_sum", "meaning": "Sum of the Borrower's consolidated quarterly net income for each quarter after the base date through the quarter ending immediately prior to the determination date, with quarterly losses ignored and, for NSJ, dividends paid by NSJ to NSE deducted.", "source_quote": "Eighty percent (80%) of the sum of such Borrower's consolidated quarterly net income (ignoring any quarterly losses and deducting, in the case of NSJ, dividends paid by NSJ to NSE)"},

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; covenant_termination_conditions_not_yet_satisfied: true iff the Article VI covenant period is still running, i.e. NOT all of the following hold: Commitments expired or terminated; principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees, expenses and other amounts payable under any Loan Document (other than contingent amounts not yet due) paid in full; all Letters of Credit expired or terminated (or cash collateralized at 103% of the aggregate undrawn amount of all outstanding Letters of Credit); all LC Disbursements reimbursed.
; is_last_date_of_fiscal_quarter: true iff the observation date is the last date of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_on_or_after_september_30_2006: true iff the observation date is on or after September 30, 2006 (the first test period ends September 30, 2006).
; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Borrower ending on the observation date.
; consolidated_cash_interest_expense: Consolidated Cash Interest Expense for the same four-consecutive-fiscal-quarter period ending on the observation date.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((covenant_termination_conditions_not_yet_satisfied Bool) (is_last_date_of_fiscal_quarter Bool) (is_on_or_after_september_30_2006 Bool) (consolidated_ebitda Real) (consolidated_cash_interest_expense Real)) Bool
  (=> (and covenant_termination_conditions_not_yet_satisfied
           is_last_date_of_fiscal_quarter
           is_on_or_after_september_30_2006)

candidate.notes: Pointwise at-any-time translation: the covenant is active unless both the Commitments are terminated and all obligations are paid in full, and it is waived when the Required Lenders have consented in writing. When active, LTI/TC must be at most 0.65, since only exceeding .65 to 1.0 is prohibited. The ratio is computed as a division. A zero Total Capitalization is left to the evaluator to report as unresolved. QF_NRA is used because the division is by a variable.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

meanings.long_term_indebtedness: Long-Term Indebtedness of the Borrowers and Subsidiaries at the observation time, as defined in the Agreement; currency units, same as total_capitalization.
meanings.total_capitalization: Total Capitalization at the observation time, as defined in the Agreement; same currency units as long_term_indebtedness.
meanings.commitments_terminated: True iff the Commitments have been terminated at the observation time.
meanings.all_obligations_paid_in_full: True iff the principal of and interest on each Loan, all Fees and all other expenses or amounts payable under any Loan Document have been paid in full at the observation time.
meanings.required_lenders_consent: True iff the Required Lenders have consented in writing, at the observation time, to the Borrower permitting the ratio to exceed .65 to 1.0.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (advance_or_obligation_unpaid Bool) ; any Advance or any other Obligation of any Loan Party under any Loan Document remains unpaid at the observation time
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool) ; any Letter of Credit is outstanding at the observation time
  (lender_commitment_outstanding Bool) ; any Lender Party has any Commitment hereunder at the observation time
  (notice_of_covenant_reduction_received Bool) ; Administrative Agent has received a Notice of Covenant Reduction at or before the observation time
  (mp_end_2002_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2002
  (mp_end_2002_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2002
  (mp_end_2002_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2002
  (mp_end_2003_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2003
  (mp_end_2003_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2003
  (mp_end_2003_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2003
  (mp_end_2003_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2003
  (mp_end_2004_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2004
  (mp_end_2004_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2004
  (mp_end_2004_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2004
  (mp_end_2004_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2004
  (mp_end_2005_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2005
  (mp_end_2005_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2005
  (mp_end_2005_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2005
  (mp_end_2005_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2005
  (mp_end_2006_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2006
  (mp_end_2006_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2006
  (mp_end_2006_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2006
  (mp_end_2006_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2006
  (mp_end_2007_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2007
  (mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later Bool) ; observation time is within a Measurement Period ending June 30, 2007 or later
  (is_last_day_of_measurement_period Bool) ; observation time is the last day of a Measurement Period
  (leverage_ratio Real) ; Leverage Ratio at the observation time, as a plain number (4.50:1.00 = 4.5)
  (senior_leverage_ratio Real) ; Senior Leverage Ratio at the observation time, as a plain number
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a plain number
  (consolidated_net_worth Real) ; Consolidated net worth of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries in dollars at the observation time
  (cumulative_net_income_excl_quarterly_losses Real) ; dollars, cumulative since April 1, 2002: sum of Consolidated Net Income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for each Fiscal Quarter, with any quarter with a net loss counted as 0
  (cumulative_equity_net_cash_proceeds Real) ; dollars, cumulative since April 1, 2002: Net Cash Proceeds received by the Borrower from its issuance of Equity Interests
  (nonrecurring_writeoff_charges Real) ; dollars, aggregate non-recurring charges incurred from the write-off of accounts receivable and other related charges tied to the pending third party carrier review of Medicare reimbursement claims or other Governmental Reimbursement Program Costs
  (consolidated_ebitda Real) ; Consolidated EBITDA at the observation time
  (consolidated_pre_minority_ebitda Real) ; Consolidated Pre-Minority EBITDA at the observation time
) Bool
  (=> (or advance_or_obligation_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_commitment_outstanding)
    (and
      ; (a) Leverage Ratio: maximum, at all times during each Measurement Period
      (=> notice_of_covenant_reduction_received (<= leverage_ratio 3.0))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2002_06_30 mp_end_2002_09_30 mp_end_2002_12_31 mp_end_2003_03_31 mp_end_2003_06_30)) (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2003_09_30 mp_end_2003_12_31)) (<= leverage_ratio 4.25))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2004_03_31 mp_end_2004_06_30)) (<= leverage_ratio 4.0))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2004_09_30 mp_end_2004_12_31)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.75))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2005_03_31 mp_end_2005_06_30)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.5))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2005_09_30 mp_end_2005_12_31)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.25))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2006_03_31 mp_end_2006_06_30 mp_end_2006_09_30 mp_end_2006_12_31 mp_end_2007_03_31 mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.0))
      ; (b) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio: minimum, as of the last day of each Measurement Period
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period (or mp_end_2002_06_30 mp_end_2002_09_30 mp_end_2002_12_31 mp_end_2003_03_31 mp_end_2003_06_30 mp_end_2003_09_30 mp_end_2003_12_31 mp_end_2004_03_31 mp_end_2004_06_30 mp_end_2004_09_30 mp_end_2004_12_31)) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.2))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period (or mp_end_2005_03_31 mp_end_2005_06_30 mp_end_2005_09_30 mp_end_2005_12_31)) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.25))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period mp_end_2006_03_31) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.3))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period (or mp_end_2006_06_30 mp_end_2006_09_30 mp_end_2006_12_31 mp_end_2007_03_31)) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 0.9))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 0.7))
      ; (c) Minimum Net Worth at all times; the non-recurring charge deduction is capped at 45,000,000
      (>= consolidated_net_worth
          (- (+ (- 250000000.0)
                (* 0.75 cumulative_net_income_excl_quarterly_losses)
                cumulative_equity_net_cash_proceeds)
             (ite (<= nonrecurring_writeoff_charges 45000000.0) nonrecurring_writeoff_charges 45000000.0)))
      ; (d) Minimum Consolidated EBITDA Ratio at all times
      (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda consolidated_pre_minority_ebitda) 0.8)
      ; (e) Senior Leverage Ratio: maximum, at all times during each Measurement Period
      (=> notice_of_covenant_reduction_received (<= senior_leverage_ratio 1.75))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2002_06_30 mp_end_2002_09_30 mp_end_2002_12_31 mp_end_2003_03_31 mp_end_2003_06_30)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 3.0))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (advance_or_obligation_unpaid Bool) ; any Advance or any other Obligation of any Loan Party under any Loan Document remains unpaid at the observation time
  (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool) ; any Letter of Credit is outstanding at the observation time
  (lender_commitment_outstanding Bool) ; any Lender Party has any Commitment hereunder at the observation time
  (notice_of_covenant_reduction_received Bool) ; Administrative Agent has received a Notice of Covenant Reduction at or before the observation time
  (mp_end_2002_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2002
  (mp_end_2002_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2002
  (mp_end_2002_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2002
  (mp_end_2003_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2003
  (mp_end_2003_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2003
  (mp_end_2003_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2003
  (mp_end_2003_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2003
  (mp_end_2004_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2004
  (mp_end_2004_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2004
  (mp_end_2004_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2004
  (mp_end_2004_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2004
  (mp_end_2005_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2005
  (mp_end_2005_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2005
  (mp_end_2005_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2005
  (mp_end_2005_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2005
  (mp_end_2006_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2006
  (mp_end_2006_06_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending June 30, 2006
  (mp_end_2006_09_30 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending September 30, 2006
  (mp_end_2006_12_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending December 31, 2006
  (mp_end_2007_03_31 Bool) ; observation time is within the Measurement Period ending March 31, 2007
  (mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later Bool) ; observation time is within a Measurement Period ending June 30, 2007 or later
  (is_last_day_of_measurement_period Bool) ; observation time is the last day of a Measurement Period
  (leverage_ratio Real) ; Leverage Ratio at the observation time, as a plain number (4.50:1.00 = 4.5)
  (senior_leverage_ratio Real) ; Senior Leverage Ratio at the observation time, as a plain number
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a plain number
  (consolidated_net_worth Real) ; Consolidated net worth of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries in dollars at the observation time
  (cumulative_net_income_excl_quarterly_losses Real) ; dollars, cumulative since April 1, 2002: sum of Consolidated Net Income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for each Fiscal Quarter, with any quarter with a net loss counted as 0
  (cumulative_equity_net_cash_proceeds Real) ; dollars, cumulative since April 1, 2002: Net Cash Proceeds received by the Borrower from its issuance of Equity Interests
  (nonrecurring_writeoff_charges Real) ; dollars, aggregate non-recurring charges incurred from the write-off of accounts receivable and other related charges tied to the pending third party carrier review of Medicare reimbursement claims or other Governmental Reimbursement Program Costs
  (consolidated_ebitda Real) ; Consolidated EBITDA at the observation time
  (consolidated_pre_minority_ebitda Real) ; Consolidated Pre-Minority EBITDA at the observation time
) Bool
  (=> (or advance_or_obligation_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_commitment_outstanding)
    (and
      ; (a) Leverage Ratio: maximum, at all times during each Measurement Period
      (=> notice_of_covenant_reduction_received (<= leverage_ratio 3.0))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2002_06_30 mp_end_2002_09_30 mp_end_2002_12_31 mp_end_2003_03_31 mp_end_2003_06_30)) (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2003_09_30 mp_end_2003_12_31)) (<= leverage_ratio 4.25))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2004_03_31 mp_end_2004_06_30)) (<= leverage_ratio 4.0))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2004_09_30 mp_end_2004_12_31)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.75))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2005_03_31 mp_end_2005_06_30)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.5))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2005_09_30 mp_end_2005_12_31)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.25))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2006_03_31 mp_end_2006_06_30 mp_end_2006_09_30 mp_end_2006_12_31 mp_end_2007_03_31 mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later)) (<= leverage_ratio 3.0))
      ; (b) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio: minimum, as of the last day of each Measurement Period
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period (or mp_end_2002_06_30 mp_end_2002_09_30 mp_end_2002_12_31 mp_end_2003_03_31 mp_end_2003_06_30 mp_end_2003_09_30 mp_end_2003_12_31 mp_end_2004_03_31 mp_end_2004_06_30 mp_end_2004_09_30 mp_end_2004_12_31)) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.2))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period (or mp_end_2005_03_31 mp_end_2005_06_30 mp_end_2005_09_30 mp_end_2005_12_31)) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.25))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period mp_end_2006_03_31) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.3))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period (or mp_end_2006_06_30 mp_end_2006_09_30 mp_end_2006_12_31 mp_end_2007_03_31)) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 0.9))
      (=> (and is_last_day_of_measurement_period mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 0.7))
      ; (c) Minimum Net Worth at all times; the non-recurring charge deduction is capped at 45,000,000
      (>= consolidated_net_worth
          (- (+ (- 250000000.0)
                (* 0.75 cumulative_net_income_excl_quarterly_losses)
                cumulative_equity_net_cash_proceeds)
             (ite (<= nonrecurring_writeoff_charges 45000000.0) nonrecurring_writeoff_charges 45000000.0)))
      ; (d) Minimum Consolidated EBITDA Ratio at all times
      (>= (/ consolidated_ebitda consolidated_pre_minority_ebitda) 0.8)
      ; (e) Senior Leverage Ratio: maximum, at all times during each Measurement Period
      (=> notice_of_covenant_reduction_received (<= senior_leverage_ratio 1.75))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2002_06_30 mp_end_2002_09_30 mp_end_2002_12_31 mp_end_2003_03_31 mp_end_2003_06_30)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 3.0))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2003_09_30 mp_end_2003_12_31)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.8))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2004_03_31 mp_end_2004_06_30)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.6))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2004_09_30 mp_end_2004_12_31)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.35))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2005_03_31 mp_end_2005_06_30)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.15))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2005_09_30 mp_end_2005_12_31)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 1.9))
      (=> (and (not notice_of_covenant_reduction_received) (or mp_end_2006_03_31 mp_end_2006_06_30 mp_end_2006_09_30 mp_end_2006_12_31 mp_end_2007_03_31 mp_end_2007_06_30_or_later)) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 1.75))
    )
  )
)

candidate.notes: Section 5.04 applies only while an Advance or Obligation is unpaid, a Letter of Credit is outstanding, or a Commitment exists, so every test sits behind that disjunction. Period schedules are encoded as implications over calendar flags supplied by the evaluator. The covenant reduction proviso replaces the scheduled cap with 3.00 for the Leverage Ratio and 1.75 for the Senior Leverage Ratio; a Notice of Covenant Reduction is not tied to any Measurement Period. The proviso in clause (e) literally says 'the Leverage Ratio', but it is read as the Senior Leverage Ratio cap of 1.75 because it sits in the Senior Leverage covenant and its figure is 1.75. The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio is tested only on the last day of a Measurement Period, with no covenant reduction override. The net worth floor is -250,000,000 + 0.75*(cumulative net income excluding quarterly losses) + equity proceeds - min(non-recurring charges, 45,000,000). The EBITDA ratio is computed by division, so a zero Pre-Minority EBITDA is reported as unresolved by the evaluator. No sign assumptions are made on any input.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding: true iff any Commitment or Loan is outstanding at the observation time.
; payment_in_full_occurred: true iff payment in full of all accrued and outstanding amounts payable by each Borrower under the agreement has occurred by the observation time.
; is_calendar_month_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a calendar month.
; delinquency_ratio: COFC Delinquency Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).
; is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a COFC fiscal quarter.
; tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio: COFC Tier 1 Capital to Managed Receivables Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (4.0% = 0.04).
; cofc_tangible_net_worth: COFC Tangible Net Worth as of the observation (determination) date, in the agreement currency.
; cofc_tnw_march_31_2004: COFC Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004, in the agreement currency.
; cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end: COFC Cumulative Net Income as of the last day of the COFC fiscal quarter most recently ended after March 31, 2004 (relative to the observation date).
; cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds: COFC Cumulative Equity Proceeds as of the observation (determination) date.
; double_leverage_ratio: Double Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, expressed as X in "X to 1" (1.25 to 1 = 1.25).
; is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a COB fiscal quarter.
; cob_tier1_leverage_ratio: COB Tier 1 Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (5.0% = 0.05).
; is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of an FSB fiscal quarter.
; fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio: FSB Tier 1 Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (5.0% = 0.05).
; cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: COB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).
; fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: FSB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).
; cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: COB Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).
; fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: FSB Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).
; cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate: COBE Tangible Net Worth on the observation date, converted to Dollars at the Dollar/pound sterling exchange rate as of March 31, 2004.
; cobe_tnw_march_31_2004: COBE Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004, in Dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding Bool)
    (payment_in_full_occurred Bool)
    (is_calendar_month_end Bool)
    (delinquency_ratio Real)
    (is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio Real)
    (cofc_tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cofc_tnw_march_31_2004 Real)
    (cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end Real)
    (cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds Real)
    (double_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (cob_tier1_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio Real)
    (cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate Real)
    (cobe_tnw_march_31_2004 Real)) Bool
  (=> (and any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding (not payment_in_full_occurred))
      (and
        ; (a) Delinquency Ratio must not exceed 6.0% at calendar month end
        (=> is_calendar_month_end (<= delinquency_ratio 0.06))
        ; (b) Tier 1 Capital to Managed Receivables Ratio must not be less than 4.0% at COFC fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end (>= tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio 0.04))
        ; (c) COFC Tangible Net Worth on any date must not be less than the stated sum
        (>= cofc_tangible_net_worth
            (+ (* 0.75 cofc_tnw_march_31_2004)
               (* 0.6 cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end)
               (* 0.6 cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds)))
        ; (d) Double Leverage Ratio must not exceed 1.25 to 1 at COFC fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end (<= double_leverage_ratio 1.25))
        ; (e) Tier 1 Leverage Ratio not less than 5.0% for COB and FSB at their fiscal quarter ends
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_tier1_leverage_ratio 0.05))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio 0.05))
        ; (f) Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio not less than 6.0% for COB and FSB
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.06))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.06))
        ; (g) Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio not less than 10.0% for COB and FSB
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.10))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.10))
        ; (h) COBE Tangible Net Worth (in Dollars at March 31, 2004 rate) on any date not less than 75% of its March 31, 2004 Tangible Net Worth
        (>= cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate (* 0.75 cobe_tnw_march_31_2004)))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding", "meaning": "True iff any Commitment or Loan is outstanding at the observation time.", "source_quote": "so long as any Commitment or Loan is outstanding"},
    {"name": "payment_in_full_occurred", "meaning": "True iff payment in full of all accrued and outstanding amounts payable by each Borrower under the agreement has occurred by the observation time.", "source_quote": "until payment in full of all accrued and outstanding amounts payable by each Borrower hereunder"},
    {"name": "is_calendar_month_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a calendar month.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of any calendar month"},
    {"name": "delinquency_ratio", "meaning": "COFC Delinquency Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).", "source_quote": "Delinquency Ratio"},
    {"name": "is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a COFC fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of any fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio", "meaning": "COFC Tier 1 Capital to Managed Receivables Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (4.0% = 0.04).", "source_quote": "Tier 1 Capital to Managed Receivables Ratio"},
    {"name": "cofc_tangible_net_worth", "meaning": "COFC Tangible Net Worth as of the observation (determination) date.", "source_quote": "COFC will not permit its Tangible Net Worth as of any date of determination"},
    {"name": "cofc_tnw_march_31_2004", "meaning": "COFC Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004.", "source_quote": "75% of its Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004"},
    {"name": "cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end", "meaning": "COFC Cumulative Net Income as of the last day of the COFC fiscal quarter most recently ended after March 31, 2004, relative to the observation date.", "source_quote": "60% of COFC Cumulative Net Income as of the last day of the fiscal quarter of COFC most recently ended after such date"},
    {"name": "cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds", "meaning": "COFC Cumulative Equity Proceeds as of the observation (determination) date.", "source_quote": "60% of COFC Cumulative Equity Proceeds as of such date of determination"},
    {"name": "double_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Double Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, expressed as X in "X to 1" (1.25 to 1 = 1.25).", "source_quote": "Double Leverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a COB fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of COB or FSB, as the case may be"},
    {"name": "cob_tier1_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "COB Tier 1 Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (5.0% = 0.05).", "source_quote": "Tier 1 Leverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of an FSB fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of COB or FSB, as the case may be"},
    {"name": "fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "FSB Tier 1 Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (5.0% = 0.05).", "source_quote": "Tier 1 Leverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio", "meaning": "COB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).", "source_quote": "Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio"},
    {"name": "fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio", "meaning": "FSB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).", "source_quote": "Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio"},
    {"name": "cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio", "meaning": "COB Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).", "source_quote": "Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio"},
    {"name": "fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio", "meaning": "FSB Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).", "source_quote": "Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio"},
    {"name": "cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate", "meaning": "COBE Tangible Net Worth on the observation date, converted to Dollars at the Dollar/pound sterling exchange rate as of March 31, 2004.", "source_quote": "converted to Dollars at the exchange rate between the Dollar and pounds sterling as of March 31, 2004"},
    {"name": "cobe_tnw_march_31_2004", "meaning": "COBE Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004, in Dollars.", "source_quote": "75% of its Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004"}
  ],
  "notes": "Percentages are encoded as fractions (6.0% = 0.06). The 1.25 to 1 ratio is encoded as 1.25. All clauses are gated by the covenant period (a Commitment or Loan outstanding and payment in full not yet occurred). Clauses (a), (b), (d)-(g) are gated by period-end flags, with separate flags and inputs for COB and FSB because each entity is tested separately. ; double_leverage_ratio: Double Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, expressed as X in "X to 1" (1.25 to 1 = 1.25).
; is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a COB fiscal quarter.

; is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of an FSB fiscal quarter.

; cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio: COB Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio as of the observation date, as a fraction (6.0% = 0.06).

; cobe_tnw_march_31_2004: COBE Tangible Net Worth as of March 31, 2004, in Dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding Bool)
    (payment_in_full_occurred Bool)
    (is_calendar_month_end Bool)
    (delinquency_ratio Real)
    (is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio Real)
    (cofc_tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cofc_tnw_march_31_2004 Real)
    (cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end Real)
    (cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds Real)
    (double_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (cob_tier1_leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio Real)
    (cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio Real)
    (cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate Real)
    (cobe_tnw_march_31_2004 Real)) Bool
  (=> (and any_commitment_or_loan_outstanding (not payment_in_full_occurred))
      (and
        ; (a) Delinquency Ratio must not exceed 6.0% at calendar month end
        (=> is_calendar_month_end (<= delinquency_ratio 0.06))
        ; (b) Tier 1 Capital to Managed Receivables Ratio must not be less than 4.0% at COFC fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end (>= tier1_capital_to_managed_receivables_ratio 0.04))
        ; (c) COFC Tangible Net Worth on any date must not be less than the stated sum
