            (+ (* 0.75 cofc_tnw_march_31_2004)
               (* 0.6 cofc_cumulative_net_income_last_quarter_end)
               (* 0.6 cofc_cumulative_equity_proceeds)))
        ; (d) Double Leverage Ratio must not exceed 1.25 to 1 at COFC fiscal quarter end
        (=> is_cofc_fiscal_quarter_end (<= double_leverage_ratio 1.25))
        ; (e) Tier 1 Leverage Ratio not less than 5.0% for COB and FSB at their fiscal quarter ends
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_tier1_leverage_ratio 0.05))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_tier1_leverage_ratio 0.05))
        ; (f) Tier 1 Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio not less than 6.0% for COB and FSB
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.06))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_tier1_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.06))
        ; (g) Total Capital to Risk Adjusted Assets Ratio not less than 10.0% for COB and FSB
        (=> is_cob_fiscal_quarter_end (>= cob_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.10))
        (=> is_fsb_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fsb_total_capital_to_risk_adjusted_assets_ratio 0.10))
        ; (h) COBE Tangible Net Worth (in Dollars at March 31, 2004 rate) on any date not less than 75% of its March 31, 2004 Tangible Net Worth
        (>= cobe_tnw_usd_at_march_31_2004_rate (* 0.75 cobe_tnw_march_31_2004)))))

All clauses are gated by the covenant period (a Commitment or Loan outstanding and payment in full not yet occurred). z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

; consolidated_pro_forma_interest_expense: Consolidated Pro-Forma Interest Expense for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.
; senior_debt_coverage_ratio: Senior Debt Coverage Ratio for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.
; is_closing_date_through_2001_12_30: true iff the observation date is on or after the Closing Date and on or before December 30, 2001.
; is_on_or_after_2001_12_31: true iff the observation date is on or after December 31, 2001.
; leverage_ratio: Leverage Ratio for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.
; cash_flow_coverage_ratio: Cash-Flow Coverage Ratio for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated Net Worth based on the financial statements of Borrower for the most recently completed fiscal quarter, in dollars.
; prior_increase_amounts_total: Sum in dollars of all Increase Amounts that took effect on increase dates strictly before this observation (0 if none).
; is_net_worth_increase_date: true iff the observation date is December 31, 2000 or the last day of a fiscal quarter after that date, so the current Increase Amount applies.
; quarter_consolidated_net_earnings: Consolidated Net Earnings of Borrower for the fiscal quarter then ended, in dollars (may be negative).
; equity_and_converted_debt_proceeds: Dollar proceeds of any equity offering by Borrower or any Subsidiary, plus proceeds of any debt offering by Borrower or any Subsidiary to the extent converted to equity, for the Increase Amount.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (consolidated_pro_forma_pre_tax_earnings Real)
  (consolidated_pro_forma_interest_expense Real)
  (senior_debt_coverage_ratio Real)
  (is_closing_date_through_2001_12_30 Bool)
  (is_on_or_after_2001_12_31 Bool)
  (leverage_ratio Real)
  (cash_flow_coverage_ratio Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (prior_increase_amounts_total Real)
  (is_net_worth_increase_date Bool)
  (quarter_consolidated_net_earnings Real)
  (equity_and_converted_debt_proceeds Real)
) Bool
  (let ((increase_amount (+ (ite (> quarter_consolidated_net_earnings 0.0) (* 0.65 quarter_consolidated_net_earnings) 0.0) equity_and_converted_debt_proceeds)))
  (let ((min_net_worth (+ 139514000.0 prior_increase_amounts_total (ite is_net_worth_increase_date increase_amount 0.0))))
    (and
      ; (a) interest coverage ratio must not be less than 1.60
      (>= (/ (+ consolidated_pro_forma_pre_tax_earnings consolidated_pro_forma_interest_expense) consolidated_pro_forma_interest_expense) 1.6)
      ; (b) senior debt coverage ratio must not exceed the period-specific cap
      (=> is_closing_date_through_2001_12_30 (<= senior_debt_coverage_ratio 2.85))
      (=> is_on_or_after_2001_12_31 (<= senior_debt_coverage_ratio 2.5))
      ; (c) leverage ratio must not exceed 4.80
      (<= leverage_ratio 4.8)
      ; (d) cash-flow coverage ratio must not be less than 1.25
      (>= cash_flow_coverage_ratio 1.25)
      ; (e) net worth must not be less than the current minimum required
      (>= consolidated_net_worth min_net_worth)))))",

    {"name": "consolidated_pro_forma_pre_tax_earnings", "meaning": "Consolidated Pro-Forma Pre-Tax Earnings for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.", "source_quote": "Consolidated Pro-Forma Pre-Tax Earnings"},
    {"name": "consolidated_pro_forma_interest_expense", "meaning": "Consolidated Pro-Forma Interest Expense for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower; it is the ratio denominator.", "source_quote": "Consolidated Pro-Forma Interest Expense"},
    {"name": "senior_debt_coverage_ratio", "meaning": "Senior Debt Coverage Ratio for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.", "source_quote": "Senior Debt Coverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "is_closing_date_through_2001_12_30", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or after the Closing Date and on or before December 30, 2001.", "source_quote": "from the Closing Date through December 30, 2001"},
    {"name": "is_on_or_after_2001_12_31", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or after December 31, 2001.", "source_quote": "on December 31, 2001 and thereafter"},
    {"name": "leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Leverage Ratio for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.", "source_quote": "Leverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "cash_flow_coverage_ratio", "meaning": "Cash-Flow Coverage Ratio for the most recently completed four fiscal quarters of Borrower.", "source_quote": "Cash-Flow Coverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "consolidated_net_worth", "meaning": "Consolidated Net Worth in dollars, based on the financial statements of Borrower for the most recently completed fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "Consolidated Net Worth"},
    {"name": "prior_increase_amounts_total", "meaning": "Sum in dollars of all Increase Amounts that took effect on increase dates strictly before this observation (0 if none).", "source_quote": "by an additional Increase Amount on the last day of each fiscal quarter thereafter"},
    {"name": "is_net_worth_increase_date", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is December 31, 2000 or the last day of a fiscal quarter after it, so the current Increase Amount is added to the minimum.", "source_quote": "positively increased by the Increase Amount on December 31, 2000"},
    {"name": "quarter_consolidated_net_earnings", "meaning": "Consolidated Net Earnings of Borrower for the fiscal quarter then ended, in dollars. Only the positive part counts, at 65%.", "source_quote": "the positive Consolidated Net Earnings of Borrower for the fiscal quarter then ended"},
    {"name": "equity_and_converted_debt_proceeds", "meaning": "Dollar proceeds of any equity offering by Borrower or any Subsidiary, plus proceeds of any debt offering by Borrower or any Subsidiary to the extent converted to equity. Counted at 100% in the Increase Amount.", "source_quote": "one hundred percent (100%) of the proceeds of any equity offering by Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries or any debt offering by Borrower or any of its Subsidiaries to the extent converted to equity"}
  ],
  "notes": "Sections 5.7(a)-(e) are conjoined, with each prohibition translated as the complementary requirement. (a) (E+I)/I >= 1.60 uses a division by a variable, so the logic is QF_NRA; a zero denominator is left to the evaluator as unresolved. (b) The 2.85 and 2.50 caps are gated by two separate date flags. (c) and (d) are plain threshold checks on atomic ratios, because their definitions are not supplied. (e) The minimum is $139,514,000 plus the sum of prior Increase Amounts, plus the current Increase Amount if the observation is an increase date. The current Increase Amount is 65% of positive quarterly net earnings plus 100% of equity and converted-debt proceeds. The running total of prior Increase Amounts is supplied as an evaluator input because it depends on history. The formula assumes observations fall on or after the Closing Date and does not add a separate applicability flag."

; is_test_period_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a period of four consecutive fiscal quarters of the Company (or, if less, the number of full fiscal quarters since the Closing Date) ending with any fiscal quarter.
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as at the observation date, as a decimal fraction (30% = 0.30).
; consolidated_tangible_net_worth: Consolidated Tangible Net Worth at the observation time, in US dollars.
; net_cash_proceeds_post_closing_equity: cumulative Net Cash Proceeds, in US dollars, of all issuances by the Company of shares of its Capital Stock consummated after the Closing Date, as of the observation time.
; company_solvency_ratio: Solvency Ratio of the Company as at the observation date, as a decimal fraction (135% = 1.35).
; has_material_insurance_subsidiary: true iff at the observation date there is at least one Insurance Subsidiary that is a Material Subsidiary.
; max_material_insurance_subsidiary_solvency_ratio: highest Solvency Ratio, as a decimal fraction, among Insurance Subsidiaries that are Material Subsidiaries as at the observation date. It is only used when has_material_insurance_subsidiary is true.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_test_period_end Bool)
                            (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
                            (consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real)
                            (net_cash_proceeds_post_closing_equity Real)
                            (company_solvency_ratio Real)
                            (has_material_insurance_subsidiary Bool)
                            (max_material_insurance_subsidiary_solvency_ratio Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.1(a): the ratio must not exceed 30% at a test period end
    (=> is_test_period_end (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 0.3))
    ; 6.1(b): at any time CTNW >= 700M + 100% of first 200M of proceeds + 50% of the remainder
    (>= consolidated_tangible_net_worth
        (+ 700000000.0
           (ite (<= net_cash_proceeds_post_closing_equity 200000000.0)
                net_cash_proceeds_post_closing_equity
                (+ 200000000.0 (* 0.5 (- net_cash_proceeds_post_closing_equity 200000000.0))))))
    ; 6.1(c)(i): the Company's Solvency Ratio must not be more than 135% at a test period end
    (=> is_test_period_end (<= company_solvency_ratio 1.35))
    ; 6.1(c)(ii): same limit for Material Subsidiaries that are Insurance Subsidiaries
    (=> (and is_test_period_end has_material_insurance_subsidiary)
        (<= max_material_insurance_subsidiary_solvency_ratio 1.35))))

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; designation_occurs: true if at this observation the Borrower designates any Restricted Subsidiary as an Unrestricted Subsidiary, or any Unrestricted Subsidiary as a Restricted Subsidiary, under Section 6.14.
; designation_to_unrestricted: true if the designation at this observation is of a Subsidiary as an Unrestricted Subsidiary (not the reverse).
; default_before_designation: true if a Default has occurred and is continuing immediately before the designation.
; default_after_designation: true if a Default has occurred and is continuing immediately after the designation.
; first_priority_net_leverage_pro_forma: Consolidated First Priority Net Leverage Ratio immediately after giving Pro Forma Effect to the designation (ratio x:1.00 as a Real).
; total_net_leverage_pro_forma: Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio immediately after giving Pro Forma Effect to the designation (ratio x:1.00 as a Real).
; compliance_certificate_delivered: true if the Borrower has delivered to the Administrative Agent a certificate setting forth in reasonable detail the calculations demonstrating compliance with the leverage ratio tests, as a condition precedent to effectiveness of the designation.

; subsidiary_is_or_owns_infusion_business: true if the Subsidiary constitutes or owns a part of the Infusion Business.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((designation_occurs Bool) (designation_to_unrestricted Bool) (default_before_designation Bool) (default_after_designation Bool) (first_priority_net_leverage_pro_forma Real) (total_net_leverage_pro_forma Real) (compliance_certificate_delivered Bool) (subsidiary_is_restricted_for_other_debt Bool) (subsidiary_is_or_owns_infusion_business Bool)) Bool
  (=> designation_occurs
      (and (not default_before_designation)
           (not default_after_designation)
           (<= first_priority_net_leverage_pro_forma 4.00)
           (<= total_net_leverage_pro_forma 5.25)
           compliance_certificate_delivered
           (=> designation_to_unrestricted
               (and (not subsidiary_is_restricted_for_other_debt)

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; advance_unpaid: true if any Advance remains unpaid at the observation time.
; bank_has_commitment: true if any Bank has any Commitment under the Agreement at the observation time.
; majority_banks_written_consent: true if the Majority Banks have consented in writing to CFSC not complying with Section 5.04 at the observation time.
; debt_m1..debt_m6: CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the 1st (most recent) to 6th preceding calendar month.
; networth_m1..networth_m6: CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the 1st (most recent) to 6th preceding calendar month.
; is_december_31: true if the observation date is a December 31.
; is_on_or_after_dec_31_2010: true if the observation date is on or after December 31, 2010.
; debt_current: CFSC Consolidated Debt on the observation date.
; networth_current: CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the observation date.
; is_calendar_quarter_end: true if the observation date is the end of a calendar quarter.
; adjusted_profit_rolling4q: consolidated profit of CFSC and Subsidiaries excluding income taxes, Interest Expense and Net Gain/(Loss) From Interest Rate Derivatives, for the rolling four-quarter period most recently ended, per GAAP.
; interest_expense_rolling4q: consolidated Interest Expense of CFSC and Subsidiaries for the rolling four-quarter period most recently ended, per GAAP.
; support_agreement_terminated: true if CFSC terminated the Support Agreement at this observation.
; support_agreement_adversely_amended: true if CFSC amended or modified the Support Agreement at this observation in a way that, in the Agent's determination, adversely affects the Banks' interests under the Agreement.
; support_notice_30_days_given: true if the Agent and the Banks were given at least 30 days prior written notice of that termination, amendment or modification.
; support_majority_banks_consent_obtained: true if the written consent of the Majority Banks to that termination, amendment or modification was obtained.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (advance_unpaid Bool)
  (bank_has_commitment Bool)
  (majority_banks_written_consent Bool)
  (debt_m1 Real) (debt_m2 Real) (debt_m3 Real) (debt_m4 Real) (debt_m5 Real) (debt_m6 Real)
  (networth_m1 Real) (networth_m2 Real) (networth_m3 Real) (networth_m4 Real) (networth_m5 Real) (networth_m6 Real)
  (is_december_31 Bool)
  (is_on_or_after_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (debt_current Real)
  (networth_current Real)
  (is_calendar_quarter_end Bool)
  (adjusted_profit_rolling4q Real)
  (interest_expense_rolling4q Real)
  (support_agreement_terminated Bool)
  (support_agreement_adversely_amended Bool)
  (support_notice_30_days_given Bool)
  (support_majority_banks_consent_obtained Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or advance_unpaid bank_has_commitment) (not majority_banks_written_consent))
    (and
      ; 5.04(a)(i): at all times, average of six month-end Leverage Ratios <= 10.0
      (<= (/ (+ (/ debt_m1 networth_m1) (/ debt_m2 networth_m2) (/ debt_m3 networth_m3)
                (/ debt_m4 networth_m4) (/ debt_m5 networth_m5) (/ debt_m6 networth_m6)) 6.0) 10.0)
      ; 5.04(a)(ii): each December 31 from December 31, 2010, Leverage Ratio <= 10.0
      (=> (and is_december_31 is_on_or_after_dec_31_2010)
          (<= (/ debt_current networth_current) 10.0))
      ; 5.04(b): at each calendar quarter end, interest coverage >= 1.15
      (=> is_calendar_quarter_end
          (>= (/ adjusted_profit_rolling4q interest_expense_rolling4q) 1.15))
      ; 5.04(c): Support Agreement termination or adverse amendment needs 30 days notice and Majority Banks consent
      (=> (or support_agreement_terminated support_agreement_adversely_amended)
          (and support_notice_30_days_given support_majority_banks_consent_obtained)))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "advance_unpaid", "meaning": "True if any Advance remains unpaid at the observation time.", "source_quote": "So long as any Advance shall remain unpaid"},
    {"name": "bank_has_commitment", "meaning": "True if any Bank has any Commitment under the Agreement at the observation time.", "source_quote": "any Bank shall have any Commitment hereunder"},
    {"name": "majority_banks_written_consent", "meaning": "True if the Majority Banks have consented in writing to CFSC not complying with Section 5.04 at the observation time.", "source_quote": "unless the Majority Banks shall otherwise consent in writing"},
    {"name": "debt_m1", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the most recent preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "debt_m2", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the 2nd preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "debt_m3", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the 3rd preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "debt_m4", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the 4th preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "debt_m5", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the 5th preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "debt_m6", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the last day of the 6th preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "networth_m1", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the most recent preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "networth_m2", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the 2nd preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "networth_m3", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the 3rd preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "networth_m4", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the 4th preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "networth_m5", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the 5th preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},
    {"name": "networth_m6", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the last day of the 6th preceding calendar month.", "source_quote": "the last day of each of the six preceding calendar months"},

    {"name": "debt_current", "meaning": "CFSC Consolidated Debt on the observation date.", "source_quote": "on the date for which computed"},
    {"name": "networth_current", "meaning": "CFSC's Consolidated Net Worth on the observation date.", "source_quote": "on the date for which computed"},
    {"name": "is_calendar_quarter_end", "meaning": "True if the observation date is the end of a calendar quarter.", "source_quote": "calculated at the end of each calendar quarter"},

    {"name": "interest_expense_rolling4q", "meaning": "Consolidated Interest Expense of CFSC and Subsidiaries for the rolling four quarters most recently ended, per GAAP.", "source_quote": "(ii) Interest Expense"},
    {"name": "support_agreement_terminated", "meaning": "True if CFSC terminated the Support Agreement at this observation.", "source_quote": "CFSC will not terminate, or make any amendment or modification to, the Support Agreement"},
    {"name": "support_agreement_adversely_amended", "meaning": "True if CFSC amended or modified the Support Agreement in a way that, in the Agent's determination, adversely affects the Banks' interests under the Agreement.", "source_quote": "which, in the determination of the Agent, adversely affects the Banks' interests pursuant to this Agreement"},
    {"name": "support_notice_30_days_given", "meaning": "True if the Agent and the Banks were given at least 30 days prior written notice of the termination, amendment or modification.", "source_quote": "at least thirty (30) days prior written notice"},
    {"name": "support_majority_banks_consent_obtained", "meaning": "True if the written consent of the Majority Banks to the termination, amendment or modification was obtained.", "source_quote": "obtaining the written consent of the Majority Banks"}
  ],
  "notes": "Applicability: the covenants apply while any Advance is unpaid or any Bank has a Commitment, unless the Majority Banks consent in writing. Section 5.04(a)(i) is applied at every observation. It averages the six month-end ratios, each computed as debt divided by net worth, so division is nonlinear and QF_NRA is used. A zero denominator is left for the evaluator to report as unresolved. Section 5.04(a)(ii) is gated by two separate flags (December 31, and on or after December 31, 2010). Section 5.04(b) is gated by the quarter-end flag and uses atomic rolling-four-quarter inputs.   (majority_banks_written_consent Bool)
  (debt_m1 Real) (debt_m2 Real) (debt_m3 Real) (debt_m4 Real) (debt_m5 Real) (debt_m6 Real)
  (networth_m1 Real) (networth_m2 Real) (networth_m3 Real) (networth_m4 Real) (networth_m5 Real) (networth_m6 Real)
  (is_december_31 Bool)
  (is_on_or_after_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (debt_current Real)
  (networth_current Real)
  (is_calendar_quarter_end Bool)
  (adjusted_profit_rolling4q Real)
  (interest_expense_rolling4q Real)
  (support_agreement_terminated Bool)
  (support_agreement_adversely_amended Bool)
  (support_notice_30_days_given Bool)
  (support_majority_banks_consent_obtained Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and (or advance_unpaid bank_has_commitment) (not majority_banks_written_consent))
    (and
      ; 5.04(a)(i): at all times, average of six month-end Leverage Ratios <= 10.0
      (<= (/ (+ (/ debt_m1 networth_m1) (/ debt_m2 networth_m2) (/ debt_m3 networth_m3)
                (/ debt_m4 networth_m4) (/ debt_m5 networth_m5) (/ debt_m6 networth_m6)) 6.0) 10.0)
      ; 5.04(a)(ii): each December 31 from December 31, 2010, Leverage Ratio <= 10.0
      (=> (and is_december_31 is_on_or_after_dec_31_2010)
          (<= (/ debt_current networth_current) 10.0))
      ; 5.04(b): at each calendar quarter end, interest coverage >= 1.15
      (=> is_calendar_quarter_end
          (>= (/ adjusted_profit_rolling4q interest_expense_rolling4q) 1.15))
      ; 5.04(c): Support Agreement termination or adverse amendment needs 30 days notice and Majority Banks consent
      (=> (or support_agreement_terminated support_agreement_adversely_amended)
          (and support_notice_30_days_given support_majority_banks_consent_obtained)))))

candidate.notes: Applicability: the covenants apply while any Advance is unpaid or any Bank has a Commitment, unless the Majority Banks consent in writing. Section 5.04(a)(i) is applied at every observation. It averages the six month-end ratios, each computed as debt divided by net worth, so division is nonlinear and QF_NRA is used. A zero denominator is left for the evaluator to report as unresolved. Section 5.04(a)(ii) is gated by two separate flags (December 31, and on or after December 31, 2010). Section 5.04(b) is gated by the quarter-end flag and uses atomic rolling-four-quarter inputs. Section 5.04(c) is modeled with event inputs: termination or an adverse amendment requires both 30 days' notice and Majority Banks consent.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

             (ite period_includes_june_30_1999_quarter
                  (+ ebitda_four_quarters_before_proviso 3996000.0)
                  ebitda_four_quarters_before_proviso))
          3.75)))

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Consolidated Parties.
; interest_coverage_ratio: the Interest Coverage Ratio as of the observation date (atomic Real, definition not supplied).
; timberland_coverage_ratio: the Timberland Coverage Ratio at the observation time (atomic Real, definition not supplied).
; leverage_ratio: the Leverage Ratio as of the observation date (atomic Real, definition not supplied).
; is_quarter_closing_date_through_2014: true iff the fiscal quarter ending on the observation date is within the period from the Closing Date through and including December 31, 2014.
; is_quarter_march_2015_or_later: true iff the fiscal quarter ends on March 31, 2015 or later.
; acquisition_consideration_usd: consideration in US dollars for the individual Permitted Acquisition that gives rise to the Adjusted Leverage Ratio window covering this quarter.
; prior_notice_given_5_business_days: true iff the Borrowers gave prior written notice to the Administrative Agent at least five Business Days before that Acquisition.
; in_adjusted_four_quarter_window: true iff this fiscal quarter is one of the four fiscal quarters beginning with the quarter in which that Permitted Acquisition occurs.
; pro_forma_compliant_with_adjusted_ratio: true iff the Company is in compliance on a Pro Forma Basis with the Adjusted Leverage Ratio after giving effect to that Permitted Acquisition.
; adjusted_ratio_reuse_permitted: true iff the Adjusted Leverage Ratio is not barred by an earlier application, meaning either no earlier application or the Company has since complied with the table Leverage Ratio for at least four consecutive fiscal quarters.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (interest_coverage_ratio Real)
    (timberland_coverage_ratio Real)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_quarter_closing_date_through_2014 Bool)
    (is_quarter_march_2015_or_later Bool)
    (acquisition_consideration_usd Real)
    (prior_notice_given_5_business_days Bool)
    (in_adjusted_four_quarter_window Bool)
    (pro_forma_compliant_with_adjusted_ratio Bool)
    (adjusted_ratio_reuse_permitted Bool)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) Interest Coverage Ratio >= 3.00 at each fiscal quarter end
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= interest_coverage_ratio 3.0))
    ; (b) Timberland Coverage Ratio > 3.00 at all times
    (> timberland_coverage_ratio 3.0)
    ; (c) Leverage Ratio max 5.00 through Dec 31, 2014
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_closing_date_through_2014)
        (<= leverage_ratio 5.0))
    ; (c) Leverage Ratio max 4.50 from March 31, 2015, or 5.00 if the Adjusted Leverage Ratio applies
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_quarter_march_2015_or_later)
        (<= leverage_ratio
            (ite (and (>= acquisition_consideration_usd 50000000.0)
                      prior_notice_given_5_business_days
                      in_adjusted_four_quarter_window
                      pro_forma_compliant_with_adjusted_ratio
                      adjusted_ratio_reuse_permitted)
                 5.0
                 4.5)))
  )
)",

; undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week: Undrawn Availability, in dollars, maintained over the rolling two week period ending at this observation.
; undrawn_availability_current: Undrawn Availability, in dollars, at this observation time (the at-all-times floor).
; year_end_2005_financials_received: true iff Borrowers' 2005 year end financial statements have been received by the time of this observation.
; default_or_event_of_default_exists: true iff a Default or an Event of Default exists at this observation.
; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; is_jun_30_2005: true iff the observation date is June 30, 2005.
; is_jul_31_2005: true iff the observation date is July 31, 2005.
; is_aug_31_2005: true iff the observation date is August 31, 2005.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
  (is_sep_30_2005_three_month_test Bool)
  (is_dec_31_2005_six_month_test Bool)
  (is_mar_31_2006_nine_month_test Bool)
  (is_jun_30_2006_twelve_month_test Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_jun_30_2006 Bool)
  (undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week Real)
  (undrawn_availability_current Real)
  (year_end_2005_financials_received Bool)
  (default_or_event_of_default_exists Bool)
  (consolidated_ebitda Real)
  (is_jun_30_2005 Bool)
  (is_jul_31_2005 Bool)
  (is_aug_31_2005 Bool)
) Bool
  (and
    ; (A) FCCR >= 1.05 on each specified test date
    (=> (or is_sep_30_2005_three_month_test
            is_dec_31_2005_six_month_test
            is_mar_31_2006_nine_month_test
            is_jun_30_2006_twelve_month_test
            is_fiscal_quarter_end_after_jun_30_2006)
        (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.05))
    ; (B) before receipt of 2005 year end financials: rolling two week >= 1,000,000 and at all times >= 250,000
    (=> (not year_end_2005_financials_received)
        (and (>= undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week 1000000.0)
             (>= undrawn_availability_current 250000.0)))
    ; (B) thereafter: >= 500,000 provided no Default or Event of Default exists
    (=> (and year_end_2005_financials_received (not default_or_event_of_default_exists))
        (>= undrawn_availability_rolling_two_week 500000.0))
    ; (C) minimum Consolidated EBITDA on the specified dates
    (=> is_jun_30_2005 (>= consolidated_ebitda (- 65000.0)))
    (=> is_jul_31_2005 (>= consolidated_ebitda 80000.0))
    (=> is_aug_31_2005 (>= consolidated_ebitda 90000.0))
  )

issues: The comment for covenant_term_in_effect is logically inconsistent with the source. The source says the covenants last until the Commitments terminate, all Letters of Credit terminate or expire, and all amounts are paid in full. The covenant therefore stays in effect while ANY of these remains outstanding, and ends only when ALL have occurred. The comment's 'i.e.' list joins the 'not terminated / not paid' conditions with 'and', which reads as all of them still being outstanding. That would wrongly end the covenant once any single item is satisfied. 'All Letters of Credit have not terminated' is also ambiguous between 'none' and 'not all'. The parameter meaning is therefore underspecified or contradictory, so the formalization cannot be established as faithful.

The two separate period flags (is_in_initial_period and is_thereafter_period) are defined correctly, but nothing in the formula enforces that exactly one of them applies after Dec 31, 1997. This is acceptable under the evaluator-supplied calendar convention and is not itself a defect.
judge.reason: The thresholds and strictness are correct: 'not less than' becomes >= 2.0 for quarter-ends from Dec 31, 1997 through Dec 30, 1998, and >= 2.5 thereafter. The quarter-end scoping is also correct. However, the covenant_term_in_effect parameter comment mis-states the source's termination condition by describing a conjunction of 'not terminated' conditions, where the covenant should remain in effect while any one obligation is outstanding. That makes the parameter meaning ambiguous and inconsistent with the source, so I cannot accept the formalization as faithful.

{

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; obligations_outstanding: true iff, at the observation, Bank remains committed to extend credit to Borrower or any liabilities of Borrower to Bank under the Loan Documents remain outstanding (payment in full not yet made).
; bank_written_consent: true iff Bank has otherwise consented in writing (waiving the Section 4.9 requirements) at the observation.
; compliance_commenced: true iff the observation is at or after the first compliance determination, i.e. Borrower's financial statements for the period ending November 30, 1997.
; on_or_before_1998_02_28: true iff the observation date is on or before 2/28/98.
; on_or_before_1998_05_31: true iff the observation date is on or before 5/31/98.
; on_or_before_1998_08_31: true iff the observation date is on or before 8/31/98.
; on_or_before_1998_11_30: true iff the observation date is on or before FYE 11/30/98.
; on_or_before_1999_05_31: true iff the observation date is on or before 5/31/99.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end of Borrower.
; total_current_assets: consolidated total current assets in dollars.
; total_current_liabilities: consolidated total current liabilities in dollars, including the outstanding principal balance of the Line of Credit.
; total_stockholders_equity: consolidated total stockholders' equity in dollars.
; subordinated_debt: consolidated subordinated debt in dollars.
; intangible_assets: consolidated intangible assets in dollars.
; non_current_liabilities: consolidated non-current liabilities in dollars.
; net_income_after_taxes_quarter: consolidated net income after taxes for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.
; net_profit_before_tax_r4q: consolidated net profit before tax over the rolling four fiscal quarters ending at the observation, in dollars.
; interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q: interest expense net of capitalized interest expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars.
; depreciation_expense_r4q: depreciation expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars.
; amortization_expense_r4q: amortization expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars.
; total_interest_expense_r4q: total interest expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars (denominator of Interest Coverage Ratio).
; funded_debt: all current and non-current interest-bearing liabilities, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (obligations_outstanding Bool)
    (bank_written_consent Bool)
    (compliance_commenced Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_02_28 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_05_31 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_08_31 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1998_11_30 Bool)
    (on_or_before_1999_05_31 Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (total_current_assets Real)
    (total_current_liabilities Real)
    (total_stockholders_equity Real)
    (subordinated_debt Real)
    (intangible_assets Real)
    (non_current_liabilities Real)
    (net_income_after_taxes_quarter Real)
    (net_profit_before_tax_r4q Real)
    (interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q Real)
    (depreciation_expense_r4q Real)
    (amortization_expense_r4q Real)
    (total_interest_expense_r4q Real)
    (funded_debt Real)) Bool
  (=> (and obligations_outstanding (not bank_written_consent) compliance_commenced)
    (and
      ; (a) Current Ratio = total current assets / total current liabilities
      (>= (/ total_current_assets total_current_liabilities)
          (ite on_or_before_1998_05_31 1.25
            (ite on_or_before_1998_08_31 1.40
              (ite on_or_before_1999_05_31 1.50 2.0))))
      ; (b) Tangible Net Worth = equity + subordinated debt - intangible assets
      (>= (- (+ total_stockholders_equity subordinated_debt) intangible_assets)
          (ite on_or_before_1998_08_31 3000000.0
            (ite on_or_before_1999_05_31 5300000.0 7500000.0)))
      ; (c) Total Liabilities / Tangible Net Worth
      (<= (/ (- (+ total_current_liabilities non_current_liabilities) subordinated_debt)
             (- (+ total_stockholders_equity subordinated_debt) intangible_assets))
          (ite on_or_before_1998_02_28 2.25
            (ite on_or_before_1998_05_31 3.0
              (ite on_or_before_1998_11_30 2.25 1.75))))
      ; (d) quarterly net income after taxes at each fiscal quarter end
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= net_income_after_taxes_quarter 1.0))
      ; (e) Interest Coverage Ratio = EBITDA / total interest expense, rolling four quarters
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
          (>= (/ (+ net_profit_before_tax_r4q interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q
                    depreciation_expense_r4q amortization_expense_r4q)
                 total_interest_expense_r4q)
              (ite on_or_before_1998_08_31 3.5 4.5)))
      ; (f) Funded Debt / EBITDA, rolling four quarters
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
          (<= (/ funded_debt
                 (+ net_profit_before_tax_r4q interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q
                    depreciation_expense_r4q amortization_expense_r4q))
              1.5)))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "obligations_outstanding", "meaning": "True iff Bank remains committed to extend credit or any liabilities of Borrower to Bank under the Loan Documents remain outstanding (payment in full not yet made).", "source_quote": "so long as Bank remains committed to extend credit to Borrower pursuant hereto"},
    {"name": "bank_written_consent", "meaning": "True iff Bank has otherwise consented in writing, waiving the requirements at the observation.", "source_quote": "unless Bank otherwise consents in writing"},
    {"name": "compliance_commenced", "meaning": "True iff the observation is at or after the first compliance determination, the financial statements for the period ending November 30, 1997.", "source_quote": "with compliance determined commencing with Borrower's financial statements for the period ending November 30, 1997"},
    {"name": "on_or_before_1998_02_28", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or before 2/28/98.", "source_quote": "up to and including 2/28/98"},
    {"name": "on_or_before_1998_05_31", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or before 5/31/98.", "source_quote": "up to and including 5/31/98"},
    {"name": "on_or_before_1998_08_31", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or before 8/31/98.", "source_quote": "up to and including 8/31/98"},
    {"name": "on_or_before_1998_11_30", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or before FYE 11/30/98.", "source_quote": "up to and including FYE 11/30/98"},
    {"name": "on_or_before_1999_05_31", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is on or before 5/31/99.", "source_quote": "up to and including 5/31/99"},
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation is a fiscal quarter end of Borrower.", "source_quote": "determined as of each fiscal quarter end"},
    {"name": "total_current_assets", "meaning": "Consolidated total current assets in dollars.", "source_quote": "total current assets divided by total current liabilities"},
    {"name": "total_current_liabilities", "meaning": "Consolidated total current liabilities in dollars, including the outstanding principal balance of the Line of Credit.", "source_quote": "current liabilities will include without limitation the outstanding principal balance of the Line of Credit"},
    {"name": "total_stockholders_equity", "meaning": "Consolidated total stockholders' equity in dollars.", "source_quote": "total stockholders' equity plus subordinated debt less any intangible assets"},
    {"name": "subordinated_debt", "meaning": "Consolidated subordinated debt in dollars, added in Tangible Net Worth and subtracted in Total Liabilities.", "source_quote": "total stockholders' equity plus subordinated debt less any intangible assets"},
    {"name": "intangible_assets", "meaning": "Consolidated intangible assets in dollars, subtracted in Tangible Net Worth.", "source_quote": "total stockholders' equity plus subordinated debt less any intangible assets"},
    {"name": "non_current_liabilities", "meaning": "Consolidated non-current liabilities in dollars.", "source_quote": "the aggregate of current liabilities and non-current liabilities less subordinated debt"},
    {"name": "net_income_after_taxes_quarter", "meaning": "Consolidated net income after taxes for the fiscal quarter ending at the observation, in dollars.", "source_quote": "Net income after taxes not less than $1.00 on an quarterly basis"},
    {"name": "net_profit_before_tax_r4q", "meaning": "Consolidated net profit before tax over the rolling four fiscal quarters ending at the observation, in dollars (EBITDA component).", "source_quote": "net profit before tax plus interest expense (net of capitalized interest expense), depreciation expense and amortization expense"},
    {"name": "interest_expense_net_capitalized_r4q", "meaning": "Interest expense net of capitalized interest expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars (EBITDA component).", "source_quote": "net profit before tax plus interest expense (net of capitalized interest expense), depreciation expense and amortization expense"},
    {"name": "depreciation_expense_r4q", "meaning": "Depreciation expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars (EBITDA component).", "source_quote": "net profit before tax plus interest expense (net of capitalized interest expense), depreciation expense and amortization expense"},
    {"name": "amortization_expense_r4q", "meaning": "Amortization expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars (EBITDA component).", "source_quote": "net profit before tax plus interest expense (net of capitalized interest expense), depreciation expense and amortization expense"},
    {"name": "total_interest_expense_r4q", "meaning": "Total interest expense over the rolling four fiscal quarters, in dollars (denominator of Interest Coverage Ratio).", "source_quote": "EBITDA divided by total interest expense"},
    {"name": "funded_debt", "meaning": "All current and non-current interest-bearing liabilities, in dollars.", "source_quote": "all current and non-current interest-bearing liabilities"}
  ],
  "notes": "Pointwise translation under QF_NRA because ratios divide by variable quantities. Division is kept as written so zero denominators are reported unresolved. The date flags are cumulative 'on or before' flags and the evaluator must supply them consistently. Everything is gated on the covenant term (obligations_outstanding), no written Bank consent, and compliance having commenced. Items (d)-(f) apply only at fiscal quarter end. The 'rolling four quarter' inputs are supplied by the evaluator. EBITDA uses interest expense net of capitalized interest, while the coverage denominator uses total interest expense, as the source distinguishes them. Total Liabilities uses current liabilities (including Line of Credit principal) plus non-current liabilities less subordinated debt."

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_first_three_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of one of the first three fiscal quarters of a year.
; is_december_31: true iff the observation date is December 31 of a year.
; total_liabilities: Total Liabilities (USD) at the observation date.
; tangible_net_worth: Tangible Net Worth (USD) at the observation date.
; working_capital: Working Capital (USD) at the observation time.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter.
; adjusted_ebitda_coverage_ratio: Adjusted EBITDA Coverage Ratio, as a ratio to 1, on a rolling four quarter basis as of the observation date.
; actual_expenses_ytd: actual expenses for the portion of the fiscal year ended with the quarter ending at the observation date (USD).
; projected_expenses_ytd: projected expenses in the Annual Budget for the same portion of the fiscal year (USD).
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_first_three_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (is_december_31 Bool)
                            (total_liabilities Real)
                            (tangible_net_worth Real)
                            (working_capital Real)
                            (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
                            (adjusted_ebitda_coverage_ratio Real)
                            (actual_expenses_ytd Real)
                            (projected_expenses_ytd Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) Total Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth
    (=> is_first_three_fiscal_quarter_end (<= (/ total_liabilities tangible_net_worth) 1.5))
    (=> is_december_31 (<= (/ total_liabilities tangible_net_worth) 1.25))
    ; (b) Working Capital at all times
    (>= working_capital 11000000.0)
    ; (c) Adjusted EBITDA Coverage Ratio at each fiscal quarter end
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= adjusted_ebitda_coverage_ratio 2.25))
    ; (d) Annual Budget Variance: actual must not exceed projected by more than 15%
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= actual_expenses_ytd (* 1.15 projected_expenses_ytd)))))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

  (transaction_is_disposition_all_assets_to_restricted_subsidiary Bool) ; the transaction is a Disposition of all or substantially all assets (upon voluntary liquidation or otherwise) to another Restricted Subsidiary
  (a_counterparty_is_borrower Bool) ; the other party to the merger is a Borrower
  (a_borrower_survives Bool) ; a Borrower is the continuing or surviving Person
  (a_counterparty_is_company Bool) ; the other party to the merger is the Company
  (a_company_survives Bool) ; the Company is the continuing or surviving Person
  (company_direct_debt_after_merger Real) ; Consolidated Total Debt in USD for which the Company is the direct obligor after giving effect to the merger, amalgamation or consolidation
  (a_counterparty_is_other_restricted_subsidiaries Bool) ; the other party or parties are one or more other Restricted Subsidiaries of the Company (other than a Borrower)
  (a_subsidiary_loan_party_merging_with_restricted_subsidiary Bool) ; a Subsidiary Loan Party is merging or amalgamating with another Restricted Subsidiary
  (a_survivor_is_subsidiary_loan_party Bool) ; the continuing or surviving Person is a Subsidiary Loan Party
  (a_acquisition_permitted_under_6_04 Bool) ; the acquisition of the Subsidiary Loan Party by the surviving Restricted Subsidiary is permitted under Section 6.04
  (b_company_good_faith_best_interests Bool) ; the Company determines in good faith that the action is in the best interests of Holdings, the Company, the Borrowers and the Restricted Subsidiaries
  (b_not_materially_disadvantageous_to_lenders Bool) ; the action is not materially disadvantageous to the Lenders
  (c_transferor_is_loan_party Bool) ; the transferor in the Disposition is a Loan Party
  (c_transferee_is_loan_party Bool) ; the transferee is a Loan Party
  (c_investment_in_non_loan_party_rs_permitted Bool) ; true if, to the extent the Disposition constitutes an Investment, it is an Investment in a non-Loan Party Restricted Subsidiary permitted by Section 6.04, or it is not an Investment
  (c_fmv_disposition_and_noncash_consideration_permitted_investment Bool) ; true if, to the extent it is a Disposition to a non-Loan Party Restricted Subsidiary, it is for Fair Market Value and any note or non-cash consideration is an Investment in a non-Loan Party Restricted Subsidiary permitted by Section 6.04, or it is not such a Disposition
  (d_borrower_survives Bool) ; a Borrower is the continuing or surviving Person of the Borrower merger
  (d_successor_organized_us Bool) ; the Successor Borrower is organized or existing under the laws of the United States or a political subdivision thereof
  (d_successor_assumes_obligations Bool) ; the Successor Borrower expressly assumes all the Borrower's obligations under the Agreement and other Loan Documents by a supplement reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agents
  (d_loan_parties_reaffirmed Bool) ; each Loan Party other than the Borrower (unless it is the other merger party) has reaffirmed its Guarantee and Liens for the Successor Borrower's obligations by an agreement reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agents
  (d_certificate_and_opinion_delivered Bool) ; the Borrower has delivered to each Administrative Agent a Responsible Officer certificate and an opinion of counsel stating that the merger complies with the Agreement
  (d_other_person_is_loan_party Bool) ; the other Person in the Borrower merger is a Loan Party
  (d_other_person_is_company Bool) ; the other Person in the Borrower merger is the Company
  (company_direct_debt_prior_to_merger Real) ; Consolidated Total Debt in USD for which the Company is the direct obligor prior to giving effect to the Borrower merger
  (event_of_default_exists_after_transaction Bool) ; an Event of Default exists after giving effect to the merger or consolidation
  (d_kyc_info_provided Bool) ; the Borrower has provided the documentation and information about the Successor Borrower reasonably requested for KYC and anti-money laundering rules, or no such request is outstanding
  (e_counterparty_is_company_or_borrower Bool) ; the other Person in the Holdings or Intermediate Parent merger is the Company or a Borrower
  (e_holdings_or_ip_survives Bool) ; Holdings or the Intermediate Parent, as applicable, is the continuing or surviving Person
  (e_successor_assumes Bool) ; the Successor Holdings expressly assumes all obligations of Holdings or Intermediate Parent under the Agreement and other Loan Documents by a supplement reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agents
  (e_loan_parties_reaffirmed Bool) ; each other Loan Party (unless it is the other merger party) has reaffirmed its Guarantee and Liens for the Successor Holdings' obligations by an agreement reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agents
  (e_successor_owns_all_subsidiaries Bool) ; immediately after the merger the Successor Holdings directly or indirectly owns all Subsidiaries owned by Holdings or Intermediate Parent immediately prior
  (e_certificate_opinion_delivered Bool) ; Holdings or Intermediate Parent has delivered to each Administrative Agent a Responsible Officer certificate and an opinion of counsel stating that the merger complies with the Agreement
  (e_counterparty_is_subsidiary_guarantor Bool) ; the other Person in the Holdings or Intermediate Parent merger is a Subsidiary Guarantor
  (permitted_holdings_debt_outstanding Bool) ; any Permitted Holdings Debt is outstanding at the time of the merger
  (interest_coverage_ratio_pro_forma Real) ; Interest Coverage Ratio on a Pro Forma Basis, as a ratio x in x to 1.00
  (e_kyc_info_provided Bool) ; the Company and each Borrower have provided the documentation and information about the Successor Holdings reasonably requested for KYC and anti-money laundering rules, or no such request is outstanding
  (f_effects_investment_permitted_6_04 Bool) ; the merger, consolidation or amalgamation is made to effect an Investment permitted pursuant to Section 6.04
  (f_survivor_is_restricted_subsidiary Bool) ; the continuing or surviving Person is a Restricted Subsidiary
  (f_complied_5_11_5_12 Bool) ; the surviving Restricted Subsidiary, together with each of the Restricted Subsidiaries, has complied with Sections 5.11 and 5.12
  (g_is_transactions Bool) ; the action is the consummation of the Transactions by Holdings, the Company, the Borrowers or the Restricted Subsidiaries
  (h_effects_disposition_permitted_6_05 Bool) ; the merger, dissolution, liquidation, consolidation or amalgamation is made to effect a Disposition permitted pursuant to Section 6.05
) Bool
  (=> fundamental_change_occurs
    (or
      ; exception (a)
      (and actor_is_non_borrower_restricted_subsidiary
           transaction_is_merger_consolidation_amalgamation
           (or (and a_counterparty_is_borrower a_borrower_survives)
               (and a_counterparty_is_company a_company_survives
                    (<= company_direct_debt_after_merger 2000000000))
               (and a_counterparty_is_other_restricted_subsidiaries
                    (=> a_subsidiary_loan_party_merging_with_restricted_subsidiary
                        (or a_survivor_is_subsidiary_loan_party a_acquisition_permitted_under_6_04)))))
      ; exception (b)
      (and actor_is_non_borrower_restricted_subsidiary
           transaction_is_liquidation_dissolution_or_legal_form_change
           b_company_good_faith_best_interests
           b_not_materially_disadvantageous_to_lenders)
      ; exception (c)
      (and (or actor_is_company actor_is_non_borrower_restricted_subsidiary)
           transaction_is_disposition_all_assets_to_restricted_subsidiary
           (=> c_transferor_is_loan_party
               (or c_transferee_is_loan_party
                   c_investment_in_non_loan_party_rs_permitted
                   c_fmv_disposition_and_noncash_consideration_permitted_investment)))
      ; exception (d)
      (and actor_is_borrower
           transaction_is_merger_consolidation_amalgamation
           (or d_borrower_survives
               (and d_successor_organized_us d_successor_assumes_obligations
                    d_loan_parties_reaffirmed d_certificate_and_opinion_delivered
                    d_kyc_info_provided))
           (=> (not d_other_person_is_loan_party) (not event_of_default_exists_after_transaction))
           (=> d_other_person_is_company (<= company_direct_debt_prior_to_merger 2000000000)))
      ; exception (e)
      (and actor_is_holdings_or_intermediate_parent
           transaction_is_merger_consolidation_amalgamation
           (not e_counterparty_is_company_or_borrower)
           (not event_of_default_exists_after_transaction)
           (or e_holdings_or_ip_survives
               (and e_successor_assumes e_loan_parties_reaffirmed
                    e_successor_owns_all_subsidiaries e_certificate_opinion_delivered
                    (not (and e_counterparty_is_subsidiary_guarantor
                              permitted_holdings_debt_outstanding
                              (not (>= interest_coverage_ratio_pro_forma 2.0))))
                    e_kyc_info_provided)))
      ; exception (f)
      (and actor_is_non_borrower_restricted_subsidiary
           transaction_is_merger_consolidation_amalgamation
           f_effects_investment_permitted_6_04
           f_survivor_is_restricted_subsidiary
           f_complied_5_11_5_12)
      ; exception (g)
      g_is_transactions
      ; exception (h)
      (and actor_is_non_borrower_restricted_subsidiary
           h_effects_disposition_permitted_6_05))))

candidate.notes: The covenant is a prohibition with exceptions (a) through (h). It is encoded pointwise: if a fundamental change occurs at the observation, at least one exception must be fully satisfied. If no fundamental change occurs, the covenant holds. Exception (a)(ii) tests the $2,000,000,000 Company direct-debt cap after the merger, and exception (d) tests it before the merger, so these are separate Real inputs. In exception (d), 'such Person' is read as the other Person in the merger. The proviso that the successor be substituted for the Borrower or Holdings is a consequence, not a condition, so it is omitted. The KYC provisos are encoded as Boolean conditions on the Successor Borrower and Successor Holdings branches. The 6.04, 6.05, 5.11 and 5.12 cross-references are Boolean inputs because those sections were not supplied. The Interest Coverage Ratio is an atomic Real because its definition was not supplied. No division is used.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

issues: Exception (c) is encoded with vacuous-truth escape hatches. c_investment_in_non_loan_party_rs_permitted is true when the Disposition 'is not an Investment'. For a Loan Party transferor disposing to a non-Loan Party, any Disposition that is not an Investment therefore satisfies alternative (B) automatically. Alternative (C) then adds nothing, and the Fair Market Value and non-cash consideration requirements can be bypassed. The source offers (A), (B) or (C) as genuine alternatives, so this is an incorrect decomposition that can mark a noncompliant transaction compliant.

Exception (e) is limited to transaction_is_merger_consolidation_amalgamation. The source also covers a Person 'into which Holdings or Intermediate Parent has been liquidated', and that route has no corresponding path in the encoding. A permitted Successor Holdings liquidation therefore falls through to noncompliance.

The Boolean parameters d_kyc_info_provided and e_kyc_info_provided are defined as 'or no such request is outstanding'. This builds a presumption into the input that is not in the source. The KYC proviso is also applied only inside the non-surviving branch, a placement choice the source does not clearly support.

The fundamental_change_occurs trigger covers merger, consolidation, amalgamation, liquidation and dissolution, but exception (b) also permits a 'change of legal form'. The trigger and the exception scopes are therefore not fully consistent.
judge.reason: The overall structure (a)-(h) is mostly sound, and the thresholds ($2,000,000,000 with <=, Interest Coverage Ratio >= 2.0) are correct. However, exception (c) can be satisfied vacuously for non-Investment Dispositions, which skips the Fair Market Value requirement. Exception (e) omits the liquidation-into-successor case. These errors make the formalization not equivalent to the source, so it is rejected.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

In the supplied text the year column of the schedule is missing. Only the ratio column survives: '2.50 to 1.00 2.50 to 1.00 2.75 to 1.00 2.75 to 1.00'.   (c_transferor_is_loan_party Bool) ; The transferor in the 7.04(c) transaction is a Loan Party.
  (c_transferee_is_loan_party Bool) ; The transferee in the 7.04(c) transaction is a Loan Party.
  (c_investment_debt_permitted_7_02_7_03 Bool) ; To the extent the 7.04(c) transfer is an Investment or gives rise to Indebtedness, the Investment is permitted in a non-Loan Party Restricted Subsidiary under 7.02 or the Indebtedness is permitted Indebtedness of such a Restricted Subsidiary under 7.03.
  (d_parent_merges_with_other_person Bool) ; The Parent Borrower merges with any other Person.
  (d_parent_is_surviving_corporation Bool) ; The Parent Borrower is the continuing or surviving corporation of the 7.04(d) merger.
  (d_successor_is_us_entity Bool) ; The Successor Borrower is an entity organized or existing under the laws of the United States, any state, the District of Columbia or any territory.
  (d_successor_assumes_obligations Bool) ; The Successor Borrower expressly assumes all the Parent Borrower's obligations under the Agreement and Loan Documents by a supplement in form reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent.
  (d_us_subsidiary_borrowers_confirmed Bool) ; Each U.S. Subsidiary Borrower, unless it is the other party to the merger, has confirmed by a supplement to the U.S. Security Agreement that its obligations apply to the Successor Borrower's obligations.
  (d_officer_cert_and_opinion_delivered Bool) ; The Parent Borrower has delivered to the Administrative Agent an officer's certificate and an opinion of counsel stating that the merger and supplement comply with the Agreement.
  (e_rs_merges_with_other_person Bool) ; A Restricted Subsidiary merges or consolidates with any other Person.
  (e_effects_permitted_investment_7_02 Bool) ; The 7.04(e) merger is in order to effect an Investment permitted under Section 7.02, i.e. subclause (i). False means subclause (ii), any other purpose.
  (e_survivor_is_parent_or_rs Bool) ; The continuing or surviving Person is the Parent Borrower or a Restricted Subsidiary.
  (e_survivor_group_complied_6_11 Bool) ; The surviving Person, together with each of its Restricted Subsidiaries, has complied with the applicable requirements of Section 6.11.
  (e_involves_sub_borrower_not_surviving Bool) ; The 7.04(e) merger involves a Subsidiary Borrower that is not the surviving Person.
  (e_surviving_rs_assumes_sub_borrower_obligations Bool) ; The surviving Restricted Subsidiary expressly assumes all the Subsidiary Borrower's obligations under the Agreement and Loan Documents by a supplement in form reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent.
  (senior_secured_leverage_ratio Real) ; Senior Secured Leverage Ratio for the Test Period immediately preceding the merger, calculated on a Pro Forma Basis, as a number to 1.0.
  (f_transaction_purpose_is_disposition Bool) ; The transaction is a merger, dissolution, liquidation, consolidation or Disposition whose purpose is to effect a Disposition.
  (f_disposition_permitted_7_05 Bool) ; The Disposition the transaction is meant to effect is permitted under Section 7.05.
) Bool
  (=> (and (or lender_has_commitment
               loan_obligation_accrued_payable_unpaid
               letter_of_credit_outstanding_uncollateralized)
           fundamental_change_occurs)
      (or
        ; (a) merger with the Parent Borrower
        (and a_holdings_or_rs_merges_with_parent
             a_parent_borrower_survives
             a_parent_remains_us_incorporated
             (=> a_is_holdings_merger
                 (and a_holdings_no_other_direct_subs
                      a_direct_parent_assumes_holdings_obligations)))
        ; (b)(i) non-Loan Party Restricted Subsidiary mergers
        b1_nonloanparty_rs_merges_with_nonloanparty_rs
        ; (b)(ii) Restricted Subsidiary liquidation, dissolution or change of legal form
        (and b2_rs_liquidates_dissolves_or_changes_form
             b2_good_faith_best_interests
             b2_not_materially_disadvantageous_to_lenders)
        ; (c) Disposition to the Parent Borrower or another Restricted Subsidiary
        (and c_rs_disposes_all_assets_to_parent_or_rs
             (=> c_transferor_is_loan_party
                 (or c_transferee_is_loan_party
                     c_investment_debt_permitted_7_02_7_03)))
        ; (d) Parent Borrower merger
        (and d_parent_merges_with_other_person
             (not default_exists_or_would_result)
             (or d_parent_is_surviving_corporation
                 (and d_successor_is_us_entity
                      d_successor_assumes_obligations
                      d_us_subsidiary_borrowers_confirmed
                      d_officer_cert_and_opinion_delivered)))
        ; (e) Restricted Subsidiary merger
        (and e_rs_merges_with_other_person
             (not default_exists_or_would_result)
             e_survivor_is_parent_or_rs
             e_survivor_group_complied_6_11
             (or e_effects_permitted_investment_7_02
                 (and (=> e_involves_sub_borrower_not_surviving
                          e_surviving_rs_assumes_sub_borrower_obligations)
                      (<= senior_secured_leverage_ratio 4.5))))
        ; (f) transaction to effect a permitted Disposition
        (and f_transaction_purpose_is_disposition
             (not default_exists_or_would_result)
             f_disposition_permitted_7_05))))

candidate.notes: Pointwise encoding: when the covenant is in force (a Commitment exists, or an accrued and payable Loan/Obligation other than Other Liabilities is unpaid, or an uncollateralized Letter of Credit is outstanding) and a fundamental change occurs, at least one of the exceptions (a)-(f) must be fully satisfied. The conditions in each exception are separate Boolean inputs, not an opaque flag. The leverage test in (e)(B)(2) is encoded with a non-strict <= 4.5, using the supplied ratio as an atomic Real. In (e), I read the 'if (1) ... and (2) ...' wording in subclause (B) as two cumulative requirements that apply only to subclause (ii), that is, when the merger is not for a permitted Section 7.02 Investment. The Subsidiary Borrower assumption is required only if the Subsidiary Borrower does not survive. In (a)(z), the Holdings-specific conditions apply only to a Holdings merger. Sections 6.11, 7.02, 7.03 and 7.05 were not supplied, so their outcomes are Boolean inputs. The 'Holdings shall not' reference to Section 7.14 does not affect Section 7.04 and is not encoded.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

judge.reason: The formula is a pointwise implication. If any of the three conditions holds (a Commitment, an accrued and unpaid Obligation, or an uncollateralized Letter of Credit) and a fundamental change occurs, then at least one exception in 7.04(a)-(f) must be satisfied. Each exception is encoded faithfully. (a) requires the Parent Borrower to survive and remain U.S.-incorporated, with the extra Holdings-merger conditions only when it is a Holdings merger, and has no Default condition. (b)(i) and (b)(ii) have no Default condition, and (b)(ii) includes both the good-faith and not-materially-disadvantageous requirements. (c) requires the transferee to be a Loan Party or the permitted Investment/Indebtedness condition when the transferor is a Loan Party. (d) and (e) both require no Default. (d) requires the Parent Borrower to survive, or else the four Successor Borrower conditions (A)-(D). (e) requires a survivor that is the Parent Borrower or a Restricted Subsidiary and compliance with Section 6.11. For subclause (ii) only, (e) adds the Subsidiary Borrower assumption (when that borrower does not survive) and the Senior Secured Leverage Ratio of at most 4.5, which matches the non-strict source threshold. (f) requires no Default and a permitted 7.05 Disposition. Every parameter has a specific source-grounded comment. The ratio is an atomic input, no division occurs, and no financial positivity or other unsupported assumptions are introduced. Nothing exceeds the finite-history pointwise scope.

; waived_in_writing: Bool, true if the Required Banks have waived compliance in writing for the obligation at the observation.
; accounting_system_maintained: Bool, true if Chemical and each Subsidiary maintain a system of accounting in accordance with sound accounting practice at the observation.
; is_quarterly_deadline: Bool, true if the observation is the 45th day after the close of one of the first three fiscal quarters of a fiscal year of Chemical.
; quarterly_statements_delivered_in_time: Bool, true if, for that quarter, each Bank received the clause (a) statements (consolidated and consolidating balance sheets and income statements, and consolidated cash flow statements, for the quarter and year to date and the corresponding prior-year periods, certified by the CFO) on or before the 45th day after quarter close.
; is_annual_deadline: Bool, true if the observation is the 90th day after the close of a fiscal year of Chemical.
; annual_statements_delivered_in_time: Bool, true if, for that fiscal year, each Bank received the clause (b) audit report and accompanying financial statements, plus unaudited consolidating balance sheets and income statements, on or before the 90th day after year close.
; compliance_certificate_delivered_with_statements: Bool, true if the Compliance Certificate in the form of Exhibit H, signed by the President or CFO, was delivered together with the clause (a) or (b) statements due at this observation.
; is_last_quarter_certificate_deadline: Bool, true if the observation is the 45th day after the close of the last fiscal quarter of a fiscal year of Chemical and its Subsidiaries.
; compliance_certificate_delivered_for_last_quarter: Bool, true if a Compliance Certificate in the form required by subsection (c) was delivered on or before the 45th day after the last fiscal quarter's close.
; pricing_ratio_certificate_delivered_for_last_quarter: Bool, true if a Pricing Ratio Certificate (Exhibit L), signed by the President or CFO and showing the Pricing Ratio calculation as of the last day of that fiscal quarter, was delivered on or before the 45th day after the quarter's close.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (credit_in_use_or_available Bool)
  (amount_unpaid Bool)
  (waived_in_writing Bool)
  (accounting_system_maintained Bool)
  (is_quarterly_deadline Bool)
  (quarterly_statements_delivered_in_time Bool)
  (is_annual_deadline Bool)
  (annual_statements_delivered_in_time Bool)
  (compliance_certificate_delivered_with_statements Bool)
  (is_last_quarter_certificate_deadline Bool)
  (compliance_certificate_delivered_for_last_quarter Bool)
  (pricing_ratio_certificate_delivered_for_last_quarter Bool)) Bool
  (=> (and (or credit_in_use_or_available amount_unpaid) (not waived_in_writing))
      (and accounting_system_maintained
           (=> is_quarterly_deadline quarterly_statements_delivered_in_time)
           (=> is_annual_deadline annual_statements_delivered_in_time)
           (=> (or is_quarterly_deadline is_annual_deadline) compliance_certificate_delivered_with_statements)
           (=> is_last_quarter_certificate_deadline
               (or compliance_certificate_delivered_for_last_quarter
                   pricing_ratio_certificate_delivered_for_last_quarter)))))",

Clause (d) requires prompt delivery of SEC and exchange filings, including registration statements, periodic reports, Form 10-K, Form 10-Q and Form 8-K. issues: The single Boolean required_lenders_consented_in_writing waives both covenants at once, but the source has two separate covenants (8.1(a) leverage and 8.1(b) capitalization). Its comment says consent to "the relevant ratio breach", and "relevant" is undefined. If the Required Lenders consent to only one covenant, the flag cannot be set correctly. True would wrongly waive the other covenant, and false would wrongly enforce the covenant that was waived. Consent should be split into one input per covenant or ratio.
Because of the ambiguous consent scope, the parameter meaning is underspecified and the scope decomposition of the waiver is not faithful to the source.
judge.reason: The ratio thresholds and strictness are correct: leverage <= 2.5 only on the last day of a Four-Quarter Period, and capitalization <= 0.55 at every observation. The Facility Termination Date guard is also reasonable. The shared, vaguely defined consent flag, however, applies one waiver to both separate covenants. That is an incorrect scope decomposition and an underspecified parameter meaning, so the formalization is not faithful.
