{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; commitments_in_effect: True if the Commitments remain in effect at the observation time.
; letter_of_credit_excess_outstanding: True if a Letter of Credit remains outstanding in a face amount exceeding the sum of cash then held in the applicable Letter of Credit Account and the face amount of back-to-back letters of credit delivered under Section 2.02(j) and Section 2.29(j), as applicable.
; amounts_owing: True if principal of or interest on any Loan, or reimbursement of any LC Disbursement, is owing to any Lender or the Administrative Agent (including any other amount due and unpaid on the first date none of the foregoing is in effect, outstanding or owing).
; is_semiannual_appraisal_date: True if the observation is the January 10 or July 10 date by which the clause (1) delivery, made within the 30 days prior to that date, is due.
; at_least_90_days_after_first_appraised_collateral_added: True if this January 10 or July 10 date is at least 90 days after the Appraised Collateral was first added to the Collateral.
; semiannual_appraisal_delivered: True if the Borrower delivered to the Administrative Agent an Appraisal of the Pledged Aircraft, Pledged Engines and Pledged Spare Parts on a date within 30 days prior to this January 10 or July 10 date.
; is_additional_collateral_pledge_date: True if the observation date is the date on which Additional Collateral comprised of Appraised Collateral is pledged as Collateral.
; additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered: True if an Appraisal of the Additional Collateral being pledged (only that Additional Collateral) has been delivered to the Administrative Agent on the pledge date.
; additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days: Age in days, as of the pledge date, of the Appraisal delivered for the Additional Collateral.
; is_new_spare_engine_same_type_exception: True if the Additional Collateral is a new spare Engine pledged within 90 days after delivery from the manufacturer to the applicable Grantor and is of the same make and model as a spare Engine currently included in (or being replaced in) the Collateral (an Existing Engine Type).
; borrower_elects_appraisal_for_new_engine: True if the Borrower elects to provide an Appraisal of the new spare Engine for purposes of determining its Appraised Value under clause (ii) of the proviso of the definition of Appraised Value.
; agent_request_while_event_of_default: True if the Administrative Agent has made a request for Appraisals and an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.
; days_since_agent_request: Number of days elapsed from the Administrative Agent's request to the observation time.
; delivered_within_45_days_of_request: True if the Borrower delivered the requested Appraisals to the Administrative Agent within 45 days following the request.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (commitments_in_effect Bool)
    (letter_of_credit_excess_outstanding Bool)
    (amounts_owing Bool)
    (is_semiannual_appraisal_date Bool)
    (at_least_90_days_after_first_appraised_collateral_added Bool)
    (semiannual_appraisal_delivered Bool)
    (is_additional_collateral_pledge_date Bool)
    (additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered Bool)
    (additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days Real)
    (is_new_spare_engine_same_type_exception Bool)
    (borrower_elects_appraisal_for_new_engine Bool)
    (agent_request_while_event_of_default Bool)
    (days_since_agent_request Real)
    (delivered_within_45_days_of_request Bool)) Bool
  (let ((covenant_in_force (or commitments_in_effect letter_of_credit_excess_outstanding amounts_owing)))
    (and
      ; clause (1): semiannual appraisal delivery
      (=> (and covenant_in_force is_semiannual_appraisal_date at_least_90_days_after_first_appraised_collateral_added)
          semiannual_appraisal_delivered)
      ; clause (2): appraisal on pledge of Additional Collateral, with provisos (ii) and (iii)
      (=> (and covenant_in_force is_additional_collateral_pledge_date
               (not (and is_new_spare_engine_same_type_exception (not borrower_elects_appraisal_for_new_engine))))
          (and additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered
               (<= additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days 180.0)))
      ; clause (3): delivery within 45 days after Administrative Agent request during an Event of Default
      (=> (and covenant_in_force agent_request_while_event_of_default (> days_since_agent_request 45.0))
          delivered_within_45_days_of_request))))",

    {"name": "commitments_in_effect", "meaning": "True if the Commitments remain in effect at the observation time.", "source_quote": "for so long as the Commitments remain in effect"},
    {"name": "letter_of_credit_excess_outstanding", "meaning": "True if a Letter of Credit remains outstanding in a face amount exceeding cash held in the Letter of Credit Account plus back-to-back letters of credit delivered under Section 2.02(j) and Section 2.29(j), as applicable.", "source_quote": "any Letter of Credit remains outstanding (in a face amount in excess of the sum of (i)"},

; days_since_agent_request: Number of days elapsed from the Administrative Agent's request to the observation time.

(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (commitments_in_effect Bool)
    (letter_of_credit_excess_outstanding Bool)
    (amounts_owing Bool)
    (is_semiannual_appraisal_date Bool)
    (at_least_90_days_after_first_appraised_collateral_added Bool)
    (semiannual_appraisal_delivered Bool)
    (is_additional_collateral_pledge_date Bool)
    (additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered Bool)
    (additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days Real)
    (is_new_spare_engine_same_type_exception Bool)
    (borrower_elects_appraisal_for_new_engine Bool)
    (agent_request_while_event_of_default Bool)
    (days_since_agent_request Real)
    (delivered_within_45_days_of_request Bool)) Bool
  (let ((covenant_in_force (or commitments_in_effect letter_of_credit_excess_outstanding amounts_owing)))
    (and

               (not (and is_new_spare_engine_same_type_exception (not borrower_elects_appraisal_for_new_engine))))
          (and additional_collateral_appraisal_delivered
               (<= additional_collateral_appraisal_age_days 180.0)))
      ; clause (3): delivery within 45 days after Administrative Agent request during an Event of Default
      (=> (and covenant_in_force agent_request_while_event_of_default (> days_since_agent_request 45.0))

The ratio is computed as Consolidated Indebtedness divided by EBITDA. Division by non-constant EBITDA is nonlinear, so the logic is QF_NRA. A zero EBITDA is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, and no positivity assumption is added. Cross-multiplying was deliberately avoided because it would give wrong results for negative EBITDA. The covenant applies only at Fiscal Quarter ends, so the body is conditioned on is_fiscal_quarter_end. The lead-in condition (Commitments expired or terminated, and Loans and fees paid in full) defines how long the covenant lasts. It is not modeled as an input, since the evaluator supplies observations only while the covenant is in force. Consolidated Indebtedness and EBITDA are not defined in the supplied text, so they remain atomic Real inputs.

A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant.   (loans_outstanding Real)
  (other_permitted_indebtedness Real)
  (sum_exceeded_25m_at_or_before_observation Bool)
  (is_after_1999_09_30 Bool)
  (unrestricted_retained_earnings Real)
  (period_closing_through_1999_09_30 Bool)
  (period_1999_12_31_through_2000_09_30 Bool)
  (period_2000_12_31_through_2001_09_30 Bool)
  (period_2001_12_31_through_2002_09_30 Bool)
  (period_2002_12_31_through_2003_09_30 Bool)
) Bool
  (and

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end quarter_ends_on_or_before_1999_03_31)

    ; 6.14(a)(ii): leverage ratio must not exceed 0.65 for quarters ending after 3/31/1999
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end quarter_ends_after_1999_03_31)

    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end

    ; 6.14(c): Consolidated EBIT / Consolidated Interest Expense must not be less than 1.70
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= (/ consolidated_ebit_4q consolidated_interest_expense_4q) 1.70))
    ; 6.14(d) first sentence: Loans plus other Permitted Indebtedness must not exceed $25,000,000 through 9/30/1999
    (=> is_effective_date_through_1999_09_30

    ; 6.14(d) second sentence: applies prior to the sum ever exceeding $25,000,000, and in any event after 9/30/1999
    (=> (or is_after_1999_09_30 (not sum_exceeded_25m_at_or_before_observation))

          (=> period_2001_12_31_through_2002_09_30

          (=> period_2002_12_31_through_2003_09_30
              (> (/ unrestricted_retained_earnings (+ loans_outstanding other_permitted_indebtedness)) 2.50))))
  )

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (quarter_ends_on_or_before_1999_03_31 Bool)
  (quarter_ends_after_1999_03_31 Bool)
  (consolidated_indebtedness Real)
  (consolidated_capitalization Real)
  (cash_dividends_and_distributions_4q Real)
  (overhead_4q Real)
  (interest_expense_4q Real)
  (cash_taxes_4q Real)
  (consolidated_ebit_4q Real)
  (consolidated_interest_expense_4q Real)
  (is_effective_date_through_1999_09_30 Bool)
  (loans_outstanding Real)
  (other_permitted_indebtedness Real)
  (sum_exceeded_25m_at_or_before_observation Bool)
  (is_after_1999_09_30 Bool)
  (unrestricted_retained_earnings Real)
  (period_closing_through_1999_09_30 Bool)
  (period_1999_12_31_through_2000_09_30 Bool)
  (period_2000_12_31_through_2001_09_30 Bool)
  (period_2001_12_31_through_2002_09_30 Bool)
  (period_2002_12_31_through_2003_09_30 Bool)
) Bool

              (> (/ unrestricted_retained_earnings (+ loans_outstanding other_permitted_indebtedness)) 0.75))
          (=> period_1999_12_31_through_2000_09_30
              (> (/ unrestricted_retained_earnings (+ loans_outstanding other_permitted_indebtedness)) 1.00))
          (=> period_2000_12_31_through_2001_09_30
              (> (/ unrestricted_retained_earnings (+ loans_outstanding other_permitted_indebtedness)) 1.50))
          (=> period_2001_12_31_through_2002_09_30
              (> (/ unrestricted_retained_earnings (+ loans_outstanding other_permitted_indebtedness)) 2.00))
          (=> period_2002_12_31_through_2003_09_30
              (> (/ unrestricted_retained_earnings (+ loans_outstanding other_permitted_indebtedness)) 2.50))))
  )
)

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (loans_unpaid Bool) ; true if at the observation any Loan remains unpaid
  (required_lenders_written_waiver Bool) ; true if the Required Lenders have agreed in writing to permit the Debt/action observed
  (debt_occurs Bool) ; true if the Borrower or a Restricted Subsidiary creates, incurs, assumes or suffers to exist a Debt item (incl. Acquired Debt) at this observation
  (incurrer_is_borrower Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Incurred by the Borrower
  (incurrer_is_borrower_or_guarantor Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Incurred by the Borrower or a Guarantor
  (fccr Real) ; Borrower's Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio on the date of the Incurrence, after giving effect to the Debt and the application of proceeds
  (adjusted_debt Real) ; Adjusted Debt of the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries, after giving effect to the Debt and the application of proceeds
  (adjusted_ctnw Real) ; Adjusted Consolidated Tangible Net Worth, after giving effect to the Debt and the application of proceeds
  (is_refinancing_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Refinancing Debt
  (is_non_recourse_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Non-Recourse Debt
  (is_loan_documents_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Debt created under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents
  (is_second_lien_or_exchange_notes_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is evidenced by the Second Lien Notes or Exchange Notes issued in exchange therefor
  (is_credit_facility_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Debt under Credit Facilities
  (credit_facilities_debt_total Real) ; aggregate Debt under Credit Facilities in USD after giving effect to the Incurrence
  (consolidated_tangible_assets Real) ; Consolidated Tangible Assets in USD
  (is_guarantee_of_agreement_debt Bool) ; true if the item is a guarantee of Debt of the Borrower under this Agreement or any other Second Priority Obligations
  (is_performance_deposit_debt Bool) ; true if the item is Debt under deposits securing tenders, bids, leases, statutory obligations, surety and appeal bonds, progress payments, government contracts and like obligations (excluding obligations for payment of borrowed money)
  (is_loan_party_guarantee Bool) ; true if the item is a Guarantor guaranteeing Debt of the Borrower or another Guarantor, or the Borrower guaranteeing Debt of a Guarantor
  (guaranteed_debt_permitted Bool) ; true if the Debt guaranteed is permitted to be Incurred under this Agreement
  (guaranteed_debt_non_recourse Bool) ; true if the Debt guaranteed is Non-Recourse Debt
  (is_rs_debt_owed_to_eligible_holder_A Bool) ; true if the item is Debt of a Restricted Subsidiary owing to the Borrower or a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (subordination_A_satisfied Bool) ; true if the (vii)(A) Debt is subordinated to any Guaranty of such Restricted Subsidiary in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the Agent, or no such Guaranty exists
  (holder_still_eligible_A Bool) ; true if the Person to whom the (vii)(A) Debt is owing is currently the Borrower or a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (is_borrower_debt_owed_to_eligible_guarantor_B Bool) ; true if the item is Debt of the Borrower owing to a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (subordination_B_satisfied Bool) ; true if the (vii)(B) Debt is subordinated to the Borrower's obligations under this Agreement in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the Agent
  (holder_still_eligible_B Bool) ; true if the Person to whom the (vii)(B) Debt is owing is currently a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (is_capital_lease_purchase_money_debt Bool) ; true if the item is Debt under Capital Leases or purchase money obligations Incurred to acquire or finance the purchase price or cost of construction or improvement of property or equipment used in the business
  (capital_lease_purchase_money_outstanding Real) ; aggregate amount in USD of such Capital Lease and purchase money Debt outstanding after the Incurrence
  (is_bond_financing_obligation Bool) ; true if the item is obligations for, pledges of assets for, or guaranties of bond financings of political subdivisions or enterprises thereof in the ordinary course of business, as determined in good faith by the Borrower
  (is_seller_land_debt Bool) ; true if the item is Debt owed to a seller of entitled land, lots under development or finished lots, payable upon future sale of such land or lots
  (general_basket_outstanding Real) ; aggregate principal amount in USD of Debt that would be outstanding under clause (b)(xi) including this item
  (debt_purports_subordinated Bool) ; true if the Debt item purports by its terms to be subordinated to any other Debt of the Borrower or of the Guarantor
  (incurrer_is_borrower_or_rs_guarantor Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Incurred by the Borrower or by a Guarantor that is a Restricted Subsidiary
  (subordinated_to_loans_same_extent Bool) ; true if the Debt item is expressly subordinated to the Loans or the Guaranty of such Guarantor at least to the same extent and manner as to such other Debt
) Bool
  (=> (and loans_unpaid (not required_lenders_written_waiver))
    (and
      ;; Section 6.02(a), (b) and (d): the Debt must fit at least one permitted category
      (=> debt_occurs
        (or
          ;; (a)(i) or (a)(ii) ratio tests
          (and incurrer_is_borrower_or_guarantor
               (or (>= fccr 2.0)
                   (< (/ adjusted_debt adjusted_ctnw) 7.5)))
          ;; (b)(i)
          is_refinancing_debt
          is_non_recourse_debt
          ;; (b)(ii)
          (and incurrer_is_borrower is_loan_documents_debt)
          (and incurrer_is_borrower is_second_lien_or_exchange_notes_debt)
          ;; (b)(iii)
          (and incurrer_is_borrower_or_guarantor
               is_credit_facility_debt
               (<= credit_facilities_debt_total
                   (ite (>= 200000000.0 (* 0.15 consolidated_tangible_assets))
                        200000000.0
                        (* 0.15 consolidated_tangible_assets))))
          ;; (b)(iv)
          is_guarantee_of_agreement_debt
          ;; (b)(v)
          is_performance_deposit_debt
          ;; (b)(vi)
          (and is_loan_party_guarantee guaranteed_debt_permitted (not guaranteed_debt_non_recourse))
          ;; (b)(vii)(A)
          (and is_rs_debt_owed_to_eligible_holder_A subordination_A_satisfied holder_still_eligible_A)
          ;; (b)(vii)(B)
          (and is_borrower_debt_owed_to_eligible_guarantor_B subordination_B_satisfied holder_still_eligible_B)
          ;; (b)(viii)
          (and is_capital_lease_purchase_money_debt (<= capital_lease_purchase_money_outstanding 50000000.0))
          ;; (b)(ix)
          is_bond_financing_obligation
          ;; (b)(x)
          is_seller_land_debt
          ;; (b)(xi)
          (<= general_basket_outstanding 100000000.0)))
      ;; Section 6.02(c): subordination restriction
      (=> (and debt_occurs incurrer_is_borrower_or_rs_guarantor debt_purports_subordinated)
          subordinated_to_loans_same_extent))))",

candidate.smt2:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (loans_unpaid Bool) ; true if at the observation any Loan remains unpaid
  (required_lenders_written_waiver Bool) ; true if the Required Lenders have agreed in writing to permit the Debt/action observed
  (debt_occurs Bool) ; true if the Borrower or a Restricted Subsidiary creates, incurs, assumes or suffers to exist a Debt item (incl. Acquired Debt) at this observation
  (incurrer_is_borrower Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Incurred by the Borrower
  (incurrer_is_borrower_or_guarantor Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Incurred by the Borrower or a Guarantor
  (fccr Real) ; Borrower's Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio on the date of the Incurrence, after giving effect to the Debt and the application of proceeds
  (adjusted_debt Real) ; Adjusted Debt of the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries, after giving effect to the Debt and the application of proceeds
  (adjusted_ctnw Real) ; Adjusted Consolidated Tangible Net Worth, after giving effect to the Debt and the application of proceeds
  (is_refinancing_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Refinancing Debt
  (is_non_recourse_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Non-Recourse Debt
  (is_loan_documents_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Debt created under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents
  (is_second_lien_or_exchange_notes_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is evidenced by the Second Lien Notes or Exchange Notes issued in exchange therefor
  (is_credit_facility_debt Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Debt under Credit Facilities
  (credit_facilities_debt_total Real) ; aggregate Debt under Credit Facilities in USD after giving effect to the Incurrence
  (consolidated_tangible_assets Real) ; Consolidated Tangible Assets in USD
  (is_guarantee_of_agreement_debt Bool) ; true if the item is a guarantee of Debt of the Borrower under this Agreement or any other Second Priority Obligations
  (is_performance_deposit_debt Bool) ; true if the item is Debt under deposits securing tenders, bids, leases, statutory obligations, surety and appeal bonds, progress payments, government contracts and like obligations (excluding obligations for payment of borrowed money)
  (is_loan_party_guarantee Bool) ; true if the item is a Guarantor guaranteeing Debt of the Borrower or another Guarantor, or the Borrower guaranteeing Debt of a Guarantor
  (guaranteed_debt_permitted Bool) ; true if the Debt guaranteed is permitted to be Incurred under this Agreement
  (guaranteed_debt_non_recourse Bool) ; true if the Debt guaranteed is Non-Recourse Debt
  (is_rs_debt_owed_to_eligible_holder_A Bool) ; true if the item is Debt of a Restricted Subsidiary owing to the Borrower or a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (subordination_A_satisfied Bool) ; true if the (vii)(A) Debt is subordinated to any Guaranty of such Restricted Subsidiary in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the Agent, or no such Guaranty exists
  (holder_still_eligible_A Bool) ; true if the Person to whom the (vii)(A) Debt is owing is currently the Borrower or a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (is_borrower_debt_owed_to_eligible_guarantor_B Bool) ; true if the item is Debt of the Borrower owing to a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (subordination_B_satisfied Bool) ; true if the (vii)(B) Debt is subordinated to the Borrower's obligations under this Agreement in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the Agent
  (holder_still_eligible_B Bool) ; true if the Person to whom the (vii)(B) Debt is owing is currently a Guarantor that is both a Wholly Owned Subsidiary and a Restricted Subsidiary
  (is_capital_lease_purchase_money_debt Bool) ; true if the item is Debt under Capital Leases or purchase money obligations Incurred to acquire or finance the purchase price or cost of construction or improvement of property or equipment used in the business
  (capital_lease_purchase_money_outstanding Real) ; aggregate amount in USD of such Capital Lease and purchase money Debt outstanding after the Incurrence
  (is_bond_financing_obligation Bool) ; true if the item is obligations for, pledges of assets for, or guaranties of bond financings of political subdivisions or enterprises thereof in the ordinary course of business, as determined in good faith by the Borrower
  (is_seller_land_debt Bool) ; true if the item is Debt owed to a seller of entitled land, lots under development or finished lots, payable upon future sale of such land or lots
  (general_basket_outstanding Real) ; aggregate principal amount in USD of Debt that would be outstanding under clause (b)(xi) including this item
  (debt_purports_subordinated Bool) ; true if the Debt item purports by its terms to be subordinated to any other Debt of the Borrower or of the Guarantor
  (incurrer_is_borrower_or_rs_guarantor Bool) ; true if the Debt item is Incurred by the Borrower or by a Guarantor that is a Restricted Subsidiary
  (subordinated_to_loans_same_extent Bool) ; true if the Debt item is expressly subordinated to the Loans or the Guaranty of such Guarantor at least to the same extent and manner as to such other Debt
) Bool
  (=> (and loans_unpaid (not required_lenders_written_waiver))
    (and
      ;; Section 6.02(a), (b) and (d): the Debt must fit at least one permitted category
      (=> debt_occurs
        (or
          ;; (a)(i) or (a)(ii) ratio tests
          (and incurrer_is_borrower_or_guarantor
               (or (>= fccr 2.0)
                   (< (/ adjusted_debt adjusted_ctnw) 7.5)))
          ;; (b)(i)
          is_refinancing_debt
          is_non_recourse_debt
          ;; (b)(ii)
          (and incurrer_is_borrower is_loan_documents_debt)
          (and incurrer_is_borrower is_second_lien_or_exchange_notes_debt)
          ;; (b)(iii)
          (and incurrer_is_borrower_or_guarantor
               is_credit_facility_debt
               (<= credit_facilities_debt_total
                   (ite (>= 200000000.0 (* 0.15 consolidated_tangible_assets))
                        200000000.0
                        (* 0.15 consolidated_tangible_assets))))
          ;; (b)(iv)
          is_guarantee_of_agreement_debt
          ;; (b)(v)
          is_performance_deposit_debt
          ;; (b)(vi)
          (and is_loan_party_guarantee guaranteed_debt_permitted (not guaranteed_debt_non_recourse))
          ;; (b)(vii)(A)
          (and is_rs_debt_owed_to_eligible_holder_A subordination_A_satisfied holder_still_eligible_A)
          ;; (b)(vii)(B)
          (and is_borrower_debt_owed_to_eligible_guarantor_B subordination_B_satisfied holder_still_eligible_B)
          ;; (b)(viii)
          (and is_capital_lease_purchase_money_debt (<= capital_lease_purchase_money_outstanding 50000000.0))
          ;; (b)(ix)
          is_bond_financing_obligation
          ;; (b)(x)
          is_seller_land_debt
          ;; (b)(xi)
          (<= general_basket_outstanding 100000000.0)))
      ;; Section 6.02(c): subordination restriction
      (=> (and debt_occurs incurrer_is_borrower_or_rs_guarantor debt_purports_subordinated)
          subordinated_to_loans_same_extent))))

candidate.notes: Pointwise encoding of Section 6.02: when Loans are unpaid and there is no written Required Lender waiver, any observed Debt item must satisfy the ratio tests (Borrower/Guarantors only) or at least one clause (b) basket, and clause (c) must also hold. Clause (d) is reflected by the disjunction over categories, so any compliant classification suffices. The adjusted_debt/adjusted_ctnw division is kept as written, so the evaluator reports a zero denominator as unresolved. Aggregate-cap baskets (iii), (viii) and (xi) take the post-incurrence aggregate amounts as inputs. QF_NRA is used because the ratio divides by a variable.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_month_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a month ("as of the last day of each month").
; unrestricted_cash_at_bank: Borrower's unrestricted cash (and equivalents) held at Bank, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; accounts: all of Borrower's Accounts, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; unpaid_equipment_advances: unpaid Equipment Advances, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; other_indebtedness_to_bank: any other indebtedness owing to Bank, in dollars, as of the observation date.
; ebitda_prev_3_months: Borrower's earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization in dollars, calculated for the previous 3 months ending at the observation date.
; monthly_pretax_loss: Borrower's pre-tax loss for the month ending at the observation date, in dollars, as a positive loss amount.
; is_feb_or_mar_2002_month: true iff the month being tested is February 2002 or March 2002.
; is_month_after_mar_2002: true iff the month being tested is after March 2002.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_month_end Bool)
    (unrestricted_cash_at_bank Real)
    (accounts Real)
    (unpaid_equipment_advances Real)
    (other_indebtedness_to_bank Real)
    (ebitda_prev_3_months Real)
    (monthly_pretax_loss Real)
    (is_feb_or_mar_2002_month Bool)
    (is_month_after_mar_2002 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ; (i) Liquidity Coverage: ratio of at least 1.50 to 1.00
    (=> is_month_end
        (>= (/ (+ unrestricted_cash_at_bank accounts)
               (+ unpaid_equipment_advances other_indebtedness_to_bank))
            1.5))
    ; (ii) EBITDA: at least $60,000 over previous 3 months

Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. ; is_fiscal_quarter_end: the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.

; ebitda_four_quarters: EBITDA (Consolidated EBITDA) of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for the most recently completed four fiscal quarter period, in dollars.
; interest_expense_quarter: Interest Expense of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for the fiscal quarter, in dollars.
; total_assets: Consolidated total assets of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries at the date of determination, in dollars, as reported (including the effect of the charges).
; total_liabilities: Consolidated total liabilities of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries at the date of determination, in dollars, as reported.

; cumulative_net_income: Consolidated net income of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, as reported, cumulative for the period after Oct 26, 1997 to and including the date of determination, in dollars.
; charges_reducing_net_income: Asset Impairment Charges and Restructuring Charges, in dollars, to the extent they have reduced that cumulative Consolidated net income (added back).
; leverage_ratio: the Borrower's Leverage Ratio as of the fiscal quarter end (atomic; ratio value, e.g. 5.5 for 5.50:1).
; capex_base: aggregate cash Capital Expenditures made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, in dollars, over the measurement period. The period is the four fiscal quarter period, except that it is the one fiscal quarter ended Feb 15 1998, the two fiscal quarters ended May 10 1998, or the three fiscal quarters ended Aug 2 1998 for those dates. It is unscaled and uncapped.
; amort_base: aggregate principal amount of all scheduled amortization payments on Debt made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, in dollars, over the same measurement period as capex_base. It is unscaled.
; tax_base: aggregate tax expense incurred by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, in dollars, over the same measurement period as capex_base. It is unscaled.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (advance_unpaid Bool)
    (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
    (lender_party_has_commitment Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (qe_feb_15_1998 Bool)

    (qe_may_9_1999 Bool)
    (qe_aug_1_1999 Bool)
    (qe_oct_31_1999 Bool)

    (qe_may_14_2000 Bool)
    (qe_aug_6_2000 Bool)
    (qe_oct_29_2000 Bool)
    (qe_feb_18_2001 Bool)
    (qe_may_13_2001 Bool)
    (qe_aug_5_2001 Bool)
    (qe_oct_28_2001_or_later Bool)
    (ebitda_four_quarters Real)
    (interest_expense_quarter Real)
    (total_assets Real)
    (total_liabilities Real)
    (charges_reducing_excess Real)
    (cumulative_net_income Real)
    (charges_reducing_net_income Real)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (capex_base Real)
    (amort_base Real)
    (tax_base Real)) Bool
  (=> (or advance_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_party_has_commitment)
    (and
      ; (a) Interest Coverage Ratio, minimum by fiscal quarter ending
      (=> (or qe_feb_15_1998 qe_may_10_1998 qe_aug_2_1998 qe_oct_25_1998)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 2.25))
      (=> (or qe_feb_14_1999 qe_may_9_1999 qe_aug_1_1999 qe_oct_31_1999)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 2.75))
      (=> (or qe_feb_20_2000 qe_may_14_2000 qe_aug_6_2000 qe_oct_29_2000)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 3.25))
      (=> (or qe_feb_18_2001 qe_may_13_2001 qe_aug_5_2001 qe_oct_28_2001_or_later)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 3.75))
      ; (b) Net Worth, at all times (pointwise)
      (>= (+ (- total_assets total_liabilities) charges_reducing_excess)
          (* 0.5 (+ cumulative_net_income charges_reducing_net_income)))
      ; (c) Leverage Ratio, maximum by fiscal quarter ending
      (=> (or qe_feb_15_1998 qe_may_10_1998 qe_aug_2_1998)
          (<= leverage_ratio 5.5))
      (=> (or qe_oct_25_1998 qe_feb_14_1999 qe_may_9_1999 qe_aug_1_1999)
          (<= leverage_ratio 4.75))
      (=> (or qe_oct_31_1999 qe_feb_20_2000 qe_may_14_2000)
          (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
      (=> (or qe_aug_6_2000 qe_oct_29_2000 qe_feb_18_2001 qe_may_13_2001 qe_aug_5_2001)
          (<= leverage_ratio 4.0))
      (=> qe_oct_28_2001_or_later
          (<= leverage_ratio 3.75))
      ; (d) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio >= 1.10:1 at each fiscal quarter end, with 1998 provisos
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (ite qe_feb_15_1998
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters
                    (ite (> (* (/ 13.0 4.0) capex_base) 35000000.0) 35000000.0 (* (/ 13.0 4.0) capex_base)))
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter (* (/ 13.0 4.0) amort_base) (* (/ 13.0 4.0) tax_base)))
              1.10)
        (ite qe_may_10_1998
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters
                    (ite (> (* (/ 13.0 7.0) capex_base) 35000000.0) 35000000.0 (* (/ 13.0 7.0) capex_base)))
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter (* (/ 13.0 7.0) amort_base) (* (/ 13.0 7.0) tax_base)))
              1.10)
        (ite qe_aug_2_1998
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters
                    (ite (> (* (/ 13.0 10.0) capex_base) 35000000.0) 35000000.0 (* (/ 13.0 10.0) capex_base)))
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter (* (/ 13.0 10.0) amort_base) (* (/ 13.0 10.0) tax_base)))
              1.10)
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters capex_base)
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter amort_base tax_base))
              1.10)))))
    )))
",

; amort_base: aggregate principal amount of all scheduled amortization payments on Debt made by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, in dollars, over the same measurement period as capex_base. It is unscaled.
; tax_base: aggregate tax expense incurred by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, in dollars, over the same measurement period as capex_base. It is unscaled.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (advance_unpaid Bool)
    (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
    (lender_party_has_commitment Bool)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (qe_feb_15_1998 Bool)
    (qe_may_10_1998 Bool)
    (qe_aug_2_1998 Bool)
    (qe_oct_25_1998 Bool)
    (qe_feb_14_1999 Bool)
    (qe_may_9_1999 Bool)
    (qe_aug_1_1999 Bool)
    (qe_oct_31_1999 Bool)
    (qe_feb_20_2000 Bool)
    (qe_may_14_2000 Bool)
    (qe_aug_6_2000 Bool)
    (qe_oct_29_2000 Bool)
    (qe_feb_18_2001 Bool)
    (qe_may_13_2001 Bool)
    (qe_aug_5_2001 Bool)
    (qe_oct_28_2001_or_later Bool)
    (ebitda_four_quarters Real)
    (interest_expense_quarter Real)
    (total_assets Real)
    (total_liabilities Real)
    (charges_reducing_excess Real)
    (cumulative_net_income Real)
    (charges_reducing_net_income Real)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (capex_base Real)
    (amort_base Real)
    (tax_base Real)) Bool
  (=> (or advance_unpaid letter_of_credit_outstanding lender_party_has_commitment)
    (and
      ; (a) Interest Coverage Ratio, minimum by fiscal quarter ending
      (=> (or qe_feb_15_1998 qe_may_10_1998 qe_aug_2_1998 qe_oct_25_1998)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 2.25))
      (=> (or qe_feb_14_1999 qe_may_9_1999 qe_aug_1_1999 qe_oct_31_1999)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 2.75))
      (=> (or qe_feb_20_2000 qe_may_14_2000 qe_aug_6_2000 qe_oct_29_2000)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 3.25))
      (=> (or qe_feb_18_2001 qe_may_13_2001 qe_aug_5_2001 qe_oct_28_2001_or_later)
          (>= (/ ebitda_four_quarters interest_expense_quarter) 3.75))
      ; (b) Net Worth, at all times (pointwise)
      (>= (+ (- total_assets total_liabilities) charges_reducing_excess)
          (* 0.5 (+ cumulative_net_income charges_reducing_net_income)))
      ; (c) Leverage Ratio, maximum by fiscal quarter ending
      (=> (or qe_feb_15_1998 qe_may_10_1998 qe_aug_2_1998)
          (<= leverage_ratio 5.5))
      (=> (or qe_oct_25_1998 qe_feb_14_1999 qe_may_9_1999 qe_aug_1_1999)
          (<= leverage_ratio 4.75))
      (=> (or qe_oct_31_1999 qe_feb_20_2000 qe_may_14_2000)
          (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
      (=> (or qe_aug_6_2000 qe_oct_29_2000 qe_feb_18_2001 qe_may_13_2001 qe_aug_5_2001)
          (<= leverage_ratio 4.0))
      (=> qe_oct_28_2001_or_later
          (<= leverage_ratio 3.75))
      ; (d) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio >= 1.10:1 at each fiscal quarter end, with 1998 provisos
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (ite qe_feb_15_1998
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters
                    (ite (> (* (/ 13.0 4.0) capex_base) 35000000.0) 35000000.0 (* (/ 13.0 4.0) capex_base)))
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter (* (/ 13.0 4.0) amort_base) (* (/ 13.0 4.0) tax_base)))
              1.10)
        (ite qe_may_10_1998
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters
                    (ite (> (* (/ 13.0 7.0) capex_base) 35000000.0) 35000000.0 (* (/ 13.0 7.0) capex_base)))
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter (* (/ 13.0 7.0) amort_base) (* (/ 13.0 7.0) tax_base)))
              1.10)
        (ite qe_aug_2_1998
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters
                    (ite (> (* (/ 13.0 10.0) capex_base) 35000000.0) 35000000.0 (* (/ 13.0 10.0) capex_base)))
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter (* (/ 13.0 10.0) amort_base) (* (/ 13.0 10.0) tax_base)))
              1.10)
          (>= (/ (- ebitda_four_quarters capex_base)
                 (+ interest_expense_quarter amort_base tax_base))
              1.10)))))
    )))

candidate.notes: All four covenants (a)-(d) are conjoined and apply only while an Advance is unpaid, a Letter of Credit is outstanding, or a Lender Party has a Commitment. Each date-specific threshold is gated by a quarter-ending-date flag, so (a) and (c) are not checked at quarter ends that match no listed date. The net worth test (b) is evaluated at every observation. Net worth compares the excess with 50% of cumulative net income literally, with no floor at zero, and with the Asset Impairment and Restructuring Charges added back to both sides. The ratios use real division, so a zero denominator is reported as unresolved by the evaluator. In (d), the 13/4, 13/7 and 13/10 factors apply to capex, scheduled amortization and tax only, not to EBITDA or Interest Expense. For those three 1998 quarters the scaled capex is capped at $35,000,000, on the reading that the cap applies to the scaled component. The quarter-ending flags are treated as mutually exclusive supplied inputs.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; commitments_expired_or_terminated: true if the Commitments have expired or terminated at this observation.
; loans_and_fees_paid_in_full: true if the principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees payable under the agreement have been paid in full at this observation.
; letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated: true if all Letters of Credit have expired or terminated at this observation.
; lc_disbursements_reimbursed: true if all LC Disbursements have been reimbursed at this observation.
; incurs_indebtedness: true if the United States Borrower or any Subsidiary creates, incurs or assumes any Indebtedness at this observation.
; interest_coverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma: true if the Interest Coverage Ratio is satisfied on a pro forma basis after giving effect to the incurrence of the Indebtedness and the intended contemporaneous application of its proceeds.
; leverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma: true if the Leverage Ratio is satisfied on a pro forma basis after giving effect to the incurrence of the Indebtedness and the intended contemporaneous application of its proceeds.
; subsidiary_incurs_indebtedness: true if a Subsidiary (not the United States Borrower itself) creates, incurs or assumes Indebtedness at this observation, including a guarantee of Indebtedness.
; incurring_subsidiary_is_license_subsidiary: true if the Subsidiary incurring the Indebtedness is a License Subsidiary.
; aggregate_principal_incurred_under_clause_b_i: aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness incurred pursuant to clause (b)(i) and outstanding at this observation, in currency units.
; available_subsidiary_debt_amount: the Available Subsidiary Debt Amount at the time such Indebtedness is incurred, in currency units.
; is_guarantee_by_domestic_subsidiary_guarantor_of_qualified_indebtedness: true if the Subsidiary Indebtedness is a guarantee by a domestic Subsidiary of the United States Borrower (including the License Subsidiaries) that is a Subsidiary Guarantor, of Indebtedness of the United States Borrower that constitutes Qualified Indebtedness.
; guarantee_release_conditions_satisfied: true if the Guarantee Release Conditions have been satisfied at this observation.
; incurs_short_term_indebtedness: true if the United States Borrower or any Subsidiary creates, incurs or assumes any Short-Term Indebtedness at this observation.
; aggregate_short_term_indebtedness_principal: aggregate principal amount of Short-Term Indebtedness of the United States Borrower and its Subsidiaries outstanding at this observation, after giving effect to any incurrence, in dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_expired_or_terminated Bool)
  (loans_and_fees_paid_in_full Bool)
  (letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated Bool)
  (lc_disbursements_reimbursed Bool)
  (incurs_indebtedness Bool)
  (interest_coverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma Bool)
  (leverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma Bool)
  (subsidiary_incurs_indebtedness Bool)
  (incurring_subsidiary_is_license_subsidiary Bool)
  (aggregate_principal_incurred_under_clause_b_i Real)
  (available_subsidiary_debt_amount Real)
  (is_guarantee_by_domestic_subsidiary_guarantor_of_qualified_indebtedness Bool)
  (guarantee_release_conditions_satisfied Bool)
  (incurs_short_term_indebtedness Bool)
  (aggregate_short_term_indebtedness_principal Real)
) Bool
  (let ((covenant_in_force
         (not (and commitments_expired_or_terminated
                   loans_and_fees_paid_in_full
                   letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated
                   lc_disbursements_reimbursed))))
    (=> covenant_in_force
        (and
          ; 6.01(a)
          (=> incurs_indebtedness
              (and interest_coverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma
                   leverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma))
          ; 6.01(b) exceptions (i) and (ii)
          (=> subsidiary_incurs_indebtedness
              (or (and (not incurring_subsidiary_is_license_subsidiary)
                       (<= aggregate_principal_incurred_under_clause_b_i
                           available_subsidiary_debt_amount))
                  (and is_guarantee_by_domestic_subsidiary_guarantor_of_qualified_indebtedness
                       (not guarantee_release_conditions_satisfied))))
          ; 6.01(c)
          (=> incurs_short_term_indebtedness
              (<= aggregate_short_term_indebtedness_principal 300000000.0))))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "commitments_expired_or_terminated", "meaning": "True if the Commitments have expired or terminated at this observation.", "source_quote": "Until the Commitments have expired or terminated"},
    {"name": "loans_and_fees_paid_in_full", "meaning": "True if the principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees payable under the agreement have been paid in full at this observation.", "source_quote": "the principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees payable hereunder have been paid in full"},
    {"name": "letters_of_credit_expired_or_terminated", "meaning": "True if all Letters of Credit have expired or terminated at this observation.", "source_quote": "all Letters of Credit have expired or terminated"},
    {"name": "lc_disbursements_reimbursed", "meaning": "True if all LC Disbursements have been reimbursed at this observation.", "source_quote": "all LC Disbursements shall have been reimbursed"},
    {"name": "incurs_indebtedness", "meaning": "True if the United States Borrower or any Subsidiary creates, incurs or assumes any Indebtedness at this observation.", "source_quote": "create, incur or assume any Indebtedness unless at the time of such creation, incurrence or assumption"},
    {"name": "interest_coverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma", "meaning": "True if the Interest Coverage Ratio is satisfied on a pro forma basis after giving effect to the incurrence and the intended contemporaneous application of proceeds.", "source_quote": "the Interest Coverage Ratio"},
    {"name": "leverage_ratio_satisfied_pro_forma", "meaning": "True if the Leverage Ratio is satisfied on a pro forma basis after giving effect to the incurrence and the intended contemporaneous application of proceeds.", "source_quote": "the Leverage Ratio are satisfied on a pro forma basis"},
    {"name": "subsidiary_incurs_indebtedness", "meaning": "True if a Subsidiary creates, incurs or assumes Indebtedness at this observation, including a guarantee of Indebtedness.", "source_quote": "will not permit any Subsidiary to create, incur or assume any Indebtedness except that"},
    {"name": "incurring_subsidiary_is_license_subsidiary", "meaning": "True if the Subsidiary incurring the Indebtedness is a License Subsidiary.", "source_quote": "other than a License Subsidiary"},
    {"name": "aggregate_principal_incurred_under_clause_b_i", "meaning": "Aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness incurred pursuant to the Subsidiary basket in clause (b)(i) and outstanding at this observation, in currency units.", "source_quote": "aggregate principal amount of Indebtedness incurred pursuant to this clause (ii)"},
    {"name": "available_subsidiary_debt_amount", "meaning": "The Available Subsidiary Debt Amount at the time the Indebtedness is incurred, in currency units.", "source_quote": "the Available Subsidiary Debt Amount at the time such Indebtedness is incurred"},
    {"name": "is_guarantee_by_domestic_subsidiary_guarantor_of_qualified_indebtedness", "meaning": "True if the Subsidiary Indebtedness is a guarantee by a domestic Subsidiary that is a Subsidiary Guarantor (including a License Subsidiary) of Indebtedness of the United States Borrower constituting Qualified Indebtedness.", "source_quote": "any domestic Subsidiary of the United States Borrower (including the License Subsidiaries) which is a Subsidiary Guarantor may guarantee Indebtedness of the United States Borrower which constitutes Qualified Indebtedness"},
    {"name": "guarantee_release_conditions_satisfied", "meaning": "True if the Guarantee Release Conditions have been satisfied at this observation.", "source_quote": "so long as the Guarantee Release Conditions have not been satisfied"},
    {"name": "incurs_short_term_indebtedness", "meaning": "True if the United States Borrower or any Subsidiary creates, incurs or assumes any Short-Term Indebtedness at this observation.", "source_quote": "create, incur or assume any Short-Term Indebtedness"},
    {"name": "aggregate_short_term_indebtedness_principal", "meaning": "Aggregate principal amount of Short-Term Indebtedness of the United States Borrower and its Subsidiaries outstanding at this observation, after giving effect to any incurrence, in dollars.", "source_quote": "the aggregate principal amount of Short-Term Indebtedness does not exceed $300,000,000 at any time outstanding"}
  ],
  "notes": "Pointwise translation. The covenant applies only while the termination conditions (Commitments expired or terminated, Loans and fees paid in full, Letters of Credit expired or terminated, LC Disbursements reimbursed) do not all hold. Clause (a): the Interest Coverage Ratio and Leverage Ratio thresholds are not supplied, so each is a Boolean pro forma satisfaction input. Clause (b): an incurrence by a Subsidiary is permitted if it falls under exception (i) (a non-License Subsidiary within the Available Subsidiary Debt Amount cap) or exception (ii) (a permitted guarantee while the Guarantee Release Conditions are unsatisfied). The source mislabels the (b)(i) cap as 'this clause (ii)'; I read it as the cap on clause (i). Clause (c): the $300,000,000 cap is tested at observations where Short-Term Indebtedness is incurred, using the aggregate outstanding after giving effect to that incurrence. The preamble's 'United States Borrower (for itself and its Subsidiaries)' is reflected in the incurrence flags. Classification of Indebtedness and Subsidiary status are evaluator-supplied inputs."
}

  (c_rg_is_surviving Bool) ; True if the Restricted Guarantor is the surviving corporation of the 6.04(c) transaction
  (c_successor_organized_permitted Bool) ; True if the surviving or transferee Person is organized under the laws of the Restricted Guarantor's jurisdiction of organization or of the United States, any state, DC or any territory (6.04(c)(i)(A))
  (c_successor_is_other_than_rg Bool) ; True if the Successor Person is other than the Restricted Guarantor
  (c_successor_assumed_obligations Bool) ; True if the Successor Person expressly assumed all the Obligations of the Restricted Guarantor under documentation reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent
  (c_no_eod_immediately_after Bool) ; True if immediately after the 6.04(c) transaction no Event of Default exists
  (c_officer_cert_and_opinion_delivered Bool) ; True if the Borrower delivered to the Administrative Agent the Officer's Certificate and Opinion of Counsel required by 6.04(c)(i)(D)
  (c_not_violate_6_05 Bool) ; True if the 6.04(c) transaction does not violate Section 6.05
  (d_transaction Bool) ; True if at this observation Holdings consolidates, merges or winds up, or disposes of all or substantially all of its assets to any other Person (6.04(d))
  (d_to_borrower_or_guarantor Bool) ; True if Holdings consolidates with, merges into, or disposes of all or part of its assets to the Borrower or another Guarantor
  (d_holdings_survives Bool) ; True if Holdings is the surviving corporation of the 6.04(d) transaction
  (d_successor_organized_in_us Bool) ; True if the surviving or transferee Person is organized or existing under the laws of the United States, any state, DC or any territory (6.04(d)(i))
  (d_successor_is_other_than_holdings Bool) ; True if the Successor Holdings Guarantor is a Person other than Holdings
  (d_successor_assumed Bool) ; True if the Successor Holdings Guarantor assumed all the Obligations of Holdings under the Holdings Guaranty and the Security Documents under documentation reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent
  (d_no_eod_immediately_after Bool) ; True if immediately after the 6.04(d) transaction no Event of Default exists
  (notified_admin_agent_promptly Bool) ; True if the Borrower promptly notified the Administrative Agent of the 6.04(a) or 6.04(c) transaction
  (lien_deadline_reached Bool) ; True if the deadline for lien-preservation actions has been reached: the later of 30 days after the transaction and the earlier of the next Pricing Certificate delivery date and 45 days after the most recent fiscal quarter end, or any longer agreed period
  (lien_actions_taken Bool) ; True if the Borrower took all required actions to preserve and protect the Liens on the Collateral securing the Secured Obligations by that deadline
) Bool
  (=> (not termination_date_has_occurred)
    (and
      ;; 6.04(a)
      (=> borrower_a_transaction
        (and
          (or a_borrower_is_surviving_corporation a_successor_organized_in_us)
          (=> a_successor_is_other_than_borrower a_successor_assumed_obligations)
          (or is_transactions_including_merger
              b_i_transfer_to_borrower_or_restricted_guarantor
              (and b_ii_reorg_merger_with_affiliate b_ii_indebtedness_not_increased)
              b_iii_foreign_subsidiary_transfer
              (and a_no_default_or_eod_immediately_after a_pro_forma_can_incur_1_dollar))
          a_guarantors_confirmed_obligations
          a_officer_cert_and_opinion_delivered))
      ;; 6.04(c)
      (=> c_transaction
        (or c_x_transfer_to_restricted_guarantor_or_borrower
            (and c_y_dissolution_liquidation_winding_up c_y_no_material_adverse_effect_expected)
            (and
              (or c_rg_is_surviving c_successor_organized_permitted)
              (=> c_successor_is_other_than_rg c_successor_assumed_obligations)
              c_no_eod_immediately_after
              c_officer_cert_and_opinion_delivered
              c_not_violate_6_05)))
      ;; 6.04(d)
      (=> d_transaction
        (or d_to_borrower_or_guarantor
            (and
              (or d_holdings_survives d_successor_organized_in_us)
              (=> d_successor_is_other_than_holdings d_successor_assumed)
              d_no_eod_immediately_after)))
      ;; Proviso to (a) and (c): notice and Lien preservation
      (=> (or borrower_a_transaction
              (and c_transaction
                   (not c_x_transfer_to_restricted_guarantor_or_borrower)
                   (not (and c_y_dissolution_liquidation_winding_up c_y_no_material_adverse_effect_expected))))
        (and notified_admin_agent_promptly
             (=> lien_deadline_reached lien_actions_taken))))))

candidate.notes: Pointwise encoding of Section 6.04. Each transaction flag gates its sub-clause, and all clause conditions are Boolean event-state inputs. The Total Net Leverage Test in Section 6.01(a) is not supplied, so the $1.00 incurrence capacity is a Boolean input. (a)(i) is read as the Borrower surviving OR the successor being organized in the US. The 6.04(b) exceptions relieve only (a)(iii) and (a)(iv). The 6.04(c) exceptions (x) and (y) are treated as satisfying all of 6.04(c). The notice and lien-preservation proviso is applied to (a) transactions and to (c) transactions not covered by those exceptions. The opening sentence refers to Holdings only for 6.04(c) and 6.09(b), but 6.04(d) is encoded as written because it directly restricts Holdings. Termination Date is modeled as a Boolean flag.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true when the observation date is the end of one of the Company's fiscal quarters, the date as of which both ratios are determined.
; consolidated_net_indebtedness: Consolidated Net Indebtedness of the Company and its Subsidiaries on a consolidated basis at the quarter end (numerator of the Consolidated Leverage Ratio).
; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA of the Company and its Subsidiaries for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending with this quarter end.
; period_in_grid_aug2014_may2015: true when the four-quarter period ends on a date from August 31, 2014 through and including May 31, 2015 (grid maximum 4.50).
; period_in_grid_aug2015_may2016: true when the period ends from August 31, 2015 through and including May 31, 2016 (grid maximum 4.25).
; period_in_grid_aug2016_may2017: true when the period ends from August 31, 2016 through and including May 31, 2017 (grid maximum 4.00).
; period_in_grid_aug2017_onward: true when the period ends on August 31, 2017 or any fiscal quarter ending thereafter (grid maximum 3.75).
; pa_consideration: aggregate cash and non-cash consideration for the Permitted Acquisition, in USD, including assumed Indebtedness, the Company's good faith estimate of the maximum deferred purchase price obligations (including Earn Out Obligations) and Equity Interests.
; pro_forma_leverage_before_pa: Consolidated Leverage Ratio on a Pro Forma Basis, prior to giving effect to the Permitted Acquisition.
; certificate_delivered_prior: true when a Financial Officer certificate demonstrating the pro forma ratio was provided to the Administrative Agent prior to the Permitted Acquisition.
; within_two_increase_occasions: true when this increase is not a third or later increase in the period from the Closing Date through the Revolving Loan Maturity Date.
; four_quarters_at_base_since_prior_increase: true when no earlier increase exists, or the required ratio has been at the unincreased grid level for at least four full fiscal quarters since the prior increase.
; in_half_turn_phase: true when this period is before the first four-quarter period ending after the date six months after the Permitted Acquisition (full 0.50 increase still applies).
; in_quarter_turn_phase: true when this period is the first period ending after six months after the Permitted Acquisition, up to but not including the first period ending after twelve months after it (0.25 increase applies).
; cash_taxes_paid: expense for taxes paid in cash for the four-quarter period.
; capex_payments: payments in respect of unfinanced Consolidated Capital Expenditures or Consolidated Capital Expenditures financed with Loans for the four-quarter period, before the Supply Chain Optimization Project exclusion.
; scop_capex_net_of_insurance: Consolidated Capital Expenditures arising in connection with the Supply Chain Optimization Project, net of insurance proceeds actually received, within capex_payments, for the period.
; restricted_payments_8_07d: Restricted Payments made pursuant to clause (d) of Section 8.07 during the four-quarter period.
; consolidated_fixed_charges: Consolidated Fixed Charges of the Company and its Subsidiaries for the four-quarter period.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (consolidated_net_indebtedness Real)
    (consolidated_ebitda Real)

    (restricted_payments_8_07d Real)
    (consolidated_fixed_charges Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; (a) Leverage: ratio must not be greater than grid level plus any permitted increase, capped at 4.50

                           within_two_increase_occasions

                restricted_payments_8_07d)

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

issues: The Permitted Acquisition increase is not tied to the acquisition having closed on or before the observation. `in_half_turn_phase` is defined as true when the period is 'before the first four-quarter period ending after six months after the Permitted Acquisition'. As written, that includes periods ending before the acquisition itself, so the 0.50 increase could be applied to periods it should not cover.

No input or condition shows that a qualifying Permitted Acquisition has occurred and is the one driving the current increase. The candidate relies on `pa_consideration > 60,000,000`, which does not clearly identify a completed acquisition. Overlapping or multiple acquisitions are also not distinguished.
The meaning of `within_two_increase_occasions` and `four_quarters_at_base_since_prior_increase` for the current observation is only loosely defined, which leaves the increase gating underspecified.
judge.reason: The grid thresholds, the 4.50 cap, the strict `<` 3.75 pro forma test, the >$60M test, and the FCCR arithmetic with the $40M SCOP cap and `>= 1.25` all match the source. However, the temporal scope of the acquisition-based leverage increase is wrong or underspecified. The phase flag is defined to include periods before the acquisition, and nothing requires that the acquisition has closed. This is a possible incorrect scope for the increase, so the formalization cannot be accepted as faithful.

; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is a fiscal-quarter test date (the quarterly test for Net Worth and Current Assets/Current Liabilities, and each fiscal quarter for the EBITDA, Leverage Ratio and debt-service tests).
; net_worth: Borrower's Net Worth in dollars at the observation.
; current_assets: Borrower's Current Assets in dollars at the observation.
; current_liabilities: Borrower's Current Liabilities in dollars at the observation.
; is_calendar_year_end_test: true iff the observation is the end of a calendar year (the Capital Expenditures test date).
; is_calendar_year_1998: true iff the calendar year being tested is 1998 (false for any later calendar year).
; capital_expenditures: Capital Expenditures made or incurred in dollars during the calendar year being tested (or the portion of it elapsed).
; is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998: true iff the fiscal quarter being tested is the quarter ending September 30, 1998 (false for quarters ending December 31, 1998 and later).
; ebitda: Borrower's EBITDA in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; total_interest_expense: total interest expense in dollars on all Indebtedness for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; principal_payments: principal payments of Indebtedness in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; leverage_ratio: Borrower's Leverage Ratio (as a plain number, x for x:1.00) for the fiscal quarter being tested.
; is_financial_reporting_deadline: true iff the observation is the 45th day after the end of a fiscal quarter ending on or after June 30, 1998.
; reports_delivered: true iff, by this observation, Borrower has provided Financial Statements for that quarter and the fiscal year to date, plus the written compliance report in the form of Exhibit P.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (covenant_period_started Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (net_worth Real)
  (current_assets Real)
  (current_liabilities Real)
  (is_calendar_year_end_test Bool)
  (is_calendar_year_1998 Bool)
  (capital_expenditures Real)
  (is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998 Bool)
  (ebitda Real)
  (total_interest_expense Real)
  (principal_payments Real)
  (leverage_ratio Real)
  (is_financial_reporting_deadline Bool)
  (reports_delivered Bool)) Bool
  (and
    ;; (a) Net Worth of not less than $35,000,000, tested quarterly
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= net_worth 35000000.0))
    ;; (b) Current Assets / Current Liabilities not less than 1.25:1.00, tested quarterly
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= (/ current_assets current_liabilities) 1.25))

    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= (/ ebitda total_interest_expense)
            (ite is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998 2.0 3.0)))
    ;; (e) Leverage Ratio not more than 0.75:1.00
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (<= leverage_ratio 0.75))
    ;; (f) EBITDA / (total interest expense + principal payments of Indebtedness) not less than 1.50:1.00
    (=> (and covenant_period_started is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (>= (/ ebitda (+ total_interest_expense principal_payments)) 1.5))
    ;; (g) Financial Statements and Exhibit P compliance report provided within 45 days after quarter end
    (=> is_financial_reporting_deadline reports_delivered)))",

    {"name": "is_calendar_year_1998", "meaning": "True iff the calendar year being tested is 1998; false for any later calendar year.", "source_quote": "1998 $25,000,000 Thereafter $5,000,000"},
    {"name": "capital_expenditures", "meaning": "Capital Expenditures made or incurred in dollars during the calendar year being tested (or the portion of it elapsed).", "source_quote": "Capital Expenditures"},
    {"name": "is_quarter_ending_sept_30_1998", "meaning": "True iff the fiscal quarter being tested is the quarter ending September 30, 1998; false for quarters ending December 31, 1998 and later.", "source_quote": "September 30, 1998 2.00:1.00"},
    {"name": "ebitda", "meaning": "Borrower's EBITDA in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.", "source_quote": "EBITDA"},

    {"name": "principal_payments", "meaning": "Principal payments of Indebtedness in dollars for the fiscal quarter being tested.", "source_quote": "principal payments of Indebtedness"},
    {"name": "leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Borrower's Leverage Ratio as a plain number (x for x:1.00) for the fiscal quarter being tested; its definition is not supplied, so it is atomic.", "source_quote": "Leverage Ratio"},

issues: The Section 7.15(c) disjunct is not tied to the action under review. c_aggregate_consideration is defined as the aggregate of satisfactions made under 7.15(c), 'including this action if made under (c)'. For an action not made under (c), such as a large prepayment that fails every other exception, the evaluator would supply a small or zero aggregate. The disjunct (<= aggregate (50,000,000 - RP - Inv)) is then true, so a prohibited prepayment is judged compliant.

There is no flag for 'this action is made in reliance on basket (c)'. Without it, or a parameter defined to always include the current action's consideration, the basket cap is not applied to the action it is supposed to limit. The parameter meaning is therefore ambiguous and the cap logic is unsound.
Reading the (d)(ii) 'Consolidated Leverage Ratio of 2.00:1.00' as a maximum of 2.0 is a plausible interpretation, but the source does not state it explicitly. It is minor next to the (c) flaw.
judge.reason: The structure is mostly faithful: exceptions (a), (b) and (e) are modeled, (d) requires no default before and after plus a leverage ratio of at most 2.0, and the (c) cap is 50M minus the 7.06(i) and 7.03(p) amounts. However, the (c) exception is vacuously satisfiable. The aggregate parameter includes the current action only 'if made under (c)', so actions outside the basket can pass through it when the aggregate is low. This makes the formalization incorrect and its parameter semantics underspecified.

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; lender_has_credit_exposure: true if any Lender has any Credit Exposure under the agreement at the observation time.
; days_since_fiscal_year_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of the most recent fiscal year of the Company.
; annual_package_delivered_within_113_days: true if the annual deliverables for that fiscal year (audited consolidated balance sheet, income and cash flow statements, with prior-year comparatives and accountants' report) were delivered to the Administrative Agent no later than 113 days after the fiscal year end.
; is_first_three_quarter_period: true if the most recently ended fiscal period is one of the first three quarters of a fiscal year (not the fourth).
; days_since_quarter_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of that quarter.
; quarterly_package_delivered_within_53_days: true if the quarterly deliverables for that quarter (consolidated balance sheet, income and cash flow statements, officer-certified) were delivered no later than 53 days after the quarter end.
; days_since_officer_knowledge_of_default: days elapsed at the observation since a Responsible Officer of the Company obtained knowledge of the Default.
; default_continuing_at_day_5: true if that Default is still continuing at the five-day deadline.
; default_certificate_delivered_within_5_days: true if the certificate of the principal financial officer or principal accounting officer, setting forth the details of the Default and the action the Company is taking or proposes to take, was delivered within five days after such knowledge.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (lender_has_credit_exposure Bool)
    (days_since_fiscal_year_end Real)
    (annual_package_delivered_within_113_days Bool)
    (is_first_three_quarter_period Bool)
    (days_since_quarter_end Real)
    (quarterly_package_delivered_within_53_days Bool)
    (days_since_officer_knowledge_of_default Real)
    (default_continuing_at_day_5 Bool)
    (default_certificate_delivered_within_5_days Bool)) Bool
  (=> lender_has_credit_exposure
      (and
        (=> (> days_since_fiscal_year_end 113) annual_package_delivered_within_113_days)
        (=> (and is_first_three_quarter_period (> days_since_quarter_end 53))
            quarterly_package_delivered_within_53_days)
        (=> (and (> days_since_officer_knowledge_of_default 5) default_continuing_at_day_5)
            default_certificate_delivered_within_5_days))))

issues: The candidate formalizes only clauses (a), (b) and (f) of Section 5.01. It omits clause (c), the compliance certificate delivered with each set of financial statements, covering the Section 5.05 calculations and whether any Default exists.
It omits clause (d), the prompt certificate after Debt incurred in an acquisition that caused the Leverage Ratio to exceed 70%.
It omits clause (g), delivery of shareholder mailings, and clause (h), delivery of SEC filings.
It omits clause (i), the five-day ERISA event notices and certificates, including the $5,000,000 withdrawal liability threshold, and clause (j), additional information about Subsidiaries on request.

Clause (b) requires delivery within 53 days of the end of each of the first three quarters. Clause (a) is also reduced to a single Boolean for the whole annual package. Neither captures the required content, such as officer certification and comparative figures, in the formula itself.

Clause (f) is conditioned on the Default continuing at day 5. The source conditions the obligation on the Default being 'then continuing' when the Responsible Officer obtains knowledge, so the timing of the continuing test is not faithfully captured.

The candidate omits the electronic-delivery deemed-delivery rule and the Administrative Agent's four-Domestic-Business-Day forwarding obligation, so the scope of Section 5.01 is not fully represented.

; default_after_acquisition: true iff a Default or Event of Default occurs and is continuing after giving effect to the Acquisition.

; subsidiary_is_excluded: true iff such Subsidiary is an Excluded Subsidiary.

; stock_pledged_to_collateral_agent: true iff all outstanding Stock of such Subsidiary is pledged to the Collateral Agent pursuant to the Pledge Agreement.
; subsidiary_guaranty_executed: true iff such Subsidiary executes a Subsidiary Guaranty.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_or_commitment_outstanding Bool)
  (majority_lenders_written_consent Bool)
  (acquisition_being_made Bool)
  (aggregate_acquisition_consideration Real)

  (made_through_subsidiary_owning_only_gp_interests Bool)

  (subsidiary_is_excluded Bool)
  (stock_owned_by_borrower Bool)

  (subsidiary_guaranty_executed Bool)) Bool

        (<= (+ aggregate_acquisition_consideration section_7_6_f_investments)
            (+ permitted_investment_disposition_proceeds
               (ite (< total_debt_to_ebitd_ratio 3.5) 100000000.0
                    (ite (< total_debt_to_ebitd_ratio 4.0) 75000000.0
                         (ite (< total_debt_to_ebitd_ratio 4.5) 50000000.0 0.0)))))
        ; (B) notice required when consideration exceeds $5,000,000

            notice_given_five_business_days_prior)
        ; (C) no Default or Event of Default before or after giving effect
        (not default_before_acquisition)
        (not default_after_acquisition)
        ; (D) general partnership interests only through a Subsidiary owning no other assets
        (=> acquisition_is_general_partnership_interests
            made_through_subsidiary_owning_only_gp_interests)
        ; (E) unless Excluded Subsidiary, stock owned and pledged and guaranty executed
        (=> (and acquisition_through_subsidiary (not subsidiary_is_excluded))
            (and stock_owned_by_borrower
                 stock_pledged_to_collateral_agent
                 subsidiary_guaranty_executed)))))",

  ],

The (A) basket uses the current observed ratio, with the strictest tier applying: under 3.5 gives $100M, under 4.0 gives $75M, under 4.5 gives $50M, and 4.5 or above gives no basket, so only disposition proceeds count. z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

  (gross_revenues_excl_tenant_reimbursements Real)
  (unsecured_debt_service Real)
  (affiliate_unsecured_debt_service_share Real)
) Bool

; noncash_provisions_writeoffs: non-cash provisions for, or actual write-offs of, assets (without duplication in respect of any prior period) for the Borrower and its consolidated Subsidiaries for that same four-quarter period.
; interest_on_indebtedness: all interest in respect of Indebtedness (including the interest component of Capital Lease Obligation payments) accrued or capitalized during that same four-quarter period, whether or not paid.
; net_hedging_interest_payable: net amount payable under interest-related Hedging Agreements during that same four-quarter period, signed negative if there is a net amount receivable.

(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (net_worth Real)
    (net_income Real)
    (income_taxes Real)
    (noncash_provisions_writeoffs Real)
    (interest_on_indebtedness Real)
    (net_hedging_interest_payable Real)
    (lease_interest_factor_estimate Real)
  ) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; 5.03(a): Net Worth must not be less than $1,100,000,000

      ; 5.03(b): Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio = Cash Flow / Fixed Charges must not be less than 1.30
      ; Fixed Charges = interest_on_indebtedness + net_hedging_interest_payable + lease_interest_factor_estimate
      ; Cash Flow = net_income + income_taxes + noncash_provisions_writeoffs + Fixed Charges
      (>= (/ (+ net_income income_taxes noncash_provisions_writeoffs
                (+ interest_on_indebtedness net_hedging_interest_payable lease_interest_factor_estimate))
             (+ interest_on_indebtedness net_hedging_interest_payable lease_interest_factor_estimate))
          1.30))))

{
