  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; leverage_ratio: Leverage Ratio of the Company as of the observation date (atomic Real; ratio to 1.0).
; fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of the Company as of the observation date (atomic Real; ratio to 1.0).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Company.
; is_lease_acquisition_event: True iff at this observation the Company or a Subsidiary acquires the use or possession of Property under a lease or similar arrangement.
; aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect: After giving effect to the acquisition, aggregate fixed rentals and other consideration payable by the Company and its Subsidiaries under all such leases and similar arrangements during the fiscal year, in USD, excluding Capital Leases to the extent permitted by Section 8.7(c).
; is_clean_down_test_date: True iff the observation date is April 30, the end of the January 1 to April 30 window of a year, so the clean-down test for that year is evaluated.
; clean_down_best_period_peak: In USD, the minimum, over all 60-consecutive-day periods within January 1 to April 30 of the year, of the maximum daily aggregate principal amount of Revolving Loans, Swing Loans and L/C Obligations during that period.
; is_fy_2009: True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2009.
; is_fy_2010: True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2010.
; is_fy_2011: True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2011.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((leverage_ratio Real) (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (is_lease_acquisition_event Bool) (aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect Real) (is_clean_down_test_date Bool) (clean_down_best_period_peak Real) (is_fy_2009 Bool) (is_fy_2010 Bool) (is_fy_2011 Bool)) Bool
  (and
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= leverage_ratio 2.5))
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.25))
    (=> is_lease_acquisition_event (<= aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect 10000000.0))
    (=> (and is_clean_down_test_date is_fy_2009) (<= clean_down_best_period_peak 30000000.0))
    (=> (and is_clean_down_test_date is_fy_2010) (<= clean_down_best_period_peak 27500000.0))
    (=> (and is_clean_down_test_date is_fy_2011) (<= clean_down_best_period_peak 25000000.0))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Leverage Ratio of the Company as of the observation date (atomic Real; ratio to 1.0).", "source_quote": "permit the Leverage Ratio to be greater than 2.50 to 1.0"},
    {"name": "fixed_charge_coverage_ratio", "meaning": "Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of the Company as of the observation date (atomic Real; ratio to 1.0).", "source_quote": "permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.25 to 1.0"},
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Company.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of each fiscal quarter of the Company"},
    {"name": "is_lease_acquisition_event", "meaning": "True iff at this observation the Company or a Subsidiary acquires the use or possession of Property under a lease or similar arrangement.", "source_quote": "acquire the use or possession of any Property under a lease or similar arrangement"},
    {"name": "aggregate_lease_consideration_fy_after_effect", "meaning": "After giving effect to the acquisition, aggregate fixed rentals and other consideration payable by the Company and its Subsidiaries under all such leases and similar arrangements during the fiscal year, in USD, excluding Capital Leases to the extent permitted by Section 8.7(c).", "source_quote": "would exceed $10,000,000 during any fiscal year of the Company"},
    {"name": "is_clean_down_test_date", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is April 30, the end of the January 1 to April 30 window of a year, so the clean-down test for that year is evaluated.", "source_quote": "between January 1 and April 30 of each year"},
    {"name": "clean_down_best_period_peak", "meaning": "In USD, the minimum, over all 60-consecutive-day periods within January 1 to April 30 of the year, of the maximum daily aggregate principal amount of Revolving Loans, Swing Loans and L/C Obligations during that period.", "source_quote": "the aggregate principal amount of Revolving Loans, Swing Loans and L/C Obligations shall not exceed"},
    {"name": "is_fy_2009", "meaning": "True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2009.", "source_quote": "$30,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2009"},
    {"name": "is_fy_2010", "meaning": "True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2010.", "source_quote": "$27,500,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2010"},
    {"name": "is_fy_2011", "meaning": "True iff the observed fiscal year is the fiscal year ending December 31, 2011.", "source_quote": "$25,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2011"}
  ],
  "notes": "Leverage and FCCR are tested only at fiscal quarter-end, with a non-strict max of 2.50 and a non-strict min of 1.25. The operating lease limit applies at lease acquisition events and the cap is non-strict, since 'exceed' is prohibited. The clean-down covenant requires some 60-day period to comply, which is existential. A pointwise function cannot express this from single-day values, so the evaluator supplies the best-period peak (min over windows of max balance) at the April 30 test date. Compliance means that peak is at most the cap for the year. No cap is stated for years other than 2009 to 2011, so no clean-down constraint applies to other years. The waiver and 'so long as credit is available' conditions are treated as outside the observed inputs."

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; after_sept_30_2013: true iff the observation time is after September 30, 2013 (the date by which the post-closing deliveries are due).
; deadline_extended_in_effect: true iff the Administrative Agent has extended the period in its reasonable discretion and the extended period has not yet expired at the observation time.
; mortgage_third_party_consent_required: true iff third party consent would be required for the Mortgage, so no Mortgage will be granted by the Loan Party.
; mortgages_delivered: true iff the duly executed Mortgages (and related financing statements and instruments) have been delivered to the Administrative Agent under clause (a)(i).
; insurance_certificates_delivered: true iff certificates of insurance covering the Mortgaged Property naming the Administrative Agent have been delivered under clause (a)(ii).
; recording_payments_exempt: true iff the payments under clause (a)(iii) relate only to Recording Tax States and are not required by the last sentence of 9.19(a).
; recording_payments_delivered: true iff checks or wire transfers to the title insurance company for recording taxes, costs and fees have been delivered under clause (a)(iii).
; leasehold_interest_held: true iff a Borrower or Loan Party holds a leasehold interest in a Mortgaged Property.
; leases_delivered: true iff copies of all Leases and memoranda of leases for such leasehold Mortgaged Properties have been delivered under clause (a)(iv).
; opinion_requested: true iff the Administrative Agent, in its sole discretion, has requested a signed favorable opinion of counsel under clause (a)(v).
; opinion_delivered: true iff the signed favorable opinion of counsel requested under clause (a)(v) has been delivered.
; mortgage_recorded_in_recording_tax_state: true iff a Mortgage is recorded in a Recording Tax State at the observation time.
; total_leverage_ratio: Total Leverage Ratio for the last four fiscal quarters at the end of which financial statements under 9.4 were required to have been delivered.
; applicable_total_leverage_limit: the then applicable Total Leverage Ratio set forth in 11.1.
; notice_five_business_days_given: true iff the Administrative Agent provided notice of its intent to record such Mortgages at least five Business Days before the recording.
; sixty_days_after_notice_elapsed: true iff 60 days have elapsed after the notice-based recording date.
; recording_tax_state_mortgages_recorded: true iff the Mortgages in the Recording Tax State have been recorded.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (after_sept_30_2013 Bool)
    (deadline_extended_in_effect Bool)
    (mortgage_third_party_consent_required Bool)
    (mortgages_delivered Bool)
    (insurance_certificates_delivered Bool)
    (recording_payments_exempt Bool)
    (recording_payments_delivered Bool)
    (leasehold_interest_held Bool)
    (leases_delivered Bool)
    (opinion_requested Bool)
    (opinion_delivered Bool)
    (mortgage_recorded_in_recording_tax_state Bool)
    (total_leverage_ratio Real)
    (applicable_total_leverage_limit Real)
    (notice_five_business_days_given Bool)
    (sixty_days_after_notice_elapsed Bool)
    (recording_tax_state_mortgages_recorded Bool)) Bool
  (let ((leverage_trigger (> total_leverage_ratio (- applicable_total_leverage_limit 0.25))))
    (and
      ; Deliveries due on or prior to September 30, 2013, unless extended
      (=> (and after_sept_30_2013 (not deadline_extended_in_effect))

; sixty_days_after_notice_elapsed: true iff 60 days have elapsed after the notice-based recording date.
; recording_tax_state_mortgages_recorded: true iff the Mortgages in the Recording Tax State have been recorded.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (after_sept_30_2013 Bool)
    (deadline_extended_in_effect Bool)
    (mortgage_third_party_consent_required Bool)
    (mortgages_delivered Bool)
    (insurance_certificates_delivered Bool)
    (recording_payments_exempt Bool)
    (recording_payments_delivered Bool)
    (leasehold_interest_held Bool)
    (leases_delivered Bool)
    (opinion_requested Bool)
    (opinion_delivered Bool)
    (mortgage_recorded_in_recording_tax_state Bool)
    (total_leverage_ratio Real)
    (applicable_total_leverage_limit Real)
    (notice_five_business_days_given Bool)
    (sixty_days_after_notice_elapsed Bool)
    (recording_tax_state_mortgages_recorded Bool)) Bool

               (or (not leasehold_interest_held) leases_delivered)
               (or (not opinion_requested) opinion_delivered)))
      ; Recording in a Recording Tax State only if the leverage trigger and notice are satisfied
      (=> mortgage_recorded_in_recording_tax_state
          (and leverage_trigger notice_five_business_days_given))
      ; Once triggered and noticed, recording within 60 days
      (=> (and leverage_trigger notice_five_business_days_given sixty_days_after_notice_elapsed)
          recording_tax_state_mortgages_recorded))))

                            (pre_fifth_quarter_reached Bool)

                            (post_sep2015_reached Bool)
                            (post_mar2016_reached Bool)
                            (post_sep2016_reached Bool)) Bool

        (=> post_sep2015_reached (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))

candidate.notes: The clauses within each regime are cumulative, so each active clause is enforced separately. Pre-Acquisition clause (ii) uses 3.5 instead of 3.25 during a Qualified Acquisition window. Post-Acquisition clauses (iii) and (iv) use 4.0 during a Qualified Acquisition window; clauses (i) and (ii) have no such increase. Compliance is checked only at fiscal quarter ends, which are the dates the covenant tests. The temporal flags are evaluator-supplied calendar inputs. The Effective Date and Acquisition Closing Date are not given as dates, so they are represented through those flags.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; is_quarter_end_after_agreement_date: true iff the fiscal quarter ending at this observation ends after the date of the Agreement ("the date hereof").
; is_quarter_end_before_2003_12_31: true iff the fiscal quarter ending at this observation ends strictly prior to December 31, 2003.
; consolidated_ebit: Consolidated EBIT for the then most-recently ended four fiscal quarters, as of this observation.
; consolidated_interest_expense: Consolidated Interest Expense for the then most-recently ended four fiscal quarters, as of this observation.
; consolidated_indebtedness: Consolidated Indebtedness as of the end of the fiscal quarter at this observation.
; consolidated_ebitda: Consolidated EBITDA for the then most-recently ended four fiscal quarters, as of this observation.
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated Net Worth of the Borrower at this observation time.
; net_income_q4_2002: Consolidated Net Income earned in the fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2002 (may be negative; losses are floored at zero inside the formula).
; sum_fy_net_income_2003_onward_no_loss_deduction: Sum, over each fiscal year beginning with the fiscal year ending December 31, 2003, of that year's Consolidated Net Income earned, with any fiscal year that has a loss counted as zero (no deduction for losses).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_after_agreement_date Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_before_2003_12_31 Bool)
  (consolidated_ebit Real)
  (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
  (consolidated_indebtedness Real)
  (consolidated_ebitda Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (net_income_q4_2002 Real)
  (sum_fy_net_income_2003_onward_no_loss_deduction Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.19.1 Interest Coverage Ratio: EBIT / Interest Expense must not be less than 2.75 (quarters ending after the date hereof and before 12/31/2003) or 3.00 (quarters thereafter)

; ebitda: EBITDA for the four preceding fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; consolidated_net_worth: Consolidated Net Worth as of the last day of the fiscal quarter.
; cum_net_income: cumulative Consolidated Net Income since March 31, 2000 (signed value as supplied).
; cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions: cumulative cash distributions of earnings of Unrestricted Subsidiaries made to a Consolidated Company after March 31, 2000, to the extent previously excluded from Consolidated Net Income or Consolidated Net Loss by clause (i) of their definitions.
; cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds: cumulative Net Proceeds from any Equity Offering consummated after March 31, 2000.
; cum_stock_repurchases: cumulative actual stock repurchases made by the Borrower after March 31, 2000 and permitted by Section 8.13.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (fc_period_1 Bool)
  (fc_period_2 Bool)
  (fc_period_3 Bool)
  (consolidated_ebitr Real)
  (fixed_charges Real)
  (lev_period_1 Bool)
  (lev_period_2 Bool)
  (lev_period_3 Bool)
  (total_funded_debt Real)
  (ebitda Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (cum_net_income Real)
  (cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions Real)
  (cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds Real)
  (cum_stock_repurchases Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; (i) Fixed Charges: ratio must not be less than the minimum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_1) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 1.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_2) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 2.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_3) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 2.50))

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_2) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_3) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.25))
    ; (iii) Consolidated Net Worth must not be less than the required amount
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= consolidated_net_worth
            (- (+ 358860000.0
                  (* 0.5 cum_net_income)
                  (* 0.5 cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions)
                  cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds)
               cum_stock_repurchases)))
  )

; cum_stock_repurchases: cumulative actual stock repurchases made by the Borrower after March 31, 2000 and permitted by Section 8.13.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (fc_period_1 Bool)
  (fc_period_2 Bool)
  (fc_period_3 Bool)
  (consolidated_ebitr Real)
  (fixed_charges Real)
  (lev_period_1 Bool)
  (lev_period_2 Bool)
  (lev_period_3 Bool)
  (total_funded_debt Real)
  (ebitda Real)
  (consolidated_net_worth Real)
  (cum_net_income Real)
  (cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions Real)
  (cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds Real)
  (cum_stock_repurchases Real)
) Bool
  (and
    ; (i) Fixed Charges: ratio must not be less than the minimum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_1) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 1.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_2) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 2.00))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fc_period_3) (>= (/ consolidated_ebitr fixed_charges) 2.50))
    ; (ii) Total Funded Debt to EBITDA: ratio must not exceed the maximum
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_1) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_2) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.50))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_period_3) (<= (/ total_funded_debt ebitda) 3.25))
    ; (iii) Consolidated Net Worth must not be less than the required amount
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= consolidated_net_worth
            (- (+ 358860000.0
                  (* 0.5 cum_net_income)
                  (* 0.5 cum_unrestricted_sub_distributions)
                  cum_equity_offering_net_proceeds)
               cum_stock_repurchases)))
  )
)

candidate.notes: Three Section 8.1 tests are conjoined, each applicable at fiscal quarter end. Fixed Charges: ratio must be >= the minimum (not less than). Total Funded Debt to EBITDA: ratio must be <= the maximum (not exceed). Net worth: Consolidated Net Worth >= 358,860,000 + 50% cumulative net income + 50% Unrestricted Subsidiary distributions + 100% Equity Offering net proceeds - permitted repurchases. Period flags are supplied by the evaluator, with separate flags for the two ratio tests because their period boundaries differ. Ratios use division, so a zero denominator is reported as unresolved by the evaluator. The 'Maturity Date' and 'Closing Date' are used only through the supplied period flags. The 'since March 31, 2000' cumulative amounts are atomic inputs, since the source gives no update rules for them. Logic is QF_NRA because the ratios divide by variables.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; commitments_or_advances_outstanding: true iff any Advance remains unpaid or any Lender has any Commitment at the observation time
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is the end of a fiscal quarter
; hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth: HDFS consolidated shareholder's equity net of intangible assets, USD, per Agreement Accounting Principles
; preferred_stock: preferred stock component of Consolidated Equity, USD
; subordinated_indebtedness: Subordinated Indebtedness component of Consolidated Equity, USD
; consolidated_finco_debt: Indebtedness of HDFS and its Consolidated Subsidiaries per most recent consolidated balance sheet, excluding Subordinated Indebtedness and Subordinated Intercompany Indebtedness, USD
; ebitda_net_income: net income (or net loss) of Harley and its Consolidated Subsidiaries for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD (pro forma for acquisitions/dispositions)
; consolidated_interest_expense: Harley and Consolidated Subsidiaries interest expense, cash or non-cash, including capitalized interest, for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD
; income_taxes: taxes on or measured by income, including franchise taxes in lieu of income taxes, for the four-quarter period, USD
; depreciation_expense: depreciation expense for the four-quarter period, USD
; amortization_expense: amortization expense for the four-quarter period, USD
; nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses: non-recurring cash restructuring expenses incurred in the four-quarter period, before applying the cap, USD
; is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010: true iff the four-quarter period ends on or about December 31, 2010 (cap 150,000,000)
; is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010: true iff the four-quarter period ends at the end of a fiscal year after the one ending on or about December 31, 2010 (cap 50,000,000)
; other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges: other non-cash or extraordinary charges added back for the period, USD
; cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks: cash payments made during the period on non-cash charges previously added back and paid after the quarter incurred, USD (subtracted)
; is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010: true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, June 30 or September 30, 2010
; is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010: true iff the fiscal quarter ends December 31, 2010
; is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later: true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, 2011 or any later fiscal quarter end
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_or_advances_outstanding Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real)
  (preferred_stock Real)
  (subordinated_indebtedness Real)
  (consolidated_finco_debt Real)
  (ebitda_net_income Real)
  (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
  (income_taxes Real)
  (depreciation_expense Real)
  (amortization_expense Real)
  (nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses Real)
  (is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010 Bool)
  (other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges Real)
  (cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks Real)
  (is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and commitments_or_advances_outstanding is_fiscal_quarter_end)
    (and
      ; (B) minimum Consolidated Tangible Net Worth of HDFS
      (>= hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth 500000000.0)
      ; (C) Finco Leverage Ratio = Consolidated Finco Debt / Consolidated Equity must not exceed 10.00
      (<= (/ consolidated_finco_debt
             (+ hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth preferred_stock subordinated_indebtedness))
          10.0)
      ; (D) Interest Coverage Ratio = Consolidated EBITDA / Consolidated Interest Expense must not be below the minimum
      (=> (or is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later)
        (>= (/ (- (+ ebitda_net_income
                     consolidated_interest_expense
                     income_taxes
                     depreciation_expense
                     amortization_expense
                     (ite is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010
                          (ite (<= nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses 150000000.0)
                               nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses
                               150000000.0)
                          (ite is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010
                               (ite (<= nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses 50000000.0)
                                    nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses
                                    50000000.0)
                               nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses))
                     other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges)
                  cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks)
               consolidated_interest_expense)
            (ite is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 2.0
                 (ite is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 2.25 2.5)))))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "commitments_or_advances_outstanding", "meaning": "True iff any Advance remains unpaid or any Lender has any Commitment at the observation time.", "source_quote": "So long as any Advance shall remain unpaid or any Lender shall have any Commitment hereunder"},
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter.", "source_quote": "as of the end of any fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth", "meaning": "HDFS consolidated shareholder's equity net of intangible assets, USD, per Agreement Accounting Principles.", "source_quote": "its consolidated shareholder's equity net of intangible assets"},
    {"name": "preferred_stock", "meaning": "Preferred stock component of Consolidated Equity, USD.", "source_quote": "(ii) preferred stock"},
    {"name": "subordinated_indebtedness", "meaning": "Subordinated Indebtedness component of Consolidated Equity, USD.", "source_quote": "(iii) Subordinated Indebtedness"},
    {"name": "consolidated_finco_debt", "meaning": "Indebtedness of HDFS and its Consolidated Subsidiaries per the most recent consolidated balance sheet, excluding Subordinated Indebtedness and Subordinated Intercompany Indebtedness, USD.", "source_quote": "all Indebtedness of HDFS and its Consolidated Subsidiaries as reflected in the most recent Consolidated balance sheet of HDFS"},
    {"name": "ebitda_net_income", "meaning": "Net income (or net loss) of Harley and its Consolidated Subsidiaries for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD, with pro forma effect for acquisitions and dispositions.", "source_quote": "net income (or net loss) of Harley and its Consolidated Subsidiaries"},
    {"name": "consolidated_interest_expense", "meaning": "Interest expense of Harley and its Consolidated Subsidiaries, cash or non-cash, including capitalized interest, for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD. Used in the EBITDA add-back and as the Interest Coverage Ratio denominator.", "source_quote": "interest expense (whether cash or non-cash)"},
    {"name": "income_taxes", "meaning": "Taxes on or measured by income, including franchise taxes imposed in lieu of income taxes, for the four-quarter period, USD.", "source_quote": "taxes on or measured by income (including franchise taxes imposed in lieu of income taxes)"},
    {"name": "depreciation_expense", "meaning": "Depreciation expense for the four-quarter period, USD.", "source_quote": "depreciation expense"},

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; commitments_or_advances_outstanding: true iff any Advance remains unpaid or any Lender has any Commitment at the observation time
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is the end of a fiscal quarter
; hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth: HDFS consolidated shareholder's equity net of intangible assets, USD, per Agreement Accounting Principles
; preferred_stock: preferred stock component of Consolidated Equity, USD
; subordinated_indebtedness: Subordinated Indebtedness component of Consolidated Equity, USD
; consolidated_finco_debt: Indebtedness of HDFS and its Consolidated Subsidiaries per most recent consolidated balance sheet, excluding Subordinated Indebtedness and Subordinated Intercompany Indebtedness, USD
; ebitda_net_income: net income (or net loss) of Harley and its Consolidated Subsidiaries for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD (pro forma for acquisitions/dispositions)
; consolidated_interest_expense: Harley and Consolidated Subsidiaries interest expense, cash or non-cash, including capitalized interest, for the four fiscal quarters then ended, USD

; depreciation_expense: depreciation expense for the four-quarter period, USD
; amortization_expense: amortization expense for the four-quarter period, USD
; nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses: non-recurring cash restructuring expenses incurred in the four-quarter period, before applying the cap, USD
; is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010: true iff the four-quarter period ends on or about December 31, 2010 (cap 150,000,000)
; is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010: true iff the four-quarter period ends at the end of a fiscal year after the one ending on or about December 31, 2010 (cap 50,000,000)
; other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges: other non-cash or extraordinary charges added back for the period, USD
; cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks: cash payments made during the period on non-cash charges previously added back and paid after the quarter incurred, USD (subtracted)
; is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010: true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, June 30 or September 30, 2010
; is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010: true iff the fiscal quarter ends December 31, 2010
; is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later: true iff the fiscal quarter ends March 31, 2011 or any later fiscal quarter end
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (commitments_or_advances_outstanding Bool)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth Real)
  (preferred_stock Real)
  (subordinated_indebtedness Real)
  (consolidated_finco_debt Real)
  (ebitda_net_income Real)
  (consolidated_interest_expense Real)
  (income_taxes Real)
  (depreciation_expense Real)
  (amortization_expense Real)
  (nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses Real)
  (is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010 Bool)
  (other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges Real)
  (cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks Real)
  (is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 Bool)
  (is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and commitments_or_advances_outstanding is_fiscal_quarter_end)
    (and
      ; (B) minimum Consolidated Tangible Net Worth of HDFS
      (>= hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth 500000000.0)
      ; (C) Finco Leverage Ratio = Consolidated Finco Debt / Consolidated Equity must not exceed 10.00
      (<= (/ consolidated_finco_debt
             (+ hdfs_consolidated_tangible_net_worth preferred_stock subordinated_indebtedness))
          10.0)
      ; (D) Interest Coverage Ratio = Consolidated EBITDA / Consolidated Interest Expense must not be below the minimum
      (=> (or is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 is_quarter_end_mar_31_2011_or_later)
        (>= (/ (- (+ ebitda_net_income
                     consolidated_interest_expense
                     income_taxes
                     depreciation_expense
                     amortization_expense
                     (ite is_four_quarter_period_ending_dec_31_2010
                          (ite (<= nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses 150000000.0)
                               nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses
                               150000000.0)
                          (ite is_four_quarter_period_ending_fiscal_year_end_after_2010
                               (ite (<= nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses 50000000.0)
                                    nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses
                                    50000000.0)
                               nonrecurring_cash_restructuring_expenses))
                     other_noncash_or_extraordinary_charges)
                  cash_payments_on_prior_noncash_addbacks)
               consolidated_interest_expense)
            (ite is_quarter_end_mar_jun_sep_2010 2.0
                 (ite is_quarter_end_dec_31_2010 2.25 2.5)))))))

{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; covenant_in_effect: true at the observation time if any of the Notes remain unpaid or any Bank has any Commitment under the Agreement.
; total_funded_debt: the Borrower's Total Funded Debt at the observation time (as defined in the Agreement), in currency units.
; cash_flow: the Borrower's Cash Flow (as defined in the Agreement), in the same currency units as total_funded_debt, for the measurement period used in the Total Funded Debt to Cash Flow ratio.
; consolidated_net_worth: the Borrower's Consolidated Net Worth at the observation time (as defined in the Agreement), in the same currency units as total_funded_debt.
; is_fiscal_year_1996: true if the observation time falls in Fiscal Year 1996.
; is_fiscal_year_1997: true if the observation time falls in Fiscal Year 1997.
; is_fiscal_year_1998: true if the observation time falls in Fiscal Year 1998.
; is_quarter_1: true if the observation time falls in the 1st fiscal quarter.
; is_quarter_2: true if the observation time falls in the 2nd fiscal quarter.
; is_quarter_3: true if the observation time falls in the 3rd fiscal quarter.
; is_quarter_4: true if the observation time falls in the 4th fiscal quarter.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((covenant_in_effect Bool)
                            (total_funded_debt Real)
                            (cash_flow Real)
                            (consolidated_net_worth Real)
                            (is_fiscal_year_1996 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_year_1997 Bool)
                            (is_fiscal_year_1998 Bool)
                            (is_quarter_1 Bool)
                            (is_quarter_2 Bool)
                            (is_quarter_3 Bool)
                            (is_quarter_4 Bool)) Bool
  (=> covenant_in_effect
    (and
      ; (a) Total Funded Debt / Cash Flow <= 4.5
      (<= (/ total_funded_debt cash_flow) 4.5)
      ; (b) Total Funded Debt / (Total Funded Debt + Consolidated Net Worth) <= table limit for the period
      (=> (and is_fiscal_year_1996 is_quarter_1) (<= (/ total_funded_debt (+ total_funded_debt consolidated_net_worth)) 0.51))
      (=> (and is_fiscal_year_1996 is_quarter_2) (<= (/ total_funded_debt (+ total_funded_debt consolidated_net_worth)) 0.49))
      (=> (and is_fiscal_year_1996 is_quarter_3) (<= (/ total_funded_debt (+ total_funded_debt consolidated_net_worth)) 0.47))

teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the end of a Fiscal Quarter of the Borrower (the test date for clauses (a)-(e) and (g)).
; consolidated_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a plain number (0.60 means 0.60 to 1.00).
; consolidated_secured_indebtedness_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Secured Indebtedness Leverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a fraction (30.0% = 0.30).
; consolidated_recourse_secured_leverage_ratio: Consolidated Recourse Secured Leverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).
; consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio: Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a plain number (1.50 means 1.50 to 1.00).
; tangible_net_worth: Tangible Net Worth as of the Fiscal Quarter end, in US dollars.
; cumulative_equity_issuance_net_cash_proceeds_after_2014_06_30: cumulative sum of all Net Cash Proceeds from any Equity Issuance after June 30, 2014, in US dollars, as of the observation.
; is_four_quarter_period_test: true iff the observation is a test of a four (4) calendar quarter period of the Consolidated Parties for clause (f).
; restricted_payments_to_non_credit_party_holders_four_quarters: Restricted Payments made by the Consolidated Parties to holders of their Capital Stock during the four-quarter period, in US dollars, excluding payments to holders that are Credit Parties.
; ffo_distribution_allowance: the FFO Distribution Allowance for the same four-quarter period, in US dollars.
; restricted_payments_made_while_default_exists_or_would_result: amount of Restricted Payments by the Consolidated Parties to holders of their Capital Stock (excluding holders that are Credit Parties) made at times when a Default or Event of Default then existed or would result from the payment, in US dollars.
; unencumbered_pool_property_count: number of Unencumbered Pool Properties in the Borrowing Base as of the Fiscal Quarter end.
; aggregate_unencumbered_pool_property_value_amount: Aggregate Unencumbered Pool Property Value Amount of the Unencumbered Pool Properties in the Borrowing Base as of the Fiscal Quarter end, in US dollars.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (consolidated_leverage_ratio Real)
    (consolidated_secured_indebtedness_leverage_ratio Real)
    (consolidated_recourse_secured_leverage_ratio Real)
    (consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cumulative_equity_issuance_net_cash_proceeds_after_2014_06_30 Real)
    (is_four_quarter_period_test Bool)
    (restricted_payments_to_non_credit_party_holders_four_quarters Real)
    (ffo_distribution_allowance Real)
    (restricted_payments_made_while_default_exists_or_would_result Real)
    (unencumbered_pool_property_count Real)
    (aggregate_unencumbered_pool_property_value_amount Real)
  ) Bool
  (and
    ; (a) leverage ratio must not be greater than 0.60
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= consolidated_leverage_ratio 0.6))
    ; (b) secured leverage must not be greater than 30.0%
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= consolidated_secured_indebtedness_leverage_ratio 0.3))
    ; (c) recourse secured leverage must not be greater than 10.0%
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= consolidated_recourse_secured_leverage_ratio 0.1))
    ; (d) fixed charge coverage must not be less than 1.50
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.5))
    ; (e) Tangible Net Worth must not be less than $315,323,000 + 75% of cumulative Net Cash Proceeds
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (>= tangible_net_worth
            (+ 315323000.0 (* 0.75 cumulative_equity_issuance_net_cash_proceeds_after_2014_06_30))))
    ; (f) four-quarter Restricted Payments must not exceed the FFO Distribution Allowance
    (=> is_four_quarter_period_test
        (<= restricted_payments_to_non_credit_party_holders_four_quarters ffo_distribution_allowance))
    ; (f) no Restricted Payments while a Default or Event of Default exists or would result
    (<= restricted_payments_made_while_default_exists_or_would_result 0.0)
    ; (g) must not have fewer than 15 properties with aggregate value of at least $275,000,000
    (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
        (and (>= unencumbered_pool_property_count 15.0)
             (>= aggregate_unencumbered_pool_property_value_amount 275000000.0)))
  )
)",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the end of a Fiscal Quarter of the Borrower (the test date for clauses (a)-(e) and (g)).", "source_quote": "tested as of the end of any Fiscal Quarter of the Borrower"},
    {"name": "consolidated_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a plain number (0.60 means 0.60 to 1.00).", "source_quote": "Permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio, tested as of the end of any Fiscal Quarter of the Borrower, to be greater than 0.60 to 1.00."},
    {"name": "consolidated_secured_indebtedness_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Consolidated Secured Indebtedness Leverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a fraction (30.0% = 0.30).", "source_quote": "to be greater than 30.0%"},
    {"name": "consolidated_recourse_secured_leverage_ratio", "meaning": "Consolidated Recourse Secured Leverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a fraction (10.0% = 0.10).", "source_quote": "to be greater than 10.0%"},
    {"name": "consolidated_fixed_charge_coverage_ratio", "meaning": "Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio as of the Fiscal Quarter end, as a plain number (1.50 means 1.50 to 1.00).", "source_quote": "to be less than 1.50 to 1.00"},
    {"name": "tangible_net_worth", "meaning": "Tangible Net Worth as of the Fiscal Quarter end, in US dollars.", "source_quote": "Permit Tangible Net Worth, tested as of the end of any Fiscal Quarter of the Borrower, to be less than"},
    {"name": "cumulative_equity_issuance_net_cash_proceeds_after_2014_06_30", "meaning": "Cumulative sum of all Net Cash Proceeds from any Equity Issuance after June 30, 2014, in US dollars, as of the observation.", "source_quote": "the sum of all Net Cash Proceeds from any Equity Issuance after June 30, 2014"},
    {"name": "is_four_quarter_period_test", "meaning": "True iff the observation is a test of a four (4) calendar quarter period of the Consolidated Parties for clause (f).", "source_quote": "for any given four (4) calendar quarter period of the Consolidated Parties"},
    {"name": "restricted_payments_to_non_credit_party_holders_four_quarters", "meaning": "Restricted Payments made by the Consolidated Parties to holders of their Capital Stock during the four-quarter period, in US dollars, excluding payments to holders that are Credit Parties.", "source_quote": "the amount of Restricted Payments made by the Consolidated Parties to the holders of their Capital Stock (excluding any Restricted Payments to such holders of Capital Stock which are Credit Parties) during such period"},
    {"name": "ffo_distribution_allowance", "meaning": "The FFO Distribution Allowance for the same four-quarter period, in US dollars.", "source_quote": "to exceed the FFO Distribution Allowance for such period"},
    {"name": "restricted_payments_made_while_default_exists_or_would_result", "meaning": "Amount of Restricted Payments by the Consolidated Parties to holders of their Capital Stock (excluding holders that are Credit Parties) made at times when a Default or Event of Default then existed or would result from the payment, in US dollars.", "source_quote": "in no event shall the Consolidated Parties make any Restricted Payments to the holders of their Capital Stock (other than any Restricted Payments to such holders of Capital Stock which are also Credit Parties) if or to the extent that a Default or Event of Default then exists or would result from same"},
    {"name": "unencumbered_pool_property_count", "meaning": "Number of Unencumbered Pool Properties in the Borrowing Base as of the Fiscal Quarter end.", "source_quote": "fewer than fifteen (15) Unencumbered Pool Properties"},
    {"name": "aggregate_unencumbered_pool_property_value_amount", "meaning": "Aggregate Unencumbered Pool Property Value Amount of the Unencumbered Pool Properties in the Borrowing Base as of the Fiscal Quarter end, in US dollars.", "source_quote": "Aggregate Unencumbered Pool Property Value Amount greater than or equal to $275,000,000.00"}
  ],
  "notes": "All of Section 8.8(a)-(g) is encoded. Ratio thresholds are inclusive of the limit: 'greater than' is compliant when <=, and 'less than' is compliant when >=. Percentages are supplied as fractions. Clause (e) uses 315,323,000 + 0.75 x cumulative Net Cash Proceeds. Clause (g) is read as requiring at least 15 properties and aggregate value of at least $275,000,000. FFO Distribution Allowance is an atomic input because its definition is not supplied. The clause (f) proviso permits intercompany payments to the Borrower and Parent, who are Credit Parties and so already excluded from the capped amount. It is therefore not modeled as a separate exemption. The default sentence is applied pointwise through the input amount of payments made while a Default or Event of Default existed or would result, which must be zero. The 'until the Termination Date' temporal scope is handled by the evaluator's choice of observations."
}

issues: The parameter restricted_payments_made_while_default_exists_or_would_result has no measurement period. It does not say whether the amount is cumulative, covers the four-quarter window, or covers only the interval since the previous observation. If it is cumulative, a single past breach would make every later observation noncompliant. If it is per-interval, the formula is correct. The comment does not settle this, so the meaning is underspecified and the faithfulness of the Default-based Restricted Payments prohibition in clause (f) cannot be established.

Clause (f)'s proviso, which permits upstream Restricted Payments for REIT status or tax avoidance, is not modeled explicitly. The candidate treats the FFO cap as applying strictly to payments to non-Credit-Party holders, but the comments do not state how REIT-maintenance distributions by the Parent are treated against the cap. The source is ambiguous on this point, and the candidate does not address it.
judge.reason: Clauses (a)-(e) and (g) are encoded correctly: the thresholds and strictness are right, percentages are converted to fractions, and the 75% cumulative equity-proceeds term is included. The four-quarter FFO cap is also reasonable. However, the second clause (f) input, the Restricted Payments made while a Default exists or would result, lacks a precise time scope. That makes the Default-based prohibition ambiguous: it could be permanently violated by one past payment, or tested only per observation interval. Because underspecified parameter meanings cannot establish a faithful formalization, the candidate is not accepted.

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_month_end: true iff the observation is as of the end of a fiscal month of Holdings.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation is as of the end of a fiscal quarter of Holdings.
; consolidated_total_debt: Consolidated Total Debt as of the observation date, including any outstanding amounts under Hybrid Securities, before any hybrid exclusion.
; total_capitalization: Total Capitalization as of the observation date.
; hybrid_securities_in_debt: outstanding amount of Hybrid Securities included in Consolidated Total Debt as of the observation date.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_fiscal_month_end Bool) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (consolidated_total_debt Real) (total_capitalization Real) (hybrid_securities_in_debt Real)) Bool
  (let ((max_hybrid_exclusion (ite (<= hybrid_securities_in_debt (* 0.15 total_capitalization)) hybrid_securities_in_debt (* 0.15 total_capitalization))))
    (=> (or is_fiscal_month_end is_fiscal_quarter_end)
        (<= (/ (- consolidated_total_debt max_hybrid_exclusion) total_capitalization) 0.70))))

candidate.notes: The covenant is tested only at fiscal month-ends and fiscal quarter-ends, via the two calendar flags. The ratio must not be greater than 0.70:1.00, so the body requires <= 0.70. ; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter.
; commitments_not_terminated: true iff the Commitments have not yet expired or terminated.
; loans_or_fees_unpaid: true iff the principal of or interest on any Loan, or any fees payable under the agreement, have not been paid in full.
; letters_of_credit_outstanding: true iff any Letter of Credit has not yet expired or terminated.
; lc_disbursements_unreimbursed: true iff any LC Disbursement has not yet been reimbursed.
; in_period_effective_date_through_2008: true iff the observation date falls from the Effective Date through December 31, 2008.
; in_period_2009: true iff the observation date falls from January 1, 2009 through December 31, 2009.
; in_period_2010: true iff the observation date falls from January 1, 2010 through December 31, 2010.
; in_period_after_2010: true iff the observation date falls after December 31, 2010 (the 'thereafter' period).
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (leverage_ratio Real)
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (commitments_not_terminated Bool)
  (loans_or_fees_unpaid Bool)
  (letters_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
  (lc_disbursements_unreimbursed Bool)
  (in_period_effective_date_through_2008 Bool)
  (in_period_2009 Bool)
  (in_period_2010 Bool)
  (in_period_after_2010 Bool)
) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end
           (or commitments_not_terminated
               loans_or_fees_unpaid
               letters_of_credit_outstanding
               lc_disbursements_unreimbursed))
      (and (=> in_period_effective_date_through_2008 (<= leverage_ratio 2.0))
           (=> in_period_2009 (<= leverage_ratio 1.5))
           (=> in_period_2010 (<= leverage_ratio 1.25))
           (=> in_period_after_2010 (<= leverage_ratio 1.0)))))

issues: Scope is incomplete: the covenant has many negative covenants in Section 5.04 (liens (a), fundamental changes (b), plan terminations (d), employee benefit costs (e)), but only the financial covenants (c) are formalized, with no representation of the omitted clauses.

The leverage ratio is written as debt/capitalization <= 0.45 using Real division, which is acceptable under the unresolved-on-zero policy; however, the interest coverage test divides by interest expense, which is also acceptable. These are not the problem.

The majority_lenders_consent parameter is described as consent 'to otherwise permit non-compliance with the financial covenants', which narrows the source's consent (applies to the whole Section 5.04) and is used as a guard that disables the covenant; this is acceptable in principle but the description limits scope inconsistently with the source.

The termination condition is a conjunction of three flags (Advances paid, Commitments terminated, Guarantied Obligations paid). The source says 'unless and until all ... shall have been ...' so this is consistent, but the Advances flag description 'all of the Advances' is fine; the problem remains the missing clauses.

Omitted obligations (a), (b), (d), (e) are not formalized as inputs such as flags for non-permitted Liens, prohibited fundamental changes without conditions, PBGC liability above $15,000,000, Insufficiency/Withdrawal Liability above $25,000,000, or prohibited retiree benefit plans. These are event-state inputs that could have been supplied, so abstention is not justified.

  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) ; true iff the observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter
  (fccr_period_dec2005_to_mar2008 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends within December 31, 2005 through March 31, 2008 (min 1.25)

  (lev_qtr_jun2006_sep2007 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is June 30, 2006 through September 30, 2007 (max 7.25)

  (lev_qtr_dec2010_sep2011 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2010 through September 30, 2011 (max 6.25)
  (lev_qtr_dec2011_onward Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2011 or later (max 6.00)
  (sen_qtr_dec2005_mar2006 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2005 or March 31, 2006 (max 7.00)
  (sen_qtr_jun2006 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is June 30, 2006 (max 6.75)

  (capex_fy_row_23_3m Bool) ; true iff the current Fiscal Year is the one whose table amount is $23,300,000
  (capex_fy_row_21_6m Bool) ; true iff the current Fiscal Year is the one whose table amount is $21,600,000
  (capex_fy_row_2007_onward Bool) ; true iff the current Fiscal Year is 2007 or later (table amount $19,200,000)

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fccr_period_dec2005_to_mar2008) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fccr_period_jun2008_to_mar2010) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.35))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end fccr_period_jun2010_onward) (>= fixed_charge_coverage_ratio 1.5))

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_jun2006_sep2007) (<= leverage_ratio 7.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2007_sep2008) (<= leverage_ratio 7.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2008_sep2009) (<= leverage_ratio 6.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2009_sep2010) (<= leverage_ratio 6.5))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2010_sep2011) (<= leverage_ratio 6.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2011_onward) (<= leverage_ratio 6.0))
    ; 6.8(c) maximum Senior Leverage Ratio at fiscal quarter ends
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2005_mar2006) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 7.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_jun2006) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 6.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_sep2006) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 6.5))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2006_sep2007) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 6.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2007_sep2008) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 5.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2008_sep2009) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 5.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2009_onward) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 5.0))
    ; 6.8(d) Fiscal Year capex cap = table amount + carryover increase (excess of previous adjusted amount over previous actual, if any, capped at 50% of previous adjusted amount)
    (=> (or capex_fy_row_23_3m capex_fy_row_21_6m capex_fy_row_2007_onward)

  (sen_qtr_dec2005_mar2006 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2005 or March 31, 2006 (max 7.00)

  (sen_qtr_dec2006_sep2007 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2006 through September 30, 2007 (max 6.25)
  (sen_qtr_dec2007_sep2008 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2007 through September 30, 2008 (max 5.75)
  (sen_qtr_dec2008_sep2009 Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2008 through September 30, 2009 (max 5.25)
  (sen_qtr_dec2009_onward Bool) ; true iff the Fiscal Quarter ended is December 31, 2009 or later (max 5.00)
  (fytd_consolidated_capex Real) ; aggregate Consolidated Capital Expenditures of Company and Subsidiaries made or incurred in the current Fiscal Year through the observation date, in dollars
  (capex_fy_row_23_3m Bool) ; true iff the current Fiscal Year is the one whose table amount is $23,300,000
  (capex_fy_row_21_6m Bool) ; true iff the current Fiscal Year is the one whose table amount is $21,600,000
  (capex_fy_row_2007_onward Bool) ; true iff the current Fiscal Year is 2007 or later (table amount $19,200,000)

    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_jun2006_sep2007) (<= leverage_ratio 7.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2007_sep2008) (<= leverage_ratio 7.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2008_sep2009) (<= leverage_ratio 6.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2009_sep2010) (<= leverage_ratio 6.5))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2010_sep2011) (<= leverage_ratio 6.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end lev_qtr_dec2011_onward) (<= leverage_ratio 6.0))
    ; 6.8(c) maximum Senior Leverage Ratio at fiscal quarter ends
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2005_mar2006) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 7.0))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_jun2006) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 6.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_sep2006) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 6.5))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2006_sep2007) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 6.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2007_sep2008) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 5.75))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2008_sep2009) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 5.25))
    (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end sen_qtr_dec2009_onward) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 5.0))
    ; 6.8(d) Fiscal Year capex cap = table amount + carryover increase (excess of previous adjusted amount over previous actual, if any, capped at 50% of previous adjusted amount)
    (=> (or capex_fy_row_23_3m capex_fy_row_21_6m capex_fy_row_2007_onward)
        (<= fytd_consolidated_capex
            (+ (ite capex_fy_row_23_3m 23300000.0 (ite capex_fy_row_21_6m 21600000.0 19200000.0))
               (ite has_previous_fy_amount

                         0.0

                              (- prev_fy_adjusted_capex_limit prev_fy_actual_capex)
                              (* 0.5 prev_fy_adjusted_capex_limit)))
                    0.0))))
  )
)

; agreement_period_active: true iff the observation is on or after the date of the Agreement, the Agreement is in effect, and the Commitments have not yet terminated.
; in_first_four_quarters: true iff the observation falls within the first four (4) quarters after the Execution Date.
; after_first_four_quarters: true iff the observation falls after that first four-quarter period ("at any time thereafter").
; ebitda_ttm: EBITDA for the preceding four quarters, rolling four-quarter basis, in dollars.
; taxes_paid_ttm: taxes actually paid during those same four quarters, in dollars.
; current_ltd_next_4q: current portion of long-term debt for the upcoming four quarters, in dollars.
; interest_expense_ttm: interest expense for the preceding four quarters, rolling four-quarter basis, in dollars.
; cash_capex_ttm: uncapped cash Consolidated Capital Expenditures for the preceding four quarters, rolling basis, in dollars. The $2,000,000 cap is applied in the formula.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (agreement_period_active Bool)
  (in_first_four_quarters Bool)
  (after_first_four_quarters Bool)
  (ebitda_ttm Real)
  (taxes_paid_ttm Real)
  (current_ltd_next_4q Real)
  (interest_expense_ttm Real)
  (cash_capex_ttm Real)) Bool
  (=> agreement_period_active
    (and
      (=> in_first_four_quarters
        (>= (/ (- ebitda_ttm taxes_paid_ttm)
               (+ current_ltd_next_4q
                  interest_expense_ttm
                  (ite (<= cash_capex_ttm 2000000.0) cash_capex_ttm 2000000.0)))
            1.0))
      (=> after_first_four_quarters
        (>= (/ (- ebitda_ttm taxes_paid_ttm)
               (+ current_ltd_next_4q
                  interest_expense_ttm
                  (ite (<= cash_capex_ttm 2000000.0) cash_capex_ttm 2000000.0)))
            2.0)))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; Section 7.3 Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, evaluated pointwise at an observation time.
; All period amounts below cover the rolling 4 fiscal quarters ending at the observation date, for Borrower and its Subsidiaries.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) ; observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter
  (obligation_outstanding Bool) ; any Obligation is outstanding at the observation time
  (bank_commitment_exists Bool) ; the Bank has any commitment under the Agreement at the observation time
  (net_income Real) ; Borrower's GAAP net income for the rolling 4 quarters, after all expenses, cash taxes paid and other proper charges
  (noncash_addbacks Real) ; Sum of depreciation, non-cash accretion of closure/post-closure obligations and amortization, to the extent deducted in computing net income, over the rolling 4 quarters
  (cash_capital_contributions Real) ; Cash capital contributions to Borrower during the rolling 4 quarters
  (sub_debt_increase Real) ; Increase, if any, in Borrower's Subordinated Debt during the rolling 4 quarters (0 if none)
  (unfunded_capex Real) ; All unfunded capital expenditures during the rolling 4 quarters
  (sub_debt_decrease Real) ; Decrease, if any, in Borrower's Subordinated Debt during the rolling 4 quarters (0 if none)
  (fixed_charges Real) ; Principal payments owing to third parties for money borrowed, including capitalized leases, paid or scheduled to be paid during the rolling 4 quarters, including scheduled reductions in the Reducing Revolving Commitment Amount
  ) Bool
  (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end (or obligation_outstanding bank_commitment_exists))
      (>= (/ (- (- (+ (+ (+ net_income noncash_addbacks) cash_capital_contributions) sub_debt_increase) unfunded_capex) sub_debt_decrease)
             fixed_charges)
          1.5)))

    (quarter_end_on_or_after_2005_06_30 Bool)
    (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real)
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (lev_tier_3_25 Bool)
    (lev_tier_3_00 Bool)
    (lev_tier_2_75 Bool)
    (lev_tier_2_50 Bool)
    (lev_tier_2_25 Bool)
    (fiscal_year_2005_or_later Bool)
    (capex_current_fy Real)
    (prior_fy_is_2005_or_later Bool)
    (capex_prior_fy Real)
  ) Bool

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Company, and so the last day of a period of four consecutive fiscal quarters.
; is_secured_phase_through_2013: true iff the observation falls from the Agreement Date through the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2013.
; is_secured_phase_from_2014: true iff the observation is for a fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2014 or thereafter.
; total_indebtedness: Total Indebtedness as at the observation date.
; total_asset_value: Total Asset Value as at the observation date, before the Section 10.13(j) pro forma adjustment.
; acquired_book_value: Undepreciated GAAP book value (after any impairments) of Acquisition Properties acquired (or to be acquired with any borrowing) by the Borrower or its Subsidiaries since the last day of the prior fiscal quarter. Use 0 if none.
; secured_indebtedness: Secured Indebtedness as at the observation date.
; total_ebitda: Total EBITDA for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; total_fixed_charges: Total Fixed Charges for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
; tangible_net_worth: Tangible Net Worth at the observation time.
; equity_net_cash_proceeds: Net Cash Proceeds from issuances of Equity Interests by the Borrower or the Company after December 31, 2011, cumulative through the observation time.
; unsecured_indebtedness: Unsecured Indebtedness as at the observation date.
; unencumbered_asset_value: Unencumbered Asset Value as at the observation date, before the Section 10.13(j) pro forma adjustment.
; sold_asset_value: Actual value of any assets sold by the Borrower or its Subsidiaries since the last day of the prior fiscal quarter. It is excluded from Unencumbered Asset Value. Use 0 if none.
; unencumbered_noi: Unencumbered NOI for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date, before the pro forma adjustment.
; sold_noi: Actual NOI for the relevant period of any assets sold by the Borrower or its Subsidiaries since the last day of the prior fiscal quarter. It is excluded from Unencumbered NOI. Use 0 if none.
; projected_acquired_noi: Projected NOI for the next four quarters, based on the Borrower's good-faith projections, for assets acquired (or to be acquired with any Borrowing) since the last day of the prior fiscal quarter. Use 0 if none.
; unsecured_interest_expense: Unsecured Interest Expense for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (is_secured_phase_through_2013 Bool)
    (is_secured_phase_from_2014 Bool)
    (total_indebtedness Real)
    (total_asset_value Real)
    (acquired_book_value Real)
    (secured_indebtedness Real)
    (total_ebitda Real)
    (total_fixed_charges Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (equity_net_cash_proceeds Real)
    (unsecured_indebtedness Real)
    (unencumbered_asset_value Real)
    (sold_asset_value Real)
    (unencumbered_noi Real)
    (sold_noi Real)
    (projected_acquired_noi Real)
    (unsecured_interest_expense Real)) Bool
  (let ((tav_adj (+ total_asset_value acquired_book_value))
        (uav_adj (+ (- unencumbered_asset_value sold_asset_value) acquired_book_value))
        (unoi_adj (+ (- unencumbered_noi sold_noi) projected_acquired_noi)))
    (and
      ; (a) Total Leverage Ratio must not exceed 60%
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= (/ total_indebtedness tav_adj) 0.6))
      ; (b) Secured Leverage Ratio: 40% through Dec 31, 2013; 30% from Mar 31, 2014
      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_secured_phase_through_2013)
          (<= (/ secured_indebtedness tav_adj) 0.4))
      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_secured_phase_from_2014)
          (<= (/ secured_indebtedness tav_adj) 0.3))
      ; (d) Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio must not be less than 1.65 to 1.0
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= (/ total_ebitda total_fixed_charges) 1.65))
      ; (e) Tangible Net Worth must not be less than the minimum
      (>= tangible_net_worth (+ 1167787200.0 (* 0.5 equity_net_cash_proceeds)))
      ; (f) Unencumbered Leverage Ratio must not exceed 60%
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (<= (/ unsecured_indebtedness uav_adj) 0.6))
      ; (g) Unencumbered Coverage Ratio must not be less than 1.75 to 1.0
      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= (/ unoi_adj unsecured_interest_expense) 1.75)))))",

    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter of the Company, and so the last day of a period of four consecutive fiscal quarters.", "source_quote": "as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of the Company"},

    {"name": "total_indebtedness", "meaning": "Total Indebtedness as at the observation date.", "source_quote": "the ratio of Total Indebtedness to Total Asset Value"},

    {"name": "acquired_book_value", "meaning": "Undepreciated GAAP book value (after impairments) of Acquisition Properties acquired or to be acquired since the last day of the prior fiscal quarter. Use 0 if none.", "source_quote": "the undepreciated GAAP book value (after any impairments) of any Acquisition Properties acquired"},
    {"name": "secured_indebtedness", "meaning": "Secured Indebtedness as at the observation date.", "source_quote": "the ratio of Secured Indebtedness to Total Asset Value"},
    {"name": "total_ebitda", "meaning": "Total EBITDA for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "the ratio of Total EBITDA to Total Fixed Charges"},
    {"name": "total_fixed_charges", "meaning": "Total Fixed Charges for the four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date.", "source_quote": "the ratio of Total EBITDA to Total Fixed Charges"},
    {"name": "tangible_net_worth", "meaning": "Tangible Net Worth at the observation time.", "source_quote": "Permit Tangible Net Worth to be less than"},

; unsecured_indebtedness: Unsecured Indebtedness as at the observation date.
; unencumbered_asset_value: Unencumbered Asset Value as at the observation date, before the Section 10.13(j) pro forma adjustment.

; unencumbered_noi: Unencumbered NOI for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the observation date, before the pro forma adjustment.

(define-fun covenant_holds (

    (is_secured_phase_through_2013 Bool)
    (is_secured_phase_from_2014 Bool)
    (total_indebtedness Real)

    (acquired_book_value Real)
    (secured_indebtedness Real)
    (total_ebitda Real)
    (total_fixed_charges Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (equity_net_cash_proceeds Real)
    (unsecured_indebtedness Real)
    (unencumbered_asset_value Real)
    (sold_asset_value Real)
    (unencumbered_noi Real)
    (sold_noi Real)
    (projected_acquired_noi Real)
    (unsecured_interest_expense Real)) Bool

        (uav_adj (+ (- unencumbered_asset_value sold_asset_value) acquired_book_value))
        (unoi_adj (+ (- unencumbered_noi sold_noi) projected_acquired_noi)))

      (=> (and is_fiscal_quarter_end is_secured_phase_from_2014)

      (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end (>= (/ unoi_adj unsecured_interest_expense) 1.75)))))

; is_on_or_after_effective_date: true if the observation date is on or after the Effective Date.
; is_commitment_termination_date_occurred: true if the Commitment Termination Date has occurred as of the observation.
; is_payment_in_full_made: true if the Notes, the Commitment Fee and all other sums then due and payable under the Loan Documents have been paid in full as of the observation.
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true if the observation date is the end of a fiscal quarter of the Borrower.
; interest_coverage_ratio: the Borrower's Interest Coverage Ratio at the observation, expressed as a number X meaning X:1.0.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((is_on_or_after_effective_date Bool) (is_commitment_termination_date_occurred Bool) (is_payment_in_full_made Bool) (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool) (interest_coverage_ratio Real)) Bool
  (=> (and is_on_or_after_effective_date
           (not (and is_commitment_termination_date_occurred is_payment_in_full_made))
           is_fiscal_quarter_end)
      (>= interest_coverage_ratio 2.0)))

candidate.notes: The covenant applies on and after the Effective Date until the later of the Commitment Termination Date and payment in full. It is therefore in force while at least one of those two events has not yet occurred, which the formula encodes as not (both occurred). The test is only required at fiscal quarter end. The threshold is non-strict (>= 2.0), matching 'not less than'. The ratio is atomic, so the formula contains no division.

A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; leverage_ratio: Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the Fiscal Quarter being observed (atomic Real; definition not supplied).
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a Fiscal Quarter.
; quarter_on_or_after_1996_09_30: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ending on the observation date is the Fiscal Quarter ending September 30, 1996 or a later one.
; quarter_in_period_closing_to_1997_12_31: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends within the period from the Closing Date through December 31, 1997.
; quarter_in_period_1998: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends within the period from January 31, 1998 through December 31, 1998.
; quarter_after_1998: true iff the Fiscal Quarter ends after December 31, 1998 ("Each Fiscal Quarter thereafter").
; advance_unpaid: true iff any Advance remains unpaid at the observation.
; letter_of_credit_outstanding: true iff any Letter of Credit remains outstanding at the observation.
; other_obligation_unpaid: true iff any other Obligation remains unpaid at the observation.
; commitment_in_force: true iff any portion of the Commitment remains in force at the observation.
; consent_obtained: true iff the Administrative Agent, with the required Bank approval (Requisite Banks, or all Banks if required by Section 11.2), has consented otherwise to the Leverage Ratio breach.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (leverage_ratio Real)
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (quarter_on_or_after_1996_09_30 Bool)
    (quarter_in_period_closing_to_1997_12_31 Bool)
    (quarter_in_period_1998 Bool)
    (quarter_after_1998 Bool)
    (advance_unpaid Bool)
    (letter_of_credit_outstanding Bool)
    (other_obligation_unpaid Bool)
    (commitment_in_force Bool)
    (consent_obtained Bool)) Bool

                      (not consent_obtained))))
    (and (=> (and applies quarter_in_period_closing_to_1997_12_31) (<= leverage_ratio 3.0))
         (=> (and applies quarter_in_period_1998) (<= leverage_ratio 3.8))

    {"name": "quarter_in_period_1998", "meaning": "True iff the Fiscal Quarter ends within the period from January 31, 1998 through December 31, 1998.", "source_quote": "January 31, 1998 through December 31, 1998"},
    {"name": "quarter_after_1998", "meaning": "True iff the Fiscal Quarter ends after December 31, 1998, i.e. is a Fiscal Quarter thereafter.", "source_quote": "Each Fiscal Quarter thereafter"},
    {"name": "advance_unpaid", "meaning": "True iff any Advance remains unpaid at the observation.", "source_quote": "any Advance remains unpaid"},
    {"name": "letter_of_credit_outstanding", "meaning": "True iff any Letter of Credit remains outstanding at the observation.", "source_quote": "any Letter of Credit remains outstanding"},
    {"name": "other_obligation_unpaid", "meaning": "True iff any other Obligation remains unpaid at the observation.", "source_quote": "any other Obligation remains unpaid"},
    {"name": "commitment_in_force", "meaning": "True iff any portion of the Commitment remains in force at the observation.", "source_quote": "any portion of the Commitment remains in force"},
    {"name": "consent_obtained", "meaning": "True iff the Administrative Agent, with the required Bank approval (Requisite Banks, or all Banks if required by Section 11.2), has consented otherwise to the Leverage Ratio breach.", "source_quote": "unless the Administrative Agent (with the written approval of the Requisite Banks or, if required by Section 11.2, of all of the Banks) otherwise consents"}
  ],

The maximum Leverage Ratio is 3.00 through December 31, 1997, 3.80 for 1998, and 3.00 thereafter, with 'greater than' prohibited so the test is <=. teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (obligations_outstanding_or_commitment Bool) ; True if any principal of or interest on any Loan or any other Obligation (whether or not due) remains unpaid, or any Lender has any Commitment
  (required_lenders_written_consent Bool) ; True if the Required Lenders have otherwise consented in writing to the departure from Section 6.03
  (senior_leverage_ratio Real) ; Senior Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the four consecutive fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date, as a number X for X:1.0
  (fixed_charge_coverage_ratio Real) ; Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio for the twelve consecutive months ending on the observation date, as a number X for X:1.0
  (adjusted_consolidated_ebitda Real) ; Adjusted Consolidated EBITDA for the twelve consecutive months ending on the observation date, in the same currency units as the table amounts
  (is_end_2003_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2003
  (is_end_2004_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2004
  (is_end_2004_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2004
  (is_end_2004_09 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of September 2004
  (is_end_2004_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2004
  (is_end_2005_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2005
  (is_end_2005_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2005
  (is_end_2005_09 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of September 2005
  (is_end_2005_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2005
  (is_end_2006_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2006
  (is_end_2006_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2006
  (is_end_2006_09 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of September 2006
  (is_end_2006_12 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of December 2006
  (is_end_2007_03 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of March 2007
  (is_end_2007_06 Bool) ; observation date is the last day of June 2007
  (is_end_after_2007_06 Bool) ; observation date is a month-end falling after June 2007 (the "Thereafter" period)
  ) Bool
  (=> (and obligations_outstanding_or_commitment (not required_lenders_written_consent))
    (and
      ; (a) Senior Leverage Ratio must not be greater than the maximum
      (=> (or is_end_2003_12 is_end_2004_03) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 3.0))
      (=> (or is_end_2004_06 is_end_2004_09 is_end_2004_12) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.75))
      (=> (or is_end_2005_03 is_end_2005_06 is_end_2005_09 is_end_2005_12 is_end_2006_03) (<= senior_leverage_ratio 2.5))

It omits the rest of Section 7.2: the certificate within 120 days of fiscal year end (a), the public reports (b), litigation notice (c), Default and Material Adverse Effect notices within 3 Business Days (d), the ERISA/PBGC/Multiemployer Plan notices (e)-(h), and the 60-day information requests (i). The Boolean schedule_delivered_with_report bundles several content requirements into one flag: Mortgage location and filing information, the PV-10 Value of the Borrowing Base Properties, and the demonstration of the Collateral Coverage Ratio. The formula does not check any of these separately.

The formula applies the 1.5 threshold only to the schedule's demonstration and treats it as a requirement on the ratio value itself. The source requires a schedule demonstrating that the ratio is at least 1.5, so this reading goes beyond the text. It is a minor point next to the large omissions.
judge.reason: The threshold (>= 1.5) and the implication from Reserve Report delivery are reasonable for the part of (j)(ii) that is modeled. But Section 7.2 contains many other delivery and notice obligations, plus 7.2(j)(i), and none of these appear in the formula. The function therefore does not capture the covenant as a whole, so it is incomplete and not equivalent to the source.
