teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_NRA)
; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the measurement date for covenants 5.3(A)-(E).
; current_assets: consolidated current assets under GAAP at the observation date.
; current_liabilities: consolidated current liabilities under GAAP at the observation date.
; ebit_4q: consolidated EBIT under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.
; interest_expense_4q: consolidated Interest Expense under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.
; ebitda_4q: consolidated EBITDA under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period most recently ended at the observation date.
; current_portion_lt_indebtedness: current portion of long term Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated under GAAP, at the observation date.
; senior_lt_indebtedness: consolidated senior long term indebtedness under GAAP at the observation date.
; current_portion_other_lt_debt: consolidated current portion of all other long term debt (indebtedness) besides senior long term indebtedness, under GAAP, at the observation date.
; net_worth: consolidated Net Worth under GAAP at the observation date.
; existing_sub_notes_outstanding: principal amount of the Existing Subordinated Notes outstanding at the observation date, in USD; the formula caps its use at 8,500,000.
; tangible_net_worth: consolidated Tangible Net Worth under GAAP at the observation date, in USD.
; cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income: sum, over each quarterly accounting period commencing after the Closing Date through the observation date, of that quarter's net income, with loss quarters counted as zero (no deduction for losses), in USD.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (current_assets Real)
    (current_liabilities Real)
    (ebit_4q Real)
    (interest_expense_4q Real)
    (ebitda_4q Real)
    (current_portion_lt_indebtedness Real)
    (senior_lt_indebtedness Real)
    (current_portion_other_lt_debt Real)
    (net_worth Real)
    (existing_sub_notes_outstanding Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; (A) current ratio >= 1.35
      (>= (/ current_assets current_liabilities) 1.35)
      ; (B) EBIT / Interest Expense >= 2.00
      (>= (/ ebit_4q interest_expense_4q) 2.0)
      ; (C) EBITDA / (current portion of LT Indebtedness + Interest Expense) >= 1.75
      (>= (/ ebitda_4q (+ current_portion_lt_indebtedness interest_expense_4q)) 1.75)
      ; (D) (senior LT + current portion other LT) / (senior LT + current portion other LT + Net Worth + min(8,500,000, Existing Subordinated Notes outstanding)) <= 0.65
      (<= (/ (+ senior_lt_indebtedness current_portion_other_lt_debt)
             (+ senior_lt_indebtedness current_portion_other_lt_debt net_worth
                (ite (<= existing_sub_notes_outstanding 8500000.0) existing_sub_notes_outstanding 8500000.0)))
          0.65)
      ; (E) Tangible Net Worth >= 45,000,000 + 50% of cumulative net income, losses not deducted
      (>= tangible_net_worth (+ 45000000.0 (* 0.5 cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income))))))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "is_fiscal_quarter_end", "meaning": "True iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the measurement date for all of covenants 5.3(A)-(E).", "source_quote": "measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter"},
    {"name": "current_assets", "meaning": "Consolidated current assets under GAAP at the observation date.", "source_quote": "current assets"},
    {"name": "current_liabilities", "meaning": "Consolidated current liabilities under GAAP at the observation date.", "source_quote": "current liabilities"},
    {"name": "ebit_4q", "meaning": "Consolidated EBIT under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.", "source_quote": "EBIT for such 4-quarter period"},
    {"name": "interest_expense_4q", "meaning": "Consolidated Interest Expense under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date; used in covenants (B) and (C).", "source_quote": "Interest Expense for such 4-quarter period"},
    {"name": "ebitda_4q", "meaning": "Consolidated EBITDA under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period most recently ended at the observation date.", "source_quote": "EBITDA"},
    {"name": "current_portion_lt_indebtedness", "meaning": "Current portion of long term Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated under GAAP, at the observation date.", "source_quote": "the current portion of long term Indebtedness"},
    {"name": "senior_lt_indebtedness", "meaning": "Consolidated senior long term indebtedness under GAAP at the observation date.", "source_quote": "senior long term indebtedness"},
    {"name": "current_portion_other_lt_debt", "meaning": "Consolidated current portion of all long term debt other than senior long term indebtedness, under GAAP, at the observation date.", "source_quote": "the current portion of all other long term debt"},

; is_fiscal_quarter_end: true iff the observation date is the last day of a fiscal quarter, the measurement date for covenants 5.3(A)-(E).
; current_assets: consolidated current assets under GAAP at the observation date.
; current_liabilities: consolidated current liabilities under GAAP at the observation date.
; ebit_4q: consolidated EBIT under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.
; interest_expense_4q: consolidated Interest Expense under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period ending at the observation date.
; ebitda_4q: consolidated EBITDA under GAAP for the rolling 4-quarter period most recently ended at the observation date.
; current_portion_lt_indebtedness: current portion of long term Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, consolidated under GAAP, at the observation date.
; senior_lt_indebtedness: consolidated senior long term indebtedness under GAAP at the observation date.
; current_portion_other_lt_debt: consolidated current portion of all other long term debt (indebtedness) besides senior long term indebtedness, under GAAP, at the observation date.
; net_worth: consolidated Net Worth under GAAP at the observation date.
; existing_sub_notes_outstanding: principal amount of the Existing Subordinated Notes outstanding at the observation date, in USD; the formula caps its use at 8,500,000.
; tangible_net_worth: consolidated Tangible Net Worth under GAAP at the observation date, in USD.
; cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income: sum, over each quarterly accounting period commencing after the Closing Date through the observation date, of that quarter's net income, with loss quarters counted as zero (no deduction for losses), in USD.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
    (current_assets Real)
    (current_liabilities Real)
    (ebit_4q Real)
    (interest_expense_4q Real)
    (ebitda_4q Real)
    (current_portion_lt_indebtedness Real)
    (senior_lt_indebtedness Real)
    (current_portion_other_lt_debt Real)
    (net_worth Real)
    (existing_sub_notes_outstanding Real)
    (tangible_net_worth Real)
    (cumulative_positive_quarterly_net_income Real)) Bool
  (=> is_fiscal_quarter_end
    (and
      ; (A) current ratio >= 1.35
      (>= (/ current_assets current_liabilities) 1.35)
      ; (B) EBIT / Interest Expense >= 2.00
      (>= (/ ebit_4q interest_expense_4q) 2.0)
      ; (C) EBITDA / (current portion of LT Indebtedness + Interest Expense) >= 1.75
      (>= (/ ebitda_4q (+ current_portion_lt_indebtedness interest_expense_4q)) 1.75)
      ; (D) (senior LT + current portion other LT) / (senior LT + current portion other LT + Net Worth + min(8,500,000, Existing Subordinated Notes outstanding)) <= 0.65

             (+ senior_lt_indebtedness current_portion_other_lt_debt net_worth

Clause (a) applies at any time, but the flag refers to "the relevant Fiscal Quarter" without saying which quarter applies at a non-quarter-end observation. It also says the statements "reflect the ratio values supplied", but quarterly statements cannot generally reflect an intra-quarter ratio observation.

The flag's description is partly circular. It is defined as "the condition for a Default to be deemed to have occurred", which restates the proviso instead of giving an independent event meaning. Both ratio caps are non-strict (<=) and must hold together (AND). The covenant applies until the Revolving Credit Maturity Date, and afterwards until all Letters of Credit have expired and the Indebtedness and other obligations are finally paid and performed. It is therefore active if any of the three period flags is true. The two ratios are atomic inputs because their definitions are not supplied, so no division appears in the formula.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

meanings.net_premium_ratio: Net Premium Ratio of the Insurance Subsidiary being observed at this observation time (atomic; definition not supplied).
meanings.gross_premium_ratio: Gross Premium Ratio of the Insurance Subsidiary being observed at this observation time (atomic; definition not supplied).
meanings.is_on_or_before_revolving_credit_maturit: true iff the observation time is on or before the Revolving Credit Maturity Date.
meanings.letters_of_credit_unexpired: true iff at the observation time not all Letters of Credit have expired.
meanings.obligations_not_finally_paid_or_performe: true iff at the observation time the Indebtedness has not been finally paid in full, or the Company has not performed all other obligations under the Agreement and the other Loan Documents.

(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (consolidated_total_indebtedness Real)

    (is_fiscal_quarter_end_on_or_after_2012_09_29 Bool)

    (=> is_fiscal_month_end

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

meanings.leverage_ratio: the Borrower's Leverage Ratio as of the observation date, expressed as a number X meaning X to 1.00 (e.g. .65 means .65 to 1.00). Atomic input; its definition is not supplied.

issues: The comment for challenging_actions_pending_or_threatened narrows §7.13(b)(ii). The source says no actions are "pending, or, to the knowledge of the Borrower, threatened" against the Borrower or the other party or parties. The candidate counts threatened actions only against the Borrower and counts only pending actions against the other parties. Threatened challenges against the other parties could therefore be supplied as false and the acquisition would wrongly pass.

projected_7_11_compliance_or_good_faith_projection_certified is a vague disjunction of 'compliance certified' and 'certification limited to good-faith projection'. It does not say precisely what must be true for the Projected Determination Period, so a soft input stands in for the projected-compliance requirement.

historic_pro_forma_7_11_compliance bundles 'is in and will be in compliance' with the Historic Determination Period only. The 'will be' language and the split between the Historic and Projected periods are not cleanly separated, which makes the scope decomposition imprecise.
judge.reason: The applicability guard (Acquisition made and Commitments, unpaid Obligations or Letters of Credit outstanding), the 2.75 leverage cap, the $25,000,000 cash-plus-commitments floor and the board-approved-or-non-hostile condition match the source. However, the litigation condition's parameter meaning drops threatened actions against the other parties, so the formalization is not faithful. The projected-compliance input is also vaguely defined, so the candidate is not accepted.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant.                             (deferred_revenue Real)
                            (long_term_equipment_advances Real)

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

; restricted_transaction_occurs: Bool, true if at this observation the Borrower or a Subsidiary merges/consolidates, permits a merger into it, sells/transfers/leases/disposes of assets or Subsidiary Equity Interests (including via Sale and Leaseback, singly or in a series), or liquidates/dissolves.
; default_exists_before_or_after: Bool, true if a Default has occurred and is continuing at the time of, or immediately after giving effect to, the transaction.
; event_of_default_outstanding_or_resulting: Bool, true if an Event of Default is then outstanding or would result from the clause (vii) Layne Energy sale.
; merger_into_borrower_borrower_survives: Bool, clause (i): any Person merges into the Borrower and the Borrower is the surviving corporation.
; subsidiary_merges_into_loan_party_survivor_loan_party: Bool, clause (ii): a Subsidiary merges into a Loan Party and the surviving entity is that Loan Party.
; merger_involves_borrower: Bool, true if the clause (ii) merger involves the Borrower.
; borrower_is_surviving_entity: Bool, true if the Borrower is the surviving entity of the clause (ii) merger.
; subsidiary_assets_to_loan_party_or_related_liquidation: Bool, clause (iii): a Subsidiary disposes of its assets to a Loan Party, or liquidates/dissolves in connection with such a transaction.
; cash_equivalents_or_ordinary_cash_use_permitted: Bool, clause (iv): sale or liquidation of cash equivalents, or use of cash in the ordinary course, to the extent not otherwise prohibited hereunder.
; inventory_sale_ordinary_course: Bool, clause (v)(A): sale of inventory in the ordinary course of business.
; used_or_obsolete_asset_disposition_ordinary_course: Bool, clause (v)(B): sale, trade-in or disposition of used equipment for value in the ordinary course consistent with past practice, or of obsolete or unused assets no longer necessary, useful or productive in the business.
; technology_license_ordinary_course: Bool, clause (v)(C): entry into licenses of technology in the ordinary course of business.
; other_disposition_under_clause_v_d: Bool, clause (v)(D): the transaction is an other sale, transfer, lease or disposition relying on the $10,000,000 basket.

; nonloan_party_subsidiary_liquidation: Bool, clause (vi): a Subsidiary that is not a Loan Party liquidates or dissolves.

; fiscal_year_changed_from_effective_date_basis: Bool, section (c): the Borrower or a Subsidiary changes its fiscal year from the basis in effect on the Effective Date.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (restricted_transaction_occurs Bool)
  (default_exists_before_or_after Bool)
  (event_of_default_outstanding_or_resulting Bool)
  (merger_into_borrower_borrower_survives Bool)
  (subsidiary_merges_into_loan_party_survivor_loan_party Bool)
  (merger_involves_borrower Bool)
  (borrower_is_surviving_entity Bool)
  (subsidiary_assets_to_loan_party_or_related_liquidation Bool)
  (cash_equivalents_or_ordinary_cash_use_permitted Bool)
  (inventory_sale_ordinary_course Bool)
  (used_or_obsolete_asset_disposition_ordinary_course Bool)
  (technology_license_ordinary_course Bool)
  (other_disposition_under_clause_v_d Bool)
  (clause_v_d_fiscal_year_total_usd Real)
  (nonloan_party_subsidiary_liquidation Bool)
  (borrower_good_faith_best_interests_determination Bool)
  (layne_energy_equity_sale Bool)
  (layne_energy_equity_sold_percent_aggregate Real)
  (leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_1 Real)
  (leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_2 Real)
  (sale_leaseback_permitted_by_section_6_10 Bool)
  (transaction_permitted_by_section_6_04_g_or_h Bool)
  (engages_material_other_business Bool)
  (fiscal_year_changed_from_effective_date_basis Bool)
) Bool
  (and
    (=> restricted_transaction_occurs
      (and
        (not default_exists_before_or_after)
        (or
          merger_into_borrower_borrower_survives
          (and subsidiary_merges_into_loan_party_survivor_loan_party
               (=> merger_involves_borrower borrower_is_surviving_entity))
          subsidiary_assets_to_loan_party_or_related_liquidation
          cash_equivalents_or_ordinary_cash_use_permitted
          inventory_sale_ordinary_course
          used_or_obsolete_asset_disposition_ordinary_course
          technology_license_ordinary_course
          (and other_disposition_under_clause_v_d
               (<= clause_v_d_fiscal_year_total_usd 10000000))
          (and nonloan_party_subsidiary_liquidation
               borrower_good_faith_best_interests_determination)
          (and layne_energy_equity_sale
               (<= layne_energy_equity_sold_percent_aggregate 40)
               (not event_of_default_outstanding_or_resulting)
               (< leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_1 2.5)
               (< leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_2 2.5))
          sale_leaseback_permitted_by_section_6_10
          transaction_permitted_by_section_6_04_g_or_h)))
    (not engages_material_other_business)
    (not fiscal_year_changed_from_effective_date_basis)))",

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (restricted_transaction_occurs Bool)
  (default_exists_before_or_after Bool)
  (event_of_default_outstanding_or_resulting Bool)
  (merger_into_borrower_borrower_survives Bool)
  (subsidiary_merges_into_loan_party_survivor_loan_party Bool)
  (merger_involves_borrower Bool)
  (borrower_is_surviving_entity Bool)
  (subsidiary_assets_to_loan_party_or_related_liquidation Bool)
  (cash_equivalents_or_ordinary_cash_use_permitted Bool)
  (inventory_sale_ordinary_course Bool)
  (used_or_obsolete_asset_disposition_ordinary_course Bool)
  (technology_license_ordinary_course Bool)
  (other_disposition_under_clause_v_d Bool)
  (clause_v_d_fiscal_year_total_usd Real)
  (nonloan_party_subsidiary_liquidation Bool)
  (borrower_good_faith_best_interests_determination Bool)
  (layne_energy_equity_sale Bool)
  (layne_energy_equity_sold_percent_aggregate Real)
  (leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_1 Real)
  (leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_2 Real)
  (sale_leaseback_permitted_by_section_6_10 Bool)
  (transaction_permitted_by_section_6_04_g_or_h Bool)
  (engages_material_other_business Bool)
  (fiscal_year_changed_from_effective_date_basis Bool)
) Bool
  (and
    (=> restricted_transaction_occurs
      (and
        (not default_exists_before_or_after)
        (or
          merger_into_borrower_borrower_survives
          (and subsidiary_merges_into_loan_party_survivor_loan_party
               (=> merger_involves_borrower borrower_is_surviving_entity))
          subsidiary_assets_to_loan_party_or_related_liquidation
          cash_equivalents_or_ordinary_cash_use_permitted
          inventory_sale_ordinary_course
          used_or_obsolete_asset_disposition_ordinary_course
          technology_license_ordinary_course
          (and other_disposition_under_clause_v_d
               (<= clause_v_d_fiscal_year_total_usd 10000000))
          (and nonloan_party_subsidiary_liquidation
               borrower_good_faith_best_interests_determination)
          (and layne_energy_equity_sale
               (<= layne_energy_equity_sold_percent_aggregate 40)
               (not event_of_default_outstanding_or_resulting)
               (< leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_1 2.5)
               (< leverage_ratio_fiscal_quarter_prior_2 2.5))
          sale_leaseback_permitted_by_section_6_10
          transaction_permitted_by_section_6_04_g_or_h)))
    (not engages_material_other_business)
    (not fiscal_year_changed_from_effective_date_basis)))

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

teacher_raw:
{
  "status": "formalized",
  "smt2": "(set-logic QF_LRA)
; qualified_cash: Qualified Cash (USD) at the observation time.
; working_capital_availability: Working Capital Availability (USD) at the observation time, after giving effect to the Revolver/Term Loan A Reserve, Incremental Availability Reserve, Minimum Availability Amount and all other Reserves then in effect. Computed pro forma where Section 6.7(f) applies.
; is_on_or_before_2008_04_30: true iff the observation time is on or prior to April 30, 2008; false means after April 30, 2008.
; consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA (USD) for the trailing twelve-month period ended at the end of the most recently ended Fiscal Month before the observation date for which financial statements have been (or were required to be) delivered under Section 5.1(a). Computed pro forma where Section 6.7(f) applies.
; ref_month_tier_7m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about April 28, 2007, June 2, 2007, June 30, 2007 or July 28, 2007 (minimum $7,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_10m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about September 1, 2007, September 29, 2007 or October 27, 2007 (minimum $10,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_15m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about December 1, 2007, December 29, 2007 or January 31, 2008 (minimum $15,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_20m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about March 8, 2008, April 5, 2008 or May 3, 2008 (minimum $20,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_25m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is the one ended on or about June 7, 2008 or any Fiscal Month ended thereafter (minimum $25,000,000).
; fy_is_2008: true iff the Fiscal Year being measured is the Fiscal Year ended May 3, 2008.
; fy_is_2009: true iff the Fiscal Year being measured is the Fiscal Year ended on or about April 30, 2009.
; fy_is_2010_or_later: true iff the Fiscal Year being measured is the Fiscal Year ended on or about April 30, 2010 or any Fiscal Year thereafter.
; consolidated_capex_fy: aggregate Consolidated Capital Expenditures (USD) made or incurred by Holdings and all its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year through the observation time.
; has_sale_leaseback_rent_obligation: true iff Holdings or any Subsidiary has created, incurred or suffered to exist an obligation as lessee for the payment of rent for personal property in connection with a sale and leaseback transaction.
; has_other_nonpermitted_personal_property_rent_obligation: true iff Holdings or any Subsidiary has an obligation as lessee for rent for personal property under leases or agreements to lease that is neither a Capital Lease obligation within the limit in clause (A) nor an Operating Lease Obligation within the limit in clause (B).
; capital_lease_obligations_fy: aggregate obligations (USD) under Capital Leases entered into after the Closing Date owing by Holdings and its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year.
; operating_lease_obligations_fy: aggregate Operating Lease Obligations (USD) owing by Holdings and its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year.
; license_advances_software_dev_costs_fy: aggregate License Advances and Software Development Costs (USD) made or incurred by Holdings and all its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (qualified_cash Real)
  (working_capital_availability Real)
  (is_on_or_before_2008_04_30 Bool)
  (consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm Real)
  (ref_month_tier_7m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_10m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_15m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_20m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_25m Bool)
  (fy_is_2008 Bool)
  (fy_is_2009 Bool)
  (fy_is_2010_or_later Bool)
  (consolidated_capex_fy Real)
  (has_sale_leaseback_rent_obligation Bool)
  (has_other_nonpermitted_personal_property_rent_obligation Bool)
  (capital_lease_obligations_fy Real)
  (operating_lease_obligations_fy Real)
  (license_advances_software_dev_costs_fy Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.7(a): on an EBITDA Testing Date, EBITDA must meet the tiered minimum
    (=> (or (and is_on_or_before_2008_04_30 (< (+ qualified_cash working_capital_availability) 13000000.0))
            (and (not is_on_or_before_2008_04_30) (< (+ qualified_cash working_capital_availability) 18000000.0)))
        (ite ref_month_tier_7m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 7000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_10m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 10000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_15m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 15000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_20m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 20000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_25m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 25000000.0) true))))))
    ; 6.7(b): Consolidated Capital Expenditures cap per Fiscal Year
    (=> fy_is_2008 (<= consolidated_capex_fy 15000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2009 (<= consolidated_capex_fy 12000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2010_or_later (<= consolidated_capex_fy 11000000.0))
    ; 6.7(c): lease restrictions
    (not has_sale_leaseback_rent_obligation)
    (not has_other_nonpermitted_personal_property_rent_obligation)
    (=> fy_is_2008 (<= capital_lease_obligations_fy 15000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2009 (<= capital_lease_obligations_fy 12000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2010_or_later (<= capital_lease_obligations_fy 11000000.0))
    (<= operating_lease_obligations_fy 10000000.0)
    ; 6.7(d): Working Capital Availability must not be less than zero
    (>= working_capital_availability 0.0)
    ; 6.7(e): License Advances and Software Development Costs cap per Fiscal Year
    (<= license_advances_software_dev_costs_fy 10000000.0)))",
  "symbols": [
    {"name": "qualified_cash", "meaning": "Qualified Cash (USD) at the observation time.", "source_quote": "Qualified Cash at such time"},

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; qualified_cash: Qualified Cash (USD) at the observation time.
; working_capital_availability: Working Capital Availability (USD) at the observation time, after giving effect to the Revolver/Term Loan A Reserve, Incremental Availability Reserve, Minimum Availability Amount and all other Reserves then in effect. Computed pro forma where Section 6.7(f) applies.
; is_on_or_before_2008_04_30: true iff the observation time is on or prior to April 30, 2008; false means after April 30, 2008.
; consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA (USD) for the trailing twelve-month period ended at the end of the most recently ended Fiscal Month before the observation date for which financial statements have been (or were required to be) delivered under Section 5.1(a). Computed pro forma where Section 6.7(f) applies.
; ref_month_tier_7m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about April 28, 2007, June 2, 2007, June 30, 2007 or July 28, 2007 (minimum $7,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_10m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about September 1, 2007, September 29, 2007 or October 27, 2007 (minimum $10,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_15m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about December 1, 2007, December 29, 2007 or January 31, 2008 (minimum $15,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_20m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is one ended on or about March 8, 2008, April 5, 2008 or May 3, 2008 (minimum $20,000,000).
; ref_month_tier_25m: true iff that reference Fiscal Month is the one ended on or about June 7, 2008 or any Fiscal Month ended thereafter (minimum $25,000,000).
; fy_is_2008: true iff the Fiscal Year being measured is the Fiscal Year ended May 3, 2008.
; fy_is_2009: true iff the Fiscal Year being measured is the Fiscal Year ended on or about April 30, 2009.
; fy_is_2010_or_later: true iff the Fiscal Year being measured is the Fiscal Year ended on or about April 30, 2010 or any Fiscal Year thereafter.
; consolidated_capex_fy: aggregate Consolidated Capital Expenditures (USD) made or incurred by Holdings and all its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year through the observation time.
; has_sale_leaseback_rent_obligation: true iff Holdings or any Subsidiary has created, incurred or suffered to exist an obligation as lessee for the payment of rent for personal property in connection with a sale and leaseback transaction.
; has_other_nonpermitted_personal_property_rent_obligation: true iff Holdings or any Subsidiary has an obligation as lessee for rent for personal property under leases or agreements to lease that is neither a Capital Lease obligation within the limit in clause (A) nor an Operating Lease Obligation within the limit in clause (B).
; capital_lease_obligations_fy: aggregate obligations (USD) under Capital Leases entered into after the Closing Date owing by Holdings and its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year.
; operating_lease_obligations_fy: aggregate Operating Lease Obligations (USD) owing by Holdings and its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year.
; license_advances_software_dev_costs_fy: aggregate License Advances and Software Development Costs (USD) made or incurred by Holdings and all its Subsidiaries in the measured Fiscal Year.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (qualified_cash Real)
  (working_capital_availability Real)
  (is_on_or_before_2008_04_30 Bool)
  (consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm Real)
  (ref_month_tier_7m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_10m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_15m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_20m Bool)
  (ref_month_tier_25m Bool)
  (fy_is_2008 Bool)
  (fy_is_2009 Bool)
  (fy_is_2010_or_later Bool)
  (consolidated_capex_fy Real)
  (has_sale_leaseback_rent_obligation Bool)
  (has_other_nonpermitted_personal_property_rent_obligation Bool)
  (capital_lease_obligations_fy Real)
  (operating_lease_obligations_fy Real)
  (license_advances_software_dev_costs_fy Real)) Bool
  (and
    ; 6.7(a): on an EBITDA Testing Date, EBITDA must meet the tiered minimum
    (=> (or (and is_on_or_before_2008_04_30 (< (+ qualified_cash working_capital_availability) 13000000.0))
            (and (not is_on_or_before_2008_04_30) (< (+ qualified_cash working_capital_availability) 18000000.0)))
        (ite ref_month_tier_7m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 7000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_10m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 10000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_15m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 15000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_20m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 20000000.0)
        (ite ref_month_tier_25m (>= consolidated_adjusted_ebitda_ttm 25000000.0) true))))))
    ; 6.7(b): Consolidated Capital Expenditures cap per Fiscal Year
    (=> fy_is_2008 (<= consolidated_capex_fy 15000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2009 (<= consolidated_capex_fy 12000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2010_or_later (<= consolidated_capex_fy 11000000.0))
    ; 6.7(c): lease restrictions
    (not has_sale_leaseback_rent_obligation)
    (not has_other_nonpermitted_personal_property_rent_obligation)
    (=> fy_is_2008 (<= capital_lease_obligations_fy 15000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2009 (<= capital_lease_obligations_fy 12000000.0))
    (=> fy_is_2010_or_later (<= capital_lease_obligations_fy 11000000.0))
    (<= operating_lease_obligations_fy 10000000.0)
    ; 6.7(d): Working Capital Availability must not be less than zero
    (>= working_capital_availability 0.0)
    ; 6.7(e): License Advances and Software Development Costs cap per Fiscal Year
    (<= license_advances_software_dev_costs_fy 10000000.0)))

; revolving_swingline_loans_outstanding: aggregate principal amount of Revolving Loans and Swingline Loans outstanding on the observation date
; consolidated_fixed_charges: Consolidated Fixed Charges for the four consecutive fiscal quarter period ending on the observation date
(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (is_fiscal_quarter_end Bool)
  (in_period_1 Bool)
  (in_period_2 Bool)
  (in_period_3 Bool)
  (consolidated_ebitda Real)
  (cash_held Real)
  (permitted_investments_carrying_value Real)
  (revolving_swingline_loans_outstanding Real)

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

    {"name": "is_quarter_end", "meaning": "True if the observation is a quarterly measurement date for the ratios in (b) and (d)", "source_quote": "measured quarterly on a rolling twelve (12) month basis"},

candidate.notes: The covenant is applicable at fiscal quarter-end observations on or after April 30, 2000. When applicable, the Interest Coverage Ratio (EBITDDA divided by combined interest expense) must be at least 2.75 (the 'not less than 2.75 to 1.0' threshold, non-strict). EBITDDA is kept as its stated arithmetic definition: net income excluding extraordinary items plus the five add-backs. The add-back interest expense and the denominator's combined interest expense (which includes capitalized interest and the capital lease interest portion) are separate inputs because the source defines them differently. A zero denominator is left for the evaluator to report as unresolved, so QF_NRA is used. The Article 7 lead-in (so long as Commitments, Loans or Letters of Credit remain, unless the Majority Banks waive in writing) is not modeled. Waivers and the outstanding-obligation status are not given as inputs, and the evaluator is assumed to supply observations only while the covenant is in force.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

; obligations_outstanding: true iff any Commitment or Loan is outstanding (amounts not yet paid in full) at the observation.
; days_after_fiscal_year_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of the most recent fiscal year of the Borrower's operation of the Project.
; form_10k_publicly_available: true iff the REIT's annual Form 10-K for that fiscal year has become publicly available by the observation.
; business_days_after_10k_available: Business Days elapsed at the observation since the REIT's annual Form 10-K became publicly available (only meaningful when form_10k_publicly_available is true).
; annual_package_delivered: true iff the annual package under 8.01(a)(i)-(vi) (Form 10-K, operating results summary, actual-to-budget comparison, operating budget, unaudited balance sheet and income statement, updated rent roll) has been furnished to the Administrative Agent by the observation.
; days_after_quarter_end: days elapsed at the observation since the end of the relevant quarter (the REIT's fiscal quarter).
; form_10q_publicly_available: true iff the REIT's Form 10-Q for that fiscal quarter has become publicly available by the observation.
; business_days_after_10q_available: Business Days elapsed at the observation since that Form 10-Q became publicly available (only meaningful when form_10q_publicly_available is true).
; is_fourth_fiscal_quarter: true iff the relevant quarter is the fourth quarter of a fiscal year.
; quarterly_package_delivered: true iff the quarterly package under 8.01(b)(i)-(v) (Form 10-Q, year-to-date operating results summary, year-to-date actual-to-budget comparison, unaudited balance sheet and income statement, updated rent roll) has been furnished to the Administrative Agent by the observation.
; low_dscr_trigger_period_applies: true iff the relevant calendar month falls during a Low DSCR Trigger Period.

  (obligations_outstanding Bool)
  (days_after_fiscal_year_end Real)
  (form_10k_publicly_available Bool)
  (business_days_after_10k_available Real)
  (annual_package_delivered Bool)
  (days_after_quarter_end Real)
  (form_10q_publicly_available Bool)
  (business_days_after_10q_available Real)
  (is_fourth_fiscal_quarter Bool)
  (quarterly_package_delivered Bool)
  (low_dscr_trigger_period_applies Bool)
  (business_days_after_month_end Real)
  (monthly_package_delivered Bool)
  (statements_delivered_now Bool)
  (officer_certificate_delivered_now Bool)
  (information_request_outstanding Bool)
  (days_after_information_request Real)
  (requested_information_delivered Bool)) Bool
  (=> obligations_outstanding

      ; 8.01(a): deadline is the earlier of 100 days or 5 Business Days after 10-K availability
      (=> (or (> days_after_fiscal_year_end 100)
              (and form_10k_publicly_available (> business_days_after_10k_available 5)))
          annual_package_delivered)
      ; 8.01(b): earlier of 50 days or 5 Business Days after 10-Q availability; fourth quarter uses the 8.01(a) deadline

               (or (> days_after_fiscal_year_end 100)
                   (and form_10k_publicly_available (> business_days_after_10k_available 5)))
               (or (> days_after_quarter_end 50)
                   (and form_10q_publicly_available (> business_days_after_10q_available 5))))
          quarterly_package_delivered)
      ; 8.01(e): within 10 Business Days after month end during a Low DSCR Trigger Period

          monthly_package_delivered)

      (=> statements_delivered_now officer_certificate_delivered_now)
      ; 8.01(d): within 15 days after request

    {"name": "business_days_after_10q_available", "meaning": "Business Days elapsed since the REIT's Form 10-Q for the quarter became publicly available.", "source_quote": "five (5) Business Days after the Form 10-Q of the REIT for such fiscal quarter becomes publicly available"},
    {"name": "is_fourth_fiscal_quarter", "meaning": "True iff the relevant quarter is the fourth quarter of a fiscal year.", "source_quote": "in the case of the fourth quarter of each fiscal year"},
    {"name": "quarterly_package_delivered", "meaning": "True iff all quarterly items 8.01(b)(i)-(v) have been furnished to the Administrative Agent by the observation.", "source_quote": "the most recent Form 10-Q of the REIT"},
    {"name": "low_dscr_trigger_period_applies", "meaning": "True iff the relevant calendar month falls during a Low DSCR Trigger Period.", "source_quote": "during a Low DSCR Trigger Period"},
    {"name": "business_days_after_month_end", "meaning": "Business Days elapsed since the end of the relevant calendar month.", "source_quote": "within ten (10) Business Days after the end of each calendar month"},
    {"name": "monthly_package_delivered", "meaning": "True iff the monthly items 8.01(e)(i)-(iii) have been delivered for the month by the observation.", "source_quote": "an operating statement (showing monthly activity)"},

  (borrower_authority_requires_higher Bool) ; A Governmental Authority with regulatory authority over the Borrower requires higher capital amounts or a greater leverage ratio for the Borrower to remain "adequately capitalized" and in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements
  (borrower_required_total_rbc Real) ; Total Risk-based Capital amount or ratio, in percent, specified by the authority for the Borrower; used only when borrower_authority_requires_higher is true
  (borrower_required_tier1_rbc Real) ; Tier 1 Risk-based Capital amount or ratio, in percent, specified by the authority for the Borrower; used only when borrower_authority_requires_higher is true
  (borrower_required_leverage Real) ; Leverage Ratio, in percent, specified by the authority for the Borrower; used only when borrower_authority_requires_higher is true
  (sub_applicable Bool) ; This observation is of a Financial Institution Subsidiary of the Borrower, so Section 6.3(b) applies
  (sub_well_capitalized Bool) ; The Financial Institution Subsidiary is "well capitalized" for all applicable state and federal regulatory purposes at this observation time
  (sub_total_rbc_ratio Real) ; Subsidiary Total Risk-based Capital Ratio at this observation, in percent, as defined by applicable regulations or orders
  (sub_tier1_rbc_ratio Real) ; Subsidiary Tier 1 Risk-based Capital Ratio at this observation, in percent, as defined by applicable regulations or orders
  (sub_tier1_leverage_ratio Real) ; Subsidiary Tier 1 Leverage Capital Ratio at this observation, in percent, as defined by applicable regulations or orders
  (sub_subject_to_reg_action Bool) ; Subsidiary is subject to any written agreement, order, capital directive or prompt corrective action directive by a Governmental Authority having regulatory authority over it
  (sub_authority_requires_higher Bool) ; A Governmental Authority with regulatory authority over the subsidiary requires higher capital amounts or a greater leverage ratio for it to remain "well capitalized" and in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements
  (sub_required_total_rbc Real) ; Total Risk-based Capital amount or ratio, in percent, specified by the authority for the subsidiary; used only when sub_authority_requires_higher is true
  (sub_required_tier1_rbc Real) ; Tier 1 Risk-based Capital amount or ratio, in percent, specified by the authority for the subsidiary; used only when sub_authority_requires_higher is true
  (sub_required_leverage Real) ; Leverage Ratio, in percent, specified by the authority for the subsidiary; used only when sub_authority_requires_higher is true
) Bool
  (and

    (and
      borrower_adequately_capitalized
      (or
        ;; (i) stated minimum ratios and no regulatory action
        (and (>= borrower_total_rbc_ratio 8.0)
             (>= borrower_tier1_rbc_ratio 4.0)
             (>= borrower_tier1_leverage_ratio 4.0)
             (not borrower_subject_to_reg_action))

        (and borrower_authority_requires_higher
             (>= borrower_total_rbc_ratio borrower_required_total_rbc)
             (>= borrower_tier1_rbc_ratio borrower_required_tier1_rbc)
             (>= borrower_tier1_leverage_ratio borrower_required_leverage))))

        sub_well_capitalized
        (or

          (and (>= sub_total_rbc_ratio 10.0)
               (>= sub_tier1_rbc_ratio 6.0)
               (>= sub_tier1_leverage_ratio 5.0)
               (not sub_subject_to_reg_action))
          ;; (ii) authority requires higher amounts, and the subsidiary has them
          (and sub_authority_requires_higher
               (>= sub_total_rbc_ratio sub_required_total_rbc)
               (>= sub_tier1_rbc_ratio sub_required_tier1_rbc)
               (>= sub_tier1_leverage_ratio sub_required_leverage)))))))",

    (total_commitment_terminated Bool)
    (notes_outstanding Bool)
    (obligations_paid_in_full Bool)
    (total_funded_debt_to_ebitda_ratio Real)

; on_or_before_2018_12_31: true iff the observation date is prior to January 1, 2019. False means subsequent to December 31, 2018.
; total_leverage_ratio: Pro Forma Total Leverage Ratio at the observation time, as a fraction (65% = 0.65).
; a_increase_elected: true iff the Borrower has elected to increase the 7.09(a) maximum ratio to 65% for the current fiscal quarter.
; a_in_material_acquisition_window: true iff the current fiscal quarter is one in which a Consolidated Party or Unconsolidated Affiliate completes a Material Acquisition, or one of up to the next two subsequent consecutive fiscal quarters.
; a_increased_quarters_count: number of fiscal quarters (consecutive or not) during the term for which the 7.09(a) maximum ratio has been increased, counting the current quarter if increased.
; total_secured_indebtedness: Pro Forma Total Secured Indebtedness, in the same currency as total_asset_value.
; total_asset_value: Pro Forma Total Asset Value.
; total_secured_recourse_indebtedness: Pro Forma Total Secured Recourse Indebtedness.
; adjusted_ebitda_ttm: Pro Forma Adjusted EBITDA for the trailing four quarter period ending on the observation date.
; total_fixed_charges_ttm: Pro Forma Total Fixed Charges for the trailing four quarter period ending on the observation date.
; unsecured_indebtedness: Pro Forma Total Indebtedness that is Unsecured Indebtedness, in US dollars.
; unrestricted_cash: Unrestricted Cash, in US dollars.
; unencumbered_pool_value: Pro Forma Unencumbered Pool Value, in US dollars.
; e_increase_elected: true iff the Borrower has elected to increase the 7.09(e) maximum ratio to 65% for the current fiscal quarter.
; e_in_material_acquisition_window: true iff the current fiscal quarter is one in which a Consolidated Party or Unconsolidated Affiliate completes a Material Acquisition, or one of up to the next two subsequent consecutive fiscal quarters.
; e_increased_quarters_count: number of fiscal quarters (consecutive or not) during the term for which the 7.09(e) maximum ratio has been increased, counting the current quarter if increased.
; unencumbered_noi_ttm: Pro Forma Unencumbered NOI for the trailing four quarter period ending on the observation date.
; unsecured_interest_expense_ttm: Pro Forma Interest Expense on Unsecured Indebtedness for the trailing four quarter period ending on the observation date.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (on_or_after_2016_03_31 Bool)
    (on_or_before_2017_12_31 Bool)
    (on_or_before_2018_12_31 Bool)
    (total_leverage_ratio Real)
    (a_increase_elected Bool)
    (a_in_material_acquisition_window Bool)
    (a_increased_quarters_count Real)
    (total_secured_indebtedness Real)
    (total_asset_value Real)
    (total_secured_recourse_indebtedness Real)
    (adjusted_ebitda_ttm Real)
    (total_fixed_charges_ttm Real)
    (unsecured_indebtedness Real)
    (unrestricted_cash Real)
    (unencumbered_pool_value Real)
    (e_increase_elected Bool)
    (e_in_material_acquisition_window Bool)
    (e_increased_quarters_count Real)
    (unencumbered_noi_ttm Real)
    (unsecured_interest_expense_ttm Real)
  ) Bool
  (let ((a_increase_ok (and (not on_or_before_2017_12_31) a_increase_elected a_in_material_acquisition_window (<= a_increased_quarters_count 4.0)))
        (e_increase_ok (and e_increase_elected e_in_material_acquisition_window (<= e_increased_quarters_count 4.0)))
        (cash_excess (ite (> unrestricted_cash 40000000.0) (- unrestricted_cash 40000000.0) 0.0)))
    (and
      ; (a) Maximum Total Leverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_before_2017_12_31 (<= total_leverage_ratio 0.65))
      (=> (not on_or_before_2017_12_31)
          (<= total_leverage_ratio (ite a_increase_ok 0.65 0.60)))
      ; (b) Maximum Secured Leverage Ratio
      (=> (and on_or_after_2016_03_31 on_or_before_2018_12_31)
          (<= (/ total_secured_indebtedness total_asset_value) 0.55))
      (=> (not on_or_before_2018_12_31)
          (<= (/ total_secured_indebtedness total_asset_value) 0.50))
      ; (c) Maximum Secured Recourse Leverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_after_2016_03_31
          (<= (/ total_secured_recourse_indebtedness total_asset_value) 0.15))
      ; (d) Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_after_2016_03_31
          (>= (/ adjusted_ebitda_ttm total_fixed_charges_ttm) 1.5))
      ; (e) Maximum Unsecured Leverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_after_2016_03_31
          (<= (/ (- unsecured_indebtedness cash_excess) unencumbered_pool_value)
              (ite e_increase_ok 0.65 0.60)))
      ; (f) Minimum Unencumbered Interest Coverage Ratio
      (=> (and on_or_after_2016_03_31 on_or_before_2017_12_31)
          (>= (/ unencumbered_noi_ttm unsecured_interest_expense_ttm) 1.5))
      (=> (not on_or_before_2017_12_31)
          (>= (/ unencumbered_noi_ttm unsecured_interest_expense_ttm) 1.75))
    )
  )

  (let ((a_increase_ok (and (not on_or_before_2017_12_31) a_increase_elected a_in_material_acquisition_window (<= a_increased_quarters_count 4.0)))
        (e_increase_ok (and e_increase_elected e_in_material_acquisition_window (<= e_increased_quarters_count 4.0)))
        (cash_excess (ite (> unrestricted_cash 40000000.0) (- unrestricted_cash 40000000.0) 0.0)))
    (and
      ; (a) Maximum Total Leverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_before_2017_12_31 (<= total_leverage_ratio 0.65))
      (=> (not on_or_before_2017_12_31)
          (<= total_leverage_ratio (ite a_increase_ok 0.65 0.60)))
      ; (b) Maximum Secured Leverage Ratio
      (=> (and on_or_after_2016_03_31 on_or_before_2018_12_31)
          (<= (/ total_secured_indebtedness total_asset_value) 0.55))
      (=> (not on_or_before_2018_12_31)
          (<= (/ total_secured_indebtedness total_asset_value) 0.50))
      ; (c) Maximum Secured Recourse Leverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_after_2016_03_31
          (<= (/ total_secured_recourse_indebtedness total_asset_value) 0.15))
      ; (d) Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_after_2016_03_31
          (>= (/ adjusted_ebitda_ttm total_fixed_charges_ttm) 1.5))
      ; (e) Maximum Unsecured Leverage Ratio
      (=> on_or_after_2016_03_31
          (<= (/ (- unsecured_indebtedness cash_excess) unencumbered_pool_value)
              (ite e_increase_ok 0.65 0.60)))
      ; (f) Minimum Unencumbered Interest Coverage Ratio
      (=> (and on_or_after_2016_03_31 on_or_before_2017_12_31)
          (>= (/ unencumbered_noi_ttm unsecured_interest_expense_ttm) 1.5))
      (=> (not on_or_before_2017_12_31)
          (>= (/ unencumbered_noi_ttm unsecured_interest_expense_ttm) 1.75))
    )
  )
)

(set-logic QF_LRA)
; commitments_expired_or_terminated: True iff the Commitments have expired or been terminated at this observation.
; obligations_paid_in_full: True iff principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees, expenses and other amounts payable under this Agreement or any other Loan Document have been paid in full at this observation; contingent amounts not yet due are excluded.
; letters_of_credit_resolved_and_disbursements_reimbursed: True iff all Letters of Credit have expired, terminated, or been backstopped or cash collateralized in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the applicable Issuing Bank, and all LC Disbursements have been reimbursed, at this observation.
; is_spin_off_consummation: True iff this observation is the consummation of the Spin-Off, when the Spin-Off must have been consummated lawfully and consistently with the Form 10.
; spin_off_lawful_and_consistent_with_form10: True iff the Spin-Off is consummated in accordance with applicable law in all material respects and consistent with the information in the Form 10 (as in effect three Business Days prior to the Effective Date).
; is_immediately_after_spin_off: True iff this observation is immediately after giving effect to the Spin-Off.
; cash_and_cash_equivalents_usd: Cash and Cash Equivalents (as defined in the Separation Agreement) held by the Borrower and the Restricted Subsidiaries, in US dollars, after applying the adjustment procedures in the Separation Agreement.
; is_spin_off_date: True iff this observation is at the Spin-Off Date, by which the Spin-Off Documents must already have been delivered.
; true_complete_spin_off_documents_provided: True iff the Borrower has provided the Administrative Agent with true and complete copies of the Spin-Off Documents prior to the Spin-Off Date.
; has_material_adverse_form10_modification: True iff the Spin-Off Documents contain a modification from the Form 10 information that is material and adverse to the Lenders, excluding placeholder information such as the distribution ratio, the date of any DuPont Distribution and record dates.
; form10_modification_has_admin_agent_prior_written_consent: True iff the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent to the material and adverse modification from the Form 10.
; has_material_adverse_waiver_or_amendment: True iff any term or condition of the Spin-Off Documents has been waived, amended or otherwise modified in a manner material and adverse to the rights or interests of the Lenders.
; waiver_or_amendment_has_admin_agent_prior_written_consent: True iff the Administrative Agent gave prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed) to that material and adverse waiver, amendment or modification.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (commitments_expired_or_terminated Bool)
    (obligations_paid_in_full Bool)
    (letters_of_credit_resolved_and_disbursements_reimbursed Bool)
    (is_spin_off_consummation Bool)
    (spin_off_lawful_and_consistent_with_form10 Bool)
    (is_immediately_after_spin_off Bool)
    (cash_and_cash_equivalents_usd Real)
    (is_spin_off_date Bool)
    (true_complete_spin_off_documents_provided Bool)
    (has_material_adverse_form10_modification Bool)
    (form10_modification_has_admin_agent_prior_written_consent Bool)
    (has_material_adverse_waiver_or_amendment Bool)
    (waiver_or_amendment_has_admin_agent_prior_written_consent Bool)
  ) Bool
  (let ((covenant_period_over
          (and commitments_expired_or_terminated
               obligations_paid_in_full
               letters_of_credit_resolved_and_disbursements_reimbursed)))
    (or covenant_period_over
        (and
          (=> is_spin_off_consummation spin_off_lawful_and_consistent_with_form10)
          (=> is_immediately_after_spin_off (>= cash_and_cash_equivalents_usd 200000000.0))
          (=> is_spin_off_date true_complete_spin_off_documents_provided)
          (=> has_material_adverse_form10_modification form10_modification_has_admin_agent_prior_written_consent)
          (=> has_material_adverse_waiver_or_amendment waiver_or_amendment_has_admin_agent_prior_written_consent)))))

A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs.   (consent_obtained Bool)

  (funded_debt_payment_event Bool)
  (default_exists_around_event Bool)
  (is_scheduled_principal_payment Bool)

(define-fun covenant_holds (
  (total_senior_funded_debt Real)
  (subordinated_debt Real)
  (kti_series_b_subordinated_debt Real)
  (consolidated_equity Real)
  (is_period_through_june_30_1999 Bool)
  (is_period_ending_on_or_after_july_1_1999 Bool)) Bool

                  (ite (<= kti_series_b_subordinated_debt 24100000.0) kti_series_b_subordinated_debt 24100000.0))
               (+ consolidated_equity total_senior_funded_debt subordinated_debt))
            0.60))

                  (ite (<= kti_series_b_subordinated_debt 24100000.0) kti_series_b_subordinated_debt 24100000.0))
               (+ consolidated_equity total_senior_funded_debt subordinated_debt))
            0.55))))

; all_obligations_discharged: true if the Commitments have expired or terminated, no Letter of Credit remains outstanding, and principal, interest, fees and other amounts payable are paid in full (other than contingent indemnification obligations as to which no claim has been asserted).
; rjp_made_or_declared: true if the Company or any Subsidiary, directly or indirectly, declares, orders, pays, makes or sets apart a sum for a Restricted Junior Payment at this observation.
; is_subsidiary_ratable_rjp: true if the Restricted Junior Payment is made or declared by a Subsidiary ratably with respect to any class of its Capital Stock.
; is_employee_equity_repurchase_rjp: true if the Restricted Junior Payment is made by the Company to repurchase, redeem, retire, cancel or acquire for value Capital Stock or equity appreciation rights of the Company or any direct or indirect parent held by a future, present or former director, officer, member of management, employee or consultant of the Company or any Subsidiary (or the estate, heirs, family members, spouse or former spouse of any of them).
; employee_repurchase_fy_aggregate_usd: aggregate USD amount of Restricted Junior Payments of the clause (b) type in the current Fiscal Year, including this payment.
; default_exists_or_would_result: true if an Event of Default or Default has occurred and is continuing or would be caused by this Restricted Junior Payment.
; other_rjp_fy_aggregate_usd: aggregate USD amount of other Restricted Junior Payments under clause (c)(i) in the current Fiscal Year, including this payment.
; pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio: Total Leverage Ratio on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to this Restricted Junior Payment and any Indebtedness incurred in connection therewith.
(define-fun covenant_holds (
    (is_on_or_after_closing_date Bool)
    (all_obligations_discharged Bool)
    (rjp_made_or_declared Bool)
    (is_subsidiary_ratable_rjp Bool)
    (is_employee_equity_repurchase_rjp Bool)
    (employee_repurchase_fy_aggregate_usd Real)
    (default_exists_or_would_result Bool)
    (other_rjp_fy_aggregate_usd Real)
    (pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio Real)) Bool
  (=> (and is_on_or_after_closing_date
           (not all_obligations_discharged)
           rjp_made_or_declared)
      (or is_subsidiary_ratable_rjp
          (and is_employee_equity_repurchase_rjp
               (<= employee_repurchase_fy_aggregate_usd 5000000.0))
          (and (not default_exists_or_would_result)
               (or (<= other_rjp_fy_aggregate_usd 150000000.0)
                   (<= pro_forma_total_leverage_ratio 3.5))))))

candidate.notes: Pointwise encoding: when the covenant is in effect (on or after the Closing Date and not yet discharged) and a Restricted Junior Payment is made, it must fall within an exception. Exception (a) is a Subsidiary ratable payment. Exception (b) is an employee equity repurchase with the Fiscal Year aggregate <= $5,000,000. Exception (c) requires no Default and either the (c)(i) aggregate <= $150,000,000 or pro forma Total Leverage Ratio <= 3.50 (c)(ii). The ratio is kept as an atomic Real because its definition is not supplied. 3.50:1:00 is read as 3.5.

z3.instantiation_convention: We adopt pointwise temporal semantics: each generated SMT formula specifies covenant applicability and compliance at an arbitrary observation time. Recurring obligations are interpreted through universal instantiation over all relevant observation points in a supplied finite financial history, preserving a quantifier-free SMT target language. The evaluator supplies every function parameter at each observation, including calendar applicability flags. It evaluates the function and conjoins all observed results. A finite history does not establish obligations between observations. At-all-times clauses are translated pointwise under this explicitly limited observation coverage; do not abstain solely because the source says at all times. Event-state values can be function inputs with precise source-grounded meanings; actual state values and calendar data are not needed to define the function. Extra state is required only when the source semantics cannot be specified by such inputs. Numeric division by zero is reported by the evaluator as unresolved, never silently compliant or noncompliant. This definedness policy does not assume a positive or nonzero denominator for all financial observations. No financial nonnegativity, denominator positivity, or other domain assumptions are implied.

issues: Scope error in clause (c): the source says only 'the Company may make' the (c)(i) and (c)(ii) Restricted Junior Payments. The candidate has no input for whether the payer is the Company or a Subsidiary. rjp_made_or_declared covers Company and Subsidiary payments alike, so a non-ratable Subsidiary payment passes whenever there is no default and either the $150M aggregate or the 3.5x leverage test holds. The source gives Subsidiaries only the clause (a) ratable exception, so this is wrongly permitted.

Clause (b) is limited to the Company through is_employee_equity_repurchase_rjp, but clause (c) has no equivalent limit. The decomposition of exceptions by payer is therefore inconsistent with the source.

The aggregate inputs are underspecified. other_rjp_fy_aggregate_usd is described as 'other Restricted Junior Payments under clause (c)(i)' including this payment. The candidate has no input marking whether this payment is such a payment, or whether it is excluded from clause (b) and (a) amounts. The meaning is circular and cannot be pinned down against the source.
judge.reason: The overall structure is mostly right: the closing-date and discharge guard, the subsidiary ratable exception, the $5M employee cap, the no-default condition, the $150M cap and the 3.5x leverage alternative are all present, and strictness matches. But the candidate drops the Company-only restriction on clause (c), so it accepts non-ratable Subsidiary Restricted Junior Payments that the source prohibits. The (c)(i) aggregate input is also vaguely defined. The formalization is therefore not equivalent to the covenant.

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; commitment_outstanding: true at the observation time if the Commitment is outstanding.
; obligations_remain: true at the observation time if any obligation of the Borrower remains to be paid or performed under the Agreement or under the Note.
; bank_prior_written_consent: true if the Bank has given prior written consent to the Borrower's ratio exceeding 3.5 to 1.0 at this observation.
; total_liabilities: Borrower's Total Liabilities at the observation time (currency units), the numerator of the ratio.
; adjusted_tangible_net_worth: Borrower's Adjusted Tangible Net Worth at the observation time (currency units), the denominator of the ratio.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((commitment_outstanding Bool) (obligations_remain Bool) (bank_prior_written_consent Bool) (total_liabilities Real) (adjusted_tangible_net_worth Real)) Bool
  (=> (or commitment_outstanding obligations_remain)
      (or bank_prior_written_consent
          (<= (/ total_liabilities adjusted_tangible_net_worth) 3.5))))

(set-logic QF_NRA)
; banks_obligated_to_lend: true iff the Banks are still obligated to lend under the agreement at this observation.
; notes_and_interest_unpaid: true iff the Notes and interest thereon have not yet been paid in full at this observation.
; prior_written_consent_obtained: true iff the Borrower has the Banks' prior written consent to permit the interest coverage ratio to be below 1.3 to 1.0 at this observation.
; consolidated_net_income: Consolidated Net Income over the four-quarter rolling period ending at this observation.
; consolidated_net_interest_expense: Consolidated Net Interest Expense over the same four-quarter rolling period. It is added back in the numerator and is also the denominator.
; consolidated_taxes: consolidated taxes over the same four-quarter rolling period.
; consolidated_amortization: consolidated amortization over the same four-quarter rolling period.
; consolidated_depreciation: consolidated depreciation over the same four-quarter rolling period.
(define-fun covenant_holds ((banks_obligated_to_lend Bool)
                            (notes_and_interest_unpaid Bool)
                            (prior_written_consent_obtained Bool)
                            (consolidated_net_income Real)
                            (consolidated_net_interest_expense Real)
                            (consolidated_taxes Real)
                            (consolidated_amortization Real)
                            (consolidated_depreciation Real)) Bool
  (=> (and (or banks_obligated_to_lend notes_and_interest_unpaid)
           (not prior_written_consent_obtained))
      (>= (/ (+ consolidated_net_income
                consolidated_net_interest_expense
                consolidated_taxes
                consolidated_amortization
                consolidated_depreciation)
             consolidated_net_interest_expense)
          1.3)))

        (=> in_period_tlfed_to_2009_03_30 (<= leverage_ratio 4.5))
